summary: XYZprinting invites interested customers and qualified resellers to booth #2142 at the Fort Worth Convention Center, April 24-28, 2018, to see the MfgPro220 xPF 3D printer. The factory-in-a-box costs $19,950, has a 16-liter build volume, and is suited for functional prototyping, production tooling, and end-use parts. It includes cognitive software and integrated sensors for optimization, diagnostics, and monitoring, and uses Lubricant Sublayer Photo-curing technology with a structured light matrix reaching speeds of 1Z cm per minute. XYZprinting announced a partnership with BEGO and Nexa3D for a dental printer, and an agreement to invest in Nexa3D and manufacture its printers. XYZprinting is a global 3D printing provider backed by New Kinpo Group; Nexa3D makes ultrafast industrial-grade stereolithography printers.

Collagen production decreases with age, prompting interest in supplements for cosmetic and health benefits. Collagen is a protein providing structure to skin, tendons, and bones; it makes up about 30% of body protein and is made using amino acids glycine and proline plus vitamin C, zinc, and copper. About 28 types exist, with I, II, III, IV, and V most common. Supplements depend on form and source; hydrolysed collagen may be most effective. They are extracted mainly from animals, including marine, bovine, porcine, and chicken sources, and oral supplements mainly contain types I, II, and III. Reported benefits include skin, wrinkle, nail, bone, joint, and muscle support; hair growth evidence is limited to mice. Dosages vary by goal, with examples of 2.5 g, 5 g, 15 g, and up to 40 mg daily. Research is ongoing, and products should be third-party tested; 12 weeks may be advised for noticeable results. A balanced diet and foods such as meat, fish, eggs, dairy, beans, citrus fruits, strawberries, potatoes, peppers, broccoli, and bone broth can support natural collagen.

Sensient Technologies reported quarterly EPS of $0.80, beating the Zacks consensus estimate of $0.78. The company reported net margin of 9.13%, ROE of 16.73%, and announced a quarterly dividend of $0.30 per share. KeyCorp raised its price objective, and Zacks upgraded the stock.

This lecture introduces Discrete Stochastic Processes, contrasting real-world probability modeling with probability as mathematics and stressing the difficulty of choosing good models. It lists course topics such as counting processes, Poisson and renewal processes, Markov processes, random walks, and martingales. It reviews Kolmogorov’s axioms, sample spaces, events, probability measures, independence, combined models, random variables, and distribution functions. It also cites applications to communication, networks, queuing, risk management, and catastrophe management.

Launching in Asia, Latin America, and Africa, it is 3.2MB and works on 2G. IBM says mesh can carry multiple apps but faces critical-mass and security challenges; digital signatures verify trusted, unmodified messages.

Tesla Motors, Inc.’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2016 presents unaudited consolidated financial statements and notes. Total revenues were $1.147 billion, up from $939.9 million, while net loss was $282.3 million, or $2.13 per share, compared with $154.2 million, or $1.22 per share. Gross margin was 22.0%, down from 27.7%. The company produced 15,510 vehicles in the quarter, including about 2,650 Model X vehicles, and had delivered over 122,000 vehicles through March 31, 2016. It received more than 325,000 Model 3 reservations within one week of its introduction, expects 80,000 to 90,000 Model S and Model X deliveries in 2016, and targets 500,000 total vehicles in 2018. The report also discusses the Gigafactory, customer financing and resale value guarantee programs, convertible and long-term debt, a credit agreement, and legal proceedings.

The message returns to the House a bill donating public lands to States and Territories that provide colleges for agriculture and the mechanic arts. The bill grants 20,000 acres for each Senator and Representative, plus 20,000 for each additional Representative under the 1860 census; the Interior Department estimates 6,060,000 acres worth $7,575,000 at $1.25 per acre. States must provide at least one college within five years or the grant ceases and proceeds must be repaid; States with public lands receive land, while others receive land scrip to be sold and used only for the prescribed purposes. The author objects that the bill is both inexpedient and unconstitutional. He argues it would deprive the Treasury of most land-sale revenue, especially as scrip would compete with bounty-land warrants and lower prices. It would blur Federal and State spheres, encourage States to seek Federal funds, and remove restraints on State taxation. It would injure new States by encouraging speculators to acquire large tracts and raise prices for settlers. It is doubtful it would advance agriculture and mechanic arts because the Federal Government could not enforce the trust. It would injure existing colleges, and aid might better go to professorships in existing institutions. He also argues Congress lacks constitutional power to donate public lands to States for education; the power to dispose of territory or property does not mean to give it away, and public lands purchased with tax money share the same limitations as money. He distinguishes earlier land grants for schools and universities in new States as consistent with prudent management of public lands, but says this broad donation to all States cannot be justified on that principle.

The Drive concept is a two-receiver tag: a 10–12 yard basic/in-cut and a 3–4 yard shallow crossing route underneath at linebacker level. It creates a triangle read for the QB and stresses linebacker-level coverage. It is similar to shallow cross but the routes come from the same side, with the tight end route creating a rub. It works well against man and Cover 4, but struggles against Cover 2 and Cover 3 because they introduce 4 or 5 low defenders. Route coaching points: TE runs basic 10–12 yards; TB checks protection and releases on a flare; slot runs shallow 3–4 yards; X runs an outside-release go; Z runs a post. Against man, the TE and slot stay on the move; against zone, the TE sits in voids and the slot sits 3 yards outside the tackle box. The QB peeks the post pre-snap, then progresses from X go, to slot shallow, to TE basic, to RB check-down. Variations include using bunch formation to expose man coverage and attaching drive to backside schemes for a quick blitz throw or outlet, with post-wheel primary.

This document describes the Versioned Chip Endorsement Key (VCEK) certificate and the Key Distribution System (KDS) interface used to retrieve certificate information. The passage describes a vehicle sensing system using radar sensors with a two-dimensional array of transmitting and receiving antennas. A control applies two-dimensional MIMO processing to outputs of the receiving antennas to detect objects exterior the vehicle. In an embodiment, 12 transmitting antennas are arranged in three rows of four, and 16 receiving antennas are arranged in four columns of four, providing 192 virtual receivers and an enhanced two-dimensional virtual aperture for improved horizontal and vertical accuracy and resolution. The system may support autonomous driving, semi-autonomous driving, parking, blind spot detection, cross traffic alert, lane change and merge aid, automatic emergency braking, pedestrian detection, turn assist, and intersection collision mitigation, and may fuse radar data with camera image data.

Later, post-conviction DNA testing showed Bobby Poole raped her; Poole raped six more women while Cotton was imprisoned. Jennifer says traumatic memory can fail. Russia’s central bank cut its key interest rate to 9.25% from 9.75%, its second cut this year, and hinted at further cuts as inflation continues to fall; it forecasts inflation at 4% by end-2017 and within target in 2018–2019.

A scheduled Oct. 15 paycheck for 1.3 million active-duty service members may pressure legislators and the White House to end the government shutdown, with Goldman economists expecting a compromise by mid-October and prediction markets seeing high odds it lasts past Oct. 14. A short-term continuing resolution is considered likely, though analysts warn the shutdown could extend into November.

This work describes the fabrication and cryogenic characterization of hybrid NbN/Si-SiGe microwave circuits consisting of CPW resonators capacitively coupled to a common feedline on a 100 nm NbN film sputtered on a Si/SiGe wafer. Two λ/4 CPW resonators are discussed, while qubit-level analysis is reported separately. Fabrication included a BOE dip, NbN sputtering, e-beam lithography, CF4/Ar etching, and a deep SF6/C4F8 etch of the CPW gaps to 1 μm, stopping at the SiGe buffer layer. Measurements at 50 mK gave fundamental frequencies near 5.04 and 5.57 GHz for S1 and 5.08 and 5.60 GHz for S2. Internal quality factors increased with power, coupling quality factors remained largely constant, and internal quality factors stayed stable over repeated cooldowns spanning two years. Loss analysis indicated TLS, quasiparticle, and scattering losses, with scattering centers and quantum-well charge noise as dominant contributors. The platform is presented as CMOS-compatible, stable, and suitable for further development, though calculated relaxation time of about 14 ns indicates further improvements are needed for scalable transmon qubits.

A competitive global marketplace requires a workforce reflecting market diversity to avoid limited ideas. Subconscious biases can affect hiring; studies found men favored for math-skilled jobs, white-sounding names receiving more callbacks, and non-English last names receiving fewer. To build diversity, review job posting language to list behaviors rather than personality types, remove names from resumes, use quizzes or challenges to assess skills, and analyze gut feelings to ensure prejudice is not the cause.

Amazon celebrated the 20th anniversary of its IPO on May 15, 2017, having grown from an e-commerce startup to the fourth largest U.S. public company. Founded by Jeff Bezos, Amazon launched on July 16, 1995 as an online bookstore with a customer-focused mission. Its May 15, 1997 IPO raised $54 million at $18 per share; the stock closed at $23.50, giving it a $438 million market capitalization. Amazon expanded into product categories and acquisitions, introduced Prime in 2005 and Prime Day in 2015, launched the Kindle in 2007 and later devices, and began renting excess computer network space in 2006, which became AWS. Some efforts failed, including the Fire Phone. Amazon emphasized long-term cash flow growth over short-term profitability. At the IPO’s 20th anniversary, its market capitalization was $458 billion; cumulative 1997-2016 net income was $4.9 billion, with 60% from 2015-16. In 2016, net sales were $135,987 million, operating income $4,186 million, and net income $2,371 million; AWS had net sales of $12,219 million and operating income of $3,108 million.

Microsoft Corporation’s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2020, describes Microsoft as a technology company and covers its mission, products and services, three operating segments, COVID-19 impacts, sustainability and racial-injustice initiatives, operations, research and development, distribution and licensing, customers, executive officers, employees, and risk factors.

The passage examines Ethereum’s block production evolution from MEV-Boost to ePBS (EIP-7732), which removes trusted relays by staking builders and using PTC deadlines for payload and blob delivery. This creates a “free option”: after the proposer commits, builders can withhold payloads or blobs to prevent unfavorable blocks from becoming canonical, leaving slots empty without protocol penalty. The option is especially valuable when block value depends on late external signals, such as CEX-DEX arbitrage. Theory predicts option value and exercise probability rise with volatility, option-window length, liquidity, and CEX-DEX MEV value share, and fall with atomic MEV and penalties. Empirically, for an 8-second window, the option is profitable in 0.82% of blocks and 34.6% of missed blocks on average, but spikes on high-volatility days. Builder exercise rates vary with CEX-DEX flow dependence. Trailing MEV reduces consecutive-slot exercise. Mitigations include shortening the option window, which lowers exercise probability but reduces scalability, and penalties, which reduce exercise but raise entry barriers and affect blob inclusion. A dynamic penalty mechanism targeting 0.1% exercise achieved 0.096% average exercise probability with a low average penalty. The paper concludes the free option threatens liveness, market efficiency, LP returns, and on-chain pricing, and may affect other time-sensitive applications like prediction markets.

The 2025 Nobel Prize in physiology or medicine went to Shimon Sakaguchi, Mary Brunkow and Fred Ramsdell for discovering regulatory T cells. These cells calm the immune system and prevent autoimmune disorders, inflammation and fetal rejection. Sakaguchi identified T-regs in 1995; Brunkow and Ramsdell tracked a mutation causing fatal autoimmune disease in mice. Scientists are learning to harness T-regs for immune-related conditions.

The passage addresses treatment challenges in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, including resistance to androgen signaling inhibitors and taxanes. It describes AR wild-type and splice variants, especially ARv567 and ARv7, in relation to microtubule association, nuclear localization, and docetaxel/paclitaxel sensitivity. It details computational tracking of EB1 comets to measure microtubule dynamics, with ARv7-expressing M12 cells showing faster EB1 speeds. It discusses patient-derived prostate cancer organoids, culture optimization with Y-27632, and issues selecting tumor cells. It reports that pVHL and GSK3β regulate microtubule dynamics, with pVHL loss or GSK3β-mediated pVHL phosphorylation increasing microtubule turnover, while GSK3 inhibition restores baseline dynamics. It also covers taxane resistance, BRCA1 knockdown, ERG effects on drug-target engagement, small molecules affecting microtubule dynamics or ferroptosis, and proposed methods to anticipate drug resistance and sensitize resistant prostate tumors using microtubule dynamics and gene expression signatures.

The passage states Donchian Channels, invented by Richard Donchian, use an upper band based on the high of the last N bars and a lower band based on the low of the last N bars. They work as a trend-following indicator for commodities and currencies but not stocks; reversed, they can work as a mean-reversion indicator for stocks. In S&P 500 tests, a simple long strategy had a 4.57% CAGR from 1960 to October 2021 versus 7.15% buy-and-hold, with lower drawdown. For SPY from 1993 to October 2021, a mean-reversion test produced a best CAGR of 9.16% with a 5-day lookback. Curtis Faith’s tests on currencies, commodities, and Treasuries from 1996 to 2007 returned 29.4% and 57.2% CAGR. The passage concludes Donchian Channels work for commodities/currencies as trend following and for stocks as mean reversion, and are similar to but distinct from Bollinger Bands.

The passage examines special education and teacher preparation in Hungary by first describing Hungary’s demographics, government, and economy. Hungary is one of Europe’s oldest countries, bordered by Slovakia, Ukraine, Romania, Austria, Slovenia, Croatia, and Serbia. It has 9.7 million people, over 93% Hungarian, with minorities including Roma, Germans, Slovaks, Croats, Romanians, Serbs, Poles, Slovenians, Rusyns, Greeks, and Armenians. It is divided into 19 counties and 174 districts. After World War II and the Treaty of Trianon in 1920, it lost 71% of its land mass; population later decreased and currently has a negative natural increase rate. The government is a multiparty parliamentary democracy; the president is elected every five years and can serve two terms, while the prime minister has other powers. The economy moved from agriculture to a centrally planned economy, later recession, and Orbanomics, with unemployment at 3.8% in 2022.

General education dates to the eighteenth century; the first modern Education Act in 1868 required compulsory education for ages six to twelve, now ages six to sixteen. In 2020 about 82% of ages three to twenty-two attended formal education. Students learn a second language in fourth grade and a third in secondary school. The system includes pre-primary/kindergarten, primary, secondary, and post-secondary education. Hungary has a free choice of school policy, public schools require application and acceptance, and 15.4% of primary pupils attend private school. Secondary admissions are rigorous, with entrance examinations; upper secondary students must complete at least 50 hours of community service and a school-leaving examination. Higher education includes public and private institutions.

Teacher preparation varies: preschool teachers need three years theoretical and one year practical training; kindergarten and primary teachers need bachelor’s degrees; primary education degrees are four-year college programs with 15-20% practical training; secondary teacher training typically lasts about six years. In 2013 Hungary reintroduced undivided teacher education: primary teachers receive five years, secondary teachers six years, both with the last year as teaching practice. Student teaching and practicum occur in the final year with a mentor. The 2013 teacher career model created a two-year traineeship, evaluation exam, portfolio, and categories from novice teacher to researcher teacher. Teachers can receive salary increases after required in-service training every six years.

Special education began with a separate school for deaf students in 1802 and a special education college for teachers in 1906. A committee of educators, special education professionals, and physicians diagnoses disabilities and recommends placement, but parents make the final decision. The 2011 Act on Public Education defines special educational needs and provides rights to free compulsory primary education, generally accessible secondary education, and vocational training. Supports include counseling, early development and care, development support and training, speech therapy, pedagogical care, conductive care, gifted education, and special physical education. In 2019 there were more than 88,000 special education needs students, 60% educated in inclusive environments. Hungary aims for more inclusion, but general education teachers receive little instruction on disabilities. An inclusive primary school, Gyermekek Háza Alternatív Általános Iskola és Gimnázium, mainstreams children with disabilities and has trained general education teachers. Special education teachers complete a four-year university program and choose one or two of eight specialties.

Laws include the Education Act of 1868, Act III of 1993, which provided family allowances and care funding, and Act CXC of 2011. Current issues include diagnosis difficulties, especially autism; inaccessible old school buildings; incomplete inclusion; frontal teaching methods; insufficient special education training for general teachers; low teacher pay, described as worst in the OECD; and teacher attrition, with greater retention in private and church-run schools. The passage recommends improving diagnosis and referral systems, creating incentives for autism diagnosis, increasing accessibility, training staff, improving teacher training and pay, and addressing retention. It concludes that Hungary has improved special education over 200 years and has laws and regulations providing rights for individuals with disabilities, but still has room for improvement.

President Donald Trump suggested some federal workers furloughed during the government shutdown will not receive back pay, saying it “depends on who we’re talking about” and that “for the most part” the government will take care of its people. Shares of West Fraser, Interfor, and Canfor fell; all were downgraded to market perform. BMO said a resolution was unlikely soon ahead of NAFTA talks, with little substantive negotiation. Analysts said tariffs and stronger dollar pressure earnings, but longer-term prospects look more positive.

Ronald Reagan spoke at the University of Virginia, praising Thomas Jefferson’s influence on higher education, free inquiry, and democratic government. He drew parallels between Jefferson’s era and contemporary populism and described global movements toward democracy and free markets. Reagan said Soviet-American relations had improved through dialog, summits, arms-control efforts such as the INF and START negotiations, regional settlements, and human-rights progress, but warned that serious differences and Soviet authoritarianism remained. He advocated trust but verify, military strength, candor, and executive-congress cooperation in foreign policy. In questions, Reagan said most-favored-nation status for the Soviet Union should depend on deeds matching words; called PLO acceptance of Israel’s right to exist and resolutions 242 and 338 a step toward Middle East peace; defended his anti-terrorism policy and the response to Libya; urged young people to vote; cited restoring the military and economic recovery, tax reform, and deregulation as accomplishments; and said he would remain active after leaving office, possibly speaking or writing, while Nancy Reagan would continue antidrug work.

Japan's economy grew faster than expected in April-to-June, with GDP up 4% annualized and 1% quarterly. Consumer spending and capital expenditure rose, and strong domestic demand offset an export drop. The expansion is Japan's longest in a decade, aided by Olympic-related investment and government efforts to boost spending.

Select Security acquired Intelligent Technology Inc. and Carolina Security Group, adding nearly 1,000 customers and team members and a downtown Charlotte branch consolidating western North Carolina operations. Scientists at Newcastle University have 3D printed the first human corneas. The research also showed corneas could be printed to match a patient’s eye dimensions. Further testing is needed, and transplants are several years away.

This study evaluated a reproducible, data-driven method for prioritising AI-detected chest X-ray abnormalities to support faster lung cancer diagnosis. It was conducted across seven acute care trusts in Greater Manchester using two cohorts: a retrospective cohort of 1,282 patients with confirmed lung cancer and abnormal CXR, and a prospective cohort of 13,802 GP-referred primary care CXRs. The AI system ran in shadow mode and detected up to 124 findings. Findings were classified as CRITICAL, HIGH, or STANDARD, and three prioritisation strategies were assessed. Strategy 1 selected 19 HIGH findings with a prevalence ratio >5, yielding sensitivity 92.82% and specificity 87.21%. Strategy 2 included all HIGH findings with a ratio >2, yielding sensitivity 97.27% and specificity 62.68%. Strategy 3 used clinical judgement, yielding sensitivity 95.87%, specificity 79.11%, and NPV 99.95%, detecting 1,229 of 1,282 lung cancer patients. The study concludes that prioritising AI-detected CXR findings can maximise sensitivity and NPV while accepting lower PPV, and that shadow-mode deployment supports clinical safety. Limitations included same-region data, assumed prevalence, and the need for external validation.

The lecture discusses pseudorandom graphs, focusing on \(n,d,\lambda\) graphs and the expander mixing lemma. The Appellate Division reversed Solomon Montlake’s grand larceny conviction and granted a new trial. At a prior trial, the jury was dismissed after the prosecutor repeatedly accused defense counsel of being a criminal. The court held that dismissal during trial, before submission to the jury, was a proper exercise of discretion and did not bar retrial; the former-jeopardy plea was therefore overruled. It also found that cross-examining an alibi witness about unpaid rent was an unwise exercise of discretion but not reversible. Reversible error, however, occurred in the alibi charge: the jury was told it could not acquit on alibi unless the proof established that the defendants “could not have been” at the crime scene, requiring exclusion of even a bare possibility. The court held this was not cured by general reasonable-doubt instructions, that the burden as to alibi was not on the defendant, and that reasonable doubt as to presence entitled the defendant to acquittal.

The passage covers SD Memory Card command definitions and operations. Using CDC WONDER data from 1999 to 2020, this study estimated excess mortality and excess years of potential life lost (YPLL) among non-Hispanic Black people compared with non-Hispanic White people aged <85 years. From 1999 to 2020, there were an estimated 658,356 excess deaths among Black females and 1,154,108 among Black males, plus 34,938,070 excess YPLL among Black females and 47,005,048 among Black males. Excess mortality and YPLL declined until about 2011–2012, plateaued through 2019, and increased in 2020 to rates similar to earlier years. Heart disease had the highest excess mortality rates; cancer, diabetes, HIV, assault, cerebrovascular disease, perinatal deaths, and COVID-19 also contributed. The greatest YPLL disparity was among the youngest. The study states that disparities persist, gains were fragile and erased in 2020, and excess deaths and YPLL could serve as accountability metrics. Limitations include possible inaccuracies in death certificate race and cause-of-death reporting. The conclusion states that over the 22-year period Black people in America lost more than 80 million years of life and new strategies are needed.

A simple moving average (SMA) is a continuously calculated average of an asset’s price over a specified period, used to identify trend direction and potential support or resistance. Shorter-period SMAs are more sensitive and generate more signals and trades; longer-period SMAs are smoother and less sensitive. The SMA lags because it equal-weights past prices, while the EMA gives more weight to recent prices and reacts faster. The SMA can be used on non-price data; it may confirm trends in strongly trending markets but produce false signals in range-bound markets and be misleading with seasonal or cyclical patterns. Backtests indicate short-term mean reversion and long-term trend-following uses: short-term buying when the close crosses below a short-term SMA was profitable, with a 5-day CAGR of 8.34%; long-term buying when the close crosses above a long-term SMA became more profitable as the average lengthened, with the 200-day average returning 7.89% and a lower max drawdown than buy and hold. Tables 3 and 4 confirmed longer holding periods gave better returns; buying when the close crossed above the 200-day SMA and holding 200 days averaged 10.93% per trade. Main takeaways are to buy below a short-term SMA and sell when it crosses above, and for long-term SMAs to buy when price crosses above and sell when it crosses below. There is no best or worst SMA; backtesting is needed.

The DAWN-plasma study was a randomized, open-label, phase 2 proof-of-concept multicenter trial comparing standard of care plus convalescent plasma with standard of care alone in hospitalized adult COVID-19 patients. Participants were randomized 2:1; 489 were randomized, and 483 (320 plasma, 163 control) were included in the full analysis set. Plasma recipients received 4 units totaling about 800–1000 mL, with 2 units within 12 hours after randomization and 2 units 24–36 hours after the first administration; median volume was 884 mL, and 80.7% of units had neutralizing-antibody titers ≥1/320. The primary endpoint, proportion alive and free of mechanical ventilation on Day 15, did not differ significantly between groups (plasma 83.7% vs control 84.1%). No statistically significant differences were found in secondary endpoints, mortality, or other outcomes. Adverse events, serious/severe adverse events, and fatal adverse events were similar between groups; transfusion-related side effects occurred in 19/320 plasma patients (5.9%). The intervention did not change the natural course of antibody titers. The study concluded that early transfusion of 4 units of high-titer convalescent plasma did not significantly improve clinical status in hospitalized COVID-19 patients.

This prospective, hospital-based follow-up study assessed adult patients (≥18 years) who underwent surgery for symptoms/signs suggestive of acute intestinal obstruction at Amana, Mwananyamala and Temeke regional referral hospitals in Dar es Salaam from December 2021 to July 2022. It included 51 patients from Amana, 95 from Mwananyamala and 82 from Temeke; male:female was 3:1, median age was 34 (IQR 27–45) years, and median hospital stay was 4 (IQR 3–6) days. Adhesions were the commonest surgical diagnosis (n=98; OR 5.7, 95% CI 4.3–7.1), followed by hernia (n=48), volvulus (n=37) and abdominal tumors (n=20). Outcomes included discharge home (173, 76%), surgical site infection (20, 9%), wound dehiscence (2), anastomotic leak (1), referral (8), death (12, 5.3%) and unknown outcome (12, 5.3%). Tests for confounders and interactions were non-significant at 5%. The discussion notes possible referral bias for adhesions, male preponderance, mortality needing scrutiny, unknown outcomes needing further study, and study strengths/limitations.

Averaging down is a trading or investing method in which a stock owner buys more shares after the price falls, lowering the average purchase price and the rise needed to break even. The passage says it can be part of a planned scale-in entry or backtested strategy, but it can also mean adding to a losing position, especially when selling volume is high or the decline is not temporary. It depends on whether the trader is long-term or short-term, the company, strategy, and risk tolerance. A backtest on SPY using RSI and two 50% buys produced similar capital with smoother returns, reduced drawdowns, and improved metrics. The passage states stocks are best for averaging down because they are prone to mean reversion; other markets are less mean revertive.

This study compared a chest radiograph-based biological age model (CXR-Age) with first- and second-generation epigenetic clocks (Horvath Age and DNAm PhenoAge) in 2,097 Project Baseline Health Study participants. Chronological age correlated more strongly with epigenetic clocks than with CXR-Age. CXR-Age and DNAm PhenoAge acceleration were associated with subclinical coronary atherosclerosis, abnormal pulmonary function, and frailty/disability; CXR-Age associations were robust in adults as young as 45, unlike DNAm PhenoAge. Plasma proteomic analyses found associations of CXR-Age acceleration with CDH13 and ApoD and of DNAm PhenoAge with thirteen proteins including CDH13. The authors conclude that CXR-Age was associated with worse cardiopulmonary function and frailty and may capture broad aging processes, while noting limitations including lack of longitudinal data and limited interpretability.

The passage describes a medRxiv preprint study on automating phenotype extraction and normalization from dysmorphology physical examinations. It proposes PhenoID, a two-module transformer pipeline: an extractor identifies spans of dysmorphic findings while ignoring normal findings, and a normalizer maps each span to a Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO) term. The authors built an EHR dysmorphology documentation system, annotated 3,826 organ-system observations from 1,655 individuals with HPO terms, and evaluated disjoint and overlapping terms using Noisy-BIO and Recast-BIO schemas. PhenoID achieved 0.717 F1 on normalization and 0.715 F1 on extraction plus normalization, outperforming six competing systems. With gold-truth spans, the normalizer reached 0.82 F1, approaching inter-annotator agreement of 0.844 F1. Error analysis identified ontology imperfections, descriptive spans, misplaced attention, hyperonym prediction, misspellings, acronyms, hyponym prediction, inference-requiring mentions, unknown reasons, and annotation errors. The authors conclude PhenoID achieves state-of-the-art performance but that extraction and semantic understanding remain limitations.

New research in PNAS shows that limiting a resource can harness competition among pathogens to prevent drug resistance. In mice infected with malaria, treatment failed in 40 percent when a nutrient was given, due to resistant strains, but infection did not rebound when the nutrient was limited. Limiting the nutrient stopped resistant parasites from growing when both sensitive and resistant parasites were present, though resistant parasites survived when alone. The authors say this ecological manipulation could extend existing drugs and prevent resistance to new drugs. They propose identifying resources needed more by resistant strains, confirming limitation eliminates them, and determining intervention strategy and timing, possibly during drug development.

The application is a continuation of U.S. patent application Ser. No. 16/464,063, a national stage of PCT/US2017/062721, which claims priority to U.S. Provisional 62/427,573. It states government support under contract N00014-16-C-1026. The passage describes LIDAR, point clouds, and classification of objects in 3D point clouds. A method obtains a 3D point cloud, extracts a surface normal and feature-variable values in a translational and rotational invariant coordinate system, computes first and second classification statistics, compares them to statistics for N classes, and if the estimated first and second classes differ, computes a third classification statistic from a closest fit between the point cloud and model point clouds for only the first and second classes. The object is assigned to the first or second class, and a device is operated based on the assigned class. In embodiments, the first statistic is a spin image, the second is a covariance matrix, and the third is iterative closest point. An apparatus includes a laser source, splitter, optical coupler, optical detector, and processor. Experimental results and computational hardware are also described.

This work develops a new classical EAM potential for the ternary W-H-He system for radiation damage simulations, extending the Mason W-H potential to include helium. The new potential is compared with the Li and Yang potentials, which were not fitted to relaxation volumes and tend to overestimate them.

This study used Mendelian randomization to examine causal relationships among gut microbiota, plasma metabolites, and fibromyalgia (FM). It identified four gut microbial taxa with protective effects (family Enterobacteriaceae, genus Butyricicoccus, genus Coprococcus1, order Enterobacteriales) and two taxa as potential risk factors (genus Eggerthella, genus Ruminococcaceae UCG005). It also identified 82 plasma metabolites associated with FM, involving caffeine metabolism, α-linolenic acid metabolism, and GLP-1/incretin pathways. 2,3-Dihydroxypyridine and palmitoylcholine mediated the effects of Enterobacteriaceae and Enterobacteriales on FM. The study suggests dietary interventions may help manage FM, but limitations include European ancestry, lack of demographic subgroup analyses, and need for further validation.

C-BerryTrans is a C++ program under GNU General Public License 3.0 that evaluates Berry curvature (Ω), anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC), and anomalous Nernst conductivity (ANC) within an ab initio framework. It computes Ω using the Kubo formula from eigenvalues and momentum-matrix elements extracted from WIEN2k, integrates Ω over the Brillouin zone, weights AHC by the Fermi–Dirac distribution, and extends the formalism for ANC using an entropy function. The code is parallelized over k-points with OpenMP, stores band-resolved Ω in a binary file, and computes AHC/ANC as a post-process for ranges of chemical potential and temperature. It requires SOC for AHC/ANC and is presented as a direct, interpolation-free alternative to Wannier-based methods. Its workflow includes SOC-included self-consistent WIEN2k calculations, k-list generation, Ω calculation, and post-processing; it was tested on Fe, Pd, Fe3Al, and Co2FeAl and includes a visualization module, berryTrans plot.py.

The passage introduces a hybrid method-of-moments (MoM) and generalized scattering matrix (GSM) framework for multiscale electromagnetic problems involving antennas and large surrounding structures. In contrast to a prior MoM and T-matrix approach, the large environment—such as a radome, reflector, or implantation medium—is discretized and solved by MoM, while the antenna is represented by its GSM. This reduces unknowns by encapsulating antenna details in a compact GSM and allows reuse of precomputed antenna data and GSM advances. The framework can be extended to GSM-PO and GSM + T-matrix hybrids. Section II presents field decomposition, PMCHWT equations, RWG basis expansion, and the GSM-based coupling formulation.

The Single/Double Offense uses double and down screens to free a shooter, requiring defenders to disrupt both. Since “Bigs” screen for “Smalls,” NBA teams prefer “Show and Recover” over switching, because switching can create post mismatches. Phase 1 involves dictating the shooter’s direction and pressuring the ballhandler toward the sideline. Phase 2 defends the double screen by showing, chasing, and recovering, then denying passes, pressuring the wing, defending the post, and packing weakside players toward the ball. Phase 3 defends the single screen option similarly, with matchup adjustments and possible traps on post mismatches. The All Out SOS Disruption uses defense-initiated action and traps the shooter on the wing. It includes forcing the ballhandler to a sideline pushpoint, possible inversion by double-screen defenders, sequential and “Contact” switches, Snuggle denials, wing traps, post fronts, rotations to Triangle “I” positions, and closeouts as the ball leaves the passer’s hands. Phase 1 disrupts the double screen; Phase 2 disrupts the single screen, including wing traps and base-go scenarios.

The lecture restates the Weierstrass M-test: if functions \(f_j\) are dominated by summable nonnegative numbers \(M_j\), then their partial sums converge uniformly. It gives an example showing \(\sum \cos(160^j x)/4^j\) converges uniformly on \(\mathbb R\) and defines a continuous function. It defines uniform convergence of a series as uniform convergence of its partial sums.

For a power series with radius of convergence \(\rho\), the lecture states that for any \(R\in(0,\rho)\), the series converges uniformly on \([x_0-R,x_0+R]\), proved using the Weierstrass M-test. It follows that power series can be differentiated and integrated term by term inside the radius of convergence. The differentiated power series has the same radius of convergence, and iterating shows the \(k\)-th derivative can be computed term by term; evaluating at \(x_0\) gives \(k!a_k\), so every power series is the Taylor series of its function.

The lecture then presents Weierstrass’s approximation theorem: every continuous function on \([0,1]\) is the uniform limit of polynomials. The proof reduces to the case \(f(0)=f(1)=0\), extends \(f\) by zero, defines \(c_n\) and \(q_n(x)=c_n(1-x^2)^n\), notes \(q_n\ge0\), \(\int_{-1}^1 q_n=1\), and \(q_n\to0\) uniformly away from \(0\). It defines \(p_n(x)=\int_0^1 f(t)q_n(t-x)\,dt\), shows \(p_n\) is a polynomial, and proves \(p_n\to f\) uniformly. The lecture also mentions Lebesgue integration and Fourier series as further topics.

This study developed a cost-effective, culture-independent citizen science approach to sample household drinking water microbiomes in China. From December 2020 to August 2021, 50 tap water samples were collected from 19 provinces/regions, including opportunistic samples after the 2021 Henan Floods and Typhoon In-Fa Landfall. Using a low-biomass protocol, 22 of 50 samples tested positive for microbial DNA. 16S rRNA gene metabarcoding of pooled samples yielded 7,635 Amplicon Sequence Variants and revealed a diverse microbiome. Pathogenic bacteria including Mycobacterium spp., Acinetobacter spp., and Legionella spp. were detected in all PCR-positive samples. Additional pathogenic species and/or toxin-producing cyanobacteria were detected in local samples from Zhengzhou and Changzhou following the extreme weather events. The study underscores the utility of citizen science in enhancing microbial monitoring and informing future public health strategies for water safety.

As people age, natural collagen production decreases. Collagen is a protein giving structural support, strength and elasticity to skin, tendons and bones; it accounts for about 30% of body protein and is made with amino acids glycine and proline plus vitamin C, zinc and copper. About 28 collagen types exist, with I, II, III, IV and V most common. Supplements are mainly animal-derived—marine, bovine, porcine, chicken—though some come from plants or GMOs. Hydrolysed collagen may be most effective. Oral supplements mainly contain types I, II and III. Reported benefits include skin growth, reduced wrinkles, firmer skin, stronger nails, bone and joint support, tendon/ligament/fascia support, possible muscle repair, and limited mouse research on hair. Dosage depends on goal; labels give recommendations. Experts advise third-party-tested products and at least 12 weeks for noticeable results. Balanced diets rich in collagen-producing nutrients/foods are most reliable. Research is ongoing.

A controlled human malaria infection study in The Gambia used 19 semi-immune adult males classified as sero-high or sero-low by antibody levels against six P. falciparum antigens. All were infected with NF54/3D7 sporozoites and treated once parasitaemia was detectable or symptoms began. Sero-low individuals had significantly higher peak parasitaemia than sero-high individuals. Controllers, defined by longest latency and smallest parasite multiplication rate, were both sero-high.

Whole transcriptome analysis of parasites from ten volunteers on treatment day found var genes among the most differentially expressed between sero-high and sero-low individuals; var genes were robustly detected, while stevor and rifin genes were poorly detected except PF3D7_0401600. RT-qPCR and RNA sequencing showed high concordance. Var expression was higher and more diverse, with higher Shannon entropy, in sero-low individuals, whereas sero-high individuals had a more restricted repertoire. Clustering separated controllers from non-controllers across Gambian and Gabon data.

In vivo var turnover probabilities increased with time; groups A, C, and E had the highest transition rates, with median rates above 1 per day, corresponding to over 86% per cycle. In vitro, sero-low isolates converged to near-identical var expression patterns within 20 days, while sero-high isolates did not show uniform patterns even after 50 days. Modeling indicated sero-low samples reached a high-entropy steady state quickly, while sero-high samples were slower; in vitro C/BC switching rates were close to in vivo rates, whereas A/B rates were lower.

Protein microarray analysis showed sero-high individuals recognized more 3D7 PfEMP1 domains before and after infection, while sero-low individuals’ breadth more than doubled after infection. Pre-existing PfEMP1 antibodies were moderately negatively associated with var expression during infection, strongest for groups B/C, A, and B, but not significant for B/A and var2csa. Antibody acquisition was not necessarily dependent on PfEMP1 expression intensity. Overall, var genes were the main source of transcriptome heterogeneity, and host immunity shaped var expression patterns.

The passage argues that distributed-system patterns are valuable because they allow developers to learn from others’ mistakes, provide a shared vocabulary, and enable reusable components. It describes single-node container patterns that are coscheduled and share resources: the sidecar pattern augments or extends an application container; the ambassador pattern brokers interactions between the application container and the outside world; and the adapter pattern modifies an application’s interface to conform to expected conventions. Examples include adding HTTPS to a legacy service, configuration synchronization, topz, a simple PaaS, sharded Redis, service brokering, experimentation/request splitting, Prometheus monitoring, fluentd log normalization, and MySQL health monitoring. The passage also discusses designing modular containers through parameterization, API surface, and documentation. For multi-node systems, it introduces microservices and patterns including replicated load-balanced stateless services, readiness probes, session-tracked services, application-layer replicated services, caching layers, rate limiting, SSL termination, sharded services and caches, replicated sharded caches, and sharding functions.

In Riverton Investment Corp. v. United States, a tax refund case, Riverton alleged that 1990s payments to buy back stock from management stockholders were deductible compensation, not non-deductible stock redemptions. The court found Paragraph 9 of the Management Stockholder’s Agreement ambiguous; parol evidence showed the timing restriction lapsed upon certain transactions, but restrictions on transfer, buyer, and price remained permanent. Thus, the management stockholders’ ownership interest in stock acquired in the 1980s was sufficiently restricted that no “transfer” occurred, so the 1990s payments were not redemptions. The court sustained Riverton’s objections, rejected the Magistrate Judge’s recommendation, denied the United States’s summary judgment and motion to strike, granted Riverton’s summary judgment, and entered judgment for Riverton. The parties were to file a joint stipulation on damages and/or interest within thirty days.

A review of over 140 scientific articles by Sarah Sajedi examines health risks from nano- and microplastics in single-use plastic water bottles. People ingest an average of 39,000–52,000 microplastic particles yearly, with bottled water drinkers consuming up to 90,000 more than tap water drinkers. The particles shed from bottles during making, storage, transport, and breakdown and are ingested directly. They can enter the bloodstream and vital organs and are linked to chronic inflammation, oxidative stress, hormonal disruption, impaired reproduction, neurological damage, and cancers. Long-term effects remain poorly understood due to limited testing and unstandardized detection. Legislation rarely addresses single-use water bottles; Sajedi says education is key, and bottles are for emergencies, not daily use, because the issue is chronic toxicity.

The lecture covers chapter 7 algebra, aiming to introduce finite fields and their construction and operations. It reviews integers, mod-n arithmetic (Zn), groups, cyclic groups isomorphic to Zn, subgroups, cosets, coset addition, quotient groups, and Lagrange’s theorem that a finite subgroup’s size divides the group’s size. It defines fields as sets with addition and multiplication satisfying abelian-group and distributive axioms, with examples including the real, complex, binary, and prime fields Fp. For prime p, Fp uses elements 0 through p−1 with mod-p operations; every finite field with p elements is isomorphic to Fp, and every finite field has a prime subfield/characteristic p. In characteristic 2, addition equals subtraction. The lecture then begins polynomials over a field, covering coefficients, degree, the zero polynomial, indeterminates, addition, multiplication, degree of products, and units/invertible polynomials. It also notes upcoming lectures on Reed-Solomon codes.

Former Southport MP John Pugh fears Homebase’s closure could lead to more job losses. He criticizes approval for a 60,000 sq ft Sainsbury’s at Meols Cop, despite 400 proposed jobs, warning it may draw larger stores from the town centre and cause hollowing out, and says Sefton Council encouraged it.

GoDaddy gave The Daily Stormer 24 hours to move its domain after the neo-Nazi website violated its terms by denigrating Heather Heyer, who was killed at a white nationalist rally in Virginia.

New research found dieters who set ambitious targets lost twice as many pounds as those who set realistic goals. In a 12-month study of more than 24,000 obese Slimming World members with a BMI of at least 30 attending weekly support, those aiming to lose less than 10% lost an average 11%, while those with the most ambitious targets lost an average 19%. Obesity experts call for changes to public health guidance suggesting a realistic 5-10% target, encouraging slimmers to aim for their dream weight. Hollie Barrett lost 8st 6lbs after setting a high Personal Achievement Target.

WIRED’s guide covers tested bags to bring on a plane, including carry-on suitcases and travel backpacks. Updated October 2025, it reviews models such as Travelpro, Peak Design Roller Pro, Rimowa, Antler, State Logan, Briggs & Riley, Yeti Crossroads 35L, Beis, Take Off, Tom Bihn Aeronaut 45, Six Moon Designs, and Aer Travel Pack 3, noting features, materials, warranties, carry-on size compliance, and drawbacks like weight, noise, durability, or price. A Colorado panel voted to limit what health plans pay for Amgen’s Enbrel, an arthritis treatment, in a first-in-the-nation move. The Colorado Prescription Drug Affordability Board set a $600-per-unit ceiling for government agencies and commercial plans covering state residents. This is about $30,350 annually per person, versus roughly $53,000 average paid by state insurance plans in 2023, according to state claims data.

The passage explains that long snappers are expected to perform near-perfectly, snapping to holders on extra points and field goals and to punters on punts, where accuracy and consistency are crucial. Their work is essential to special teams but does not appear on stat sheets. In the NFL, teams reserve a roster spot for the position. Long snappers need accuracy, consistency, balance, athleticism, and physicality, with a thick, linebacker-like build, and they also cover punts. Shuckers officials say MGM Park opening-series attendance rose 21% over last year, including a record Jackie Robinson Day crowd; ESPN featured Johnny Davis's catch. The team next plays in Chattanooga, returns April 22 with a jersey auction and weekly promotions.

Shelley Corman forwarded a PAKK Yahoo group digest (Number 529) to Ricki Winters, asking her to add it to contacts. The digest contains 24 adoption-related messages, including discussions of HIV testing for Russia/Kazakhstan, Travel-On’s discounted Delta airfares for adopting parents traveling to Russia and Kazakhstan, accommodations in Kazakhstan, adoption from Taraz, changing children’s birth dates, tantrums/conscience, and new-member introductions. The passage reports on language comprehension development and introduces the 15-item Language Phenotype Assessment (LPA), designed to assess Command, Modifier, and Syntactic phenotypes in children aged 2 to 5 using toy-animal manipulatives and brief instructions. It states that existing tests were unsuitable for ages 2–4 because of vocabulary focus, overly complex instructions, age norms, or picture-based responses. The LPA and a parent-reported Language Phenotype Evaluation Checklist (LPEC) were administered to 116 neurotypical children; the LPA was also administered to 79 children with ASD. In neurotypical children, LPA scores increased from ages 1.5 to 5 and then plateaued. Clinician-observed median acquisition ages were 1.6 years for Command, 3.0 for Modifier, and 3.7 for Syntactic phenotypes; parent-reported ages were 1.6, 2.7, and 3.0 years. LPA was reported to have high internal consistency, test-retest reliability, and inter-observer agreement; LPEC also showed high reliability, and LPA/LPEC scores correlated strongly (r = 0.78). Among children with ASD aged 5 and older, fewer reached the Syntactic Phenotype than neurotypical peers. The passage states the LPA may support early identification and monitoring of language deficits and language therapy, while noting limitations such as the logistical challenge of manipulatives.

The Trump administration announced it will continue much of the Obama administration’s nuclear weapons policy but take a more aggressive stance toward Russia, saying Russia must be convinced a limited nuclear attack in Europe would bring “unacceptably dire costs.” The review calls for no net increase in strategic nuclear weapons, calls North Korea a “clear and grave threat” and says any North Korean nuclear attack would end that regime, and casts China as a potential nuclear adversary. It largely follows Obama’s modernization blueprint and existing arms control agreements, including New START, but ends Obama’s push to reduce the role of nuclear weapons. It proposes modifying some Trident missiles with smaller-yield warheads and later developing a nuclear-armed sea-launched cruise missile to counter Russia. Arms control groups criticized the review.

Ministers negotiating with the DUP admitted abolishing line dancing might be necessary for progress. The DUP objects because founder Ian Paisley called it sinful, catering to fleshly lusts, and naff. David Davis cited compromise and said other concessions were rejected. Leave voter Nigel Walker supported the decision as an acceptable price of Brexit.

A new EducationNext poll found public support for charter schools fell from 51 percent to 39 percent in one year, while support for universal vouchers and tax-credit scholarships rose slightly but stayed in line with recent trends. The charter decline occurred among Democrats, Republicans, and all racial and ethnic groups. School choice is central to Trump and DeVos’s education agenda. The poll also showed partisan shifts on vouchers and a “Trump effect”: Republicans were more likely to support issues Trump supports, Democrats less, but Trump’s net influence was nearly nil. Approval of local public schools was similar among Republicans and Democrats.

The present technology relates generally to robotic systems and, more specifically, to robotic multi-gripper assemblies configured to selectively grip and hold objects. Systems can include a transport robot with multi-gripper assemblies configured to operate independently or in conjunction to grip/release a single object or multiple objects, simultaneously or sequentially. The multi-gripper assemblies can include addressable vacuum regions or banks configured to draw in air so that only selected objects are held via a vacuum grip. A manifold assembly can be fluidically coupled to each addressable region and to at least one vacuum line so that each region independently provides negative pressure via an array of suction elements sufficient to hold target objects while the robotic apparatus moves the gripper between locations. Methods include receiving image data representative of a group of objects, identifying target objects based on the image data, selecting addressable vacuum regions based on the identified target objects, and commanding the transport robot to cause the selected vacuum regions to hold and transport the target objects. A vision sensor device can capture image data representative of target objects adjacent to or held by the vacuum gripper device. The passage also describes robotic environments and components, controllers, sensors, force detector assemblies, vacuum grippers, suction elements, sealing members, vacuum levels and airflow, registration records, transport plans, and operational flows for gripping, transporting, verifying grip, regripping, and dropping objects.

The Fraser Institute will release a study on Feb. 16 examining the revenue neutrality of British Columbia’s carbon tax, including whether carbon tax revenues are offset by other tax reductions and how much higher taxes the B.C. government collects. Revenue neutrality was promised when the tax was introduced in 2008.

The lecture discusses sequences of functions and defines pointwise convergence and uniform convergence. Uniform convergence implies pointwise convergence, but pointwise convergence does not imply uniform convergence. Examples include \(f_n(x)=x^n\) on \([0,1]\), which converges pointwise to a discontinuous limit and uniformly on \([0,b]\) for \(b<1\), but not on \([0,1]\); and tent functions that converge pointwise to 0 but not uniformly. The lecture then considers interchanging limits for continuity, differentiation, and integration. Under uniform convergence, the uniform limit of continuous functions is continuous, the integral of the uniform limit equals the limit of the integrals, and under uniform convergence of derivatives, the uniform limit of continuously differentiable functions is differentiable with derivative equal to the limit of the derivatives. Under pointwise convergence, all three can fail. Finally, it states the Weierstrass M-test: if \(|f_j(x)|\le M_j\) for all \(x\) and \(\sum M_j\) converges, then \(\sum f_j(x)\) converges absolutely and its partial sums converge uniformly.

The De'Longhi Rivelia automatic latte maker is discounted to $1,300 and can make milk-based coffee drinks via touchscreen. It has a swappable bean hopper, bean adapt settings, and a milk frother. It is easier than a portafilter machine but doesn’t match its potential coffee quality.

Imran Mohammad is a Rohingya from Myanmar and a UNHCR-declared refugee. He spent his fourth birthday in Manus prison, having arrived in Papua New Guinea on October 29, 2013, at age 19, and is now 23. He was moved to Delta compound, a narrow shipping container shared with three Somali men; about 300 men lived there with lines for food, toilets, showers, and one washing machine, and scarce razors and washing powder. He later moved to Mike compound, with over 400 men, a TV room for 50, and no air-conditioning in metal shipping container rooms. He considered suicide but held onto hope, avoided lines, spent time with teachers, and focused on learning and writing, adopting “the pen is mightier than the sword.” Food was thrown away but not allowed to be taken; phone calls were restricted, and now phones cannot be talked on due to slow Internet. He describes indefinite detention, wasted birthdays, and wanting freedom and family.

The Triangle (1-3-1) offense can attack a Diamond & One defense by placing the Star in the middle and isolating the Star one-on-one. The Star’s defender is usually skilled at pass denial but unprepared for post defense. High post entry initiates inside triangle action, with O4 in the short corner, the weakside wing in low post, and two outside players rotating into a two-guard front. Options include high post isolation and triangle action, kick-out passes and post flash, and high post lobs against overplay. Implementation requires execution, coordination, high post isolations, back cuts, interior passing, spot-up shots, defensive recognition, communication, timing, and experience. Diamond & One, a Box & One derivative, uses four zone defenders and a fifth denying the scoring ace.

A funnel-web, described as the world’s most venomous spider, was spotted in a house in Springwood, NSW, near Sydney. Funnel-webs are common around households on Australia’s east coast from Queensland to New South Wales but are rarely seen; a new species was found in northern Tasmania, and there were previously 35 known species. Their venom can shut down the nervous system, with reports of human death after 15 minutes. Symptoms include nausea, muscle cramps, sweating, and numbness around the mouth. The Australian Museum recorded 13 deaths, but no fatality has occurred since an antivenene was invented in 1981. Experts say the spiders are defensive rather than aggressive and advise leaving them alone, taking caution, and going to hospital immediately if bitten.

He will rely on the Constitution he swears to preserve, protect, and defend, which defines executive powers and purposes including union, justice, domestic tranquillity, common defense, general welfare, and liberty. Historically, total solar eclipses often caused fear, as seen in ancient Greek, Viking, and Chinese beliefs. David Baron’s book describes an 1878 eclipse that terrified many Americans; one father killed his son and himself. The passage reports an optimization-phase study using the MOST framework to develop a mobile health platform for childhood sleep promotion. The study enrolled 97 children aged 9–12 with insufficient sleep and randomized them in a 2^5 factorial design to test five components over a 7-week intervention with a 2-week follow-up: sleep goal (guideline-based or personalized), child-directed loss-framed financial incentive, caregiver-directed loss-framed financial incentive, screen time reduction messaging, and daily routine messaging. All received sleep tracking and weekly performance feedback. Baseline weeknight sleep averaged 7.7 hours; sleep increased by 24 minutes during intervention and 21 minutes at follow-up. No single component setting achieved the ≥30-minute optimization criterion. Interaction analysis identified two combinations that did. The highest ranked included caregiver-directed loss-framed incentive, screen time reduction messaging, and daily routine messaging, with either sleep goal setting equally effective; it increased sleep by 39.6 minutes during intervention and 33.2 minutes at follow-up. The second ranked included caregiver-directed incentive and daily routine messaging, with either sleep goal setting equally effective; it increased sleep by 32.0 and 26.6 minutes. Child-directed incentive was not favorable. The authors report next steps for an evaluation phase and note limitations including single site, predominantly non-Hispanic White sample, short follow-up, and single-sensor tracker.

The passage addresses deontic argumentation, which concerns whether actions or states-of-affairs are obligatory, permitted, or otherwise normatively qualified. It focuses on weak permission, where permission is derived when the opposite obligation is not derivable. It argues that grounded and stable semantics inadequately handle weak permissions, especially when multiple deontic rules conflict. To address this, it defines a Deontic Argumentation Theory using facts, rules, natural arguments, imaginary arguments, attack, support, and undercut relations. It then proposes a wp-semantics with wp-acceptable and wp-rejected arguments, defined through a fixed-point construction. The passage proves that the wp-extension is unique, conflict-free, and that no argument is both wp-justified and wp-rejected. It also shows that in wp-conflictual theories, weak permissions for conflicted literals are wp-justified, making weakly facultative conclusions justified, unlike under grounded or stable semantics. It proves that wp-semantics extends grounded semantics. Examples illustrate deontic conflicts and facultative conclusions. The discussion covers conflicting norms, legal systems, and weak versus strong permission. Related work reviews prior deontic argumentation and Defeasible Deontic Logic. The paper concludes by presenting the new semantics and noting future work on deontic operators and possible-world semantics.

They aim to standardize and improve cloud security vendor reviews by promoting and strengthening CSA’s STAR and related tools as recommended practices. Daniella Teutsch and Sara Wolf founded HydroChic in 2007 to offer modest women more attractive swimwear. They found customers including women who had mastectomies, bariatric surgery, skin cancer, or psoriasis wanted supportive, concealing, or skin-protecting garments. At the start of the Supreme Court’s new term, legal experts predict higher education will be a frequent subject, though the main docket lists only two college-related cases, both on transgender rights: West Virginia v. Riley Oil Company in Paoli, Indiana, is a family-run full-service gas station operating since 1971. It pumps gas, washes windshields, and checks oil for free without charging extra. Owners Jo Ann and Jeff Riley say six family members work there, and they expect the business to remain in the family.

Oklahoma City Taco Bell employees called police early Tuesday to report 52-year-old Zette Madden allegedly chasing them with a tire iron, demanding money, and damaging cash registers, doors, a drive-thru window and menu. An officer tasered her after repeated demands to drop the weapon; she was hospitalized for hand cuts and jailed on multiple charges.

Molecular dynamics simulations using LAMMPS and an EAM potential studied nanoindentation of single-crystalline hcp α-Ti along [0001], [10-10], and [2-110] orientations at 10, 300, and 600 K. Load–displacement curves showed an initial Hertzian elastic response followed by pop-in, which was most pronounced for [0001], while prismatic orientations showed smoother dislocation nucleation. [0001] had the largest residual depth, lowest elastic recovery, and highest dislocation density across temperatures, increasing with temperature. Prismatic orientations had lower dislocation densities that generally decreased with temperature due to recovery and annihilation. Basal a-type dislocations dominated plasticity, with c-type, prismatic, and pyramidal c+a dislocations also present; pyramidal slip became more active at higher temperatures. Schmid factor and shear strain maps linked high resolved shear stress to activated slip zones. Surface morphologies varied by orientation: circular pile-up for [0001], two-lobe for [10-10], and asymmetric pile-up for [2-110]. Temperature increased atomic mobility, made deformation more diffuse, and enhanced recovery, while stress-induced HCP→BCC transformation was favored at low temperatures. The simulations reproduced surface features in close agreement with AFM experiments.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K on June 2, 2022, reporting updated guidance for the quarter ending June 30, 2022 due to unfavorable foreign exchange rate movement through May. A slide deck with the revised guidance was furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

Falkland Islands Senior Fisheries Scientist Alexander Arkhipkin contributes to international efforts on high seas fishing impacts. He said unregulated areas have limited information on vessels, catch, species and sizes, affecting straddling stock assessments and increasing overfishing risk. In the SW Atlantic, over 250 jiggers and trawlers take squid, hake and rock cod. In the Eastern Pacific, foreign vessels fishing jumbo squid rose to almost 300 jiggers. Nintendo confirmed Labo will include a Toy Con Garage kit for building custom cardboard accessories, using basic inputs, actions, and if-then statements. It demonstrated a cardboard electric guitar and electronic tennis. Access may require buying a Labo set.

Darren Till won a close, controversial unanimous decision over Stephen Thompson in the UFC Fight Night 130 main event on May 27, 2018, in Liverpool. Till offered to rematch Thompson in America as soon as possible if Thompson is not injured; the fight was close, with little action aside from Till’s final-round knockdown.

The Department of Justice directed Education Secretary Linda McMahon to investigate the University of Nevada at Reno’s UndocuPack program, citing reports that the university assisted undocumented immigrants through resource referrals, student aid, academic and career support, including jobs not requiring a Social Security Number, and asking whether taxpayer funds were used. The DOJ has sued five states and the Education Department has investigated five universities over related policies.

The passage describes computer-implemented methods, systems, and program products for facilitating offline transactions. A first user device receives an offline payment request from a merchant payment system via a local communications connection, provides a payment approval message, and later provides offline transaction information to a payment server when connected. The payment server maintains an offline status repository, and an e-wallet’s offline mode is enabled for only one user device at a time. The first user device can receive an instruction to transfer the offline mode to a second user device, after which the first device disables its offline mode. The passage also describes local communications, offline reserve amounts, transaction records, and preventing duplicate processing using transaction IDs when connectivity is restored. It further includes cloud computing and flowchart/detail descriptions.

The High Post Split Offense is described as a simple, long-used offense using a 2-3 high alignment, quick high post splits, down screens, and back cuts. It provides scoring opportunities for all five players, eliminates weakside defensive help, and creates strong offensive rebounding advantages. The passage details phases including high post splits, down screens, high post isolation, and strong post ups, along with reads and counters for defensive actions such as tight play, switches, overplays, chasing, cheating over screens, and show-and-recover. It also lists entry variations such as Flop/Back Cut, Wing Pass, Wing Double Away, and Post Single/Double, plus post lobs, wing feeds, post exchanges, and player interchange. Success depends on spacing, execution, coordination, timing, defensive recognition, and individual skill development.

The application is a continuation of Ser. No. 16/933,069, which is a continuation of Ser. No. 16/101,900, now U.S. Pat. No. 10,717,350, which is a continuation of Ser. No. 15/342,407, now U.S. Pat. No. 10,046,632, and claims priority to U.S. Provisional Ser. No. 62/250,649. The disclosure relates to pickup truck tonneau covers. The Yankees’ season is over, and Aaron Judge will evaluate his elbow injury. After a late-July injury and IL stint, he mostly served as DH before returning to the outfield in early September, though his arm strength was not fully back. Judge said he will work on the elbow but did not know if surgery is needed.

The court found Norrell established a prima facie failure-to-promote case, but Waste Away gave a legitimate nondiscriminatory reason that White was most qualified, citing his prior experience as district sales manager for the combined districts, outside sales experience, organizational and leadership skills, and other factors. The court held Norrell did not show pretext; alleged remarks by Malphrus and Johnson were stray, isolated, or unrelated to the promotion decision, and Malphrus was not a decisionmaker. The court granted Waste Away’s motion for summary judgment on all claims, entered final judgment for Waste Away, and taxed costs against Norrell.

The Triangle Post Offense is a defensive-recognition system based on sound principles, precise court spacing, and fundamental execution, created and refined by Tex Winter. It uses a sideline triangle on one side and a two-man game on the other, with all players knowing the options for each spot. Its components are entry, sideline triangle, and weakside two game. Players space 15–20 feet to spread the defense and enable passing, post play, drives, cuts, and splits. Entries include guard outside and inside cuts, dribble clear, off guard cut, post pop, base screen, ball reversal, and dribble weave. Sideline triangle actions include strong post ups, post splits, high post split, post isolation, corner pass screen-and-roll, and post solo cuts. The weakside two game has pass and dribble series with counters based on defensive reads. The offense also includes automatic counters against overplay, teaching and breakdown drills, individual skill work, game strategies such as scouting, and a case for learning how to defend it.

Bollinger Bands are a well-known technical indicator developed by John Bollinger in the 1980s to analyze asset volatility and potential trend changes. They consist of a central moving average with standard deviations projected above and below it. TradingView can calculate and customize them, with default settings using a 20-period moving average and adjustable standard deviations. Bollinger Bands can help visualize volatility and estimate reversals or trend continuation, but alone they do not guarantee a profitable system. Disadvantages include false signals, ineffectiveness in range-bound markets, signal delays, and sensitivity to time period and settings. A breakout strategy uses band breaches. Pine Script can calculate them using ta.sma() and ta.stdev(). Effectiveness depends on trading rules, parameter optimization, and backtesting.

The passage explains the double top chart pattern strategy. A double top has two swing highs around the same level, with a swing low between them, and is a bearish reversal pattern at the end of an uptrend or a prolonged pullback in a downtrend. The highs form resistance; a neckline connecting the swing low to the preceding swing low serves as support. A break below the neckline suggests a possible downward reversal. Traders may close long positions, and short sellers may enter on a neckline break or retest. Profit targets are estimated by projecting the pattern height downward from the neckline, with stop losses in the middle or above the pattern. Trading rules include an uptrend, swing highs within 3%, and a volume break below the neckline. Coding and backtesting are difficult. Bulkowski’s manual study of 500 stocks over five years found 39% of double tops reached target, versus 68% for double bottoms. Shorting is described as difficult, with the stock market having a tailwind, making shorting generally futile except in brief falling markets.

The Piotroski F-Score is a stock-selection strategy developed by Joseph Piotroski, a Stanford finance professor. It is commonly used for value stocks and also for growth stock selection, but it is not a guarantee of success and should be used with other tools and research. The article discusses benefits, portfolio implementation, backtesting, financial ratios, risk-return analysis, and FAQs. It cites backtests: Alpha Architect tested NYSE stocks from 1974 to December 2014 in the top 40% by market value; stocks scoring at least 6 produced annual returns of 13.3% for Alpha Architect’s version, 12.6% for the original Piotroski score, and 11.2% for the S&P 500. For the cheapest 20% with Piotroski scores above 6, returns were 15.9%, 15.2%, and 11.2%, respectively. ValueSignals tested European stocks from June 1999 to 2011, and Alexander Eriksen studied Norwegian and Swedish stocks from 1997 to the end of 2011.

At Monday’s oral argument, several Supreme Court justices appeared willing to let trial courts limit what defense lawyers discuss with clients during overnight recesses while the client is still testifying. This lecture concludes the predecessor problem by presenting lower bounds. It surveys results by Ajtai, Miltersen, Beame and Fich, Xiau, Sen, and Patrascu and Thorup. The main proof is Sen’s round-elimination proof for colored predecessor in the cell probe model, viewed through communication complexity: Alice represents the query, Bob represents the static data structure or memory, and rounds correspond to memory reads. It proves an Ω(min(log_a w, log_b n)) lower bound for static randomized colored predecessor, where a is logarithmic space and b is the word size. For polynomial space, this implies Ω(min(log_w n, log w / log log n)), nearly matching Van Emde Boas and fusion tries up to a log log factor. The proof splits inputs into chunks, eliminates Alice-to-Bob messages to reduce w and Bob-to-Alice messages to reduce n, accumulates error, and obtains a contradiction if all messages can be eliminated.

The passage reports a study of 40 participants (13 healthy controls and 27 with rheumatoid arthritis [RA]; 11 treated with methotrexate [MTX], 11 with abatacept, and 5 with rituximab) after SARS-CoV-2 mRNA vaccination. Blood samples were analyzed for S-specific antibodies, neutralization, and S-specific T and B cell responses. Rituximab-treated subjects had near-undetectable anti-S antibodies and substantially reduced S-specific CD4+ T cell responses. Abatacept-treated subjects had lower S-specific and neutralizing antibodies, similar RBD-specific B cell numbers but reduced B cell activation and IgG class switching, altered memory B cell differentiation, and reduced production of IL-2, IFNγ, and IL-21 by S-specific CD4+ T cells. MTX-treated subjects had a lower magnitude S-specific CD4+ T cell response but no significant differences in antibody levels, neutralization, or RBD-specific B cell phenotype/class switching versus controls. The passage concludes that abatacept impairs vaccine responses through defective T cell help for B cells and supports temporary cessation of abatacept before vaccination when clinically manageable.

This study assessed the reliability, validity, and responsiveness of an Arabic version of the Orthognathic Quality of Life Questionnaire (OQLQ) in Saudi Arabian patients with malocclusions and dentofacial deformities. The OQLQ has 22 items across four dimensions, with total scores from 0 to 88 and higher scores indicating lower quality of life. Translation used forward/back-translation and expert review. In 74 patients, internal consistency was excellent (Cronbach’s α=0.92). Test-retest reliability in 15 patients ranged from 0.601 to 0.879. Validity was assessed against subjective appearance after surgery and overall surgical satisfaction; overall OQLQ and facial esthetics scores correlated with VAS satisfaction. Responsiveness was examined before and after surgery in the full cohort and a paired subset of 12; overall OQLQ scores were lower after surgery, and facial esthetics improved in the paired analysis. The Arabic OQLQ was reported as conceptually similar, comprehensible, reliable, valid, and responsive, though limitations included small validation cohorts and a single private practice.

The speaker says the team is part of the series and excited for the next game.
