They are confident on the road, value team depth and trade additions, and credit ownership’s commitment. The next game in Anaheim is sold out and up for grabs. A teammate deserves praise for working hard despite injuries. They are focused only on tomorrow.

This systematic review aimed to synthesize evidence on how student personality traits influence satisfaction and success in online higher education. It followed Cochrane and PRISMA methods, searched multiple databases, and included 23 peer-reviewed studies from 2000 to June 2024 that used recognized Big Five or Myers-Briggs assessments. All included studies were level 4 evidence, resulting in low strength of evidence. Findings were organized into themes covering interaction between personality and online education, comparison of class formats, and student choice of format. Conscientiousness was positively associated with satisfaction and grades; agreeableness and openness were often positively related; neuroticism was generally negatively related; extraversion showed mixed effects and preferences. No studies examined occupational therapy programs. Limitations included low evidence level, date restrictions, possible omissions, geographic and cultural variation, and nonstandardized satisfaction surveys. The review concludes that personality traits, self-efficacy, locus of control, and self-regulation relate to online learning outcomes and suggests tailored, UDL-based supports and future intervention research.

In 1977 Leeds hosted the UK’s first Reclaim the Night march, prompted partly by the Yorkshire Ripper killings and women’s nighttime safety. Forty years later, it inspired RashDash’s *The Darkest Corners*, performed in a Holbeck car park as part of Transform 17, which addresses continuing harassment and violence against women and celebrates female activists.

Adjuncts of Southwestern College rallied for better wages and equal protections as full-time instructors. Few attended, with more adjunct speakers than audience members. Adjuncts teach almost 75 percent of classes, lack full-time benefits, often travel among colleges, work long hours, face rehiring risks, and have insurance difficulties. President Kindred Murillo and Trustee Roberto Alcantar spoke in support. Adjuncts urged students and faculty to help obtain paid office hours and disability leave.

Turing GPUs support USB Type-C and VirtualLink to deliver power, display, and data to VR headsets through a single connector. TU102 and TU104 use NVLink for SLI GPU-to-GPU transfers, supporting two-way SLI. Turing introduces RT Cores and RTX technology for real-time ray tracing via hybrid rendering, denoising, and BVH acceleration. It also adds Tensor Cores and NGX for AI-based graphics, including DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez. Additional features include Mesh Shading, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, Multi-View Rendering, and extended resource management. VR improvements include VirtualLink, MVR, foveated rendering, and VRWorks Audio. The passage also covers TU104, TU106, and Tesla T4 specifications, the RTX-OPS workload metric, and ray tracing mechanics such as BVH and ray-traced shadows, ambient occlusion, and reflections.

Demi Guo, 26, co-founded AI video company Pika after leaving a Stanford Ph.D. program; Pika has raised about $135 million at a $470 million valuation and reports 16.4 million users. It launched a TikTok-like app and a Predictive Video feature that uses simple prompts or a selfie to generate complete videos with script, music, dance, background, lighting, camera angles and effects. Pika targets Gen Z and Gen Alpha for self-expression and says it differs from AI “slop” and from tools such as OpenAI’s Sora and Meta’s Vibes. The newsletter also reported that AI start-ups are affecting San Francisco apartment demand and rents; TSMC’s profit rose 39.1% on AI chip demand and it raised its 2025 revenue forecast; Spotify is partnering with Sony, Universal, Warner, Merlin and Believe on “responsible” AI music products; and a survey found 11% would consider using AI mental health tools, 8% trust AI in this space, and 4% have tried one.

This study explored students’ perceptions and preferences regarding online learning (OL) and emergency remote education (ERE). It surveyed 88 undergraduate students at a Colombian university using descriptive statistics, the add-on preferential groups model, permutation tests, and content analysis of open-ended questions. Results showed that students generally had positive perceptions of both modalities, but rated OL higher in most assessed factors, with statistically significant differences in several items. OL was preferred for content quality, independent and asynchronous activities, assessment strategies, resources, and time management, while student-student interaction was slightly more preferred in ERE. Content analysis identified advantages of ERE such as continuity during COVID-19, comfort, flexibility, ICT use, and instructor contact, and advantages of OL such as structure, organization, flexibility, learning effectiveness, interaction, and ICT use. Suggested improvements included instructor training, better organization, more interaction, more dynamic activities, and reducing content and assessment overload. The study concluded that both modalities were positively perceived and that ongoing instructor training and peer interaction should be promoted in post-COVID-19 learning design.

Mark Cuban said Trump’s planned TrumpRx.gov platform could be impactful if it forces PBMs to change. The federal website aims to sell prescription drugs directly to consumers at discounts and will go live in early 2026; Pfizer will sell drugs at direct-to-consumer cost averaging 50% savings and receive a three-year reprieve from Trump’s pharmaceutical tariffs. Cuban, who founded Cost Plus Drugs in 2022, said the challenge is whether PBMs and insurance companies or the president have more power. He graded the platform a “B,” saying it would have been an “A” but PBM stocks rose after the announcement. He said it is still rigged to benefit big PBMs, though it has a chance if PBMs are forced to change, in which case Trump would get credit. Public-health experts are skeptical, noting the platform currently applies only to Pfizer and, by cutting out PBMs, cannot accept insurance, so it mainly helps the uninsured.

The Russell 2000 is a market-weighted small-cap index of approximately 2,000 U.S. stocks and a subset of the Russell 3000. It rebalances annually, typically on the fourth Friday of June, by adding, removing, and adjusting constituents and weights to reflect the small-cap universe, which can create market imbalances. The passage describes a Russell 2000 rebalancing trading strategy that buys on the close of the first trading day after June 23 and sells on the close of the first trading day of July to capture an end-of-June rally. A backtest from 1988 using ^RUT reports an average late-June gain of 1.34% over about six trading days, versus 0.85% for the S&P 500. A hedged version, long Russell 2000 and short S&P 500, averaged only 0.23% and was weak initially and flattish recently. The article concludes the strategy may work well.

Digital leaders use data-driven objectives to coordinate across organizational levels and align them with strategy, helping teams understand how their goals contribute to a shared “North Star” vision. Implementing objectives requires buy-in and a top-down, bottom-up process, not simply mandated OKRs; excessive analysis can burden decisions and reduce human intuition. Digital laggards often have high-level priorities weakly connected to strategy, leading employees to deprioritize misunderstood objectives and causing misalignment. Data culture can align organizations vertically through metrics and horizontally through common data models and transparent access. Digital leaders emphasize data culture as central, aligning beliefs, values, and actions, while laggards show gaps between espoused and actual behavior due to entrenched habits, insufficient skills, and limited top-down focus. Changing mindsets and behaviors is difficult, but laggards are not doomed, and leaders also face cultural tensions. Mature firms differ in data culture. Organizations fit four patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant—and can build on strengths with targeted actions. Keystone Strategy is described as a consulting firm serving Fortune Global 500 companies, law firms, and government agencies.

It highlights the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card: unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 cash rewards bonus after $500 in purchases in the first 3 months, 0% intro APR for 12 months on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, a variable APR thereafter, $0 annual fee, and up to $600 cell phone protection. The President returns to the House of Representatives the bill entitled "An act making appropriations for the improvement of certain harbors and rivers" with objections to its becoming law. The bill would appropriate $1,378,450 for more than forty separate improvement objects, many local. He argues the Constitution does not grant the Federal Government power to construct internal improvements within the States or appropriate money for that purpose, and that this power is neither express nor a necessary incident to granted powers. He says many objects are local, not connected with foreign commerce or naval/commercial shelter, and that the bill’s principle would lead to consolidation, sectional conflict, wasteful spending, unequal benefits, and injustice to States that funded their own improvements. Some provisions alone would not draw objection. He also objects that the bill appropriates between $1,000,000 and $2,000,000 for objects of no pressing necessity during a foreign war, when a loan or Treasury notes have been authorized, and would lead to larger appropriations, debt, or taxes. He therefore withholds approval.

Coach DeBoer said his team made mistakes, was tentative early, improved, and did not deserve to win, adding it must find another level. He expects a response similar to earlier series against Philadelphia and the Rangers, said the team will self-analyze and improve by Saturday, and noted community excitement. He said scoring against the opposing goalie requires traffic, shots, and patience, as in the Lundqvist series; was unsure whether a layoff helped; and said the team would keep its routine rather than change speeches. This document is a statistical analysis plan for Zealand Pharma protocol ZP4207-17086. It outlines methods for a phase 3, randomized, double-blind, placebo- and active-controlled, parallel-arm trial of dasiglucagon 0.6 mg versus placebo and GlucaGen® in children with type I diabetes mellitus, to demonstrate superiority of dasiglucagon to placebo, compare it with GlucaGen®, and assess safety and pharmacokinetics. The plan covers study documents, design and periods, sample size, analysis sets, general analysis considerations, efficacy analyses including time to plasma glucose recovery, PK/PD analyses, safety analyses, adverse event and laboratory summaries, data handling, and programming/QC appendices.

GA10x GPUs use GDDR6X memory developed with Micron, using PAM4 signaling to reach up to 19.5 Gbps and 936 GB/s, over 52% more peak bandwidth than TU102. GDDR6X adds MTA encoding, new training/adaptation/equalization, pseudo-independent memory channels, and EDR for detecting and replaying transmission errors. NVIDIA RTX IO works with Microsoft DirectStorage to provide GPU-based lossless decompression and faster SSD-to-GPU loading, improving I/O and reducing CPU utilization. The A40, based on GA10x, is a data center GPU for visual computing, with up to 2X FP32, 2X ray-tracing, and 5X (10X with sparsity) AI throughput over Quadro RTX 6000, PCIe Gen4, 48GB memory scalable to 96GB via NVLink, display outputs, vGPU, Quadro Sync, and EGX compatibility. GA10x display support includes 4K120, 8K60, DisplayPort 1.4a, HDMI 2.1, DSC, HDR, and HDCP. Fifth-generation NVDEC supports MPEG-2, VC-1, H.264, H.265, VP8, VP9, and AV1 decode; seventh-generation NVENC supports encoding. Ampere offers up to 2x improvements in shading, ray tracing, and AI, second-generation RT Cores, third-generation Tensor Cores with sparsity, and DLSS. The RTX A6000 includes 48GB GDDR6 and can combine two boards via NVLink for 96GB.

The passage cites international tribunal cases involving detained or seized vessels, including The Hope On, where the majority held the claimant entitled to damages for arrest and detention, measuring loss of use by the probable catch during enforced absence from fishing grounds, and the Col. The passage explains that momentum works long term, but in the short term the SPY tends to be higher after a red day and lower after a green day, which is attributed to mean reversion. The 2017 Sonora High School Athletic Hall of Fame inductees include former Wildcats and coaches, with graduates spanning 1950 to 2008. The passage states that Banned Books Week (Oct. 5–11) arrives as censorship threats rise. A PEN America report found 22,810 instances of book banning in U.S. public schools from 2021 to 2025, and a climate of fear affects even librarians. Although Banned Books Week began in 1982 and higher education once treated it with indifference, the culture of book banning is now widespread. Conservatives seek to ban ideas about diversity, gender, and politics across colleges. Examples include New College of Florida eliminating its Gender and Diversity Center and discarding library books; censorship at military academies; a West Point professor resigning over removed works by Baldwin, Morrison, Walker, and others; Texas A&M dismissing a professor and auditing courses; and a Trump administration compact threatening federal funds unless universities abolish units that “belittle” conservative ideas. The passage notes public opposition to book banning and calls for a broad alliance to defend expression.

A federal judge ruled that the Freedom of Access to Clinic Entrances Act, which bars harassment of women seeking abortion services, also applies to Falun Gong practitioners. U.S. District Judge Jack Weinstein rejected a constitutional challenge by the Chinese Anti-Cult World Alliance, finding that religion is deeply rooted in interstate commerce and that Congress could reasonably conclude violence and intimidation at houses of worship would affect interstate commerce. Weinstein also said “place of religious worship” must be construed broadly, not limited to formal temples. The ruling stemmed from a lawsuit by Zhang Jingrong and other Falun Gong practitioners claiming harassment by the alliance.

The Carter administration used MONs to introduce higher-risk, higher-cost, or more geographically specific operations under approved general objectives. MONs required CIA-State and broader interagency coordination and later applied to significant changes to findings; entirely new covert actions still required new presidential findings. Congress was typically notified within 48 hours. The Intelligence Oversight Act of 1980 limited briefings to two intelligence committees, clarified that being informed did not require approval, and allowed prior notice to be limited to the Gang of Eight in extraordinary circumstances. Later entries from January 1983 concern U.S.-Soviet relations and Shultz’s four-part agenda: human rights, arms control, regional issues, and bilateral relations.

In St. Louis & San Francisco Railroad Company v. Conarty, the court affirmed the judgment for Fannie M. Conarty, administratrix and widow of W. G. Conarty, against the railroad. The denial of removal to federal court was upheld because the Employers’ Liability Act, as amended April 5, 1910, prohibits removal, citing Kansas City Southern Railway Company v. Cook. Under the amended Act, only one action and one recovery are allowed for the widow and next of kin, and that action may include both pecuniary loss and the deceased’s pain and suffering, whose right of action survives to his personal representative. A coal car loaded at Huntington, Arkansas, consigned to Texas, was damaged in Oklahoma, returned to Fort Smith for repairs, unloaded, stored, and later moved for switching when it collided with an engine; the court found it was still in use in interstate commerce under the Safety Appliance Act. The railroad was liable because the injury would not have occurred but for the defective coupler, even though the deceased was not using it. The widow was permitted to testify about contributions, and the judgment was affirmed.

The RBZ said the official US dollar-to-bond note exchange rate remains 1:1 and advised the public to transact through licensed financial institutions. Governor John Mangudya said 45 institutions are licensed and other currency exchanges may have a fee spread of no more than 10 percent. He said illegal money changers have been arrested under SI 122a of 2017, and warned retailers refusing non-cash payments.

The dollar began the week at three-week highs against a currency basket after New York Fed President William Dudley reinforced the Fed’s rate-hike commitment. The dollar index rose 0.1 percent to 101.260. The dollar gained 0.3 percent to 111.43 yen, while the euro fell 0.1 percent to $1.0580. Markets watched Syria, North Korea, and the French election. U.S. March job growth missed forecasts, but unemployment fell to 4.5 percent, and speculators’ dollar net longs hit a five-week low.

The passage reports results on continuous-wave interferometry. An interferometer estimates phase from the outgoing field; unbiased estimators satisfy the quantum Cramer-Rao bound, quantified by quantum Fisher information. For unentangled inputs, FQ ≤ n(n+2), saturated by a pair of squeezed states. For time-dependent signals, pure squeezed-state inputs and no losses give a spectral QCRB; for n≫2 this implies Heisenberg scaling, with precision increasing as inverse squeezing bandwidth and inverse square photon occupancy per mode. This bound can be attained by a nonlinear estimator using filtered homodyne records, such as a linearized maximum-likelihood estimator.

Chronic hepatitis C (CHC), caused by hepatitis C virus, is a major public health problem and leading cause of chronic liver disease; it can cause chronic inflammatory necrosis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Complications and extrahepatic manifestations include ascites, upper gastrointestinal bleeding, portal hypertensive gastropathy, autoimmune disorders, mixed cryoglobulinemia, Sjogren’s syndrome, thyroid disorders, and type 2 diabetes (T2DM). HCV infection is a risk factor for T2DM, and HCV clearance may reduce T2DM risk. This study aimed to evaluate the prognostic value of PNI, NLR, and PLR in chronic hepatitis C-associated cirrhosis complicated by T2DM. It included group A (56), group B (85), and group C (85); group A was divided into poor prognosis (23) and good prognosis (33) after 6 months. Blood parameters were measured and PNI, NLR, and PLR calculated.

The Rubber Band trading strategy is a contrarian/mean-reversion strategy for stocks that identifies overbought or oversold points where price may snap back toward the mean. It can use Keltner Channels, Bollinger Bands, or momentum oscillators. With Keltner Channels, a buy setup occurs below the lower band and a sell setup above the upper band, with profit targets at the middle band or before the opposite band. A backtested XLP example showed 328 trades, 0.45% average gain per trade, 6.1% CAGR, 20% time in market, profit factor 2, and 16% max drawdown. The strategy works mainly on stocks.

UK university staff are in their fourth week of strikes over the end of defined benefit pension schemes. Talks have failed, and UCU has issued 14 more strike days, likely between April and June, during exams; whether they proceed depends on talks. Edinburgh University was criticised for asking law staff to provide old lecture recordings during action.

This study examined plasma biomarkers combined with non-invasive measures to predict cognitive decline in non-demented individuals using machine learning. Data were from ADNI, with Cohort 1 including NFL and p-tau181 but not Aβ42/40, and Cohort 2 including all three plasma biomarkers. Predictors included demographics, APOE4, baseline composite cognitive scores (ADNI-MEM, ADNI-EF, ADNI-LAN, ADNI-VS), plasma biomarkers, and MRI measures. The framework used ridge linear regression on MRI data to calculate an MRI score, then random forest regression with nested cross-validation to compare basic, plasma, MRI, and combined models. For ADNI-MEM decline, the combined model showed the highest correlation and lowest MAE; plasma and MRI models also improved over the basic model. Other cognitive domains showed less improvement, except ADNI-LAN. Prediction was worse in cognitively unimpaired than MCI groups. Survival analyses showed predicted ADNI-MEM decline tertiles were associated with progression to MCI/dementia in CU individuals and dementia in MCI individuals, with the combined model generally showing the highest performance. Aβ42/40 had lower importance than NFL and p-tau181, while MRI and baseline cognitive scores were often strongest. The study concluded that plasma biomarkers, especially combined with MRI and cognitive scores, can predict domain-specific decline and dementia progression, though early prediction in CU individuals remains challenging, with limitations including focus on AD-specific biomarkers and the ADNI cohort.

A National Academy of Sciences and National Academy of Medicine report says heritable DNA editing should be allowed only to prevent serious, strongly heritable diseases, not to enhance traits. Although germline editing is illegal in the U.S., CRISPR-Cas9 advances make it a realistic possibility. The panel says germline clinical trials should target serious disease genes, lack reasonable alternatives, undergo public scrutiny, and include long-term follow-up; public debate and international oversight are urged.
Singapore Police arrested eight women and 15 men in a week-long operation across Yishun, Ang Mo Kio and Sengkang; offences included Women’s Charter, gambling, and drink-driving.

Aiden Markram was named South Africa's captain after Faf du Plessis was forced out with a finger injury. Markram called it an honour and said senior players would help him. South Africa trails India 1-0 in the six-match series and needs an improved performance in the second ODI on Sunday.

Google is expanding speech recognition to support 30 new languages and locales, bringing the total to 119. The additions include eight Indian languages, Swahili, and Amharic. They are initially supported in Gboard for Android, Voice Search, and Cloud Speech API, with other Google products to follow. U.S. English speakers can dictate emojis. The expansion targets emerging markets, especially India, and was developed using native-speaker samples and machine learning.

Saints will play Exeter Chiefs away on Nov 4, Dragons at home on Nov 11, Sale Sharks away on Jan 26 weekend, and Harlequins at home in early February. They are grouped with Saracens, Scarlets and Worcester Warriors; the top team in each pool reaches the semi-finals.

TeraAgent is a distributed simulation engine that extends BioDynaMo to enable scale-out agent-based simulations across multiple servers by spatially partitioning the simulation space and handling aura updates, agent migration, and load balancing. It introduces a serialization mechanism that avoids pointer deduplication, deserialization, endianness conversion, and schema evolution while allowing mutable deserialized data, and a delta encoding scheme to reduce inter-server data transfer. It supports MPI hybrid and MPI only modes and aims to hide distributed execution from users, allowing model execution from laptops to supercomputers without code modification. Evaluation shows TeraAgent simulates 501.51 billion agents on 84,096 CPU cores, simulates 250× more agents than BioDynaMo, achieves an 8× higher agent update rate per CPU core than Biocellion, improves visualization performance by 39×, has median serialization speedups of 110× and deserialization of 37×, and reduces data transfer by up to 3.5×. It produces the same results as BioDynaMo.

This paper proposes a model-based geostatistical (MBG) method for designing and analyzing soil-transmitted helminth (STH) impact assessment surveys. The method uses baseline prevalence data, environmental risk factors, and preventive chemotherapy history to predict baseline and impact prevalence surfaces via geostatistical models, a multi-state Markov model, and local thinning. It was applied to Kenya, Sierra Leone, and Zimbabwe. Compared with the classical approach, MBG designs achieved equivalent accuracy with substantially smaller sample sizes and lower costs; average survey cost decreased by 80%, with reductions of 91% in Zimbabwe, 86% in Kenya, and 62% in Sierra Leone. The paper states MBG can provide accurate, lower-cost impact assessments and finely resolved prevalence maps, and that a manual and web application are being developed, with the framework potentially usable for other neglected tropical diseases.

CoreLogic reported May home prices rose 7.1% year over year and 1.1% month over month. It cited lean supply, higher prices, and May mortgage rates averaging a seven-year high of 4.6%. Among 100 largest metros, 40% were overvalued, 26% undervalued, and 34% at value. CoreLogic projects a 5.1% national increase from May 2018 to May 2019 and noted strong demand despite high prices.

The passage describes a vehicle vision and driver monitoring system that uses one or more cameras to capture exterior and interior image data. The system estimates driver distraction workload and driving workload, optionally using a maximum workload, to determine driver attention. Inputs may include driver identity, driving behavior, position, emotions, health, focus, vehicle control, drowsiness, environment, climate, audio, entertainment use, and passenger monitoring. Workloads may be weighted and adjusted, and driver attention may be expressed as a percentage. The passage also describes modules with inputs/outputs, states, confidence, availability, calibration, machine learning prediction, autonomous vehicle driver definitions, sensors, image processing, and communication systems.

Alere concluded its financial statements for 2013–2015 should not be relied upon due to misstatements. Restatements are preliminarily expected to relate mainly to revenue recognition at its South Korean location and one Japanese transaction. Alere expects unremediated material weaknesses and an additional control-environment material weakness at SD, and may need more time to file its March 31 10-Q.
Shonda Rhimes and her Shondaland production company have signed a deal to create new shows for Netflix. Her existing series will continue on ABC. No financial terms or deal duration were disclosed.

The American Academy of Pediatrics noted that five medical tests commonly ordered for children who are short, overweight or showing early puberty signs are not always necessary, especially if otherwise healthy. The tests include hormone and endocrine tests, vitamin D screening, thyroid or insulin tests for overweight children, and thyroid ultrasounds. The AAP advised weighing risks and benefits and using evidence-based strategies.

Letters posted by Grassroots Leadership describe conditions and family separations in immigration detention. An anonymous Guatemalan woman called one facility “la perrera,” saying she spent eight days without bathing or brushing her teeth, slept on the floor under aluminum-paper blankets, and was treated “as though we were animals.” She said she did not know her children’s fate for 21 days. Other women, including Mirian and Claudia, wrote of missing their children and seeking reunion. A lawyer said the anonymous woman’s children were released to their father on June 19 and she was released June 26. ICE said it could not address specific claims because names and facilities were unclear. Volunteers helped women write and send the letters.

Pairs trading involves simultaneously buying and selling two highly correlated financial instruments to trade the spread rather than the market’s direction, aiming for market-neutral profits whether markets rise, fall, or move sideways. The passage discusses examples such as KO/PEP and GS/MS, correlation and cointegration, strategy tests, and advantages and disadvantages including leverage, shorting costs, slippage, commissions, black swan events, and pairs wandering apart. It concludes that pairs trading strategies are still working but that profitability may be diminishing, and backtests of KO/PEP and GS/MS yielded returns lower than buying and holding the S&P 500.

The passage describes a method, apparatus, terminal, and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium for displaying a marker element in a virtual scene. Marker indication information indicates a target virtual item marked by a user account for user accounts in the same team; graphic data of the marker element is obtained and rendered at a designated location around the target virtual item. A server detects whether the target virtual item is within a visible distance of a current virtual object and sends marker indication information; terminals may also display distance information and remove marker elements after preset durations.

A judge ordered Thomas Alter, a Texas State University history professor, reinstated after being fired for allegedly inciting violence at a virtual socialism conference. He cannot teach and is reinstated without pay during review; another judge ordered Michael Hook reinstated.

Tesla Motors, Inc. filed Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2016. The filing reports total revenues of $2.30 billion for the three months ended September 30, 2016, versus $936.8 million for the same period in 2015, and net income of $21.9 million versus a net loss of $229.9 million. For the nine months ended September 30, 2016, total revenues were $4.72 billion and net loss was $553.6 million. As of September 30, 2016, Tesla had $3.08 billion in cash and cash equivalents and $12.59 billion in total assets. The filing also describes its agreement to acquire SolarCity, vehicle leasing and resale value guarantee programs, convertible and long-term debt, equity incentive plans, Gigafactory and manufacturing plans, customer deposits, legal proceedings, and a subsequent $30.8 million land purchase.

The speaker says a late first-period goal was hard to accept, but the team came out in the second, created chances, and was stopped by good saves. He stresses a good start, confidence, and leaving everything on the ice, and says both teams know a turnaround is possible. He feels he has been playing his game, but allowing three or more goals makes winning tough; many goals were deflections, and he must raise his level. He chose to skate today and is moving on from a tough loss, focusing on the next game. He calls the opponent the best team faced, says they exploit mistakes, and adds the team must play its best, earn luck, create traffic, get loose pucks, and match the opposing goalie.

Researchers found that ALS patients had stronger immune cell responses to C9orf72 than people without ALS, while responses to TDP-43 and SOD1 were comparable. Among patients with C9orf72 responses, those whose immune cells produced anti-inflammatory signals were predicted to survive longer. The findings, published in Nature, suggest an autoimmune component to ALS and raise possibilities for targeting the immune system or tracking autoimmune cells, but they do not prove ALS is caused by immune responses. Further study is needed.

AMD shares surged after an AI chip deal with OpenAI. Evercore’s Emanuel noted a bubble scenario could take the S&P 500 to 9,000 in 2026. Gold rallied above $3,900/oz amid a yen slump and U.S. rate cut bets. Market commentary said momentum remains intact but charts show early warnings; the S&P 500 closed up 2.2% in July and 7.8% YTD, then slipped 1.6% on August’s first day. Volatility and credit spreads are in a seasonal upturn; investors are skewing toward tech, and U.S. electricity demand hit a record. July was risk-on with stocks up and bonds down; August began poorly, with short-term technicals tenuous but medium/long-term trend indicators healthy. The passage also includes fund names, AI strategy promotions, and risk disclosures.

Crime involving cryptocurrencies is rising while reported crimes in Japan are falling. The Jan. 26 theft of 523 million NEM coins from Coincheck, which says it lost ¥58 billion, has heightened concern; the FSA had warned Coincheck about customer asset management. Japan has been central to virtual currency exchanges, though Mt. Gox collapsed in 2014 and Coincheck is not among the FSA’s 16 registered exchanges. Authorities have arrested a Ripple firm founder, warned about ransomware and ICO risks, and noted ICOs remain largely unregulated. Facebook banned ICO ads, and the U.S. SEC halted an allegedly fraudulent ICO. Consumers are warned to proceed at their own risk.

Ontario Liberals, if re-elected, are poised to scrap provincewide EQAO tests for Grades 3 and 9, eliminate mandatory high school literacy-test graduation requirements, and water down Grade 6 and Grade 9 tests, according to a report commissioned by Premier Kathleen Wynne. Education Minister Indira Naidoo-Harris said further consultation is needed before implementing the report’s 18 recommendations, after the June 7 election. The report says the status quo is not working and calls for transformational change, including transferring substantial assessment responsibility to teachers. The EQAO was not consulted and expressed disappointment, warning that eliminating its primary-division assessment would remove half the independent data for elementary-school improvement. The article says the government previously denied plans to scrap Grade 3 testing and mandatory literacy tests.

Auswide Bank grew from Queensland building societies, expanded to Sydney and Melbourne, listed on the Australian Stock Exchange in 1994, and converted to a bank in 2015. Its mission is to demonstrate the “power of small” by placing customers at the centre. As of June 30, 2020, it had assets of AUD3,789 million, loans and advances of AUD3,206 million, deposits and short term borrowings of AUD3,019 million, net interest revenue of AUD70.5 million, net profit after tax of AUD18.5 million, and dividends of AUD13.6 million. The passage lists representative FY2021 transactions, suggested assignment questions, and Exhibit 1 financial statements for FY2020.

The article discusses special education teacher shortages and alternative certification, focusing on an exploratory case study of the Washington Education Association (WEA) Teacher Residency Program. Developed by the Washington State Teacher’s Union and local school districts, the program was piloted during the 2023–24 academic year and operates without direct in-state IHE affiliation. It is described as the first union-led teacher preparation program in the United States. The program prepares aspiring special education teachers, aims to recruit and retain teachers reflecting community diversity, and includes evidence-based training, culturally responsive practices, UDL-aligned coursework, field placements, mentors, coaches, and assessments. Eight Washington districts participated, with three hosting residents; 16 teacher residents were admitted. The study examined training components, emerging technologies, and incentives. Technology included Mursion, Google’s Jamboard, mobile-based speech generation devices, and assistive and instructional technologies. Residents received a living wage, health insurance, placements, mentors, and instructional coaches, and committed to working in the district for three years after licensure. Funding came from WEA, local districts, state grants, and a Department of Labor grant. Limitations included scalability, sustainability, a short timeframe, and a small sample size. The conclusion states the program addresses special education teacher shortages and workforce diversity and may offer a model for other teacher preparation initiatives.

Motivate added 250 electric pedal-assist Ford GoBike Plus bikes to San Francisco’s Ford GoBike bike-share program, placing them at stations in the western half of the city. Officials and cyclists welcomed them with a group ride up Page Street. Motivate’s CEO said the e-bikes address San Francisco’s terrain, may attract new users, and could encourage 3- to 5-mile rides. Only San Francisco has them for now, with no schedule for other program cities. Motivate said it worked with cities, unlike the scooters.

The speaker says the first job is to stop the other team scoring, with scoring as a bonus. They stress simple play, avoiding turnovers, winning two more games over personal records. Experience helps with media attention, which can be fun but sometimes excessive and manageable.

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Secretary Abid Majeed directed formation of provincial, district and union council committees led by paediatricians to oversee technical and communication aspects of the upcoming measles campaign. A meeting reviewed preparations. The October campaign will vaccinate children aged nine to 59 months, targeting 4.3 million children, with emphasis on communication, staff training, logistics, vaccines and referral systems for AEFI.

IDC states that industrial enterprises face disruptive changes and regards IT-based simulations, modeling, and data analytics as key enablers. It says HPC technologies are becoming a prerequisite for modern simulations and modeling, and that public cloud and HPCaaS can expand agility and scalability or remove the need for in-house HPC infrastructure. IDC recommends virtual product and manufacturing development, a holistic data strategy with a single source of truth, evaluation of the appropriate HPC operating model, attention to scalability, security, and energy efficiency, and use of external expertise and ecosystem partners. The white paper’s findings are based on a December 2021 telephone survey of 200 IT and other departmental decision makers at industrial enterprises with more than 500 employees in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

Sarah and Laura Ayoub credit their Scottish music education, including fully funded lessons and ensemble opportunities, as crucial to their careers. The passage describes debate over music tuition: 22 local authorities charge for it, while ten do not. Highland Council transferred its tuition service to High Life Highland, and Clackmannanshire voted to double costs, with parents paying £524 a year. Renfrewshire increased music tuition spending by £200,000. Campaigns such as Save Our Strings and Develop not Dismantle oppose cuts, and concerns are raised about falling music teacher numbers and council services potentially ceasing. The Scottish government cites the Youth Music Initiative for primary pupils, while saying local councils decide on secondary tuition charges. Supporters say music education benefits pupils whether or not they become musicians.

In Lykins v. Aluminum Workers International Union, plaintiff Toy Lykins challenged the union’s use of his required dues for purposes other than collective bargaining, contract administration, or grievance adjustment, alleging violations of First Amendment speech and association rights. Defendants moved for summary judgment. The court denied the motion. It found a justiciable controversy because plaintiff paid an initiation fee and monthly dues and alleged those funds were spent in violation of his rights. The court rejected failure-to-exhaust arguments under § 201(c), noting plaintiff demanded an account, obtained § 201 reports, and had no duty to attend union meetings. It held sufficient governmental action existed because the union shop clause operated under § 8(a)(3) of the NLRA. It held the NLRA does not authorize expenditure of a dissenter’s dues for political or ideological purposes, relying on Street, Allen, and Abood, and avoided a constitutional holding. It did not decide which specific expenditures must be refunded. The court ordered plaintiff to amend jurisdiction allegations, denied summary judgment, directed further responses and discovery, and scheduled pretrial and trial dates. A later order struck Part I of the memorandum and stated jurisdiction under § 1337(a) was sufficient.

A new Gallup-Walton Family Foundation survey found more than 1 in 4 U.S. public school teachers lack basic materials or staffing support needed to do their jobs, significantly affecting job satisfaction. Teachers most often report shortages of “people resources”: about two-thirds lack enough teaching assistants, aides or paraprofessionals, and 62% lack enough mental health resources or special educators. Shortages also include classroom furniture, laptops or computers, and printing supplies. Funding and difficult ordering processes are barriers. Among teachers with adequate resources, 77% report being satisfied at work, versus 44% without. About half say professional development is not grounded in students’ needs. Gallup surveyed teachers from the RAND American Teacher Panel across one school year.

The speaker says being part of Detroit’s group, from coach to Yzerman and Chelios, and winning the Stanley Cup was wonderful. He respects the coach, says a long career must end, and finds the experience more enjoyable but quick.

Ron Washington told The Athletic he will not return as Angels manager in 2026 after missing more than half of the 2025 season following quadruple bypass heart surgery. ESPN confirmed interim manager Ray Montgomery also will not get the full-time role, and the Angels will search for their sixth manager in nine years. Washington said GM Perry Minasian told him the decision not to pick up his contract option was based on team performance, not health. Washington said he believed the team was going in the right direction and would like to continue managing or join a coaching staff. The Angels finished 72-90, their 10th consecutive losing season, and Washington was 99-137 in two seasons. Montgomery’s option will not be picked up, while the rest of the coaching staff’s status is unknown. Minasian is under contract through 2026, and Albert Pujols and Torii Hunter are considered strong candidates.

This lecture addresses implementing linear shift-invariant systems described by linear constant coefficient difference equations. It assumes causal systems. Implementation requires delay, multiplication, and addition, represented by block diagrams and linear signal flow graphs. Block diagram elements include delay denoted z^-1, scalar multiplication, and two-input addition. Signal flow graphs use directed branches and nodes, with source and sink nodes; node values are sums of incoming branch outputs, and linear branch output is transmittance times branch input. A first-order example, y(n)=a y(n-1)+x(n), is shown. The lecture also presents a matrix representation of digital networks and separates the transmittance matrix into coefficient and delay parts, corresponding to coupled first-order difference equations. Computable node numbering requires no nonzero elements on or above the main diagonal of the coefficient matrix; delay-free loops correspond to noncomputable numbering. Next lectures will discuss common IIR/recursive and FIR/nonrecursive digital filter structures.

Earl of Aberdeen stated the occupation of the Sandwich Islands was unauthorized and would be inquired into; he also did not entertain the King’s compensation claim, regarding Lord George Paulet’s seizure as not forcible. Indirect causes included American predominance, Anglo-French rivalry, a French rival religion, British consular hopes of weakening American influence, and native sentiment favoring the power that first virtually acknowledged Hawaiian autonomy through Capt. Jones’s unratified but morally binding treaty. The first Hawaiian embassy sought recognition abroad. At Washington, Webster recognized Hawaiian independence for the President on December 19, 1842, and the President communicated the correspondence to Congress on December 30; Calhoun later confirmed it. In London, France and Britain agreed on November 28, 1843, to consider the islands independent and never take possession, though the convention did not guarantee autonomy against third powers.
Manchester United lost 2-0 to Spurs at Wembley; Mourinho seeks immediate response against Huddersfield, with Alexis Sanchez making his home debut, and a pre-match press conference at Carrington.

Elliott Management said NXP is worth US$135 per share standalone, above Qualcomm’s US$110 offer. Elliott, with about a 6% stake, told shareholders Qualcomm’s offer acted as a valuation ceiling and it sought a higher price than Qualcomm’s US$38 billion all-cash offer. An evaluation survey mostly agreed with the proposals, though the concept of “engineering” received lower agreement and was revised. On March 6, 2019, NVIDIA’s Compensation Committee approved a new form of global performance-based restricted stock unit notice and agreement under the Amended and Restated 2007 Equity Incentive Plan. On March 8, 2019, the Committee adopted the Fiscal Year 2020 Variable Compensation Plan, providing eligible executive officers variable cash based on achievement of corporate performance goals tied to fiscal year 2020 revenue with threshold, base operating plan, and stretch operating plan levels. Robert Cyrus Garrison was charged in Tulsa County District Court with First Degree Rape. After a hung jury, a second trial resulted in a 30-year sentence. In a two-stage proceeding, the jury found him guilty, then received a punishment instruction under 57 O.S.Supp.1969, § 138. Garrison claimed the instruction prejudiced him and enhanced punishment. The court noted Williams v. State held the statute unconstitutional; although the instruction did not justify reversal, it did justify modification because the jury was led to believe 30 years could be served in about 15, and good time credits were discretionary and should not be considered by the jury. The sentence was modified to 15 years and otherwise affirmed.

Kirkhorn will receive a $12 million stock option grant and a $4 million restricted stock unit grant; Taneja will receive a $6 million stock option grant and a $2 million restricted stock unit grant, each vesting over four years under Tesla’s standard equity policies.

Lobster 207, formally the Maine Lobstering Union, was both an IAM local lodge and a cooperative business, officially formed in 2013. By November 2017, it represented about 550 lobstermen, of whom 250 were dues-paying. It responded to pressures in Maine’s $500 million lobster industry, where lobstermen were self-employed price-takers facing low prices, regulations, global supply-chain changes, and anti-trust limits on collective action. IAM District 4 began organizing lobstermen in late 2012 after Dave Sullivan and Joel Pitcher met with them; by February 2013, 99 had signed A-cards. Lobster 207 achieved political wins, including legislation protecting lobstermen on military duty, opposing dredging in Penobscot Bay, defeating a Right to Work bill, and helping elect Robert Alley as State Representative. In September 2013, the Maine Lobstering Union was incorporated as a statewide marketing co-op. In February 2017, Lobster 207 voted to purchase the Trenton Bridge Lobster Pound’s wholesale operations for $4 million, financed by Bank of Labor, other IAM locals, a seller note, and an IAM Grand Lodge backup letter of credit. Post-acquisition, the business bought from 130 member boats, up from 30. Looking forward, Lobster 207 needed to advocate, manage the wholesale business, and grow membership; Sully prepared to discuss lessons for the IAM and labor movement.

The speaker accepts the Republican Party’s presidential nomination and emphasizes party government under the Constitution as opposed to personal or autocratic rule. He calls for restoring representative government, congressional and Senate authority, and a capable Cabinet. He opposes a world super-government or League Covenant that would surrender American freedom of action or create a military alliance, while favoring peace, reduced armaments, and an association of nations cooperating through justice and international law. Domestically he urges cooperation among labor, management, and capital, full production, thrift, economy, and deflation to restore the dollar. He supports collective bargaining without group infringement on individual rights, opposes government railroad ownership, and favors railway rehabilitation, highways, water transportation, agriculture and farm cooperatives, a protective tariff, a merchant marine, an adequate navy, a small army, immigration standards, law enforcement, women’s suffrage, rights for Negro citizens, aid for veterans, and attention to Mexico. He pledges constitutional, orderly government.

Warren Buffett is reportedly eyeing Berkshire Hathaway’s biggest deal in three years: Occidental’s petrochemical unit OxyChem for roughly $10 billion, the Wall Street Journal reported Tuesday. It could close within days and be Berkshire’s largest since its $11.6 billion Alleghany purchase in 2022. Berkshire has $344 billion cash; Buffett will step down as CEO in 2025 but remain chairman.

Christian Pulisic scored eight minutes in and helped set up Jozy Altidore as the United States beat Panama 4-0 in Orlando. Altidore scored twice, including a chipped penalty, and Bobby Wood added a goal. The U.S. ended a three-match winless streak in qualifying, moved to 12 points, and passed Panama into third place in the North and Central American and Caribbean region. Pulisic, moved to central midfield, had played a part in 11 of the Americans’ 14 goals in the hex.

The passage contains a diplomatic closing from Chichkine to Mr. Wurts and a State Department certification by John Hay dated September 1, 1900, followed by testimony from Capt. George O. Baker. Baker, a 58-year-old master mariner since 1863 with six years in the Ochotsk and Japan Seas, states that the Ochotsk whaling season opens about mid-August and lasts until mid-October, when northerly/easterly winds and gales make whaling impractical. September is best. A fair seasonal catch would be six to ten right whales, not bowhead, averaging about 1,100 pounds of bone and 100 barrels of oil each. From Vladivostok on October 1 with rugged weather begun, he would not return to the Ochotsk Sea but sail directly to San Francisco, since the season would be nearly over and the trip useless.

Declaration grievances resonate today, the passage says. It compares Trumpism’s disregard for rule of law and checks and balances to Founders’ concerns: Trump deferring to generals violates civilian control, as the king made military superior to civil power; Trump’s attacks on Mueller, DOJ, and judges echo royal interference with judiciary. The lecture continues discussion of privilege separation and focuses on capabilities. It explains the confused deputy problem: a Fortran compiler in /sysx/fort with a home files license could write throughout /sysx, and a user could cause it to write output to /sysx/stat or a billing file. The professor says the compiler used ambient authority and should have explicitly selected the privileges it exercised. Capabilities are offered as an alternative: possessing a capability to an object permits access subject to restrictions, and capabilities must be unforgeable. Unix file descriptors illustrate this because they are integers resolved through a process’s file descriptor table. A capability-style fix would open file descriptors in an unprivileged front end and pass them to a privileged compiler.

The lecture then discusses Capsicum, which sandboxes code via a capability mode where only existing capabilities can be used and global namespaces are constrained. It covers cap_enter, openat, network restrictions, process descriptors, and the disallowance of dot dot. It also discusses libcapsicum, lch_start, fd lists, and examples such as tcpdump and gzip. The lecture states Capsicum is best when developers build applications aware of sandboxing, that OKWS could benefit, and that security depends on developers giving proper capabilities and on correct kernel implementation.

The Magic Formula, popularized by Joel Greenblatt’s book *The Little Book That Beats the Market*, is a stock-selection strategy that ranks companies by high return on capital (ROIC) and high earnings yield (EY), selecting those with the best combination. It can be implemented passively or actively and aims to find undervalued companies with strong financials for long-term returns. Reactions are mixed: some cite positive backtests, international studies, and long-term outperformance, while critics note lack of theoretical basis, limited consideration of company-specific factors, possible underperformance, reliance on historical data, small-cap bias, and excluded transaction costs. Risks include poor stock performance, sector concentration, value-stock underperformance, and past performance not guaranteeing future results.

The National Weather Service Burlington VT issued a zone forecast for Monday, March 19, 2018, for northern New York areas including Clinton, St. Lawrence, Franklin, and Essex counties. Conditions were forecast as sunny or mostly sunny today with highs in the 20s and northwest winds, clear or mostly clear tonight with lows from around 1 to 15, and sunny Tuesday with highs in the upper 20s to lower 30s. Alpha-N Performance modified an M4 Coupe with software for its 3.0-liter biturbo engine, producing 560 hp. It used M4 GTS gearbox software, differential, and stability-control settings, plus Öhlins suspension, 20-inch OZ alloys, aero parts, and Recaro seats. It lapped the Nürburgring in 7:20; BMW says the M4 GTS did 7:28.

Roundhill Investments relaunched its meme-stock ETF, MEME, on Wednesday, aiming to let investors rotate into stocks dominating conversation. Its first 2021 launch coincided with a Nasdaq peak; from that launch to late 2023, the Nasdaq fell nearly 10% and the prior ETF dropped over 96%. The new fund’s largest holdings include quantum computing stocks, and it fell more than 2% Wednesday. BTIG’s Jonathan Krinsky said the relaunch signals market froth or exuberance.

The lecture illustrates designing digital low-pass filters from analog Butterworth filters using impulse invariance and the bilinear transformation. Butterworth filters are defined by cutoff frequency and order, with monotonic magnitude and poles on the Butterworth circle. For a digital filter with passband edge 0.2π and stopband edge 0.3π, the design converts digital specifications to analog specifications and solves for filter order and cutoff. With impulse invariance, the order is rounded to N=6, the passband specification is met exactly, and the stopband is exceeded to compensate for aliasing. With the bilinear transformation, critical frequencies are prewarped, N is similarly rounded to 6, and the stopband is met exactly while the passband is exceeded. The parameter T is shown to be irrelevant. The bilinear design provides better high-frequency attenuation than impulse invariance, and the procedures can generalize to other filter types.

Thokozani Khupe was elected leader of a breakaway MDC faction at an extraordinary congress and criticised male political rivals as cowardly. The congress elected other officials, including Obert Gutu, Nixon Nyikadzino, Abedinico Bhebhe, Samukele Hadebe, Chief Ndlovu, Yvonne Msarurwa, Linda Masarira, Dorothy Ncube, Fungai Masaiti, and Isabel Mwonzora. Khupe defended Masarira's election. Khupe and allies dispute Nelson Chamisa's leadership after Morgan Tsvangirai's death. Chamisa sought a High Court interdict; judgment was reserved. Zimbabwe Electoral Commission says such disputes must be resolved by courts before nomination day.

Walmart introduced a US benefit letting Walmart and Sam’s Club workers pay $1 a day for an associate’s or bachelor’s degree in business or supply chain management, with Walmart covering remaining tuition, fees, and books. Employees become eligible after 90 days, including part-time, full-time, and salaried workers, and must attend one of three online universities. Through Guild Education, they get coaching and credits for some paid trainings. About 1.4 million workers are eligible.

The passage explains that defensive ends are a prioritized defensive position because of football’s emphasis on passing and the need to disrupt offenses. They line up on the line of scrimmage at the end of formations and are responsible for stopping the run, pressuring the quarterback, recording sacks, batting down passes, hurrying the quarterback, and ripping the football loose. They need strength, quickness, recognition, consistent technique, and a lengthy, big, athletic build around 6’3–6’7 and 270–290 pounds. The passage names Reggie White, Bruce Smith, and Dwight Freeney as some of the best defensive ends ever and says elite defensive ends can impact every play and let defenses pressure passers without blitzing as often.

The passage describes the assembly and editing of Inquiry material on fisheries, natural resources, populations, commerce, economic and military geography, strategic frontiers, international law, economics, and Russo-German commercial relations, with reports due from January to mid-February; editing will digest it into briefs, and costs will cover non-voluntary workers, clerical help, and stationery. It includes a missing Lippmann memorandum on reconstruction and a December 22, 1917 memorandum on war aims and peace terms. That memorandum says Allied opportunities against Middle Europe left the Russian army no longer offensive, Rumania, Serbia, and Montenegro occupied, Austrian and German forces deep into Italian territory, and invasion of Austria-Hungary no longer possible. It states Saloniki is held but unusable offensively; Bagdad, Palestine, and Arabia’s separation removed threats to India, Suez, and the Red Sea and denied Germany Berlin-Bagdad terminals, while if Saloniki, Jerusalem, Bagdad, and Arabia remain non-German, defense possibilities against the Bagdad scheme exist.

A bride-to-be’s father bought $10,000 in bitcoin at $4,000 each to help pay for her Indiana wedding; as bitcoin reached $16,000, it now covers the whole wedding, extras, and a bridal shower, paid through a BitPay card since vendors do not accept bitcoin. The passage also notes bitcoin’s move into mainstream use, warnings about volatility and risk, and some investors’ belief in bitcoin and blockchain potential.

Utah County hired former federal defender Kathryn N. Nester to represent Tyler James Robinson, 22, accused of fatally shooting Charlie Kirk at Utah Valley University; Robinson could face the death penalty. The contract is expected to cost $750,000 over the next year, with about $600,000 expected for increased prosecution expenses, and a commissioner said taxpayers will fund over $1 million in unwanted costs.

After two poor games, the team won two at home, with the fourth and third lines each winning one. The top two lines must continue defensively. Now moving the puck better and playing like on the road, they need more scoring chances, smart defense, and no risks.

DNA tests by AncestryDNA found Britons may have about 16,000 relatives, with the North West averaging 20,000 up to eighth cousins, though most polled thought they had six cousins. Figures marked DNA Day.

The passage also covers documentation updates, support resources, trademarks, ESD caution, revision history, mechanical/packaging/orderable information, and legal notices.

The President addresses Congress on the state of the Union, framing his message around Lincoln’s faith that right makes might. He says this faith can lift the world from confusion, won the war against Germany, and is Democracy’s mission, now under final test against autocracy. The United States should lead by example at home and by standing for right and justice toward nations, especially protecting weak nations. He urges a workable budget system with a single appropriations body cooperating with the departments and Treasury, and asks Congress to pass the revised budget bill. He reports improved finances: receipts rose, expenditures and public debt fell, banks held fewer war securities, and the Treasury withdrew from the domestic credit market. He notes $7.5 billion of war debt matures within two and a half years and urges economy, salvage, adequate taxation, and retirement of floating debt. He calls for simplifying income and profits taxes, care and training for sick and disabled veterans, and action on dyestuffs and chemicals, agriculture, rural life, cold storage regulation, price labeling for interstate goods, and federal licenses for interstate corporations. He suggests a loan to Armenia under U.S. supervision and says the Philippines have met the condition for independence. He closes by confessing faith in America and the future.

The passage covers SEV-ES and SEV-SNP, which protect guest register state from the hypervisor, and the Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) used for communication during Non-Automatic Exits (NAEs). It states the document standardizes the GHCB memory area, required NAEs, minimum guest state, and special support such as NMI handling and SMP booting. It describes the GHCB as 4 KB, decrypted, page-aligned, mapped via MSR 0xc001_0130 and VMCB offset 0xa0, with a format mirroring the SEV-ES VMCB save state. It details Version 2 hypervisor feature advertisement and revisions 2.01 through 2.04, including 64-bit guest request sequence numbers, VLEK GUID, APIC ID list, VMPL execution, page state change support, SEV-TIO, Secure AVIC, and related protocol additions. It also covers GHCB MSR protocol requests and responses, GHCB GPA registration and unregistration, the Secrets Page Guest Reserved Area, EFI SNP Confidential Computing Blob configuration table, NAE event handling, VALID_BITMAP, error reporting via SW_EXITINFO1 and SW_EXITINFO2, and Page State Change.

Lasik is a common eye surgery for correcting bad eyesight. In Dubai, it can eliminate the need for glasses or contact lenses. It is described as pain-free, with immediate vision results, no bandages or stitches, and most activities resumable within 24 hours after consulting a surgeon. It also reduces expenses related to eye check-ups, glasses, and contact lenses.

On August 21, the “Great American Eclipse” will cross America from Portland, Oregon, to Charleston, South Carolina, with a partial eclipse elsewhere. It has been 99 years since a total solar eclipse crossed from the Pacific to the Atlantic. The moon will pass between the sun and Earth, blocking the sun for almost an hour and a half.

The Zipper offense is excellent for freeing up good shooters and is unique because a down screen takes place on the ball side of the floor. It creates opportunities for shooters, isolations for point dribble penetration, strong post ups, quick ball reversal, and weakside attack. It roots back to the 1960s Celtics and is contained in almost every NBA team’s playbook. Ball handler O1 initiates by dribbling to either wing as shooters O2 and O3 break high off O4’s and O5’s down screens. Once on the wing, the point can turn the corner and drive, pass to the shooter coming off the down screen, or feed the screener posting up low. The passage covers phases including point isolation and dribble penetration, proper execution of down screens, posting up strong, ball reversal, and offensive rebounding. It lists continuity options and variations such as Curl, Blocks, Back, and sideline out of bounds. Game strategy includes scouting opponents, knowing reads and counters, and using various alignments and entries. Installing the offense depends on execution, coordination, down-screen preparation, drills, and individual skill development. Even if teams do not use it, they must be prepared to defend it because it is one of the most used offenses in the game.

The paper addresses “transportation” of theorems about LF specifications: lifting properties proved relative to one regularly structured typing context to contexts with a different structure. It builds on the subordination relation for dropping irrelevant variables, extends this analysis to properties relating multiple typing judgements, and considers swapping families of contexts defined by context schemas. Formalized in the logic L_LF, the work develops context schema subsumption and a sound proof rule for theorem transportation, discusses integration into the Adelfa proof assistant, and presents examples.
Neuman sought certiorari from an order denying his challenge to the Board of Adjustment's refusal of a variance to complete a fence/wall; certiorari denied.

Amazon has introduced Chime, a UC service combining voice, video, chat, and online meetings, entering a crowded market with competitors including Adobe, Cisco, Google, Microsoft, AT&T, Verizon, and pure-play vendors. Chime provides high-fidelity calls and group conferences for up to 100 people, screen sharing, recording, native apps, calendar integration, and cross-platform meeting switching.

Coaches should first address the context of soccer tackling, including general concepts, Law 12 rules on legal and illegal contact, and referee interpretations. Legal tackling is a defender’s attempt or action to take the ball from an opponent where any contact does not violate Law 12; the tackler must conduct the tackle safely. Tackles can occur anywhere, and a foul may result in a direct free kick, possible booking, or a penalty kick if in the defender’s penalty area. Tackle choice depends on player positions, ball location, field location, and circumstances. A defensive process includes marking, staying goal-side, delaying, containing, communicating, and tackling when directed or when an opportunity arises. Law 12 addresses careless, reckless, or excessive-force challenges, with sanctions including direct free kicks, yellow cards, or red cards/ejection for serious foul play. Legal contact includes shoulder-to-shoulder fair charges with at least one foot on the ground and no excessive force; fair tackles generally contact the ball first. Illegal contact includes improper charges, jumps, kicks, pushes, strikes, tackles or challenges, trips, or challenges when the ball is not within playing distance. Referees observe defenders before, during, and after tackles, including proximity, legitimate attempt to play the ball, force, angle, and danger. Guidelines include not tackling from behind, not going in with studs up, ensuring the ball can be won, keeping one foot grounded, using proper timing and accuracy, and recovering quickly. Instruction covers front block, intermediate, and slide tackles, with coaching tips on fatigue, communication, avoiding illegal or injurious actions, and drills.

Researchers developed MeTro, a highly elastic surgical glue made from a natural elastic protein by an international team from the University of Sydney and the United States. It can seal wounds in 60 seconds with UV light, works on internal wounds and expanding/contracting tissues, and was tested on rodents and pigs. Its built-in degrading enzyme is adjustable; clinical testing is next. Results were published in Science Translational Medicine.

The passage notes a proposal that the Organization be located in an internationalized district comprising part or all of the Free Zone of the Pays de Gex and the section of the Canton of Geneva containing the League of Nations buildings, with references to 1944 discussions and documents. Apple Inc.’s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended September 26, 2020 describes its business, products, services, markets, competition, supply chain, research and development, intellectual property, employees and risk factors, including COVID-19 impacts. It reports 2020 total net sales of $274,515 million, net income of $57,411 million, basic earnings per share of $3.31 and diluted earnings per share of $3.28. A 12-year-old South Jersey girl, Charlotte Olson, collected 1,303 books and delivered them to Cooper University Health System for the Read and Reach Out program. She gathered over 2,000 books through donation centers and raised $250 for new books. The program, established in 1998, gives books to patients.

The President states that the Constitution requires him to recommend measures and report on the Union. He reports domestic prosperity and notes the recent selection of the President and Vice-President. He says the people have affirmed the constitutional equality of the States and citizens, the inviolability of sectional constitutional rights, attachment to the Union and Constitution, and condemnation of geographical parties.

He discusses sectional controversy over slavery: Northern agitation for emancipation, State laws obstructing extradition of persons held to service, territorial restrictions, the repeal of the geographical line in the Kansas-Nebraska act, and Supreme Court decisions that Congress cannot impose such restrictions on States. He says the repeal did not open the Territories to slavery but removed an unconstitutional enactment. In Kansas, disorder and violence occurred, including outside intervention, but peace has been restored without bloodshed by United States forces. He says the President has no power over local elections.

On finances, he reports Treasury receipts and expenditures, a reduced public debt, and recommends reducing customs revenue and revising revenue laws. The Army has been employed against hostile Indians and needs legislation and increased efficiency. The Navy is satisfactory and improving, with a recommended increase. The Interior reports public land sales and surveys. The Post-Office Department has a deficit and depends in part on the Treasury; he commends consideration of abolishing the franking privilege and mail steamship lines.

Foreign relations remain amicable. With Great Britain, he discusses Central American and fishery treaties, a fishery commission, and increased trade. Negotiations with Denmark over Sound dues continue, with payments under protest. No progress is reported with Spain on Cuba. On maritime rights, the United States submitted neutral-commerce principles; the Paris declaration includes abolishing privateering and effective blockades, and the United States is ready to accede if private property at sea is exempted from capture. Russia and France favor this modification. Regarding Latin America, Mexico has not redressed complaints; Nicaragua’s government is uncertain; New Granada has imposed tonnage and mail taxes and a Panama riot led the United States to demand indemnity, station naval forces, and seek security.

He concludes with congratulations on peace and prosperity and prepares to surrender the Executive trust.

U.S. Treasury yields fell after Trump said he wants low interest rates and the dollar was “getting too strong”; the 10-year yield hit a five-month low and was set for its sharpest weekly drop since October 2015. The dollar initially slumped, then rebounded. A flatter yield curve hurt bank stocks, and European shares fell. Asian shares rose on strong Chinese trade data and Trump saying the U.S. would not name China a currency manipulator. Trump also said he would not rule out re-nominating Yellen. Oil recovered; gold hovered near a five-month high.

Cover 3 remains prominent at all levels despite a rise in 2-high, split-field coverages. It affects passing reads, allows pre-snap disguise, pressures QBs, and can add run defenders. Cover 3 uses four underneath droppers and three deep defenders, with the FS in the middle, making it MOFC. It takes away posts and vertical routes, forces throws to flats or over the middle, and can add a box defender. Its weaknesses are seams and flats. Offenses attack it with quick game, RPOs, and flood concepts, exploiting the flat defender’s run/pass conflict through outs, hitches, slant/flat, dig/whip, and RPO reads. Other answers include 4 verticals with comebacks and looking off the FS, plus flood/sail concepts. Examples include Dagger, Boot TB Flat X Quick Out, Square Out-Seam, PA Power Y Cross Z Curl, and Z Orbit Pump Fake Bubble Post-Wheel.

The NR7 is a narrow-range volatility strategy, first developed by Tony Crabel in 1990, that enters on low-volatility days. A SPY backtest since 1993 produced a 7.8% CAGR, 0.27% average gain per trade, 899 trades, and 25% max drawdown. Adding one undisclosed parameter raised average gain to 0.46% and reduced drawdown to 13%, with fewer trades and a high win rate; 67% of improved-strategy trades occurred when the close was higher than the previous day. The strategy may add diversification because it does not necessarily buy on weakness.

The passage examines the 2008 global financial crisis, its causes, consequences, blame, and proposed responses. The collapse of the U.S. housing market triggered the crisis, leading to lost wealth, frozen credit markets, and bank insolvency. Contributing factors discussed include deregulation, derivatives such as mortgage-backed securities and credit default swaps, close ties between Wall Street and Washington, and a growing global pool of money seeking investment. Greed, fear, and a banking “oligarchy” are also cited. By 2009, markets had stabilized somewhat; stress tests found 10 of 19 large banks needed $75 billion in new capital, and the government used TARP and the Public Private Investment Program. Debate continued over blame and solutions. Simon Johnson advocated a systematic government-managed restructuring or receivership and breaking up large banks, while Andrew Lo proposed more effective regulation, transparency, risk accounting, corporate governance changes, and finance education reforms.

This paper presents a new Nd i/Nd ii model atom for NLTE abundance analysis in FGK stars. The atom was built from experimental atomic data, tested on the Sun and HD222925, and calibrated for hydrogen collisions, with SH = 0.1. Tests with added theoretical Nd ii levels showed negligible effects on NLTE corrections. The study applies the model to metal-poor stars, finding NLTE corrections up to ±0.3 dex for optical and H-band lines. A grid of corrections for 122 Nd ii lines was generated over FGK parameter space; corrections range from −0.3 to +0.5 dex and depend on stellar parameters, wavelength, excitation potential, and Nd abundance. Optical corrections are generally positive for metal-poor giants, while NIR H-band corrections are negative. Corrections tend to decrease with increasing Nd abundance. The paper recommends 1D NLTE corrections over LTE for r-process abundance analyses, especially for metal-poor giants, and suggests using higher-excitation lines. It also discusses implications for r-process studies and future work on more neutron-capture species and broader parameter ranges.

At a Toronto rally, Ontario Progressive Conservative Leader Doug Ford told nearly 2,000 supporters he plans to “take back this province” and believes he can form a majority government because voters dislike Liberal Premier Kathleen Wynne. The passage specifies the SEV-ES/SEV-SNP Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB), a 4 KB decrypted page mapped by the guest for guest-hypervisor communication. Its format mirrors the SEV-ES VMCB save state area through offset 0x3ff, but only required fields are listed to limit exposed guest state. SEV-SNP introduces a new GHCB protocol version and hypervisor feature advertisement. Version 2 and revisions add XSS MSR in CPUID 0xd, SW_SCRATCH shared area, restricted APIC emulation, 64-bit guest request sequence numbers, VLEK GUID, SW_EXITINFO2 error codes, APIC ID list, multiple VMPL levels, SEV-ES page state change, EFI blob protocol, SEV-TIO, Secure AVIC, debug support, and unsupported-MSR behavior.

The GHCB GPA is guest-specified, 4K aligned, saved/restored via VMCB offset 0xa0 and MSR 0xc001_0130. The GHCB MSR protocol uses lower 12 bits for requests/responses, including hypervisor feature support, CPUID, AP reset hold, GHCB GPA registration/unregistration, page state change, Run VMPL, and termination. NAE events use #VC and VMGEXIT, with VALID_BITMAP, SW_EXITCODE/INFO fields, and error codes; specific events include IOIO_PROT, MSR_PROT, VMMCALL, #NPF/MMIO, Page State Change, SNP Guest Request/Extended Guest Request, AP Creation, #HV doorbell, Send IPI, Timer, APIC ID List, Secure AVIC, SEV-TIO, and Termination. The passage also covers the Secrets Page, EFI protocol, #HV doorbell/interrupt handling, and states that SMM and nested virtualization are not supported.

In July 2020, the NHL and NHLPA negotiated a return-to-play plan for the pandemic-interrupted 2019-20 season and an extension of the CBA through 2025-26. The CBA governs league operations and revenue sharing. The 2013 CBA ended a 113-day lockout and established that player compensation would equal 50% of league revenue, with payments to players or clawbacks from salaries depending on revenue and compensation. Measuring league revenue and player compensation was important and negotiable. For the 2020 CBA, Emilie Castonguay represented players and Gary Bettman represented owners. James Johnson was indicted for the murder of J. A. Johnson, convicted, and sentenced to life imprisonment; his motion for a new trial was refused, and he excepted. The court found no error in rejecting objections to jurors who had been stricken or disqualified at a former trial, since no sufficient cause was shown. Evidence that Johnson spoke before the homicide about his father’s life insurance and after the killing asked a witness to examine his father’s papers and explain how to get insurance money was admissible to show Johnson’s statements, impression, and possible motive. The court also found no error in charging that, while Johnson admitted a killing and murder, he denied being the guilty person. Other grounds of the motion were rejected, and the verdict was supported by the evidence. Judgment affirmed.

An NPR/Marist poll finds 1 in 5 U.S. jobs is held by a contract worker, and contractors and freelancers could make up half the workforce within a decade. NPR explores this change. Scientists report creating hybrid embryos from frozen northern white rhino sperm and southern white rhino eggs, a first, as a possible way to save the northern white rhino after the last male died. They plan to harvest eggs from the two surviving females and use preserved sperm to produce pure embryos, implanting them in southern white rhino surrogates, and are also working on making eggs from frozen skin cells. They hope for a calf in about three years. Some conservationists criticize the effort as too late and say funding should target other endangered rhinos.
