The volume documents the intellectual foundations and themes of Reagan administration foreign policy, rather than specific decisions or diplomatic exchanges, using a sampling of public and internal records across eight years. It addresses themes such as resetting U.S. foreign policy after Vietnam, Watergate, and the Iran hostage crisis; promoting a world hospitable to U.S. values; activist bipartisanship; and a U.S.-Soviet relationship based on restraint and reciprocity. It focuses on Reagan, Bush, Haig, Shultz, national security advisers, Weinberger, Kirkpatrick, and State/NSC officials. Footnotes identify document sources, classifications, distribution, drafting, background, and whether Reagan or advisers read them. Editorial notes and annotations summarize unprinted material, cite related sources, describe events, and cite public statements; memoirs and first-hand accounts supplement the record. Index numbers refer to document numbers. The Advisory Committee on Historical Diplomatic Documentation monitors the series’ compilation and editorial process and advises on preparation and declassification. Declassification review under Executive Order 13526 sought release subject to national security, with concurrence from relevant bureaus, agencies, and foreign governments; the 2018–2022 review withheld 0 documents fully, excised a paragraph or more in 0, and made minor excisions in 3.

This study examined serum cardiac troponin T (cTnT) and respiratory dysfunction in ALS across a Bonn discovery cohort (nd=297) and Essen validation cohort (nv=49). Serum cTnT was elevated in 65.0% of the discovery cohort and 47.0% of the validation cohort. cTnT correlated negatively with total ALSFRSr and its respiratory domain, and with FVC, SVC, FEV1, and PEF; SVC and ALSFRSr respiratory-domain associations were recapitulated in the validation cohort. NfL correlated with total ALSFRSr but not the respiratory domain. ROC analyses showed cTnT could detect SVC/FVC below 80% and PEF below 75%, with cutoffs between 14.00 and 17.80 ng/l. The authors conclude serum cTnT may be repurposed as an ALS biomarker for respiratory capacity, independent of neurofilaments, while noting observational limitations and that correlation does not establish causality.

Ryshonda Harper Beechem became Pelahatchie, Mississippi’s first black mayor in June 2017, winning a no-runoff election by 12 votes. She has struggled with the Board of Aldermen, which has changed rules, cut salaries, made hires without consulting her, and often overridden her vetoes. In February, the board cut her salary by 75% and halved its own, making each $250 monthly, citing budget cuts. Beechem vetoed the pay cut and expressed no confidence in the board amid a state auditor’s investigation into alleged misappropriation. Three town clerks resigned in early 2018, and a clerk appointment dispute followed. Her relationship with the board is publicly hostile; she publishes vetoes on Facebook, the board often overturns them, and residents debate the town’s finances, her professionalism, and possible racism. The board also banned cellphones at meetings; Beechem vetoed that, and the board upheld the veto. Pelahatchie is in Rankin County, part of the Jackson metro area, which has seen white and economic flight from Jackson.

The study prospectively investigated the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on health-related quality of life (HRQOL) among head and neck cancer (HNC) survivors using NET-QUBIC data. Survivors who completed PROMs at 24 and 36 months after treatment before or during the pandemic were compared. Overall, there were no statistically significant differences in change in PROMs between the groups. For 31 of 46 PROMs, factors were identified that showed different effects of the pandemic on HRQOL change. After stratification, the most important factors were gender, living status, treatment modality, comorbidity, cancer progression status, lifetime major depressive disorder, and BMI. The passage concludes that the course of HRQOL between 24 and 36 months after treatment was not affected by the pandemic in general, but the pandemic changed the course of some HRQOL domains or symptoms in some subgroups.

Women make up only 11 percent of the information security workforce, and despite higher education, they are underrepresented across technology. Modular construction replaces traditional construction with standardized 3D units manufactured off-site and assembled on-site, creating challenges for building layout design and mass customization. Text-based input has been adopted for early design interaction, but extending it to modular building layout (MBL) is difficult due to the module concept, and direct BIM output remains underexplored. To address this, Text2MBL is proposed as a framework that translates textual descriptions into BIM-based MBLs through fine-grained, action-level code over sequential time steps. It hierarchically structures MBL into Modules, Unit, Room, and Utils classes and was implemented as a proof-of-concept in Autodesk Revit using the Revit API in C#. The action-based sequential representation bridges textual descriptions and BIM-compatible formats, abstracts geometric and spatial computations, and frames the task as sequence-to-sequence generation. The authors curated data pairing textual descriptions with action-based BIM code from real-world housing projects and fine-tuned Qwen2.5 large language models. Evaluation covered executable validity, semantic fidelity, and geometric consistency. Contributions include formalizing BIM-based MBLs, validating feasibility through a Revit implementation, constructing a text-to-BIM-code dataset, and demonstrating effectiveness by fine-tuning large language models.

The article describes common football pass routes from high school to the pros and explains the route tree as a coaching tool for organizing and teaching pass routes. Paralyzed Veterans of America thanked Deputy Secretary Tom Bowman for his service and wished him well in retirement. A Markov model in Brazil compared Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection screening and TB preventive treatment (TPT) with no screening among formerly incarcerated individuals. The passage reports a computational study comparing abrupt versus continuous collagen fiber architectures in a three-dimensional representative volume element with wall thickness varying from 100 to 200 μm under uniaxial tensile loading. Both networks maintained an overall collagen volume density of 35.5%, but local density differed. In the abrupt network, thin regions showed higher average stretch and stress than thick regions; in the continuous network, stretch and stress gradients were substantially reduced, and fiber stresses were more uniform. The percent difference in stretch between thick and thin regions decreased from 20% with abrupt fibers to 0.68% with continuous fibers at λ=1.5. Local fiber density was approximately uniform in the abrupt model but higher in the thin region than the thick region in the continuous model. Fiber tortuosity, controlled by recruitment stretch, modulated deformation: before fiber recruitment, geometry dominated and stretch disparities occurred in both architectures; after recruitment, disparities decreased, though they could re-emerge at higher stretches in the abrupt network. The authors state the results challenge the view that stress heterogeneity is largely determined by geometry and highlight collagen microstructure once fibers are recruited. They suggest constant-thickness models may provide reasonably accurate predictions for tissues with confirmed fiber continuity when local thickness data are unavailable. Limitations include idealized geometry and boundary conditions, focus on two idealized fiber architecture extremes, and lack of experimental validation.

Asteroid 2025 TF, about 1 to 3 meters wide, passed over Antarctica on October 1 at 00:47:26 UTC ± 18 seconds, coming within 428 ± 7 km of Earth, similar to the International Space Station’s orbit. It was detected by the Catalina Sky Survey hours after the flyby and posed no danger. ESA’s Planetary Defence Office observed it with the Las Cumbres Observatory in Australia, confirming its distance and timing with precision. Small asteroids of this size are harmless, often creating fireballs or small meteorites. Larger objects, such as 20-meter asteroids, can cause local damage, while hundreds-of-meter asteroids pose greater risk. Global observatories monitor near-Earth objects, and this flyby tested detection and prediction systems.

A solar eclipse will occur Aug. 21 across the United States. A partial eclipse will be visible widely, while a roughly 70-mile-wide path will see totality. The moon blocks the sun when the Earth, sun and moon align; eclipses do not occur monthly because the moon’s orbit is tilted about five degrees. Totality reaches Oregon between Newport and Lincoln City at 10:16 a.m. PT (1:16 ET), moves across the country at varying speeds, and ends at 2:49 p.m. ET off the Atlantic coast. Those outside totality will see 20% to 99% coverage. During totality, the sky darkens, stars appear and the temperature drops; Baily’s Beads and a diamond-ring effect occur. Viewing requires eclipse glasses except during totality; glasses should comply with ISO 12312-2. NASA will livestream, and weather and photography are addressed. The next eclipse is July 2, 2019, and the next U.S. one is April 8, 2024.

This randomized controlled superiority trial compared radial extracorporeal shock wave therapy (rESWT) plus a specific rehabilitation program (RP) with sham rESWT plus RP in athletes with acute hamstring muscle complex injury type 3b. Forty patients were randomized; after retrospective exclusion of four patients with lesions smaller than 5 mm, 36 were analyzed as the modified Intent-to-Treat population. The primary outcome was time to return to sport. Median/mean return to sport was 25.5/25.4 ± 3.5 days in the rESWT + RP group and 27.5/28.3 ± 4.5 days in the sham rESWT + RP group, a statistically significant difference (p = 0.037). Patient satisfaction at six months did not differ significantly (p = 0.145), and re-injury rates at six months also showed no significant difference (p > 0.999). The study concluded that, for acute hamstring muscle complex injury type 3b, rESWT plus the specific RP was more effective than the RP alone, and the RP alone was superior to other rehabilitation programs described in the literature.

In Jane Richmond v. Walter M. Richmond, the court granted a divorce for adultery and placed the children under the complainant’s care. The master estimated the defendant’s estate at $19,060 at filing and recommended $872 annually total: $390 for the complainant’s alimony and $482 for three children. The defendant excepted, arguing the allowances were too large. The chancellor stated there is no fixed general rule for alimony; each case depends on its circumstances. The allowance is not to be graduated solely by current rents and profits or by the complainant’s actual wants, and the defendant’s property must be estimated at the date of the master’s report, not the filing of the bill. Children placed with the mother should be fully maintained according to the father’s condition in life, without imposing a pecuniary burden on the mother. The court also indicated it could vary alimony upon changed circumstances. Considering new evidence, reduced property estimates, larger debts, and the homestead life interest, the court reduced the allowances. The final decree ordered the defendant to pay the complainant $250 annually for her support and maintenance, and $390 annually for the children’s care, maintenance, education, and clothing, payable half-yearly, with security, a lien on his property, and sequestration or other process on default. The defendant was also ordered to pay costs. Either party could apply for modification upon future changed circumstances.

Point-of-care lung ultrasound (LUS) has been proposed for evaluating COVID-19 pneumonia. This prospective cohort enrolled 264 hospitalized adults with SARS-CoV-2 who had LUS and used a mean LUS score (mLUSS) across available lung zones. The study examined baseline LUS findings and subsequent oxygen support requirements or death. Each point increase in mLUSS was associated with progression to ICU-level care and 28-day mortality, but not the composite outcome of ventilation or death. A lines were associated with decreased risk of ICU-level care and 28-day mortality. B lines were associated with 28-day mortality; pleural abnormalities were associated with mechanical ventilation plus death and death. The authors conclude individual LUS findings and mLUSS across available lung zones are associated with ultimate oxygen requirement or death, independent of illness duration.

An international team found alien species numbers are increasing globally without saturation. Over the last 200 years, established alien species grew continuously, with more than a third of first introductions recorded between 1970 and 2014. Trends differ by taxonomic group due to human activities, but all groups increase. The study used over 45,000 first records of more than 16,000 species; 37% were introduced in 1970–2014, peaking at 585 in 1996. The team says numbers are underestimated and past laws have not been effective, urging stronger prevention policies.

This study reports that in routine community-based care of advanced cancer patients, precision therapies (targeted and immunotherapy) overtook traditional cytotoxic treatments and resulted in better overall survival. At Providence, a pathologist-directed protocol initiated a single 523-gene DNA/RNA comprehensive genomic profiling (CGP) assay at diagnosis for advanced solid tumor patients, at no cost, between September 2019 and November 2021. Of 3,216 patients, median turnaround time was 14 days. Overall, 49% had at least one guideline-based actionable biomarker. CGP matched 53% to basket trial arms versus 26% with an in silico 50-gene panel, and 67% versus 33% harbored actionable mutations. Among 1,482 patients with documented follow-up and treatment, 54% with an appropriate IO biomarker received IO or IO plus chemotherapy; 59% of TT-positive patients received targeted therapy; 63% of IO-positive patients received immunotherapy with or without chemotherapy; 32% received chemotherapy alone. Median overall survival was 25 months for targeted therapy versus 17 months for chemotherapy only (HR 0.66, p<0.001, adjusted for age and tumor type). In NSCLC, median overall survival was 26 versus 16 months (HR 0.55, p=0.032).

FoLix is described as the first FDA-cleared fractional laser of its kind for hair loss, offered as an in-office, noninvasive alternative to hair transplants and daily medications. It creates microscopic channels in the scalp to trigger a healing response, boost circulation, and deliver growth signals to existing hair follicles. Sessions take 20–30 minutes with no anesthesia and little to no downtime, but treatment requires three to six sessions in the first year and up to twice yearly maintenance, at $750–$1,250 per session. It is best suited to early-to-moderate hair loss with intact but underperforming follicles, not complete baldness or extensive scarring. Side effects can include temporary redness, tightness, scalp sensitivity, and shedding; patients should consult a doctor about hair loss.

The passage reports a qualitative case study on the views of visually impaired students in professional music education regarding distance education during COVID-19. The study used semi-structured interviews with seven visually impaired students in Turkish music departments, reached through a communication network, and analyzed data by content analysis. Findings show courses were mostly synchronous, though some were asynchronous or followed asynchronously due to health or system issues. Participants used computers, phones, and tablets. Course documents were often deemed insufficient, absent, or not designed for special needs; assessment varied between individual and general arrangements. Strengths included spatial and temporal flexibility and social acceptance, while some saw no strengths. Weaknesses included low productivity, technical deficiencies in music-related sound synchronization and simultaneous singing/playing, and teachers’ technological incompetence. Suggestions included longer lessons, audio conversion of written documents, regular help, accessible software and systems, screen-size adjustments, Braille notation/archive, alternative programs, and constructive teacher attitudes. The conclusion states that distance education already has weaknesses in music education and poses additional challenges for visually impaired students; screen-dependent processes are inaccessible, students’ special needs are often ignored, and access may depend on parents, friends, or large print. It recommends assistive technologies such as screen readers, speech recognition/dictation software, Braille printers, audio content, and interactive materials, along with disability-level programs and cooperation.

United States brought action against Hale County, Alabama, its County Commission, and officials under the Voting Rights Act. The three-judge court found Hale County covered by 42 U.S.C. § 1973 and that post-1964 changes from district to at-large election of county commissioners required Section 5 preclearance, which the 1965, 1971, and 1973 enactments did not receive. Those enactments and elections under them were unlawful, but past official actions remained valid until lawful successors were elected. The November 2, 1976 election was to proceed, with commissioners serving provisionally. Defendants were ordered to submit the enactments to the Attorney General; if objected to, they could seek declaratory judgment in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia; absent action or upon unfavorable determination, a prompt district election was to be held. The court retained jurisdiction. In a supplement, the court held that Alabama’s designation covered all its political subdivisions, including Hale County.

NVIDIA Ampere GA10x GPUs feature double-speed FP32 processing by enabling FP32 on both SM datapaths, doubling peak FP32 rate; GeForce RTX 3090 delivers over 35 FP32 TFLOPS, over 2x Turing. Second-generation RT Cores deliver up to 2x performance improvement over Turing RT Cores and allow RT Core and graphics or compute workloads concurrently. Third-generation Tensor Cores support new data types, TF32, BFloat16, and Sparsity, doubling sparse throughput and providing up to 5X training throughput. GDDR6X and GDDR6 memory offer high bandwidth; RTX A6000 and A40 use 48 GB GDDR6, scalable to 96 GB via NVLink. Third-generation NVLink has four x4 links, 56.25 GB/sec per direction, 112.5 GB/sec total between two GPUs. PCIe Gen 4 doubles PCIe 3.0 bandwidth. GA102 contains GPCs, TPCs, SMs, ROPs, and memory controllers; ROPs are part of the GPC. GA10x SMs have 128 CUDA Cores, four third-generation Tensor Cores, one second-generation RT Core, 128 KB L1/Shared Memory, and support FP16. The second-generation RT engine adds motion blur acceleration, including Interpolate Triangle Position. Tensor Cores accelerate AI denoising, DLSS, NVIDIA Broadcast, and NVIDIA Canvas. GDDR6X uses PAM4 signaling and reaches up to 19.5 Gbps and 936 GB/sec. RTX IO enables GPU-based loading and decompression with DirectStorage. A40 is for data center visual computing; A6000 is for desktop workstations. GA10x supports display technologies, fifth-generation NVDEC including AV1 decode, seventh-generation NVENC, and EDR for GDDR6X overclocking. The passage also includes performance comparisons for RTX 3080, RTX 3090, RTX 3070, RTX A6000, and A40.

The passage reports that GM-CSF and CRP are involved in the hyperinflammatory response to SARS-CoV-2, and baseline GM-CSF and CRP correlate with COVID-19 progression. In the LIVE-AIR phase 3 trial, lenzilumab improved survival without invasive mechanical ventilation compared with placebo. Analysis of LIVE-AIR CRP data found baseline CRP was the strongest predictor of SWOV and predictive of progression to IMV or death. Patients with baseline CRP<150 mg/L represented 78% of the study population and had the greatest clinical benefit with lenzilumab, including improved SWOV and secondary outcomes. Participants with CRP≥150 mg/L did not show similar benefit. Lenzilumab was well tolerated with no attributable serious adverse events. The authors suggest baseline CRP may be a useful biomarker for determining which participants may be most successfully treated with lenzilumab. Limitations include post-hoc analyses that were not prospectively powered.

Institutional investing was not as predictable as expected; boards and investment committees proved imperfect, often lacking investment training. This led to a five-year PhD study of asset-owner governance—pensions, foundations, and endowments—after finding little reliable governance data. Among 35 public pension plans representing about 14.5% of industry assets, 2008–2012 five-year annualized returns ranged from 15% to -4.2%; the S&P 500 averaged 1.4% and a 60/40 balanced index about 4.5%, with more than half below average. Governance—codified, structured group investor behavior—was linked to behavioral gaps; behavioral biases affect trustees, and behavior drives choices and outcomes. Key factors included institutional knowledge, turnover, professionalism, board composition, engagement, staff, diligence, meeting frequency, retired members, and delegation to staff or consultants. Investment expenses and required contribution rate were not statistically significant. The main finding was that governance influences investment performance: top-quintile Fiduciary Effectiveness Quotient plans outperformed the bottom fifth nearly 2 to 1, and each FEQ unit improvement added 0.36% over five years, persisting with a one-year lag. Good governance drives results and can be measured.

Ray tracing is computationally intensive. Turing GPU-based ray tracing can render physically correct reflections, refractions, shadows, and indirect lighting in real time. Previously, single GPUs could not perform real-time ray tracing, so games relied on rasterization. Real-time GPU ray tracing required nearly 10 years of NVIDIA collaboration and RT Cores.

This cross-sectional study assessed knowledge, attitude, and practice (KAP) of contraception among female students of NTA TV College, Nigeria. Among 217 participants with an average age of 22 years, good knowledge, attitude, and practice levels were 55.3%, 47.5%, and 50.7%, respectively. About 74% had ever had sex. Main contraceptive information sources were friends and the internet; commonly used contraceptives were condoms and oral contraceptive pills. The commonest reason for non-use was fear of side effects or health risks. Being a young adult significantly predicted good knowledge. Being a diploma student, living off-campus, and good knowledge significantly predicted good attitude. Being from the state’s indigenous population and ever engaging in sex significantly predicted good contraceptive use. The study concluded that KAP levels were relatively low and called for improved advocacy, policies, and sexual and reproductive health services for young people.

This study translated and cross-culturally adapted the Waterloo Footedness Questionnaire-Revised (WFQ-R) into Arabic (WFQ-Ar) and examined its measurement properties. The adaptation followed Beaton and colleagues’ guidelines, using forward translation, synthesis, back translation, expert committee review, and pilot testing. A total of 320 participants were included, with 30 in pilot testing and 290 Arabic speakers completing the WFQ-Ar twice, one week apart.

The adaptation required only minor changes, including rewording one item and replacing answering-grid abbreviations with words. Face and content validity were supported by participant interviews and expert committee consensus; no floor or ceiling effects were found. Factor analysis indicated one factor with an eigenvalue greater than one, explaining 55.79% of variance after extraction, with item loadings from 0.56 to 0.82. Internal consistency was excellent (Cronbach’s α = 0.93), and test-retest reliability was excellent (ICC = 0.94), with a standard error of measurement of 4.5 points. The WFQ-Ar correlated significantly with the single foot-dominance question (r = 0.48, p < 0.001).

The authors concluded that the WFQ-Ar is a valid and reliable measure for determining footedness in Arabic-speaking populations. They noted that participants were Saudi Arabian adult, non-disabled individuals, so formal testing is recommended before use in other Arabic-speaking countries or populations.

The passage describes seasonal trading as regular price patterns at specific times. It says commodities are highly seasonal, and silver tends to rise early in the year; January and July are best, while June and September are worst. A silver seasonal strategy investing only in best-performing months, with periods December–February and July–August, backtested since 2001, outperformed buy and hold by more than 4% annually. It holds silver 5 of 12 months, returns an extra 3.9% per year, improves risk-adjusted return from 7.33% to 26.93%, and reduces maximum drawdown from -71.65% to -23.34%. The passage attributes silver seasonality to industrial users placing orders at the beginning of the new year.

The ADS868xW device includes internal or external 4.096V reference selection via the INTREF_DIS bit, with internal-reference decoupling requirements and an internal buffer for external reference mode. It supports single-ended and differential bipolar/unipolar inputs with straight-binary output and LSB = FSR/2^16. Alarm features include programmable input high/low thresholds with hysteresis and fixed AVDD thresholds of 4.7V and 5.3V, with active and tripped flags. The device has RESET, ACQ, and CONV states and uses a multiSPI interface supporting standard SPI, dual SDO, source-synchronous, and daisy-chain topologies. Programming uses nine configuration registers and data transfer frames. Application information describes an industrial analog input module using the ADS8681W with the MUX36D08. The device uses AVDD and DVDD supplies, supports NAP and power-down modes, and requires specified decoupling and PCB layout practices.

The article previews India’s probable T20I squad for the England series amid injuries and rested players. With the ODIs and T20Is before the Champions Trophy, selectors face a tough task, especially after the Bangalore conditioning camp was cancelled. KL Rahul and Shikhar Dhawan may open, with Mandeep Singh and Rishabh Pant competing. Virat Kohli and MS Dhoni are certainties; Manish Pandey, Karun Nair, Suresh Raina, and Deepak Hooda are possible. With Ashwin, Jadeja, Shami, and Umesh likely rested or injured, Amit Mishra is the lone frontline spinner, while Kuldeep Yadav and Shahbaz Nadeem may get chances. Jasprit Bumrah, Ashish Nehra, and Bhuvneshwar Kumar look set to complete the 15-man squad.

The disclosure relates to video encoding and decoding, particularly converting between SDR and HDR color volumes so one bitstream can be used by SDR and HDR systems. An encoder can receive an HDR master, a reference SDR master, and target SDR display properties; find a color volume transform that converts HDR values into SDR values substantially matching the reference SDR values when target SDR display operations are applied; generate metadata identifying the transform; and encode SDR values into a bitstream. SDR systems can decode and display SDR values, while HDR systems can decode the SDR values and use metadata for an inverse color volume transform to HDR values. Alternatively, an encoder can encode HDR values and provide metadata so SDR systems convert decoded HDR values to SDR values. The transform may be found by evaluating candidate transforms, emulating SDR display operations, and minimizing differences, and may be signaled using parametric tone mapping parameters, scaling factors, 3D-LUTs, or 1D-LUTs.

WSB obtained the city’s first four-month contract with LIHI for Camp Second Chance. It provided $75,000 through last year; LIHI operates the self-managed camp and provides case management. This year’s contract is expected this month. A second-year renewal status was requested, but the reply is not included.

A judge temporarily halted the Trump administration’s federal worker layoffs sparked by the government shutdown. A lawsuit filed by AFSCME and AFGE alleges the administration unlawfully laid off employees during the shutdown and improperly used the shutdown as the basis. Judge Susan Illston issued a temporary restraining order. Thousands face layoffs or furloughs, affecting agencies including Commerce, Education, Energy, Health and Human Services, Housing and Urban Development, Homeland Security, and Treasury. An OMB filing showed between 4,132 and 4,232 workers marked for layoffs, while OMB head Russell Vought said layoffs will total about 10,000. Some CDC workers had termination notices rescinded, but the CDC union said more than 600 remain fired. Furloughed workers are cutting spending, and bridge loans are seeing increased enrollment. The Trump administration can appeal the decision.

Ella Ravenscroft, a 20-year-old model, used sunbeds once or twice a week for two years and later had moles removed after her mother noticed two stomach moles had grown. She was left with scars and is warning about sunbed-related skin cancer risks. She shared before-and-after photos on Facebook and says she will use fake tan instead. The passage also states that sunbed use can raise melanoma risk by 16 to 20 percent; nearly 500 people are diagnosed annually in Greater Manchester, about a fifth of whom die, and changes in a mole’s colour, shape, or texture may be an early sign of melanoma.

Sprint and the Sprint Foundation announced the 1Million Project will connect 180,000 low-income high school students this school year. The five-year program aims to connect 1 million high schoolers lacking home internet. Starting Aug. 15, participants in over 1,300 schools receive a free smartphone, tablet, or hotspot plus 3GB LTE monthly for up to four years. Sprint cited a 3,750-student pilot and will donate about $2.16 billion over five years.

Gulf stock markets mostly fell on May 30 in modest volumes. Qatar’s index dropped 2.3%, led by QNB and QIB on profit-taking after MSCI weighting-related gains. Dubai fell 0.5%, below its level before visa changes were announced, while DXB Entertainments rose 4.1%. Abu Dhabi lost 0.4%, Saudi Arabia edged up 0.1% as Al Tayyar rose after repaying a loan, and Egypt fell 1.4%. Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman also declined slightly.

Hexane is a hydrocarbon organic solvent from crude oil, made of six-carbon hydrocarbons, found in plants and gasoline. Pure hexane is used in laboratories; solvent-based hexane extracts vegetable oils from crops and is used as a cleaning agent and in consumer products. It can cause health effects; OSHA’s permissible exposure limit is 500 ppm. It also removes unwanted taste and odor, supporting edible-oil demand. Asia Pacific, especially China, dominates production and consumption; Europe and North America may grow due to automotive rubber demand. An alternative seed-oil extraction uses sodium hydroxide and methanol, with moisture as a drawback.

Josie Goodenow, California Garden Clubs Inc. bee chairperson since 2014, will speak on “All About Bees” at the Laguna Beach Garden Club on Oct. 13. The program covers native bees versus European honeybees and increasing bee populations and yard health. The meeting begins at 9:30 a.m.; the public is welcome, with no charge for first-time guests.

Nicole Sciortino and Vincent Licciardello, both 30, were charged in Pennsylvania with endangering the welfare of their two children after investigators said the children, ages 10 and 11, were left home alone for three days. Police found the home in deplorable condition and said Sciortino was in Florida while Licciardello occasionally dropped off food. Both were arraigned, given $10,000 unsecured bail, and released; the children are staying with family friends.

This study used CAPP-Seq with a lung cancer-specific panel to analyze 81 CSF, blood, and tissue samples from 24 patients with advanced lung cancer undergoing lumbar puncture for suspected leptomeningeal disease (LMD); 12 patients participated in a prospective osimertinib trial with serial lumbar punctures. CSF-tDNA variant allele fractions were higher than plasma ctDNA variant allele fractions and were positively correlated. For LMD diagnosis, CSF-tDNA sensitivity was 91.7%, compared with 81.8% for cytology. CSF-tDNA was prognostic for overall survival. Resistance mutations such as EGFR T790M and MET amplification were common in peripheral blood but rare in time-matched CSF. In the osimertinib cohort, patients with CNS progression had increased CSF-tDNA VAFs at follow-up, and post-osimertinib CSF-tDNA VAF was prognostic for CNS progression. The study concludes that CSF-tDNA detection in lung cancer patients with suspected LMD is feasible and may improve LMD diagnosis, prognostication, and therapeutic strategies accounting for spatial heterogeneity in resistance mechanisms.
Jon Klemm is underrated; Greg de Vries had a great year and established himself as a solid NHL defenseman; Skoula is up-and-coming defenseman; a talented forward has been among league's best.

In 2016-17, 719 people were admitted to hospitals in the Devon, Cornwall and Isles of Scilly NHS area with eating disorders, including two children under 10. Anorexia accounted for 45% of admissions and bulimia 24%, and 94% were female. Admissions were at their highest recorded level, more than twice the 298 in 2010-11. Charities described the figures as worrying and said admissions do not establish whether eating disorder numbers are rising.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated June 14, 2021. On that date, NVIDIA entered an underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, as representative of the underwriters, to issue and sell $5.0 billion aggregate principal amount of unsecured notes: $1.25 billion of 0.309% notes due 2023, $1.25 billion of 0.584% notes due 2024, $1.25 billion of 1.550% notes due 2028, and $1.25 billion of 2.000% notes due 2031. Net proceeds were approximately $4.98 billion, intended for general corporate purposes, which may include repayment of indebtedness. The notes are governed by a base indenture with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as trustee, as supplemented. The notes are unsecured senior obligations and have specified maturities, interest payments, redemption rights, covenants, change-of-control repurchase provisions, and ranking. Item 2.03 incorporates the Item 1.01 information. Exhibits and a signature are included.

Poor medication adherence is common among hemodialysis patients, who often take 10–20 tablets daily for chronic kidney disease complications and comorbidities; non-adherence rates exceed 50%, with estimates as high as 98.6%, and are linked to inadequate complication management and increased mortality. Proposed multidimensional approaches include simplifying regimens, enhancing health literacy, and strengthening physician-patient communication through person-centered care (PCC), which incorporates evidence-based care, patient preferences, goals, values, and shared decision-making. Empirical evidence for PCC remains limited, and few studies explore how PCC affects doctor-patient interactions and medication adherence, with trust in physicians as a possible mediator. This multicenter, cross-sectional study of Japanese hemodialysis patients aimed to explore interrelationships among PCC, trust in physicians, and medication adherence and examine trust’s mediating role using mediation analysis. Data were collected at six outpatient hemodialysis facilities between April 2022 and February 2023, and medication adherence was measured with the Japanese ASK-12 scale.

The Supreme Court is considering a request to block Victor Tony Jones’s scheduled Tuesday execution. It has not granted any execution stay this year despite over 30 emergency applications; if denied, Jones would be the 34th person executed in 2025. Executions had declined from 2015 to 2021 and Biden imposed a federal moratorium, but Trump ended it, contributing to 33 executions as of Tuesday morning, with Florida playing a significant role. The Court rarely grants stays; its denials contrast with recent merits rulings for death-row inmates. It will hear a case on intellectual disability and IQ scores, with as many as 10 more executions possible before argument.

Archive360 announced that Archive2Azure is a finalist for Best Cloud Storage Solution and FastCollect for PSTs is a finalist for Best Data Storage Solution in the 2017 DBTA Readers' Choice Awards. Archive2Azure is a managed compliance storage solution for Microsoft Azure; FastCollect for PSTs is an automated PST discovery, migration, and storage solution. Winners will be featured on the DBTA website and in the August 2017 edition of Database Trends and Applications.

The case describes Tesla’s entry into the U.S. auto industry. In March 2016, Elon Musk unveiled the $35,000 Model 3, with 115,000 pre-orders that grew to 500,000 by 2018. By August 2018, Tesla was in “production hell,” working to produce 5,000 Model 3s per week after delays; in Q2 2018 it lost $743 million on $4 billion in revenue. The traditional U.S. new car market was worth about $270 billion in 2016 and was dominated by GM, Ford, Chrysler, and Toyota, with high barriers to entry and exit. Suppliers were tiered and often more profitable than automakers. Customers, especially Millennials, were shifting buying habits, while dealerships faced online alternatives. Mobility trends included electrification, autonomous driving, connectivity, and mobility-as-a-service. Tesla, founded in 2003 and led by Musk, followed a Master Plan to enter at the high end and move downmarket. Its Roadster, Model S, and Model X preceded the Model 3. Tesla vertically integrated, built the Gigafactory and Fremont plant, used high automation, and sold directly through company stores and charging/service networks. Master Plan, Part Deux envisioned self-driving shared autonomy. The case questions whether Tesla can survive and thrive.

This compilation presents news items and articles mentioning Enron. Fortune ranked Enron No. 16 on its Global 500 list. BusinessWeek reported declining second-quarter profits among bellwether companies and noted that Enron’s 196% revenue gain affected overall sales figures. Dow Jones reported that falling western U.S. electricity prices, attributed by many to federal price controls, caused power plant developers to cancel projects; Enron unit Portland General Electric halted a Boardman peaking turbine. Reuters discussed emissions trading after the Bonn climate meeting and said Enron’s trading skills could play a role. Kobe Steel planned to raise 165 billion yen for a Japanese power business, with Enron among interested foreign firms. Enron canceled its Miami-Dade power plant option and focused on Deerfield Beach, where a moratorium stalled the project. The Washington Post described Karl Rove’s five-month stock divestiture process and meetings involving Enron and other holdings. TheStreet.com reported insider stock sales by Enron executives while they publicly called the stock undervalued, and described Enron’s broadband losses and reduced valuation after its dot-com-like expectations faded.

Coach Sutter discusses a playoff series and describes an experienced player with back-to-back Pittsburgh finals experience, losing then winning, as an old-school good pro. He calls the teams skilled, hard-working character teams and says the opponent is bigger and quicker up front. He says the teams are close, with no major new changes, and emphasizes doing the same things, discipline between whistles, drawing penalties, power-play chances, and forechecking in groups while staying on the right side of the puck. He notes ice time, matchups, home ice and last change, loud buildings, and poor ice affect play, and that players are not machines and may not always play their best. Both teams are expected to play hard.

The Jaguar F-Pace has boosted Jaguar sales. An F-Pace SVR is testing at the Nürburgring, with final adjustments underway; its engine will probably be a 5.0-liter supercharged V8 from the F-Type SVR or F-Type R, making 500–575 HP.

DLSS 4 introduces transformer-based AI models for DLSS Super Resolution, Ray Reconstruction, and DLAA, trained by NVIDIA supercomputers. Compared with CNN models, transformers use self-attention, identify longer-range patterns, scale more effectively, ingest 2x more parameters, and improve stability, lighting detail, motion detail, anti-aliasing, and image quality. The Court of Appeals affirmed the trial court’s dismissal with prejudice of plaintiff’s appeal challenging the Town of Surf City’s closing of a 20-foot portion of North Shore Drive under N.C.G.S. § 160A-299. The town complied with the statute’s procedural requirements, and the closing vested a portion of the street in the town as an abutting property owner. The statute does not limit a town’s authority to close a street based on its intent when ordering the closing. Wooten was distinguishable because the town there would not obtain property rights in the closed portion. The Court also rejected plaintiff’s argument that the statute permits only full street closures.

MKM Partners raised Tutor Perini Corporation’s price target from $31.00 to $34.00 and maintained a buy rating. Other analysts issued various rating and target changes; four analysts rated the stock hold and four buy, with a consensus Buy rating and $27.29 target. This application provides a rotating shaft mechanism and a mobile terminal. The rotating shaft mechanism is applied to a foldable mobile terminal and is fixedly connected to two housings. It includes a main shaft assembly, swing arm assemblies, and a support assembly. The swing arm assembly connects the support assembly and the main shaft assembly and includes at least one connecting rod group and at least one swing arm group. Connecting rods are disposed on two sides of the main shaft assembly and are rotatably connected to it. Swing arms are disposed on the two sides, are fixedly connected to the two housings, are rotatably connected to the main shaft assembly, and are slidably connected to at least one connecting rod on the same side. Support plates are disposed on the two sides; each support plate is either rotatably connected to a same-side swing arm and slidably connected to a same-side connecting rod, or rotatably connected to the main shaft assembly and slidably connected to a same-side swing arm. When the swing arms rotate to a first position toward each other, the connecting rods or swing arms drive the support plates to a second position toward each other, and the support plates and main shaft assembly enclose folding space for a flexible display. The connecting rods rotate and the swing arms rotate relative to the main shaft assembly so that folded mechanism thickness is approximately equal to thickness of the two stacked housings. The mobile terminal includes the rotating shaft mechanism, two housings, and a flexible display fixedly connected to the two housings. The flexible display may be connected to the support plates by adhesive, and a flexible blocking layer may be inserted into the two housings.

The passage is a collection of financial-market headlines, analyst notes, and risk disclosures. Topics include seasonal weakness and institutional rebalancing, diminished liquidity and thin volume, tax-loss selling, yields and TLT, the dollar, commodities, energy, and gold levels, plus headlines on Nvidia, AI stocks, Bitcoin, S&P 500 highs and bargains, and micro-caps.

The passage discusses COVID-19 forecasting for confirmed and death cases in the USA, India, Brazil, Russia, and UK. It states that single models such as ARIMA, ARNN, or SVM are not enough because COVID-19 data contain both linear and nonlinear patterns, so hybrid models are proposed. The study develops hybrid ARNNS and SVMAR models for short-term and long-term out-of-sample forecasts, using datasets from the Global Change Data Lab with a terminal date of January 15, 2021. It reports that these models performed well for confirmed and death cases and outlines the paper’s sections on data, model formulation, experimental results, discussion, and conclusions.

The passage states that the United States has refused to enforce contractual obligations for its citizens by arms. The Rio Conference adopted a resolution recommending that governments consider asking the Second Hague Conference to examine compulsory collection of public debts and means to diminish pecuniary conflicts among nations. U.S. representatives supported this under instructions that the United States does not use armed forces to collect ordinary contract debts, because such force is inconsistent with respect for sovereignty and can lead to bullying and unjustifiable warfare, though force may be justified in cases of fraud, wrongdoing, or treaty violation. The instructions favored international consideration to distinguish such cases and said Rio should not make the discrimination because most American countries are debtors and European countries are creditors. The passage also recounts U.S.-Mexico mediation ending war among Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras, and Rio’s resolution expressing satisfaction.

Royalty North Partners Ltd. granted 35,000 incentive stock options to certain directors, officers, employees and consultants, exercisable at C$1.47 per share for five years, expiring October 6, 2022. It also awarded 37,500 Restricted Share Rights to certain directors/senior officers on October 6, 2017, fully vesting over two years.
A Kuwaiti court sentenced a Kuwaiti couple to death for torturing their three-year-old daughter to death and keeping her body in a freezer; the verdict must be reviewed by appeals and supreme courts.

The Clean 20 by Dr. Ian K. Smith teaches clean eating, reducing processed foods, and focuses on twenty clean foods. It includes a program with daily meal plans, 60 recipes and substitutions, and 20-minute workouts, emphasizing wise choices within food groups.

Lincoln City FC and Grimsby Town FC are rivals, but the railway line fans may use to reach Blundell Park originated in 1848, when the Manchester, Sheffield and Lincolnshire Railway opened the Lincoln–Barnetby–Grimsby route to transport goods and fish to and from Grimsby’s port. The route included the River Witham bridge at Stamp End, which Network Rail has replaced in a £7m project. Designed by John Fowler using box-shaped iron girders, the bridge is described in a Network Rail report by Alan Baxter as possibly the oldest surviving wrought iron box girder railway bridge in Britain or the world, and certainly Britain’s oldest such bridge still carrying trains. It required reinforcement in 1903 and 1948, with later alterations including a new steel deck in 1968; a 1937 sleeper fire was also reported.

This multicenter cross-sectional study determined SARS-CoV-2 S-IgG, NC-IgG, and serum neutralization against Wu01, BA.4/5, and BQ.1.1 in 1,411 patients treated at emergency departments of five university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany, between August and September 2022. S-IgG was detected in 95.6% and NC-IgG in 24.0% of participants; 94.4% reported at least one immunization, 45.7% reported at least one previous infection, and 67.7% were vaccinated according to German recommendations. S-IgG levels were lower with drug immunosuppression and increased with number of S-antigen contacts. NC-IgG detection, vaccinations, infections, and times since infection or vaccination predicted S-IgG levels. Neutralization was detectable against Wu01 in 94.4% and BA.4/5 in 84.9%; in a 423-participant sub-sample, 73.8% showed activity against BQ.1.1. BQ.1.1 neutralization was reduced 23.6-fold versus Wu01 and 4.2-fold versus BA.4/5. S-IgG levels were most predictive for neutralization, and previous S-antigen contacts substantially contributed to humoral immunity. The study concluded high S-IgG seroprevalence, moderate vaccination compliance, and impaired BQ.1.1 neutralization, with improvement of vaccine uptake considered critical. The study population was not representative of the general population.

Scientists used kirigami to make Mylar disk parachutes perforated with concentric slits; they open automatically when dropped, produce drag, and fall straight down regardless of initial orientation. In laboratory tests, they fell closer to an intended target than traditional or uncut disks, and a 1-kilogram water bottle dropped from 60 meters with a 0.5-meter parachute reached about 14 meters per second versus about 34 without. They could be used for humanitarian aid drops or drone package deliveries, with possible biodegradable materials and design tweaks.

Intraday trading strategies involve buying and selling a financial instrument within the same trading day, including scalping and day trading, to exploit daily price movements while avoiding overnight risks. They differ from swing trading, position trading, and investing. Intraday trading is common in forex, futures, and stocks. In the US, FINRA pattern day trading rules apply: four or more day trades in five business days if over 6% of margin account trades, $25,000 minimum equity, and up to 4x leverage. CFD trading is prohibited in the US. The passage lists rules such as learning the market, setting realistic goals, avoiding herd mentality, choosing a reputable broker, trading liquid stocks, studying fundamentals, using a quantified system, and periodically reviewing results. Indicators mentioned include moving averages, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and RSI. Intraday trading can be profitable with a quantified, backtested edge, but most traders lose money. Intraday strategies are hard to backtest and less likely to pass out-of-sample tests than daily strategies due to noise. An hourly WTI example had poor historical performance. The best time is often the first two hours after the open; capital needs vary, though many traders have too little. High-liquidity and volatile markets are preferred, with stocks considered best and forex least. Most traders lose money in a zero-sum game, though prop and institutional traders can do well.

The State appealed the trial court’s dismissal of controlled substances charges against defendant. After defendant’s arrest, cocaine and marijuana were seized; the Department of Revenue sought unpaid taxes on the seized drugs under the Drug Tax Act; a $456,574.26 Certificate of Tax Liability was docketed as a judgment, and defendant paid part. Defendant moved to dismiss, alleging double jeopardy, and the trial court allowed the motion. The Court of Appeals reversed, agreeing with the State that the ruling conflicted with Ballenger and Creason. Defendant’s reliance on a Fourth Circuit decision was insufficient because federal appellate decisions are not binding on North Carolina courts except U.S. Supreme Court decisions, and the Court of Appeals could not reexamine prior holdings or modify the statute.
Court of appeals’ judgment reversed on authority of State v. Szefcyk; Cook, J., did not participate.

Netflix fell 0.68% in premarket Monday despite Shonda Rhimes agreeing to move future shows to Netflix; her existing ABC shows remain there. The deal follows Disney pulling movies for a 2019 streaming service and Netflix acquiring Millarworld. A Barron's article calling for shares to fall 50% amid content losses and rising debt may explain selling; Netflix is up 32.95% this year.

Container images can be documented using Dockerfile directives such as EXPOSE, ENV, and LABEL, including labels from the Label Schema project. The sidecar pattern combines containers so a sidecar augments and extends an application container. The ambassador pattern uses an ambassador container to broker interactions between an application container and the rest of the world; examples include sharded Redis, service brokering, request splitting, and 10% experiments. The adapter pattern modifies an application container’s interface to conform to common interfaces for monitoring, logging, or health checks; examples include Prometheus, fluentd, and MySQL health monitoring.

Multi-node patterns include microservices, which break systems into networked services and offer benefits in reliability, agility, and scaling while making debugging and design harder. Replicated load-balanced services are stateless, use readiness probes, may use session tracking, application-layer services, caching layers, rate limiting, denial-of-service defense, and SSL termination. Sharded services serve subsets of requests, are used for stateful services and caches, and rely on sharding functions, key selection, consistent hashing, replicated shards, and hot sharding. Scatter/gather farms requests to all replicas, combines partial results, and has overhead and straggler limits; replicating shards improves reliability and scale. Event-driven FaaS/serverless computing simplifies deployment and scales automatically but forces decoupling and statelessness, complicating operations.

The Buck Sweep, associated with Tubby Raymond and the University of Delaware, is the signature play of the Wing-T. It is a misdirection off-tackle run with two pullers as lead blockers, used primarily in the Wing-T, and can hit off-tackle or the edge. Its strengths include disguising the ball carrier, stressing multiple gaps, and using angles that help undersized linemen displace defenders horizontally. Its weaknesses include reliance on timing and spacing, the need for guards or tackles to pull and block in space, and ample practice for hand-offs, pull paths, and reads. The passage also details blocking rules against 3-4 and 4-3 fronts and Shotgun Wing-T and I-Wing variations.

Concerns have arisen that Google may discontinue Inbox by Gmail because a Gmail redesign is expected, Gmail has adopted Inbox features like snoozing and Smart Reply, Inbox updates seem slower, and its iOS app has not been updated for the iPhone X notch. The article cites Allo being moved to “life support” as adding to such worries. Google says there are no changes to Inbox by Gmail with the upcoming Gmail announcement; it remains a product for users with specific workflows and tests innovative email features. The article notes recent Inbox features, including A.I.-powered Highlights, unsubscribe suggestions, and follow-up or reply suggestions, though these were not broadly announced. Inbox still differs from Gmail through bundles, trip-related organization, key-detail extraction, and cross-service reminders integration. Historical statements from Google staff said they hoped most users would eventually use Inbox, but current usage data is unavailable. A former Inbox product manager said Inbox has a non-trivial and growing number of users, and the Android app shows 10 million installs and was last updated April 5. The article concludes Inbox does not appear unused, abandoned, or set to be sunsetted soon.

Freelance writer Oobah Butler created a TripAdvisor listing for “The Shed at Dulwich,” based at his garden shed in South London, as an experiment. Using a burner phone, a website, a menu based on emotions, staged photos, and fake reviews from family and friends, he got the listing approved in May. It rose from last place among London restaurants to No. 1 by early November and received many reservation calls and inquiries, though it did not exist. Butler exposed the ruse in a Vice article. TripAdvisor said it had already penalized the property, reduced its ranking, and removed reviews; a spokesperson said its process focuses on fake reviews for real businesses and that fake restaurant listings are mainly created by journalists testing the site. Butler later opened the fake restaurant for one night.

Shiitake mushroom market is projected to reach USD 26.7 billion by 2022, growing at 15.31% CAGR; key findings also project USD 35.4 billion by 2023. Asia Pacific held 82.54% market share in 2017, with China at 97% of that market. Growth is driven by nutritional and medicinal attributes. Dried and fresh segments, and pharmaceutical/cosmetic applications, are expected to grow.

The passage discusses stroke-related motor impairment and the need for sensitive motor measures. It describes surface EMG measures such as co-contraction and muscle synergies, and notes that high-density EMG (HD-EMG) can provide high-resolution views of motor control but current systems are cumbersome. The authors characterize movement coordination in extrinsic hand muscles using an easy-to-use HD-EMG wearable sleeve across functional movements in able-bodied and chronic stroke groups, evaluating co-contraction index, muscle correlation, and muscle synergy analysis. Seven chronic stroke participants with hemiparesis and seven able-bodied participants attempted cued hand, wrist, and forearm movements while HD-EMG was recorded from the affected or right arm using the NeuroLife sleeve. Stroke participants completed clinical assessments and attempted 12 movements; able-bodied participants also performed 25 additional movements and grasps. EMG data were filtered, artifact-corrected, RMS-binned, mapped across sleeve sizes and arms, mapped to muscle groups, and decomposed into co-contraction, correlation, and synergy features.

Port Gregory was without power for four days until Sunday evening, affecting elderly residents’ medical equipment and frozen food. Resident Betty Sawers described repeated outages, about $500 in lost food, and a neighbour unable to use a CPAP. Western Power cited storms, resource constraints, and network maintenance, offering eligible customers up to $80, not for lost food.

Western Allied governments, controlled by absolute nationalists, emphasize national success and have reduced interest in an enduring peace, causing conflicts with allies and contributing to Italy’s and Rumania’s disasters. Unity requires pooling purposes and shifting political power toward middle parties and the moderate left in both coalitions. The decision includes destroying submarine bases, recapturing northern France, possible invasion of Germany, and relative reserves of men; by late 1918 Germany faces Lorraine’s reconquest as American reserves become actual.

Sonali Bendre Behl stated she was diagnosed with high-grade cancer that has metastasized and is undergoing treatment in New York. A niggling pain led to tests and the diagnosis. She said her family and friends support her, and she is optimistic and determined to fight.

Cryogenic four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM) was used to visualize polarizations in SrTiO3. Polarization was extracted from Kikuchi band asymmetries and mapped via center-of-mass shifts, supported by dynamical scattering multislice simulations. In the room-temperature cubic phase, no polarization was detected. Below the antiferrodistortive transition (T_AFD ≈105 K), SrTiO3 became locally polar, with nanoscale domains of opposite polarization, though the AFD distortion alone is centrosymmetric. At 69 K, polar nanodomains had a correlation length ξ∼20 ± 0.6 nm and showed periodic spatial ordering with λ≈25 nm. Cooling below Tq≈40 K into the quantum paraelectric regime caused fragmentation: domains became smaller and more disordered, ξ∼14 ± 0.4 nm, and periodic ordering weakened. Temperature maps showed tiny isolated domains near T_AFD, growth down to ∼69 K, then re-entrant fragmentation below 40 K and further shrinking at 23 K. Fourier-transform superlattice peaks between 69 and 91 K indicated periodic ordering with q≈0.04 nm−1. The results describe quantum paraelectricity as evolution of polar nanodomains through re-entrant disordering, not complete absence of polarization.

This manuscript presents findings of the AOTA AFWC-ALC Research Promotion ad hoc committee, which reviewed fieldwork education literature to update Academic Fieldwork Coordinators and researchers. It builds on Roberts et al. (2015) and uses the AOTA Occupational Therapy Education Research Agenda–Revised (2018) to map literature by priority category, level of education, and fieldwork level. The authors searched four databases and the Journal of Occupational Therapy Education for U.S., English-language articles published 1989–2020. After screening, 67 articles met eligibility. Results showed the literature focused disproportionately on occupational therapy Level II fieldwork (36 of 67 papers; 53%) and predominantly on Instructional Methods (23) and Learner Characteristics and Competencies (31). Only one article focused exclusively on OTA, and Level I OTA fieldwork was virtually ignored. No articles mapped to Theory Building, Signature Pedagogies, or Promotion of Diversity, Inclusion, and Equity; other gaps included OTA fieldwork, Level I fieldwork, Socialization to the Profession, and Faculty Development and Resources. Limitations included lack of quality assessment in mapping reviews, inconsistent fieldwork-level descriptions, exclusion of non-U.S., descriptive, and gray literature, and delayed publication due to COVID-19. The authors conclude that fieldwork research has ongoing gaps and call for collaborative, team-science efforts, formal inclusion of fieldwork in future AOTA Education Research Agenda revisions, and more evidence-based, data-driven fieldwork education.

The final lecture examines consequences of the collective Thomson scattering spectrum. It reviews the scattered-power formula, including dependence on the classical electron radius, laser intensity, electron number, and the spectral density function, which contains frequency-resolved information and depends on the averaged squared Fourier transform of electron density. Using test-particle formalism, the spectral density function is expressed for arbitrary electron and ion distributions, with electron and ion components; scattering is always from electrons, some revealing electrons and some ions. For Maxwellian distributions, susceptibilities and the w function are defined, with the squiggle parameter comparing phase velocity to thermal velocity. Limits are considered: alpha squared going to zero gives incoherent scattering and the electron distribution function, with no plasma response. High-frequency waves yield electron plasma/Langmuir waves, with resonances at omega squared epw equal to omega pe squared plus 3 Te/me k squared, and peak positions and widths provide density and temperature information. Low-frequency waves yield anacoustic waves; damping depends on zTe/TI, with no resonances if zTe/TI is less than 3, strong damping if less than 1, a hybrid near 1, and strong resonances if much greater than 1. Total cross-section in the Saltpeter approximation shows electron and ion feature contributions, whose dominance depends on alpha. Electron-ion drift makes anacoustic peaks asymmetric and allows measurement of drift and current, potentially magnetic field with symmetry assumptions. Collisions damp coherent features. Finite measurement volume, time, and collection angle cause gradients, velocity shear, turbulence, and multiple k vectors to broaden or mix spectra, affecting inferred temperature and density. The anacoustic spectrum can give electron temperature, ion temperature, ion flow velocity, and electron-ion drift; electron density requires electron plasma waves. Practical concerns include signal-to-noise, laser power, and cost.

The study addresses Turkey’s centralized education administration system and aims to develop a local education management board model based on OECD countries’ education management models and the views of teachers and education administrators. It states that Turkey’s system is unitary, centralized, bureaucratic, and based on top-down decisions and appointments, while accountability, transparency, democracy, participation, efficiency, and flexibility are generally not considered. The study uses a mixed-method exploratory sequential design. Qualitative data were collected from literature and OECD reports and from examining 16 OECD countries with PISA and GDP averages above OECD averages; quantitative data were collected through a questionnaire from teachers and administrators in Seyhan district, Adana, in the 2016–2017 academic year. The questionnaire was tested for validity and reliability with test-retest analysis. Findings report that 61.5% of participants preferred local administration and 38.5% central administration; 61% wanted education managed through elected boards/commissions; most preferred participatory provincial, district, vocational, school, and inspection/evaluation boards involving various education stakeholders; and most considered that 22 of 27 duties should be transferred to local education units. The study reports that OECD countries using boards/commissions scored above OECD averages in PISA and GDP, while Turkey was below OECD averages. It proposes a Local Education Boards model with central and local organization, recommends pilot studies and further research, and suggests the Ministry set top policy and monitor, evaluate, and audit while local education boards carry out implementation duties.

Texas replaced STAAR with three shorter exams administered at the beginning, middle, and end of the year and banned practice tests, aiming to reduce stress and instructional time spent on testing. In Brubaker v. State of New York, the Court of Claims addressed appropriations of claimant’s land for the St. Lawrence River project. The claim was amended to substitute Ralph Hartwell Brubaker. The court awarded $100 for the .15-acre flooding easement, $39,750 for 25.34 acres (including $12,675 direct and $27,075 consequential damage), and $27,700 for the 55.38-acre transmission-line easement, with interest as specified. Embodiments relate to a display device including a substrate; a pixel electrode and an opposing electrode; an encapsulation portion on the opposing electrode, including at least one organic layer and at least one inorganic layer alternately deposited; and a planarization layer on the encapsulation portion, covering an edge portion of the encapsulation portion. A first angle between the planarization layer edge side surface and the substrate surface is larger than a second angle between the encapsulation portion edge side surface and the substrate surface. The planarization layer may include an organic material, may have a flat upper surface, and may expose part of the encapsulation portion; its edge side surface may be curved or flat. The inorganic layer may cover the organic layer. A pattern, such as a touch electrode or touch wiring, may be on the planarization layer. The planarization layer may be on the whole encapsulation portion or mainly in a peripheral area. By increasing the flattened upper surface, the display device may allow pattern formation while reducing dead space and parasitic capacitance between the opposing electrode and the touch sensor pattern.

In Bost v. Illinois State Board of Elections, justices appeared inclined to allow Rep. Michael Bost to challenge Illinois’s mail-in ballot deadline. A substantial majority, perhaps seven justices, leaned toward reversing lower courts’ holding that Bost lacked standing. The debate focused on the standing test. Paul Clement proposed broad candidate standing; Elena Kagan said candidates should show a substantial risk of electoral disadvantage relative to the old rule, not necessarily likely loss. Sonia Sotomayor and Ketanji Brown Jackson saw no standing for Bost. Several justices seemed comfortable with Kagan’s standard. Clement said Bost could satisfy it through margin concerns and poll-watcher costs. Illinois’s solicitor general agreed with Kagan’s test but said Bost could not show standing. Brett Kavanaugh raised remedy concerns; Michael Talent said a ruling against standing would force post-election litigation, and an outcome-determinative test would leave only major parties able to litigate.

The study uses SEM in-situ microscale four-point probe measurements with microstructure characterization to analyze electrical resistivity in Al-Mg-Si alloys. Samples with different compositions were heat treated at 300°C for 24 h, 350°C for 72 h, and 350°C for 120 h, then characterized by XRD, SEM/EDS, and EBSD. Bulk resistivity was measured by the Van der Pauw method, while grain interior and individual Si and Mg2Si precipitates were measured microscopically. Bulk resistivity generally increases with higher Si and Mg content, and 350°C for 72 h yields the lowest resistivity for all compositions. Grain interior resistivity depends on heat treatment rather than composition. Si and Mg2Si precipitates contribute equally to the effective resistivity, with negligible effect from precipitate identity or shape. The alloy resistivity linearly scales with solute content, with linear coefficients depending on heat treatment. The authors conclude that microscale measurements can resolve bulk resistivity into microstructural components such as precipitates.

Results show no citations in 2021, 2022, and 2023; 100 publications in 2020 had no citations; and in 2024, 15 publications had 234 citations, averaging 15.62 per publication. The Trump administration’s push to require a $100,000 fee for new H-1B visas could imperil thousands of college jobs. Five European research institutions are leading an effort to establish October 10 as International Coccolithophore Day. Coccolithophores are microscopic single-celled ocean algae with calcium carbonate plates called coccoliths. They capture carbon dioxide, produce oxygen, nourish marine food webs, and generate over 1.5 billion tonnes of calcium carbonate annually, storing carbon in deep-sea sediments and leaving chalk and limestone geological records. Climate change is altering seawater temperature, chemistry, and nutrients, posing risks to them and dependent ecosystems. The campaign highlights European research on their role in ocean chemistry, carbon storage, and climate history, aiming to increase public awareness, ocean literacy, policy focus, and engagement.

This cross-disorder analysis used The Health Improvement Network (THIN) UK primary care database for discovery and UK Biobank for replication to compare prediagnostic symptoms and drug prescriptions before diagnoses of Alzheimer’s disease (AD), Parkinson’s disease (PD), and dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB). THIN included 20,214 AD, 28,222 PD, 4,682 DLB patients, and 20,214 controls; UKB included 1,005 AD, 2,268 PD, and 2,732 dementia patients. Logistic models examined selected health conditions and medication classes in 0–5, 5–10, and 10–15 years before diagnosis. In THIN, all conditions were more frequent in cases than controls 0–5 years before diagnosis. Memory problems were more frequent before AD; tremor more frequent before PD; and memory troubles, confusion, hallucinations, constipation, falls, and depression more frequent before DLB. Constipation before PD/DLB exceeded AD. DLB showed stronger associations with depression, anxiety, autonomic dysfunction, constipation, urinary disorders, and hypotension. Treatments for depression, anxiety, and constipation were more frequent before all three diseases; antidiabetics and antihypertensives were less frequent. Statins were less prescribed before PD than AD/DLB and more before DLB than AD. In PD patients, pre-PD prescriptions for hypercholesterolemia, constipation, depression, and psychosis were associated with dementia within five years. UKB replicated lower statin prescriptions before PD vs AD. The passage concludes neurodegenerative diseases have long prodromal phases and suggests a differential role of lipid-lowering therapies.
