It launched in 1984 and is managed by FTSE Russell. The index rebalances annually in June. The passage describes trading IWM and RTY, including a Russell 2000 Rebalancing Trading Strategy with solid performance, possible S&P 500 hedging or pair trading, and diversification because IWM trends differently than the S&P 500.

Marcus Lemonis bought bankrupt Gander Mountain, now Gander Outdoors, reopening 69 stores. Since buying Good Sam Club, he called members “marketing tools,” cancelled national rallies, and repurposed Good Sam Man as Gander Man.

Apple has reportedly shelved plans for a lighter, cheaper Vision Pro and will focus on lightweight AI smart glasses like Meta’s. Apple still plans a new Vision Pro with a better chip, but the device remains expensive, bulky, and unclear in purpose; executives privately view it as overengineered. Meta already sells Ray-Ban glasses, and Google has plans for similar glasses. The passage says there is no sign that many people want to wear computers on their faces, and it is too early to say who has won or lost.

The speaker says Doug Weight has been battling and would be missed, but the team is resilient and has other centermen. They need traffic at the net and to pressure the opposing goalie. They look forward to Saturday, have put the last game behind them, and hope to refocus, reenergize, and close out the series. The series is long, so they must compete, be physical, and play better as a team.

Winning the Stanley Cup is described as the biggest accomplishment of the speaker’s career, though he says players must keep proving themselves; the Cup may buy leeway after a bad start but not forever unless he turns his game around. He was happy playing in Finland and did not think about the NHL then; returning was tough but paid off. In the final, he tried to stay level after a huge game-winning goal, got nervous as Vancouver pressured, and said he faked his way to the Cup. He calls the Conn Smythe an honor and the Cup the biggest goal.

The passage states that Taylor Swift is credited as the sole writer on more than 60 songs, meaning she composed the lyrics and melodies alone. It lists these songs in loose chronological order, including examples like “Our Song,” “Love Story,” “Dear John,” “Red,” and “The Black Dog.” It also notes that while she has collaborated with producers and songwriters, she is credited as the lead writer on every song she has released.

This MIT OpenCourseWare lecture introduces the first of six sessions of Nuts and Bolts of New Ventures and Business Plans, taught by Joe Hadzima. The course focuses on planning and executing a new venture, with the business plan viewed as a dynamic process and shared vision, applicable to businesses, nonprofits, and government ventures. Hadzima recounts the course’s 25-year history and entrepreneurial lessons: have customers, get great people, define and communicate the task, and create and capture value. The session covers the Virtual Ink case study, course audience and interests, the formula H equals R divided by E, and business plan basics. These include why to write a plan, the plan as a selling and financing document, the pyramid from mission statement to full plan, executive summaries, the three whys, and reasons plans fail.

Several Texas public universities instructed faculty to review syllabi and course content and remove material that does not comply with federal and state laws and executive orders. San Jacinto College said it sought alignment with state course manuals and did not intend a formal policy, though an editor’s note said faculty were verbally told not to teach gender except the male-female binary. Texas Tech system employees were told not to teach, discuss, or acknowledge transgender identity. Angelo State and Texas A&M took related compliance actions. FIRE attorney Adam Steinbaugh called the directives a voluntary censorship effort unsupported by executive order and contradictory to the First Amendment. The Texas AAUP encouraged faculty to report censorship, and the passage says no federal or state laws prohibit public university professors from teaching about transgender identity.

The lecture reviews countable-state Markov processes defined by an embedded Markov chain and exponential holding rates ν_i. It recalls steady-state probabilities p_j proportional to π_j/ν_j, normalization, and conditions involving finite transition rates. A positive recurrent process requires a finite normalizing sum and steady-state π probabilities. If the relevant sum is infinite, the process has no meaningful steady state; examples include a “rattled server” with discouraged arrivals, where transitions slow down, and a hyperactive birth/death chain, where truncation shows transition rates may grow and steady state becomes meaningless.

The lecture then treats reversibility for Markov processes, backward transition rates, and a “guessing theorem”: for an irreducible process, probabilities satisfying detailed balance and normalization imply positive sample-path fractions, reversibility, and positive recurrence of the embedded chain. It applies this to birth/death processes and trees, then states Burke’s theorem for an M/M/1 queue in steady state with λ < μ: departures are Poisson at rate λ, the state at time t is independent of departures before t, and for first-come-first-serve service a customer’s arrival time given departure at t is independent of earlier departures. For tandem M/M/1 queues, departures from the first queue are Poisson at rate λ and enter the second queue; the second queue is M/M/1, and the states of the two systems are independent.

The lecture introduces random walks as sums of IID random variables, focusing on threshold crossing, time of crossing, overshoot, two-threshold problems, and applications. It discusses simple random walks with ±1 steps, where the probability of ever reaching k is (p/(1−p))^k; integer random walks; and renewal processes as special cases with positive increments. For a G/G/1 queue, it derives the waiting-time recursion w_n = max(w_{n−1} + u_n, 0), where u_n is service time minus interarrival time, making w_n a reflected random walk with renewals at 0. Finally, it introduces detection, decisions, and binary hypothesis testing, with IID observations conditional on hypotheses, probability densities, Bayes’ law, and likelihood ratios, noting that a random walk will emerge next.

Charles Robert Jenkins, a U.S. soldier who deserted to North Korea in 1965, has died in Japan aged 77. After marrying Japanese abductee Hitomi Soga in North Korea, he moved to Japan in 2004, served a 30-day sentence for desertion, lived in Sado, worked in a gift shop and wrote a book about his experiences.

Use increased from 50.7% to 54% between 2014 and 2015 under a government scheme to promote sanitary napkins among girls aged 10–19. Launched in 2011 and merged with RKSK in 2014, the scheme covers rural areas in 107 districts across 17 states. It suffers from poor quality and supply, lack of awareness, and unsafe disposal. Expenditure rose from Rs 24.33 billion in 2014-15 to Rs 37.03 billion in 2016-17. ASHAs sell six napkins for Rs 6, keep Re 1, donate Rs 5, and receive a free monthly pack. Reports cite delays up to three months, poor quality, stockouts, low uptake, non-rollout in West Bengal, and low fund utilization nationally. Awareness meetings were often not held, and ASHAs were untrained. Unsafe disposal is an environmental hazard because napkins are non-biodegradable; funds for safe disposal were largely unused.

The passage lists dated archival records from February–March 1983 concerning US-Soviet relations. It includes memoranda and meetings involving Reagan, Clark, Shultz, Dobrynin, Eagleburger, and others, with sources, classifications, drafting/clearing details, and notes. It also records Reagan’s diary account of a February 15 meeting with Shultz and Dobrynin and Clark’s skepticism that the Soviets would permit Pentecostalists to leave.

In macOS High Sierra, screenshot drop shadows can be disabled by entering `defaults write com.apple.screencapture disable-shadow true` in Terminal, then `killall SystemUIServer`. Test or restart if needed. To revert, replace `true` with `false` and kill SystemUIServer again.

The passage covers UHS-II interface selection and initialization, including the 200us STB.L detection timeout on D1 lane and fallback to SD Bus I/F mode, plus PHY, device, enumeration, configuration, and SD-TRAN initialization steps. It also describes bus speed modes, LV interface, FD624, host-controlled broadcast and addressed commands, card identification and data transfer modes, ACMD41/CMD8/CMD2/CMD3/CMD7/CMD9/CMD4 procedures, block read/write, erase/DISCARD/FULE operations, write protection, and password-based lock/unlock including COP/FEP and CMD42 behavior.

The passage says the brain should be treated like a muscle needing regular exercise and daily attention, and managing the mind is a skill. It states emotions are transient and there is no bad emotion; the goal is not happiness but accepting different stages and reducing emotional impact. It outlines a seven-step process for a clearer mind: check in and label feelings; breathe slowly with a five-count belly breath for at least 30 seconds; write down and release feelings; reframe with gratitude; play a mindful mini game; do a compassion challenge such as forgiving, appreciating someone, or giving yourself a compliment; and send a positive note to someone else. It also says accepting feelings reduces emotional impact and that people can make someone else feel better.

The passage addresses accusations that the Government edited or doctored an electoral reforms Bill. It explains that a Bill is a draft law, prepared by a government department under a minister/deputy and approved by Cabinet before Parliament; Private Members’ Bills are excluded. Law Commission recommendations pass through the Executive and Cabinet before a Bill is tabled. The author says the accusations would only make sense if the Bill came untouched from Law Commission, and calls them misinformation. Parliament debates and shapes Bills; until the Bill reaches the House, citizens should remain quiet.

The passage introduces a theoretical framework explaining emergent macroscopic linearity in large-scale nonlinear systems through spatial averaging. It reviews evidence that linear models often match nonlinear models in macroscopic brain dynamics and artificial neural networks, despite nonlinear microscopic components. The work extends prior simulations and an i.i.d. proof to heterogeneous, interconnected, spatially correlated systems using probability theory, central limit theorems, and mixing sequences. Contributions include multivariate CLT extensions, residual factors, ρ*-mixing for spatially embedded sequences, proofs that averaged state dynamics become asymptotically linear (generally LTV, and LTI under stationarity), and finite-sample convergence rates that slow with stronger correlations. It also defines ρ-mixing sequences, presents CLTs and residual-factor results, formulates the averaging problem for heterogeneous nonlinear dynamical systems, and analyzes residual factors for representative correlation decays.

At a Business Insider event sponsored by Fidelity Investments, experts discussed IPO strategies. They said companies face shifting investor expectations, regulatory demands, and keeping culture intact, while staying private longer can better prepare them. Advice included focusing on the process with expert help, quarterly reviews, operational and strategic readiness, planning for regulatory, shareholder, disclosure, and compensation requirements, finding the right investors and broker, and communicating with and supporting employees through and after the IPO.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated July 30, 2020, announcing its second quarter 2020 financial results. The filing includes Exhibit 99.1, the related press release, and Exhibit 99.2, information regarding non-GAAP financial measures.

The lecture reviews the path-integral master formula for time-ordered correlation functions and applies it to interacting theories by splitting the action into free and interaction parts. It expands in the interaction, expresses interacting correlation functions as ratios of free-theory correlation functions, and notes this matches an equation in Peskin and Schroeder. It then treats λφ⁴ theory, evaluates the two-point/Feynman function using Wick contractions, and represents contractions with Feynman diagrams. The lecture introduces coordinate-space Feynman rules involving external points, propagators, vertices with −iλ and spacetime integration, and symmetry factors. It illustrates second-order diagrams and combinatorial factors. It also develops momentum-space Feynman rules, Fourier transforms, momentum conservation at vertices, propagators, undetermined momentum integrations, and gives an example. Audience questions concern time-ordering, contractions, and connected diagrams.

The passage reviews the Netflix documentary “Unknown Number: The High School Catfish,” which follows Beal City, Michigan, students Lauryn Licari and Owen McKenny as they receive escalating harassing text messages from an unknown number for 18 months. The messages are vulgar, graphic and include threats, and the sender appears to know them personally. Local investigations stall, so the sheriff sends the FBI 720 pages of messages, and the FBI requests a forensic dump of Owen’s phone. The author says the documentary briefly covers cellphone forensics and notes phones and provider records can contain extensive data. The author also discusses parental concerns about children and cellphones and Oklahoma’s “bell to bell” no-cellphone policy for the 2025-2026 school year, citing cybercrime risks.

The passage presents SOS defensive concepts and “do’s.” Defenders pressure the ball to side, corner, or base checkpoints using SET, ON, and SMOTHER; use SNUGGLE pass denial one pass away; and use contact FRONTS on deep post ups with Slip Front and Helpside I vision/point stances. Go Base Post Traps are used when the post receives away from the low block, and Box Pressure begins on the wing, directing the ball to corner or baseline and denying middle drives. Weakside defenders use Helpside I double/triple alignments and Helpside Triangle I when traps are set; after a pass out of a trap, players rotate as the ball leaves the passer’s hands, with the High Helpside I closing out to the receiver and others rotating to nearest offensive players. Off-ball screens use Screen/Over/Switch with contact. Contact traps are used against side screen/roll before the screen, mid screen scenarios, dribble penetrations inside the baseline checkpoint, mismatches, and corner areas. Unstructured scenarios use Near Player rotations. On shots, all five box out and rebound. Checkpoints include corners, free throw line extended, baseline, and half court.

Apple Inc.’s Form 8-K reports that on June 22, 2016, Apple consummated the issuance and sale of $1,377,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.15% Notes due 2046. The Notes were issued under a subscription agreement dated June 7, 2016, with Deutsche Bank AG, Taipei Branch and KGI Securities Co. Ltd. as managers, and pursuant to an indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company, N.A., and an officer’s certificate. Interest is payable semi-annually on June 22 and December 22, beginning December 22, 2016, with maturity on June 22, 2046. The Notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking equally with other unsecured and unsubordinated debt. Exhibits include the subscription agreement, officer’s certificate, form of global note, opinion, and consent.

The paper studies how to ensure that molecules generated by LLMs are 100% valid. It finds that LLMs perform worse with SELFIES than with SMILES, and that SMILES remains the most suitable representation for molecule generation. Using LLMs as post-hoc invalid-SMILES correctors can improve validity, but correction rates vary across models and error types, and other metrics often degrade. The authors propose SmiSelf, a cross-chemical language framework that converts invalid SMILES generated by LLMs into SELFIES via molecular graphs and then back into SMILES, leveraging SELFIES robustness to correct invalid SMILES. Experiments on ChEBI-20 text-based molecule generation and class-specific molecule generation show that SmiSelf achieves 100% validity, preserves molecular characteristics, and maintains or improves other metrics, though post-hoc correction can introduce distortion in text-based generation. SmiSelf is compatible with SMILES-based generative models.

Field-free superconducting diode effect (SDE) was observed in stressed regions of NbSe2 devices, while no SDE was observed in non-stressed regions. Under magnetic fields, different devices showed ΔIc with B-even, B-odd, or mixed B-even/B-odd symmetry. In stressed NbSe2, zero-field ΔIc reached 286 μA and diode efficiency 6.76%. The passage attributes this to two independent, spatially orthogonal non-reciprocal mechanisms: stress-activated real-space polarization producing B-even SDE along the armchair direction, and field-activated valley polarization/finite-momentum pairing producing B-odd SDE along the zigzag direction.

Mike Peca has won the Selke Trophy and been nominated again; the speaker says he deserves recognition. The speaker has held different positions over nine years with the North Stars and Dallas Stars, aiming to win the Stanley Cup and be competitive, and now has a finals chance. Unrestricted free agency is viewed as a way to improve the team, with players contributing well.

Fitch Ratings affirmed Marsh & McLennan Companies, Inc.'s Long-Term Issuer Default Rating and existing senior unsecured debt ratings at 'A-' and short-term ratings at 'F2', and revised the Rating Outlook to Positive from Stable. Fitch said the actions reflect MMC's continued improved operating performance and stronger credit metrics, strong balance sheet and financial flexibility, excellent operating performance and cash flow generation, and top-tier competitive position as one of the world's largest diversified services firms, with major operations in insurance brokerage and consulting. These are partly offset by manageable contingent reputation, litigation, and regulatory risks. MMC had $1 billion of cash and equivalents at Dec. 31, 2016 and a $1.5 billion multi-currency unsecured revolving credit facility expiring in November 2020. At Dec. 31, 2016, EBITDA-to-interest coverage was over 16x, debt-to-EBITDA was 1.5x, and 2016 consolidated operating EBIT margin was 20%. Pro forma leverage after January 2017 debt issuance and refinancing rose to roughly 1.8x, with expectations to return to lower normalized levels. Upgrade triggers include EBIT margins of 18% or better, debt-to-EBITDA near 1.5x, and EBITDA-to-interest expense above 14x; Stable Outlook triggers include failure to reduce leverage to near 1.5x, coverage below 10x, material litigation or regulatory charges, or material goodwill impairment.

The Beerepoot family, owners of Melita Honey Farm in Tasmania, face the auction of their Mole Creek home after failing to pay Meander Valley council rates since 2010 because they believe the land is owned by God. The council plans to auction the property on 1 September unless all owed money is paid. Two other family properties’ rates were paid in June, but councillors had resolved in March to sell three properties when $9332 was outstanding.

OpenAI and Stripe introduced Instant Checkout in ChatGPT, powered by their open-source Agentic Commerce Protocol, allowing purchases inside AI chats. It launches first with U.S. sellers and will extend to over a million merchants. Because the protocol is open source, other AI assistants could adopt it. Stripe provides fraud prevention, payment rails, and merchant reach. OpenAI says the merchant-friendly approach is net-beneficial and scalable. Some brands may avoid it due to lost customer control and transaction fees. Merchants need structured product feeds to be recommended, creating an AIO successor to SEO. ChatGPT could become a product-recommendation arbiter, raising questions about recommendation logic and paid placement.

Scientists studied brown recluse spiders and observed them using spinnerets in a sewing-like motion to create silk micro-loops. Large spinnerets form a silk loop, and smaller ones clamp and release it. The resulting thin, flat, sticky silk has loops that enhance toughness. Its web evolved to catch ground prey. Past attempts to strengthen synthetic filaments with loops failed, but thin, flat nano-scale ribbon-shaped fibers may provide a solution. No man-made version exists yet; mathematical models and a patent application have been developed. Potential uses include space protection, parachutes, movie stunts, bungee cords, and improved fabrics or cords.

Engravings at Jebel Misma, Jebel Arnaan and Jebel Mleiha in the Nefud date to 12,800–11,400 years ago and include a herd of life-size camels and about 150 other petroglyphs. The art was made in four phases: stylized women, larger stylized humans, naturalistic animals up to 3 meters long, and later cartoonish animals. Researchers think the engravings, probably for marking territory or water, were made by early nomadic people after an arid period ended about 19,000 years ago. Tools link the artists to Eastern Mediterranean prehistoric peoples. The region was lush at times; the last lush era ended about 6,000 years ago.

The third ISL 2016 season finale on December 18 drew 54,000 stadium attendees in Kochi and 41 million TV viewers, according to BARC. STAR India reported a 41% increase in total viewers versus 2015, with 216 million total viewership compared with about 207 million. Rural viewership reached 101 million, and Mumbai and Chennai rose more than 50%, with a 20% cumulative spike in Tamil Nadu. The passage also states the season had over 25% higher overall viewer engagement and average seating capacity above 84% in ISL club cities.

Astronomer Rory Barnes’s research suggests many exoplanets found by coming high-powered telescopes will probably be tidally locked. By exploring a larger parameter space than previous models—including different initial rotation periods, larger planets, and eccentric orbits—Barnes found the old assumption that mainly small, dim stars could host tidally locked planets was limited. He writes tidal locking may be a major factor in the evolution of most potentially habitable exoplanets to be discovered soon, and every potentially habitable planet TESS detects will likely be tidally locked. He adds that atmospheres could mitigate climate extremes and that searching for life requires knowing whether a planet is tidally locked.

Japanese Finance Minister Taro Aso said the yen is vulnerable to North Korea tensions and warned against extreme instability. He declined to comment on exchange rates, saying markets should set currencies. On trade, he said the remaining 11 TPP countries should proceed without the U.S., which would eventually find rejoining TPP better than bilateral negotiations.

Industrial products, value creation processes, and supply chains are complex, while customer expectations and competitive pressures have increased. Calculations, prototypes, tests, and digital support with CAD, CAM, CAE, and 3D displays are used to help ensure products and production processes function as expected and are cost-effective. Simulation, modeling, and analysis are linked to business goals such as increasing innovation, speeding product development and time to market, reducing costs, supporting decision-making, and improving quality. They are used in product development, production and process planning, and quality management, with planned increases in deployment. Data silos and the absence of a holistic data strategy can hinder digitalization; a unified information base or “single source of the truth” is needed. IT-based simulation supports virtual prototyping, digital twins, IoT and sensor feedback loops, design optimization, digital verification and validation, and high-performance data analytics. HPC is described as a game changer for product and process innovation because it enables complex calculations, higher-quality and more intensive simulations, new usage scenarios, and greater innovation and agility. Demand for high-performance calculations is expected to rise. HPC users prefer external or cloud infrastructures and colocation over on-premises infrastructure. Challenges include security, energy consumption and sustainability, computing power, availability, complexity, costs, and lack of expertise. Cloud-based HPC and HPCaaS offer scalability, flexibility, cost optimization, global cooperation, and support for new business models. The passage recommends virtual product and manufacturing development, a holistic data strategy, evaluating HPC operating models, considering scalability, security, and energy efficiency, and leveraging external expertise. Findings are based on a December 2021 telephone survey of 200 IT and departmental decision makers from industrial enterprises with more than 500 employees in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

OPEC+ approved a smaller-than-expected output increase of 137,000 bpd starting in November, lifting oil prices around 1.5%. Brent rose to about $65.44 and WTI traded near $61.77. Analysts warned gains may be short-lived amid uneven demand and seasonal refinery maintenance, while OPEC+ prioritized price stability.

The lecture interprets the temperature obtained from Euclidean continuation in black hole and Rindler spacetimes. For black holes, periodically identifying Euclidean tau gives the Hartle-Hawking vacuum, a thermal state regular at the horizon; not identifying tau gives the Schwarzschild/Boulware vacuum, the natural canonical vacuum but singular at the horizon. For Rindler space, identifying theta with period 2pi corresponds to the standard Minkowski vacuum, which appears thermal to a uniformly accelerated Rindler observer. The lecture reviews the doubled-system description of a thermal state, where tracing out one system yields a thermal density matrix, and notes the harmonic-oscillator squeezed-state and Bogoliubov-transformation formulation. Using the Schrödinger wave-functional path integral, it derives the Minkowski vacuum as an entangled state between right and left Rindler patches; tracing out the left patch gives a Rindler thermal density matrix rho ~ exp(-2pi H_R), with beta=2pi for eta. The same reasoning is said to apply to black holes.

The passage discusses waning vaccine effectiveness against SARS-CoV-2 variants and the use of booster doses, then reports a phase III, prospective, multicenter, placebo-controlled, double-blind, randomized study of Biological E’s CORBEVAX™ as a single heterologous booster in adults aged 18–80 who were SARS-CoV-2 negative at enrolment and had received two primary doses of COVAXIN or COVISHIELD at least 6 months earlier. Of 546 screened, 416 were enrolled (208 per group); within each group, 156 received CORBEVAX™ and 52 received placebo in a 3:1 ratio. The primary objective was immunogenicity by virus neutralizing antibodies 28 days after booster versus placebo; secondary objectives included safety, tolerability, reactogenicity, anti-RBD IgG, GMT/GMC, GMFR, and immune response against Delta, with beta and cellular responses exploratory. CORBEVAX™ elicited superior immune responses versus placebo in both primed groups, higher percentages with ≥2-fold rises in nAb and anti-RBD IgG, increased nAb responses against Omicron, and enhanced IFN-gamma responses, while IL-4 levels were comparable. Reported adverse events were mild to moderate, with no serious AEs, grade-3 AEs, deaths, or AESIs, and none discontinued due to AEs. The discussion states CORBEVAX™ as a heterologous booster was safe, well tolerated, and induced effective humoral and cellular immune responses, with a limitation that immune response data were reported only at day 28 and longer follow-up is ongoing.

The study examines how Russia’s full-scale war against Ukraine affected foreign co-funding, authorship patterns, and citation impact of articles funded by MESU, NASU, and NRFU. It analyzes Scopus-indexed articles from 2020–2023 with at least one Ukrainian affiliation. Among 61,698 articles, 15,179 (25%) acknowledged funding.

The passage reports that the share of Ukrainian articles acknowledging funding rose from 21.7% to 28.5%. Articles funded by MESU, NASU, and NRFU increased from 8.6% to 11.9%, with NRFU rising from ninth to fourth place. Foreign co-funding remained common, especially for NASU, though its percentage decreased slightly for MESU and NASU and increased for NRFU. Foreign co-affiliation and foreign co-authorship increased in number for all three agencies, while percentages varied. Poland, Germany, the USA, China, the EU, the Netherlands, Slovakia, Lithuania, and Kazakhstan appeared among partners; Russia disappeared in 2022–2023. Articles with foreign funding showed higher international collaboration than those without.

Citation impact was measured as field-normalised citation impact. Foreign-funded articles had the highest impact; Ukrainian-only funding, especially NASU, generally lagged. MESU-funded articles rose in citation impact in 2022–2023, driven by highly cited outliers among authors with foreign co-affiliations. NASU-funded articles showed no significant period change, while foreign co-funding was positively associated with citation impact for NASU. NRFU-funded research declined modestly, and the benefit of foreign co-funding diminished. Unfunded articles with foreign co-affiliation or international co-authorship outperformed NASU-funded publications. The study concludes that international collaboration is important, raises concerns about funding allocation efficiency, and calls for reform and a centralised national funding database.

According to the Office for National Statistics, UK median disposable household income was £27,300 in the financial year ending 2017, up 2.3 per cent after inflation and £1,600 higher than before the 2008 downturn. Incomes grew across society, but the least wealthy benefited most: the poorest fifth rose by £1,800, while the richest fifth only just returned to pre-crisis levels. Inequality fell slowly. Income had fallen 4.5 per cent between 2010 and 2013. The increase was largely due to higher average income from employment. The gap remains: the richest fifth averaged £65,542 versus £12,748 for the poorest fifth. Retired households had median disposable income of £22,300 versus £29,900 for non-retired households, and that gap is growing again.

Research for the insurance industry after the Grenfell Tower fire found British building-material fire tests inadequate: they use only wood, though plastic is 20% of real fires, and test cladding sealed or under manufacturer conditions, unlike installed conditions with gaps, vents or ducts. The Association of British Insurers called for test reform, non-combustible materials and sprinklers.

The passage states that taxpayers either receive a refund or owe money. Late filing incurs IRS fees; not filing may forfeit refunds or lead to jail. The deadline is April 17, and extensions can avoid penalties. Refunds must be claimed within three years; as of March 8, the IRS reported about $1.1 billion in unclaimed 2014 refunds for an estimated 1 million nonfilers. Some nonfilers may qualify for withheld taxes or the EITC. If taxes are owed, the IRS sends notices, may use installment agreements, send representatives for debts over $25,000, and levy or seize assets. Communicating with the IRS is advised.

The disclosure relates to proximity sensors in a single integrated package. Prior art sensors use a plastic housing glued to a substrate, glass lenses, and a central barrier, with difficulties including small parts, lens placement accuracy, glue voids, overflow, and cross-talk. In embodiments, optical resin drops are dispensed over a light sensor chip and light source, cured to form lenses, and encapsulated in molding compound that blocks cross-talk and eliminates the plastic cap, central barrier, and glue. The assembly is polished to expose the lenses and singulated. A baffle, metal cap, or metal plate may be added. A light source may be mounted directly on the light sensor chip. Alternative embodiments use glass lenses over the optical resin, with air gaps and printed patterns or filters. Another embodiment includes a central glue stopper. Another package has an LED on a separate lead and reference and data light sensors. A sensor stick may include environmental, light, proximity, motion, and wireless connectivity sensors on a common substrate and connect to computing devices. Manufacturing may use lead frames, molding, glass lens attachment, support substrate removal, and singulation.

Bot Store, described as the world’s first and largest online marketplace for off-the-shelf plug-n-play bots, grew 100 percent in bot count in two months since launch. Artificial intelligence is the most popular category with 24 bots, speech-to-text leads downloads, finance and accounting is the most common business process, and SAP is the most prevalent application with 31 bots. With Automation Anywhere IQ Bot, partners and developers can now offer native computer vision, natural language processing, and machine learning capabilities, and several have contributed pre-trained cognitive bots for document-centric processes. Bots run on the Automation Anywhere Enterprise platform and can be combined to automate complex business processes.

California is seeking guidance from Colorado on implementing a regulated recreational cannabis system. Colorado Governor John Hickenlooper will testify before a California committee about Colorado’s experience with cannabis taxes, regulatory timelines, and lessons learned. California officials are concerned about the tight January 1, 2018 deadline and implementation challenges, including tax collection and a track-and-trace system.

Arsenal visit Tottenham on Sunday for Arsene Wenger's 50th meeting with Spurs. In the previous 49, Arsenal won 18, drew 21, and lost 10. Tottenham fan Mike Leigh says form is irrelevant, both need points, and predicts a tight 2-1 Spurs win, while doubting Chelsea will slip in the title race. Arsenal fan Akhil Vyas says recent FA Cup and league wins and a new formation boost confidence; Arsenal aim for the top four, the cup final, and to stop Spurs winning the title. He predicts a 2-1 Arsenal win or 1-1 draw, notes Spurs may finish above Arsenal for the first time in over 20 years, and says Wenger's future remains debated.

Private equity billionaire Tony James is backing a new life sciences investment firm that launched today, the firm told STAT exclusively; a headline says it is led by a former Flagship associate. The rest of the passage lists biotech updates, including pharma deals after Pfizer’s White House praise, Sarepta’s Medicaid coverage setback, digital health M&A, and other regulatory, drug, and venture capital headlines.

The passage discusses whether parents should encourage children’s belief in Santa. It states that fantastical beliefs are not harmful and are associated with positive developmental outcomes, including counterfactual reasoning and emotional development. Most children believe in Santa and abandon the belief by around age eight, and their questions reflect cognitive development. Parents may extend belief with plausible explanations or NORAD, redirect questions back to children, or provide disconfirming evidence when introducing the adult understanding of Santa as fantasy. The passage says children generally react positively to learning the truth, and a single lie is unlikely to cause irreparable damage, especially as children learn some lies are told with good intentions. It suggests modest Santa gifts and saving big gifts for parents so all children feel loved by Santa.

Three U.S., U.K. and Switzerland-based researchers won the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing cryo-electron microscopy, which creates detailed images of biomolecules by freezing them mid-movement. The prize is shared by Jacques Dubochet, Joachim Frank and Richard Henderson. The Nobel committee said the method is important for understanding life's chemistry and developing pharmaceuticals and allows visualization of molecular processes and interactions down to individual atoms.

Stephen Hawking co-hosted a Breakthrough Starshot announcement. Ten days before his death, he and Thomas Hertog submitted “A Smooth Exit from Eternal Inflation?”, discussing multiverse theory, infinite parallel universes, an alternate model, and the universe’s eventual death. Hawking never won a Nobel Prize.

The passage specifies the SEV-ES/SEV-SNP Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB) and GHCB MSR protocol, including GHCB mapping, protocol negotiation, hypervisor feature support, GHCB GPA registration, CPUID/SEV information requests, AP reset hold, page state change, termination, and error handling. This patent application is a continuation relating to a pin trap mechanism for a surgical linear cutter. It describes a linear surgical stapler with cartridge and anvil halves, a clamp lever, firing assembly, and staple cartridge for clamping, cutting, and stapling tissue. It further discloses various pin trap mechanisms that releasably couple the proximal ends of the stapler halves while allowing open and clamped states, using locking members or slides, proximal pins, notches or hooks, camming surfaces, springs, C-clips, ejector levers or slides, and rotatable locking members. The speaker says he feels more at ease as the playoffs progress but remains uptight before games. He credits the team’s prior playoff experience and pressure situations, despite some new faces, with helping players relax and handle situations. The article implements an RSI and moving average trading strategy in Python. It defines RSI overbought above 70 and oversold below 30, and SMA as the average over a specified period. The rules are to buy when the 14-day RSI is below 30 and the closing price is greater than the 5-day SMA, and sell when the 14-day RSI is greater than 70 and the closing price is lower than the 5-day SMA. The code downloads WMT daily closing prices from 2020-01-03 to 2022-01-10, calculates RSI and SMA, generates buy/sell signals, records operations, and plots an equity curve. It backtests SPY and QQQ by changing the ticker, and lists performance metrics including annual return, average gain per trade, win ratio, time invested, maximum drawdown, and risk-adjusted return.

Ferrari’s Sebastian Vettel won the 2018 Bahrain Grand Prix, holding off Mercedes’s Valtteri Bottas by 0.699 seconds. Vettel started from pole but switched to a one-stop strategy and preserved his tyres against Bottas’s fresher rubber. Red Bull’s Daniel Ricciardo and Max Verstappen retired early, and Ferrari’s Kimi Raikkonen retired after a pit incident. Lewis Hamilton finished third, followed by Pierre Gasly, Kevin Magnussen, Nico Hulkenberg, Fernando Alonso, Stoffel Vandoorne, Marcus Ericsson and Esteban Ocon. Bottas was disappointed, while Hamilton cited radio issues.

The Stochastic Indicator Strategy uses the Stochastic Oscillator to compare a security’s closing price to its price range over a period, typically 14 periods. It consists of %K and %D lines. Overbought conditions occur when %K rises above 80, and oversold conditions occur when it falls below 20. Traders use %K/%D crossovers, signal-line crossovers, and divergence to identify potential entries and exits. Adjustable parameters include moving-average lengths and overbought/oversold thresholds. The strategy can be applied across markets and timeframes. A SPY backtest from 1993 tested short-term mean reversion and %K/%D crossovers; short lookback and smoothing periods worked best, producing 556 trades, 0.57% average per trade, a 2.2 profit factor, and a 19.8% maximum drawdown, with oversold/overbought results outperforming crossovers. Limitations include false signals in low-volatility or ranging markets, lagging signals in strong trends, and conflicting signals in high volatility. The passage recommends combining the strategy with other indicators and risk management, including stop-loss orders, diversification, position sizing, and monitoring.

KeyBanc downgraded Fortinet from Overweight to Sector Weight with no price target, citing full valuation after strong share gains. It said Fortinet remains a network security standout with cloud opportunity, but its margin-expansion target has weakened, making risk-reward less favorable; shares fell 2.5%.

Saudi Aramco cut official selling prices for lighter crude grades to Asia for May, the second straight monthly cut, despite OPEC and allies’ output cuts. Arab Light fell 30 cents to a 45-cent discount to Oman-Dubai; Arab Extra Light fell 35 cents to a 60-cent premium; Super Light fell 20 cents, while Arab Medium and Heavy were unchanged. Middle East producers’ share of Asia crude imports fell in March from January, while Western exporters’ share rose. Saudis appear to be defending Asian market share for lighter grades while reducing heavier shipments.

Cancer therapies can cause cancer therapy-related cardiac dysfunction (CTRCD), and GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) have shown cardioprotective effects, but their use in CTRCD remains unvalidated. This study used TriNetX data from patients aged 18 years and older with cancer treated with cardiotoxic antineoplastic therapies who subsequently developed CTRCD between January 1, 2012, and January 1, 2023. Patients with acute coronary syndromes, CABG, or PCI were excluded. Patients were divided into GLP-1 RA and non-GLP-1 RA groups and propensity-score matched. Primary outcomes over one year included heart failure exacerbations, all-cause hospitalization or emergency department visits, and all-cause mortality.

After matching, 1,223 patients remained in each cohort. The primary composite outcome occurred in 681 GLP-1 RA patients versus 843 non-GLP-1 RA patients (55.7% vs. 68.9%; OR 0.566; p < 0.001). GLP-1 RA was associated with lower mortality, heart failure, and all-cause hospital admissions. Atrial fibrillation/flutter and ventricular tachycardia showed non-significant decreasing trends. Gastroenteritis was similar between groups. The study concludes that GLP-1 RAs may reduce mortality, heart failure exacerbations, and hospital admissions in CTRCD, though limitations include observational design, reliance on electronic health records, lack of chemotherapy regimen detail, limited demographic diversity, and one-year follow-up.

Welles met Finland’s Minister, who hoped relations would not deteriorate. Welles said the U.S., at war, could not maintain normal relations with any country actively assisting the Axis; Finnish assistance to Germany against Russia would be such assistance. Schoenfeld reported a new Germany-Finland trade agreement and a special Finland-Norway goods agreement.

Jane Goodall says conservation is more urgent than when she began, citing poaching, deforestation, and especially climate change as threats to wildlife. She remains cautiously optimistic and hopes her new documentary Jane, using 50-year-old footage of her chimpanzee work in Tanzania, prompts action.

Chairman and CEO Kenneth Lay said restoring investor confidence required replacing Fastow. The change followed an SEC informal inquiry into partnerships Fastow ran, LJM Cayman and LJM2, which did business with Enron. A respiratory assistance system delivers heated and humidified gases via a gas source, humidification chamber, chamber heater, inspiratory conduit, patient interface, and optional expiratory conduit. A controller determines characteristics of respiratory gases, such as mean flow rate, breathing pattern, bias flow, reverse flow, rebreathing, temperature, or expiratory circuit signals, to determine the type of gas source, including air entraining or non-entraining. Based on this determination, the controller can generate indicators, control or change a chamber heater set point temperature, and adjust humidity output. Rebreathing can be detected by comparing inlet and outlet flow profiles, phases, or correlations, and bias flow can be determined from flow rate changes. The system may receive user input and automatically confirm or determine operational configuration, select default or safety modes, and control heater plate temperature. Methods for determining gas source type are also provided.

CeeDee Lamb has missed two games with a high left ankle sprain. ESPN’s Todd Archer said Lamb did resistance-band work for a second straight day, his first such work since the injury, showing rehab progress. Archer guessed Lamb will return in Week 7, not Week 6, and wrote not to rule him out for next week’s game vs. Washington. Barring increased Friday participation, Lamb is likely out again.

Epidemiological studies show higher cancer incidence in immunocompromised patients, including those with HIV. AIDS-defining cancers had poor prognosis before HAART; HAART reduced AIDS-defining cancers but non-AIDS-defining malignancies are increasing among HIV-infected people. Mechanisms are poorly understood and may involve non-HIV factors such as occupational exposure to toxic metals and chemicals. The study evaluated whether p53 and bcl2 levels are associated with HIV infection, occupational exposure, oxidative damage, and antioxidant protection. In a Nigerian cross-sectional study of 128 HIV-positive and 120 HIV-negative adults divided by HIV status and occupational chemical exposure, p53, bcl2, SOD, 8OHdG, MDA, and CD4 were measured. HIV-positive exposed participants had lower p53 and bcl2 than HIV-negative unexposed participants and higher MDA; HIV-positive groups had lower CD4 counts. p53 and bcl2 correlated positively with 8OHdG and SOD. HIV status and SOD were significantly associated with p53 and bcl2. The authors conclude that immune deficiency, antioxidant deficits, oxidative stress, and apoptosis dysregulation contribute to increased genomic instability and cancer risk in HIV-infected individuals occupationally exposed to chemical mixtures, and that SOD may be essential for p53’s protective role.

Solomon Dalung said President Muhammadu Buhari’s 2015 victory proved one can win election in Nigeria without money and described it as a political revolution against “god-fatherism.” Speaking in New York, where he attended the Seventh Economic and Social Council Youth Forum, Dalung discussed the “Not too Young to Run” advocacy, blamed “urban gorillas” for manipulating politics, said he brought the APC to Plateau but lacked a god-father, and urged youths to understand the political system. The document covers MSPM0C1105/MSPM0C1106 peripherals and device information: temperature sensor with linear voltage output and factory single-point calibration; LFSS with RTC and asynchronous IWDT; VREF with 1.4V/2.5V internal references and external reference support; comparator features; security and CRC; UART, I2C, SPI, IWDT, WWDT, RTC_B, and TIMx features; analog connections; I/O diagrams and IOMUX; SWD and DEBUGSS; factory constants, DEVICEID and USERID; typical application schematic recommendations; documentation support, device nomenclature, revision history, and mechanical, packaging, and orderable information. Scientists propose installing about 10 million wind-powered pumps over the Arctic ice cap to spray seawater onto the surface and add roughly 1 metre of sea ice, which they say could reduce the risk of summer sea ice disappearing. They estimate this would require about 10 million tons of steel per year and cost around US$500 billion; covering the entire Arctic with 100 million pumps would need 100 million tons of steel per year. Previous geoengineering proposals included bright aerosols or artificial clouds. The passage says the Arctic is warming faster than anywhere else, threatening polar bears, Arctic cod, solar reflection, and weather via jet stream changes. Lead researcher Steven Desch argues government plans are insufficient, and Julienne Stroeve says the situation is more dire than worst-case scenarios. The project, outlined in Earth’s Future, is described as unlikely in its current form.

Germany’s Federal Cartel Office is investigating Temu over whether it influences merchants’ pricing and breaches competition rules. Temu says it complies with European law and is cooperating; it serves about 19 million German and over 100 million European users. Confirmed violations could lead to penalties or altered merchant terms amid broader European scrutiny of digital marketplaces.
The Third Circuit found no error after examining the record, appellants’ brief, and oral argument, and affirmed the district court’s judgment.

This study used genomic surveillance and epidemiological data from Connecticut from January 2022 to January 2023 to reconstruct SARS-CoV-2 Omicron lineage replacement dynamics. It analyzed lineage growth rates, variant-specific infection estimates, RT-qPCR viral copy numbers, and vaccine breakthrough infection risk. BA.1, BA.2, BA.4, BA.5, and XBB sequentially replaced prior lineages; BA.1 had the fastest initial growth, and later lineage replacements slowed. BA.1 and BA.2 showed greater transmission advantages over their predecessors than BA.4 and BA.5, while XBB later outcompeted late-stage BA.5. Viral copy number trends varied and only partially explained lineage replacement. Immune escape findings varied: BA.1 showed increased breakthrough risk compared with Delta, BA.2 showed little or no effect, and BA.5 and XBB had non-significant tendencies. The authors propose that Omicron lineage fitness depended on a combination of intrinsic transmissibility and immune escape shaped by host antigen exposure, and they conclude that integrated genomic surveillance with clinical and epidemiological metadata is useful for monitoring SARS-CoV-2 and other pathogens.

Tesla announced new Model Y and Model 3 Standard versions priced at $39,990 and $36,990, about $5,000 less than Premium variants but not enough to offset the canceled $7,500 EV tax credit. To cut costs, Tesla reduced features, including smaller wheels, fewer colors, less vegan leather, no rear touchscreen, and less power and range. An Edmunds analyst doubts a 10 percent price cut will win many new customers, saying a vehicle closer to $30,000 might. Japan has high life expectancy and has implemented multiple pension reforms reflecting the imbalance between an ageing population and falling natality. The passage reviews subjective survival probabilities (SSP), noting associations with mortality, differences from self-rated health, gender and socio-economic disparities, and limited research on SSP’s socio-economic determinants. It describes a study using four JSTAR waves (2007–2013) in ten Japanese prefectures to examine employment and work factors associated with SSP among people aged 50 and over. Research questions address differences in SSP by employment status, job satisfaction, and working time, and whether demographic, socio-economic, and health adjustments affect these relationships. JSTAR asks respondents for percentage probabilities of living to specific ages.

The lecture covers entry in industrial organization. It presents a two-stage model with potential entrants choosing entry and paying a sunk fixed cost K, then competing; equilibrium entry is solved by backward induction. In homogeneous goods, fixed costs and competition determine the number of entrants, with lower fixed costs leading to more entry. Bertrand, Cournot, and search models illustrate different profit patterns. Equilibrium profits can be a rounding error, and homogeneous-goods entry is generally excessive up to a possible rounding error because of business stealing. With heterogeneous goods, entry can be excessive or insufficient depending on business stealing versus consumer-surplus effects; a Hotelling example yields twice as many firms as socially optimal. Vertical differentiation can lead to natural oligopoly or specialization. The lecture also discusses census data showing high entry and exit, Jovanovic’s model of firm learning and dynamics, and Vellodi’s application to rating intermediaries, where new firms learn slowly from reviews and a platform may optimally use partially revealing information policies.

This lecture introduces MIT course 14.13, Psychology and Economics/Behavioral Economics, taught by Frank Schilbach. Schilbach describes his research at the intersection of development and behavioral economics, including poverty, financial constraints, sleep deprivation, pain, substance abuse, mental health, depression, and loneliness. He defines psychology and economics as integrating psychological and other insights into economics to make models more realistic, predictive, and useful for policy. The lecture lists standard economic assumptions—stable and well-defined preferences, rationality and utility maximization, self-interest, self-control, discounting, risk aversion, Bayesian updating, no taste for beliefs, and preferences over final outcomes—and discusses examples of deviations, including demand for commitment, imperfect Bayesian updating, social preferences and peer effects, limited self-control, demand for information, default effects, reminders, charity, and limited attention. It explains that models are simplified representations and that good models should be simple, tractable, insightful, generalizable, falsifiable, empirically consistent, and predictive. It states that behavioral economics complements standard economics. The laptop policy example discusses evidence that laptops reduce learning and possible policies, including the class’s opt-in laptop section. The lecture outlines course topics including preferences, beliefs, attention, mental health, discrimination, policy and paternalism, and poverty.

GAO-24-105648 examines the characteristics of comprehensive support and improvement (CSI) schools, how CSI plans address selected ESEA requirements, and Education’s monitoring. Using 2019–20 data and a generalizable sample of CSI plans, GAO found CSI schools enrolled about 2.5 million students, or 5 percent of all public school students, and more commonly served predominantly low-income and Black student populations, had lower proficiency rates, and had slightly higher student-teacher ratios than other public schools. About 42 percent of CSI plans appeared to address all three selected required elements—needs assessment, resource inequities, and interventions—while 30 percent addressed two and 28 percent addressed one or none. Officials reported challenges developing each element, especially evidence-based interventions. Education collects school improvement data and monitors states, identifying compliance issues, but does not independently select CSI plans for review. GAO recommends Education update monitoring protocols to independently select CSI plans; Education agreed and said it will begin doing so in spring 2024.

This study used ultra-high-field 23Na MRI and structural connectomes to examine sodium homeostasis in structural hubs in drug-resistant focal epilepsy. In patients, total sodium concentration (TSC) was increased globally and was higher in hub than non-hub regions in both patients and controls. The sodium signal fraction f was increased in the epileptogenic zone and decreased in non-epileptogenic regions, but did not differ between hub and non-hub parcels in controls or patients. Patients with epileptogenic-zone overlap with hubs showed a less pronounced TSC increase and f decrease than those without overlap, though EZ extent and clinical features did not differ statistically. The authors conclude that TSC increases in structural hubs likely reflect unspecific microstructural abnormalities, while increased f in the EZ may mark susceptibility to homeostasis failure associated with abnormal rhythms.

An early-season catastrophic injury, initially feared to last up to six months, was seen as a blessing in disguise because it forced the speaker to learn the organization, try young players in different spots, assess depth, and prepare for the trade deadline; when the player returned, he was fresh. DD gates its Local bus clock off when idle after an interrupt. If an edge-configured PIC input stays high, the PIC cannot return to Idle, new edges are missed, and the clock may not restart, potentially causing missed interrupts, system hang, or unexpected behavior.

Russian traditional sunburn remedies include dairy products such as sour cream, yogurt, and kefir for redness; egg whites, nettle decoction, or watermelon juice for pain; sea buckthorn oil for peeling and chafing; and fresh potato, carrot, or pumpkin for itching. Academic code violations remain high, with over 50 percent occurring in computer science, Thomas Doeppner said.
