The answer says yes: recent hurricanes and western wildfires will lead more voters to accept climate change as real, man-made, and serious, and to prioritize it. Migration from southern Florida and Houston will reduce Republican votes and increase Democratic votes, making some formerly safe seats competitive. The answer predicts Republicans will be punished unless they change, with future warming causing further shifts.

Europe is to launch Sentinel-3B on Wednesday to monitor Earth’s oceans as part of the EU/ESA Copernicus constellation. It will join twin Sentinel-3A in opposite orbits at about 800 km, providing data within three hours, 24/7. It will monitor sea level, temperature, pollution, sea ice, coastal vegetation, rivers, lakes and wildfires. Copernicus has a 2008–2020 budget of about €7.5 billion, offers free data, and faces uncertainty over Brexit’s impact.

Crews removed Gainesville’s “Old Joe” Confederate statue; it will be returned to the United Daughters of the Confederacy. In Tampa, a Confederate memorial park was splashed with red paint and derogatory comments. Hillsborough County commissioners had voted to remove another downtown Tampa monument. These events occurred amid Confederate monument debates and violence in Charlottesville, Virginia.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated April 24, 2019, reporting that on April 24, 2019 it issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended March 31, 2019. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The report was signed by Frank H. Brod.

The passage describes a Triangle & Two defense intended to deny and limit outstanding shooters’ touches, and a “Double Stack” combination offense to free shooters. Posts take mid-post positions with shooters aligned behind them, providing baseline spacing and a head-start advantage against stationary defenders. Options include pop out, curl, fade, back cut, and feeding the screener after a switch, plus entries such as cross, fake cross, single/double screen, base screen, and side screen. Success requires coordinated execution, drills, scouting, defensive recognition, and varying alignments and entries. The Triangle & Two uses three triangle-zone players and two chasers who deny passes and rebounds.

This passage describes GHCB/VMGEXIT communication for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP guests. It gives a version 1 example where a guest #VC handler disables preemption and interrupts, sets the GHCB physical address in MSR 0xc001_0130, clears prior invocation data, and sets required GHCB fields; the hypervisor resumes with VMEXIT_VMGEXIT, reads VMCB offset 0x00a0, translates the GHCB GPA, handles the exit using SW_EXITCODE, updates GHCB save state, recreates protocol versioning or a CPUID response, or terminates the guest. SEV-ES guests must avoid unplanned NAE events before long mode or 32-bit PAE and determine the encryption bit position.

The passage defines GHCB protocol versions, required NAE events, VALID_BITMAP usage, SW_EXITCODE/SW_EXITINFO handling, and hypervisor error responses. It describes the SEV-SNP secrets page reserved area, EFI SNP Confidential Computing Blob configuration table, and expanded message sequence numbers. It covers NAE events including IOIO_PROT, MSR_PROT, VMMCALL, #NPF/MMIO, Page State Change, SNP Guest Request, SNP Extended Guest Request, AP Creation, #HV Doorbell, #HV Send IPI, #HV Timer, APIC ID List, SNP Run VMPL, SEV-TIO, Secure AVIC, Termination Request, and unsupported NAE. It also addresses SMP boot, AP Reset Hold, AP Jump Table, NMI handling, debug registers, SMM and nested virtualization limitations, and #HV doorbell page host/guest interrupt and EOI behavior.

The AEGEAN study randomized subjects to Primary SOC or Additional Educational Program groups. At 24 weeks, 1162 subjects were randomized and 1160 treated; 1054 completed the 24-week visit. In Part 2, 524 subjects were randomized to Secondary SOC or Continued Additional Educational Program groups, and 1003 completed the 48-week visit. Baseline and demographic characteristics were comparable among groups. Apixaban compliance was high, and exposure/interruption were comparable. Mean adherence at 24 weeks was 91.64% in Primary SOC and 91.88% in Additional Educational Program, with no significant difference. Adherence was significantly lower between Week 12 and Week 24 than between first dose and Week 12, and between Week 24 and Week 48 than between first dose and Week 24. Persistence at 24 weeks was 91.7% and 91.3%; at 48 weeks it was 85.2%, 87.8%, and 86.1% across groups, with no significant differences. Safety endpoints were similar between groups. Overall, 24 deaths were reported, and no pregnancies were reported. The study demonstrated high adherence and persistence during the first 24 weeks, sustained up to 48 weeks; a proactive educational program did not provide additional adherence or persistence benefits.

At the 59th ASH Annual Meeting, Seattle Children's Research Institute presented phase 2 trial results showing that adding abatacept to a standard regimen reduced acute grade III-IV graft-versus-host disease from 32% to 3% in pediatric and adult patients receiving mismatched unrelated donor stem cell transplants. Patients receiving abatacept had improved disease-free and overall survival, intact immune reconstitution, no major uncontrolled infection, and no increase in disease relapse. Abatacept inhibits T-cell activation. A second cohort of 140 HLA-matched unrelated donor transplant patients completed enrollment in November 2017, with data expected in six months.
Geoff Cameron said Stoke City, five games winless and eight points above the drop zone, must beat relegation-threatened Hull City on Saturday to take three points.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2015. For Q3 2015, total net sales were $25,358 million, income from operations was $406 million, and net income was $79 million; for the nine months ended September 30, 2015, net sales were $71,259 million and net income was $114 million. Cash and cash equivalents were $10,709 million at September 30, 2015. The company reported segments North America, International, and AWS, with AWS net sales of $2,085 million in Q3 2015. The filing also discusses cash flows, commitments and contingencies, legal proceedings, acquisitions, long-term debt, income taxes, stockholders’ equity, and management’s discussion and analysis.

The President discusses Syria’s civil war, the August 21 chemical weapons attack that killed over a thousand people, and U.S. responsibility to respond. He says the Assad regime was responsible and that chemical weapons use violates international law and threatens U.S. security. He determined a targeted military strike could deter and degrade chemical weapons use without putting troops on the ground, pursuing an open-ended war, or removing Assad. He sought congressional support. He also cites a diplomatic opening: Russia indicated willingness to push Assad to give up chemical weapons, and Assad admitted having them and said it would join the Chemical Weapons Convention. He asked Congress to postpone a vote while pursuing diplomacy, ordered the military to maintain pressure, and said the U.S. would work with allies and the U.N. to require Assad to give up and destroy chemical weapons.

The speaker thanks Pete, Secretary Hegseth, and General Caine, and addresses senior military leadership. He discusses renaming the Department of Defense to the Department of War and changing the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America, saying the changes were popular and that a court upheld the Gulf name against AP. He says he has settled multiple wars, including Pakistan-India, Congo-Rwanda, and Azerbaijan-Armenia, and that a Middle East settlement and a Putin-Zelensky agreement remain. He cites record recruiting and retention, plans for over $1 trillion in 2026 military spending, the F-47 fighter, nuclear modernization, the Golden Dome missile defense shield, expanding the Navy by at least 19 ships, and considering battleships. He mentions NATO members committing to 5% of GDP and U.S. weapons sales to NATO. He describes domestic deployments, crime reduction in Washington, D.C., possible operations in Chicago and Portland, border security, tariffs, merit-based policies, criticism of the press and autopen, and a Board of Peace for Gaza. He calls for a strong, lethal military focused on merit and America First.

A Milwaukee woman said that around 11 p.m. on New Year’s Eve, someone kicked in her front door while she was home watching TV. Her alarm scared the suspects away, and they said it was the wrong house; she called 911, learned of similar calls on her street, and planned to change her security after the door was damaged.

Wednesday: Biogen fell as its CFO left; H&R Block rose on strong results; high-dividend stocks climbed as bond yields fell; GameStop, banks, Synchronoss, and energy stocks fell; Brookdale rose on reported sale talks.

The passage reports that Childs Farm Baby Moisturiser, priced at £3.99 and sold in shops including Boots and Asda, has been praised online as a treatment for eczema and psoriasis. Laura Gray said her psoriasis cleared within 24 hours after using it. Paige Sweeney said the cream improved her three-year-old daughter Evie-Rae’s eczema after unsuccessful dermatologist appointments and medications, and her Facebook post’s before-and-after images were shared over 40,000 times. Joanne said her one-year-old daughter Kelisha’s severe eczema cleared after four weeks of use, improving her comfort and mood. The company’s dermatologist Dr Jennifer Crawley said eczema is upsetting and fluctuating, and regular moisturising is crucial to soothe, hydrate, and allow irritated skin to heal.

This study examined whether the 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine equation, which removed a race adjustment, reduced disparities in CKD diagnosis and staging compared with the 2009 equation. Using a subset of Truveta electronic health record data, researchers evaluated patients aged 18 years or older with non-hospitalization serum creatinine values from January 1, 2016, to September 30, 2023, requiring at least three serum creatinine values over more than 90 days and excluding pregnancy, polycystic kidney disease, and acute kidney injury. GFR was estimated with both equations, and outcomes included discordance in CKD staging and earlier identification of CKD.

Among 8,080,889 patients, 15.5% were Black; 1,239,185 met criteria for CKD stages 3a, 3b, 4, or 5 using either equation. The study found significant staging discordance, mostly in earlier stages. Nearly 50% of Black patients meeting stage 3a criteria by the 2021 equation did not meet CKD criteria by the 2009 equation, and 50% of Black patients meeting stage 3b by 2021 were stage 3a by 2009. Approximately 40% of stage 4 disease among Black patients was discordant. The 2021 equation identified CKD earlier for 24% of Black patients versus 0.7% of non-Black patients. In multivariate analysis, Black patients were 126 times more likely to have an increased CKD stage using the 2021 equation. SDOH factors included in the study were not significantly associated with increased stage. The authors conclude the results underscore the need to continue examining removal of race from GFR estimation.

On April 28, 2021, Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that it issued a press release regarding its financial results for the second fiscal quarter ended March 27, 2021, attached as Exhibit 99.1. The filing also lists Apple securities registered under Section 12(b) and is signed by Luca Maestri.

The speaker says the season has reached the last possible game and discusses whether home ice, experience, or the first goal provide an advantage. They say players know what to do, have bounced back before, and must focus on the next game rather than past series. They mention mental fatigue, need for rest, and surprise at their team's penalties and emotions, which must be reviewed. They add that hate between teams is normal in a long series and makes for good competition.

Legal experts criticised the Communications (Retention of Data) Bill 2017, drafted in response to the Murray Report. They said two key recommendations are absent: specific protections for journalists’ data, including High Court authorisation for requests, and an independent, resourced monitoring body for service providers. The bill would replace the 2011 act and require district court judge authorisation for requests. It retains High Court retrospective reviews, previously criticised, while enhancing instances requiring prior judicial authorisation.
New trials show oral GLP-1 drugs help obesity weight loss; pills avoid needles and refrigeration.

Deanna Conley, 77, of Florissant, had chronic back pain for nearly 40 years and five spinal fusion surgeries. Dr. Michael Bottros at the Washington University Pain Management Center suggested a spinal cord stimulator implant, with wire leads in the epidural space that pulse to block pain signals. After a one-week trial, Conley received a permanent implant with a battery under the skin. She stopped using a walker or wheelchair, recharges the battery on a pad, and says she has a new lease on life. Bottros reports 40 to 50 patients received the implants in the past year, nearly all with remarkable results.

Rory McKelvie, 19, was found dead at an address in Biggar, Lanarkshire, last weekend; his death is not suspicious. He claimed a doctor told him his mental health issues weren’t “bad enough yet” and to return nearer breaking point. He shared his struggles online, said someone stopped him from suicide in November, and urged others to talk. His mother said he died in his sleep; tributes were paid, including by his girlfriend. NHS Lanarkshire was contacted.

Donald Trump faced criticism for a tweet defending his writing that contained misspellings and grammatical errors. Tony Schwartz, ghostwriter of The Art of the Deal, said Trump cannot read or write well and had little to do with the book. Trump criticized “Fake News” for “pouring” over his tweets and said he capitalizes words for emphasis. J.K. Rowling mocked him. Separately, Annapolis’s mayor said Trump denied lowering flags after a newsroom shooting; after criticism, Trump declared flags be lowered.

Clinton County was recently recognized as a “Top 100 Micropolitan” by Site Selection magazine. In 2017, Ohio had 16, the most, and Georgia had 14; Wilmington–Clinton County tied for 64th. Clinton County submitted four projects with $70 million in new investment, 150 new jobs, and 400 retained jobs, vetted by JobsOhio and Site Selection. A micropolitan has an urban cluster of 10,000 to under 50,000 people. Bright Farms is under construction on Davids Drive.

A collection of Nov. 30, 2001 reports said Enron faced likely bankruptcy after Dynegy ended their merger and credit downgrades to junk status. Enron Australia was barred from power futures trading, and Enron was suspended from Nord Pool, the U.K. Power Exchange, and the EEX; its status on APX and Dutch grid access remained under review. Enron Europe entered administration, delayed a job-cut meeting, failed to deliver gas to German utilities, and its European trading operations were disrupted. Enron’s overseas assets and investments remained uncertain. Federal prosecutors sought to monitor the SEC probe, the SEC promised a swift investigation, and Senate and House panels planned hearings. Analysts estimated insurers could face over $3 billion in losses, while European banks and utilities reported exposures. Dynegy said it planned to take over Northern Natural Gas despite Enron’s possible bankruptcy, and Fitch kept Dynegy on Rating Watch Negative.

Arsene Wenger wants to include all his attacking players in Arsenal’s new-look line-up. Arsenal completed a record £56million deal for Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, signed Henrikh Mkhitaryan, re-signed Mesut Ozil to a £350,000-a-week contract, and have Alexandre Lacazette. Wenger called Arsenal an attacking team and said he will try to find a way to fit them in while improving the defense and finding balance. He said re-signing Ozil was cheaper than buying a replacement. Aubameyang may not start against Everton because of fever; he gave a medical certificate to a German court after missing a hearing. Wenger said players must fight for their places and would not reassure Lacazette.

On June 1, Edmonton police charged 62-year-old blogger Barry Kent Winters with wilfully promoting hatred against an identifiable group, a rare Criminal Code charge. Police could recall no other such charge there; Alberta had three in six years. His blogs, the Baconfat Chronicles and Baconfat News, contained racist and hateful references to indigenous people, gays, lesbians, transgender people, feminists, Muslims, and many other groups, as well as rants about public figures. They repeatedly threatened to post nude pictures of Rehteah Parsons and accused her father, Glen Canning, of molesting her. After years of complaints and a 13-month investigation, police laid the charge with the deputy attorney general’s consent; courts forced the blogs down as a pre-trial release condition. The passage discusses concerns about free speech, notoriety, the Jim Keegstra precedent, and whether criminalizing offensive speech causes more harm.

The Strategic National Stockpile is a $7 billion government repository of drugs and supplies for bioterrorism, nuclear attack, infectious disease outbreaks, and other public health emergencies. Its secret warehouses hold antibiotics, vaccines, antivirals, and other items. For nearly two decades it has been managed by the CDC. The Trump administration plans to shift oversight of the $575 million program to the HHS Assistant Secretary for Preparedness and Response, which proponents say will streamline decision-making and create efficiencies. Critics, including public health officials and bipartisan members of Congress, warn the move could disrupt distribution to the “last mile,” politicize decisions, favor expensive biotech products over broader-use medicines, and may not make Americans safer. The stockpile was created in 1999 and has expanded to natural disasters and emerging infectious disease threats, deploying supplies during events such as the 2009-2010 swine flu pandemic and hurricanes that devastated Houston and Puerto Rico. Officials will not disclose warehouse numbers or locations, but a 2016 report said there are at least six.

The Larisons appealed summary judgment for Public Water Supply District #1 of Andrew County in their personal injury action. Mrs. Larison was injured when a water meter lid slid off and her leg plunged into the meter well nine days after a Water District operator read the meter. The Larisons asserted the dangerous condition exception to sovereign immunity, operator negligence, the Water District’s actual or constructive knowledge, and res ipsa loquitur. The appellate court reversed summary judgment on the operator negligence claims because a genuine issue of material fact existed as to whether the operator negligently replaced the lid; the operator’s routine and credibility were for the jury. It affirmed summary judgment on the claim that the Water District knew or should have known of a dangerous condition, because evidence that the mower caused the lid to loosen was speculative. It also affirmed dismissal of res ipsa loquitur because the Water District did not have exclusive control over the meter lid, which was accessible to tampering.

This study used SAEFVIC spontaneous reports and a self-controlled case series analysis of POLAR general practice data to assess audiovestibular conditions after COVID-19 vaccination. It found increased vertigo presentations following mRNA vaccines and increased tinnitus presentations following both mRNA and adenovirus vector vaccines, but no increased hearing loss following any COVID-19 vaccine. Reporting rates were higher for adenovirus vector vaccines than mRNA vaccines, while SCCS analysis showed increased audiovestibular risk after both vaccine types. The authors note possible confounding by COVID-19 infection and incomplete vaccination records as limitations.

The lecture discusses the Higgs mechanism, proposed in the mid-1960s by Peter Higgs and others, which gives masses to the W and Z gauge bosons and can also give masses to fermions. It explains spontaneous symmetry breaking using a complex scalar field and a potential with a nonzero vacuum expectation value. This results in a massive gauge boson, a remaining massive scalar field, and Goldstone bosons that are absorbed as longitudinal polarizations. In the Standard Model, extending to SU2×U1, the Higgs vacuum expectation value and couplings generate W± and Z masses, while the photon remains massless. The Higgs boson was discovered at the LHC in 2012.

BCom (Hons) third-semester students in Indore were served Corporate Accounts papers instead of Corporate Law for Monday’s exam; the university replaced them, delaying the exam by about 30 minutes. Because the Corporate Accounts exam was scheduled for December 18, its paper was allegedly leaked, but DAVV said bundles were opened mistakenly and not served, and said it would change the set if needed. DAVV also said BCom (Hons) would remain under the annual system.

Gold steadied below $1,250 an ounce after its biggest weekly drop since May, with trading muted before an expected Federal Reserve rate hike. Spot gold was little changed at $1,247.48, while U.S. futures rose. Money managers sharply cut net long COMEX gold and silver positions, with silver’s net positions falling by a record amount. Silver, platinum and palladium were lower.

Disparities in basic education quality and a siphon effect moving students and teachers to resource-rich areas lead to education groups, which link prestigious core schools with ordinary branch schools. Core schools send administrators and anchor teachers to branches for guidance and training, increasing high-quality resources and member school quality. Outcomes include government backing, resource sharing, management and curriculum coordination, quality assessment, improved teacher satisfaction and professional competence, student comprehensive development, and relief of school-picking fever. Problems include imposition of core school culture erasing non-core identities, ordinary schools struggling to apply prestigious schools’ educational philosophy due to differences in teacher and student ability, and core school management lacking motivation because blind expansion, costs, and performance evaluation burden it. Suggestions are to establish equal and democratic relationships and a standing committee, strengthen team building through teacher rotation, training, and online resource sharing, and win government policy and financial support and recognition. The conclusion states China promotes basic education groups for equity, describes them as contractual deep cooperation between prestigious and non-prestigious schools, and says further study is needed on cooperation without erasing individual school characteristics and sustaining motivation.

Fire Departments statewide are holding October education sessions for Fire Prevention month, themed “Every Second counts –know two ways out.” Officials advise knowing multiple exits, avoiding blocked doors and windows in colder weather, reinforcing alarm and fire safety messages with kids, and rehearsing home fire drills.

The passage presents examples and requirements for SEV-ES and SEV-SNP GHCB negotiation and VMGEXIT handling. It describes hypervisor use of VMCB offset 0x00a0 and MSR 0xc001_0130, guest #VC handling, protocol version and encryption-bit discovery, GHCB page registration, and GHCB/VMGEXIT flow. It defines NAE events and VALID_BITMAP rules, and lists handling for IOIO_PROT, MSR_PROT, VMMCALL, #NPF/MMIO, Page State Change, SNP Guest Request and Extended Guest Request, AP Creation, #HV doorbell, #HV Send IPI, #HV Timer, APIC ID List, SNP Run VMPL, SEV-TIO, Secure AVIC, and termination requests. It also covers SEV-SNP secrets page and EFI configuration table, guest identification of SEV-ES support, SMP/AP booting and AP jump table handling, NMI completion, debug register virtualization, and states that SMM and nested virtualization are not supported. It further defines #HV doorbell page fields, interrupt shadows, and host/guest behavior for pending events and EOI.

Amazon Prime Big Deal Days is running Kindle deals, described as a good time to buy a Kindle before the holiday shopping season. Many Kindle models are on sale, including the Colorsoft and Colorsoft Signature, second-generation Scribe, Kindle Paperwhite and Signature, base Kindle, Colorsoft Kids, and Paperwhite Kids. The passage notes features and recommendations for each, mentions new Kindles coming later this fall, and references additional sale and Kindle guides.

The appellant’s application for a writ of error coram nobis to vacate a prior decision and order on the ground of ineffective assistance of appellate counsel was denied because he failed to establish that he was denied effective assistance of appellate counsel.

Adidas and Refinery29 created one custom UltraBOOST X running shoe for each U.S. state in a limited Boost the Nation series. Each pair was designed by a female artist and auctioned to benefit Women Win. Georgia’s peach-themed shoe, designed by Lizzie Darden, has green laces and a plastic leaf. Bids included $350 for Georgia and $1,000 for Ohio; bidding ran through the next day.

Judgment unanimously affirmed. Defendant was convicted after a jury trial of three counts of first-degree robbery. His peremptory-challenge claim was unpreserved, and the court declined discretionary review. The suppression ruling was upheld: the initial hospital questioning, suggestion to wait, and brief request to return were not unlawful detention or forcible seizure; later reasonable suspicion justified continued detention for showup identification and questioning.

Britain's FTSE index closed higher on Wednesday after a choppy session following the formal triggering of its EU departure. The FTSE 100 ended up 0.4 percent as sterling's retreat stoked expectations for the export-heavy index, while the mid-cap index rose 0.1 percent. LSE shares rose 2.7 percent after EU regulators blocked its proposed merger with Deutsche Boerse.

A returned-mail notice to Jeff Dasovich reports that delivery to hgovenar@mail.acom2.com failed with a permanent fatal error and that the user is unknown. The original forwarded email concerns a confidential email sent to Ken Lay’s office for delivery to Sen. Brulte. It discusses proposed California electricity legislation, delivery and circulation plans, coalition and PR efforts, DWR credit issues and options, distributed generation, the California supply-demand outlook, and a suggested legislative package addressing supply, demand, competitive retail markets, and utility solvency; two attachments are listed.

This study examined perivascular space (PVS) burden in epilepsy. People with various epilepsy types were recruited and matched approximately by age and sex with healthy controls. T1-weighted MRI and PINGU segmentation were used to calculate PVS volume fractions in white matter and basal ganglia. Among 467 epilepsy patients and 473 controls, all epilepsy subtypes had higher PVS volume fractions in the basal ganglia compared with controls (101–140%; effect size 0.95–1.37; p<1.33×10−15). There was no difference in white matter PVS volume fractions between epilepsy patients and controls or between epilepsy subtypes. The TLE-HS group had larger contralateral PVS distribution asymmetry, not observed in controls or other subtypes. No association was found between PVS volume fractions and illness duration. The authors conclude basal ganglia PVS volume is enlarged in epilepsy and longitudinal studies are needed to determine directionality.

On June 16, 2016, NVIDIA Corporation reported that David M. Shannon, 60, Executive Vice President, Chief Administrative Officer and Secretary, will retire at the end of the calendar year. Shannon joined NVIDIA in August 2002 and is responsible for legal and human resources; upon his retirement, Senior Vice President and General Counsel Brian E. Cabrera, 51, will lead the legal team, and NVIDIA will recruit a human resources leader.

The passage describes formal modelling, verification, and correct-by-construction synthesis of an input selection unit, or voter unit, for a synchronous N-modular redundant measurement system used in avionics control. The voter receives readings and health status from N redundant input units, selects a prime unit, discards transient errors, isolates permanently faulty units using multi-cycle fault history, and provides a reliable output value, reliability parameters, validity status, and output age to a controller. It formulates functional requirements for fault identification, soundness and completeness, permanent-fault isolation, output generation, validity status, and output age, and derives theoretical limits that the algorithm matches. The design is a state transition system with configurable parameters including num_units, δ, persistence_lmt, and max_simul_fault. It is implemented in Rocq, with proofs embedded so the synthesized code is correct by construction and extractable to OCaml/Haskell/Scheme. Verification of requirements R1–R16 took about 23 seconds; the extracted OCaml code has 362 lines, and one cycle transition runs in about 3 milliseconds. Future directions include hierarchical redundancy management and asynchronous redundant units.

Dr. Thomas Wilson Ikubese, a 2019 presidential aspirant, joined the Alliance for New Nigeria after consultations, following NIM’s adoption of ANN; he had left the National Conscience Party two weeks earlier. He called ANN the “Third Force,” urged supporters to join and register, and sought other young aspirants to unite under NIM to wrestle power from President Buhari’s administration.

The document describes AMD’s Tiered Memory Page Migration (TMPM) engine, which provides optional extensions to SEV and SNP for page migration. It requires IOMMU enablement and can pause DMA traffic while copying pages and updating IOMMU mappings. TMPM supports commands such as PM_PAGE_MOVE_IO and PM_PAGE_MOVE_GUEST, with up to 128 pages migrated per multi-page command using a ring buffer and migration entries. It covers command formats, statuses, error handling, driver initialization and shutdown, interrupts, SPA encoding, firmware reload, performance guidance, non-migratable data structures, and restrictions including 4k alignment. The passage also includes legal notices and trademark information.

Doctors stressed awareness of eye cancer types and symptoms because most cases are detected late, making treatment complex. Specialized facilities and trained ocular oncologists are scarce in India. Retinoblastoma, common in children under five, can be saved with early detection but may be fatal if late.

The passage examines how digitalization and online informal education contribute to personalized learning in design education. It distinguishes formal, non-formal, informal, and random education and contrasts conventional with online education, noting online education’s virtual, multimedia, collaborative, active, lifelong, and personalized features. It describes the growth of online and distance education, synchronous and asynchronous courses, and design education’s use of digital tools. The study uses literature review and case studies to analyze the online workshop “Introduction to Computational Design” and course “Sustainability through Computational Design,” assessing structure, methods, resources, and outcomes. Advantages of online workshops and courses include short-term applied training, complex knowledge bundles, multidisciplinary interaction, discussion, open access, and virtual accessibility. Limitations include individual materials, competitive environments, differing educational approaches, unequal certificates, lack of involvement in formal education, and resource accessibility. The passage concludes that online informal education offers personalized learning frameworks and supports formal design education, but accessibility, certification, and integration issues remain.

This study examined integrating environmental education based on the theory of multiple intelligences in extended educational opportunity schools in Nakhon Pathom Primary Education Area 2. It used three phases: studying environmental education, developing research tools and a model, and evaluating model effectiveness. Participants included 364 lower secondary students, 44 teachers, and three school directors. Findings identified community pollution from agricultural chemicals, wastewater, air pollution, indiscriminate waste, and cultural issues from technology. Students’ environmental education learning was reasonable but lower than teachers’, with awareness lowest. A SWOT analysis informed the model. The model’s E1/E2 efficiency was 81.51/82.11, content validity was 4.60, and construct validity was 3.97. Post-study achievement was higher than pre-study, and student satisfaction was high. The study recommends promoting environmental education and developing standards and curricula for sustainable development in expanded opportunity schools.

A seven-judge Supreme Court Constitution Bench held that re-promulgation of ordinances is a fraud on the Constitution and a subversion of democratic legislative processes. It held that the President’s or Governor’s satisfaction under Articles 123 and 213 is not immune from judicial review. The majority held that laying an ordinance before the legislature is mandatory, though Justice Lokur disagreed and the CJI left the question open. The cases involved Bihar ordinances appointing school teachers. The court ruled that salaries already paid to the teachers should not be recovered.

Solar energy is now the cheapest source of power worldwide, according to a University of Surrey study. In sunniest countries, it can cost as little as £0.02 per unit, making it cheaper than coal, gas, or wind. Global installed solar passed 1.5 terawatts in 2024. Lithium-ion battery prices fell 89% since 2010, making solar-plus-storage systems cost-effective. Challenges include grid congestion and integration. Smart grids, AI forecasting, regional links, storage, perovskite cells, and sustained policy support are cited as crucial for the transition.

An anonymous 1893 notice by Mr. Kung-i of Pai-ling Shan attacks foreign creeds and “universal love,” calls reverence of heaven rebellion and love of mankind deceptive, and urges people to follow the great doctrine and burn these books. A notice addressed to a religion’s head accuses its adherents of hypocrisy, unfilial conduct, improper marriage, covetousness, forced conversion, and preaching as a pretext for sightseeing and selling books; it orders them to leave or face attack on the 7th of the third moon. In Document 2, Mr. Heard informs Mr. Gresham that followers of Confucius in Seoul memorialized the king that Tong Hâk taught false doctrines corrupting the people and asked that adherents be compelled to return to the right path or be exterminated. Anxiety that Western religion might also be denounced did not materialize. The king replied that the government would attend to its duty and admonished the petitioners to study their principles.
A non-inverting comparator with hysteresis uses a two-resistor network and VREF; it switches low-to-high above VIN1 and high-to-low below VIN2, with hysteresis as their difference.

Microsoft Corporation filed a Form 8-K dated January 26, 2015. It reported that Microsoft issued a press release announcing financial results for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2014, furnished as Exhibit 99.1. The filing was signed by Frank H. Brod.

The passage describes a bull market signal of 18 consecutive closes above the 200 SMA in a bear market. The strategy sells the S&P 500 when it drops 20% from its all-time high and buys when the signal triggers. Backtested from 1927 to present, it generated 12 signals, with average returns of 9.54% after six months and 21.84% after one year. Metrics included 7.24% CAGR, 15.26 standard deviation, 0.24 Sharpe ratio, 60% maximum drawdown, 87.38% time in market, and 8.28% risk-adjusted return. It performed better than the Golden Cross, though not risk-adjusted, and was invested 30% more time; the Golden Cross generated 49 signals. The last signal was triggered on February 15, 2023.

St. George welcomed an 11-person delegation from its sister city Ibigawa, Japan, including four runners competing in the 41st annual St. George Marathon. The delegates were welcomed at a reception, recognized at a City Council meeting and treated to an international luncheon, where Mayor Jon Pike and Ibigawa Vice Mayor Sunao Isaji exchanged ceremonial gifts. The delegation stayed with host families and had a scheduled itinerary. St. George plans to send a similar delegation to the Ibigawa Marathon in November.

Ola and Uber drivers in Delhi-NCR have threatened a one-day strike on Tuesday over low fares. The Delhi High Court restrained two taxi-driver unions from disrupting Ola and Uber services. The Sarvodaya Drivers' Association demands fares increase from Rs 6 to Rs 20 per km and abolition of the 25% commission, and plans a protest march; some groups support it, while Delhi Autorickshaw Sangh and Delhi Pradesh Taxi Union will not participate.

Rain Bird's 9v WPX is a battery-operated irrigation controller for areas without practical mains power. It is IP68 waterproof and submersible, supports 1, 2, 4, or 6 zones, and runs about one to two years on batteries.
A player describes a set play after Brad May changed: Matt and Teemu moved the puck, Teemu fed him for an open net. The team stayed disciplined and scored in the third to finish the game.

A study in Nature Ecology & Evolution found that birds and mammals adapt to changing temperatures about 2-3 times faster than reptiles and amphibians. Researchers reconstructed animal environments over 270 million years. Birds and mammals regulate their own body temperatures and use body heat to control developing babies’ temperature, aiding survival during temperature fluctuations. However, it is unclear whether these traits will help under rapid climate change. Other pressures, including pollution, hunting, habitat loss, and invasive species, are driving extinction, with species disappearing up to 10,000 times faster than normal. Rolland hopes the work helps researchers understand adaptation to climate change.

The SNP Run VMPL NAE event lets a guest request the hypervisor run the current vCPU at a different VMPL level using a unique VMSA per VMPL; if no VMSA exists for the requested level, the hypervisor must return an error. Each VMPL may have a unique GHCB, and the hypervisor must update the SPA for the VMSA and GHCB when changing levels. SEV-TIO allows guests to bind to and use trusted devices in their guest private address space, discovered via TEE-IO PCIe capabilities; the device is bound on the first SNP TIO Guest Request. Setup is performed by VMPL0 firmware for TIO-unenlightened guests or by the OS otherwise. SNP TIO Guest Request is similar to SNP Guest Request and SNP Extended Guest Request but includes non-optional unencrypted data: Guest PCI ID, MMIO range, and TDISP status. Data pages are optional, must be guest contiguous if multiple, and assigned to the hypervisor. For TDI_MSG_TDI_INFO_REQ, a 32-byte nonce may be provided, potentially causing TDI_DEV_MEASUREMENTS before forwarding. Returned data uses a table at offset 0x0 of DATA GPA with GUID, offset, and length entries terminated by a zero entry. The hypervisor validates sufficient pages and returns required pages in RBX with SW_EXITINFO2 set if insufficient. Secure AVIC manages guest-owned APIC state with a backing page per vCPU; REGISTER_BACKING_PAGE and UNREGISTER_BACKING_PAGE actions are available, and support is implied by Secure AVIC in SEV_FEATURES. Termination Request NAE lets a guest request termination, with reason code in SW_EXITINFO1 and 64 bits of termination information in SW_EXITINFO2. Unsupported NAEs use the Unsupported Event exit code. SEV-ES support identification uses CPUID properties. SMP AP boot under SEV-ES/SNP faces measured-register restrictions, using AP reset hold, AP jump table, and SNP AP Creation NAE mechanisms; AP Creation with VMSA pages allows vCPU hotplug. NMI injection uses NMI Complete, debug register virtualization is supported or intercepted, and SMM and nested virtualization are not supported. The #HV doorbell page uses PendingEvent and NoEoiRequired fields for host notifications, interrupt shadows, configuration via VMGEXIT, and defined host and guest interrupt/EOI behavior.

Kuwait will finish cleaning up a crude oil spill in its southern Gulf waters this week, its oil minister said; no cause was given. KJO said its facilities were safe and clear of a spill reports attributed to a tanker, and it planned an aerial survey.

The passage describes a patent application for an augmented reality tracking system used in image-guided surgery. A head-mounted display presents computer-generated images aligned with patient anatomy, with misalignment generally limited to about 2–3 mm; patient and tool positions are tracked. In some embodiments, a first healthcare professional wears a first head-mounted device with a first tracking device, such as a single high-speed camera, that images a patient marker and/or tool marker. The patient marker can allow determination of the head-mounted device’s location and orientation relative to the patient without triangulation. When both the patient marker and the tool are within the first tracking device’s line of sight, a computer processor generates an augmented reality image on the first display using data from the first tracking device and not from a second tracking device. When they are not both within the first line of sight, the processor generates a virtual image of the tool and patient anatomy at least partially using data from a second tracking device, which may be stationary or on a second head-mounted device worn by another person. The passage also describes related methods and apparatus, including use of an inertial-measurement unit and tracking algorithms when markers are obscured.

Investors who had focused on economic strength, corporate profits, and Trump’s tax and deregulation push helped lift stocks for nine years. Now they are skittish: stocks fell over 2% Friday, the worst week in two years, after a strong jobs report suggested rising wages and possible inflation. The real worry is that cheap central-bank money may disappear sooner. Stocks sold off and Treasury yields surged; since 2009, low rates supported the boom.

Market drops of more than 10% often cause fear and selling, but fewer than one in five corrections become bear markets, and 80% do not. Corrections are routine, averaging one per year since 1900; historically, the average correction was a 13.5% decline lasting 54 days. Bear markets average 33% S&P 500 declines, with more than a third exceeding 40%, and average about a year. From 1980 through 2015, the S&P 500 had an average intra-year decline of 14.2%, yet positive returns in 27 of 36 years. The market generally rises over the long run despite crises. The passage advises understanding market behavior, resisting panic, and taking responsibility for financial decisions.

The TPS7H500x-SP series includes the TPS7H5001-SP, TPS7H5002-SP, TPS7H5003-SP, and TPS7H5004-SP radiation-hardness-assured current mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. They support switching frequencies up to 2 MHz and topologies including buck, flyback, forward, active-clamp forward, push-pull, and full-bridge. The controllers provide single or dual primary switching outputs (OUTA/OUTB) and single or dual synchronous rectifier outputs (SRA/SRB), with roughly 150-mA peak current capability and recommended external gate drive. OUTB/SRB are active only when the duty cycle limit is set to 50% by connecting DCL to AVSS, valid for TPS7H5001-SP and TPS7H5004-SP. Dead times TDSP/TDPS and leading edge blank time are programmable via PS, SP, and LEB resistors, except TPS7H5003-SP has fixed 50-ns values. Pulse skipping occurs under specified COMP and previous duty cycle conditions. Duty cycle limits are programmable via DCL. CS_ILIM supports peak current mode PWM generation and current limit, and hiccup mode is set by CHICC. The FAULT pin provides external fault shutdown. Slope compensation is set by RSC. Thermal shutdown stops switching above 175°C and restarts below 160°C. The devices use fixed-frequency peak current mode control. Application information includes a synchronous push-pull converter design example using TPS7H5001-SP, plus power supply recommendations, layout guidelines, revision history, and mechanical, packaging, and orderable information.

The passage advocates a coherent, moderate reform plan to address real evils while avoiding reactionary and extremist positions. It argues government should supervise business rather than conduct it, promoting equality of opportunity and burden. Since combinations of capital and labor are necessary and cannot be wholly prevented, laws should not forbid all combinations but should rigorously control them to prevent public injury; railroad agreements should be permitted if sanctioned by the Interstate Commerce Commission and published. Unenforceable laws harm decent railroad men and favor wrongdoers, and the law should be amended if the Interstate Commerce Commission’s opinion is justified. On taxation, local taxes suit local matters, while some taxes require the General Government. Upon tax revision, it recommends a graduated inheritance tax and, if possible, a graduated income tax, with equitable distribution and equal treatment of rich and poor.

Apple Inc.’s Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2018 includes condensed consolidated financial statements and notes. For the second quarter of 2018, net sales were $61,137 million, net income was $13,822 million, and diluted earnings per share were $2.73; for the six months, net sales were $149,430 million, net income was $33,887 million, and diluted earnings per share were $6.63. Net sales increased 16% in the second quarter and 14% in the first six months, primarily due to higher iPhone, Services, and Other Products net sales, with increases in all geographic reportable segments. The Company began shipping HomePod in February 2018 and introduced a new 9.7-inch iPad with Apple Pencil compatibility in March 2018. During the second quarter, it spent $23.5 billion to repurchase common stock and paid $3.2 billion in dividends and dividend equivalents. The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act lowered the U.S. statutory federal income tax rate from 35% to 21% effective January 1, 2018, and imposed a deemed repatriation tax. The filing also discusses debt, derivatives, income taxes, legal proceedings including VirnetX and the European Commission State Aid Decision, and segment information.
Two teens were arrested and another remains on the run after a Frankston pursuit. A 17-year-old girl and an 18-year-old man were arrested; the man was taken to hospital after a police dog bite.

This email compiles May 18, 2001 news items mentioning Enron. A Dow Jones column says California’s long-term power contracts are jeopardized after Republicans did not back a $12.5 billion bond deal; forward power prices fell, and the state’s $43 billion March contracts may have declined about 15%, while demand fell 9% and California bought summer power. An options report describes low volatility and investors selling options, including activity in Ericsson, Microsoft and Enron. Several articles report Saudi Arabia selected international oil companies for three gas projects requiring about $25 billion: Core Venture 1, South Ghawar, went to ExxonMobil, Shell, BP and Phillips; ExxonMobil leads Core Venture 2, Red Sea, with Occidental and Enron stakes; Core Venture 3, Shaybah, went to Shell, TotalFinaElf and Conoco. Leaders for Ventures 1 and 3 and memoranda of understanding are due by June 5. The U.S. Energy Department welcomed the awards, and Shell said it was pleased.

This case describes the rise and collapse of Sam Bankman-Fried’s FTX and Alameda Research. SBF co-founded Alameda with Tara Mac Aulay and FTX with Gary Wang; Caroline Ellison led Alameda, and Nishad Singh worked at both. FTX became the second-largest crypto exchange and was valued at $32 billion in 2022. After CoinDesk leaked Alameda’s balance sheet, showing $14.6 billion in assets with 40% in FTT, Binance’s CEO announced he would sell his FTT holdings, FTT fell 80%, customers withdrew over $6 billion, and FTX paused withdrawals. FTX and related entities filed for bankruptcy on November 11, 2022. SBF was arrested and charged with eight counts of fraud, money laundering, and campaign finance offenses; he pled not guilty. Wang and Ellison pled guilty. Singh pled guilty to six criminal counts, admitting he wrote code that allowed SBF to divert FTX customer funds to Alameda, made illegal political contributions, and inflated FTX’s 2021 revenues. The SEC complaint alleged undisclosed diversion of customer funds to Alameda, special treatment for Alameda, undisclosed risk from Alameda’s illiquid assets, and undisclosed use of customer funds for investments, real estate, and political donations. John Ray became CEO and described FTX as having a complete failure of corporate controls, no independent board, no accounting department, and no listed CFO. The passage also discusses crypto regulation, exchange tokens, and questions about the roles of investors, auditors, regulators, customers, celebrities, and employees.

Penn State will no longer allow the Penn State Outing Club to organize outdoor student-led trips starting next semester, and two other outdoor clubs have been directed to end trip offerings. The university’s Student Affairs and Risk Management offices determined the activities too risky. Club leaders said they were not consulted; Penn State said the review was proactive and cited remote environments. The university will still offer a university-operated outdoors program.

Google released Android 8.0 Oreo in August with under-the-hood refinements and features including Picture-in-Picture (PiP), Notification Dots, Smart Text Selection, Notification Snoozing, and Autofill Framework. The passage focuses on PiP, which extends multi-tasking by displaying a video in a movable floating window. Not all apps support PiP; developers must enable it, and listed supported apps include Chrome, Google Duo, Google Play Movies & TV, Google Play Services, Google Maps, WhatsApp, YouTube, and VLC. YouTube PiP requires YouTube Red, unavailable in some countries, so the guide uses YouTube in Chrome Desktop mode: play a video, enter full-screen, swipe up, and tap Home. Users can move the window, open other apps, pause, close, return to full-screen, or dismiss it, and can enable PiP for apps in Settings.

In this Texas trespass-to-try-title and partition case, Thomas Henderson claimed an undivided half interest in the M. Latham league in Navarro County through a Latham-to-William F. Henderson instrument and a sheriff’s deed. The court held the instrument was a valid, absolute, unconditional deed, not an executory contract. It discussed conditions, forfeiture, stale demand, and limitations. The stale-demand defense did not apply to an executed deed and vested right. The five-year limitation defense could not be considered absent evidence of tax payment. The three-year limitation failed for lack of title or color of title, and the ten-year limitation failed for lack of required privity. The judgment for defendants was reversed and the cause remanded.
Annual Fund gifts support democracy, equity, rule of law, courts, legal representation, and justice access; donors receive thank-you items.

The address reports that efforts to persuade belligerent nations to revoke edicts harmful to neutral commerce failed. Ministers at London and Paris were instructed regarding suspension of embargo laws; France gave no answer or indication of changing its decrees, and the arrangement proposed to Great Britain was rejected. The embargo therefore remains in its original extent. It has saved mariners and mercantile property, allowed defensive measures, and demonstrated moderation and firmness; Congress must decide the best course.

On the Chesapeake attack, no British steps for redress were taken, and the preliminary obstructing adjustment is still adhered to and connected with the orders in council. Relations with other European powers are unchanged; negotiations with Spain are paused; harmony with the Barbary powers continues except for a proceeding by the dey of Algiers toward the U.S. consul. Peace with Indian neighbors is maintained; some individuals were delivered for trial, tribes seek amicable arrangements, and part of the Cherokee nation is considering soliciting U.S. citizenship.

Defense works and gunboats are underway; military recruiting is believed satisfactory; militia may need readiness, and Congress can produce uniform preparation. Arms production is being expanded internally. Suspended foreign commerce has led to increased internal manufactures and improvements. Treasury receipts were near eighteen million dollars; after expenses, debt payments, and interest, about fourteen million remained, with further payment due. A possible surplus merits Congress’s consideration for internal improvements, revenue reduction, or related powers. The address closes with gratitude and confidence in the republic.

Ukraine has partnered with Bitfury to put a broad range of government data on a blockchain platform, a project Bitfury’s CEO called the biggest government blockchain deal. They signed a memorandum of understanding. A pilot project will cover state registers, public services, social security, public health, and energy, launching late this year, then expand to all areas including cyber security. Bitfury also has a Georgia land-titling project.

Five themes may dominate investors’ and traders’ thinking next week. The Bank of England’s “Super Thursday” includes a rates decision, minutes, and quarterly Inflation Report; no rate move is expected, with focus on inflation, growth, sterling, oil, and global growth. Australian and New Zealand central banks meet amid cooling housing, below-expectation inflation, stronger currencies, plus China data releases. The U.S. December trade deficit is expected to widen; retail sales and a possible government shutdown are watched. A gap has opened between European and U.S. earnings-growth expectations as results arrive. The Seventh Circuit affirmed summary judgment for the Village of Orland Park and police officials on Joseph McGreal’s First Amendment retaliation and intentional-infliction-of-emotional-distress claims. McGreal, a fired police officer, alleged retaliation for protected speech at a November 2, 2009, board meeting. The court found no admissible evidence that the defendants knew of his speech or that it motivated his firing, and no evidence that their alternative reasons were pretextual. His emotional-distress claim failed because he offered no evidence of extreme or outrageous conduct or severe distress, admitting it was “garden variety.”

HoopTactics’ out-of-bounds plays are proven to create high-percentage shots with two to three options; if unavailable, each flows into predetermined continuity, avoiding rushed shots or set plays. Full-court situations with less than four seconds are difficult, but prepared teams can score. Inbounding under pressure faces a 5-on-4 disadvantage; a baseline play may be used to get the ball in safely. If time permits, advancing and taking a timeout is preferable.

Kyle Freeland pitched 5 1/3 innings and doubled as Colorado beat San Francisco 11-4. Freeland allowed three runs on eight hits with three strikeouts and no walks. The Rockies scored three unearned runs in the fourth and four in the seventh, including David Dahl’s first career pinch-hit homer. Every Colorado starter had at least one hit. San Francisco lost starter Jeff Samardzija after one inning to shoulder tightness and rookie Dereck Rodriguez after he was struck in the right shin by a line drive; Rodriguez allowed four runs, one earned, in 3 1/3 innings. Evan Longoria hit two solo homers and Buster Posey one for the Giants.

Maddie Sabourin, an 18-year-old high school senior, learned she is a kidney match for her grandfather, Sam Senseney, 63, who has been on the transplant list for six years and receives dialysis. Doctors initially said she was too young to donate, but Sabourin convinced them she wanted to donate one kidney. She had raised $7,500 for the American Kidney Fund and advocated for organ donation. They will meet doctors next week to schedule surgery, hoped within a month.

The passage describes 5G systems and network slicing, including AMF selection for isolated network slices. It outlines 5G architecture and network functions such as AMF, SMF, UPF, PCF, NEF, NRF, UDM, NSSF, and AUSF; registration and connection management states; PDU sessions; QoS flows; and network slice selection using S-NSSAI and requested, subscribed, configured, or allowed NSSAI. It defines isolated network slice types/levels: fully isolated, partly isolated with (R)AN shared, and partly isolated with (R)AN and AMF shared. In example registration procedures, a UE sends a registration request with requested NSSAI and network slice isolation information. Depending on the isolation type, an NRF, NSSF, or UDM selects an AMF based on network slice isolation information, requested/subscribed NSSAI, UE identity, DNN, local policies, and subscription information, and returns the selected AMF’s IP address or FQDN to the (R)AN to continue the registration procedure.

Using the James Webb Space Telescope, Trinity College Dublin astronomers observed the rogue planet SIMP-0136. They found strong auroral activity, storms, and unchanging silicate clouds. SIMP-0136 is over 1,500 °C, and precise measurements recorded temperature changes smaller than 5 °C linked to chemical changes suggestive of rotating storms. The researchers say these observations advance understanding of weather and atmospheric dynamics beyond the solar system.

In an action by the assignee of W. W. Montague & Co. to set aside Louis Helbing’s deeds of gift to his wife Louise, judgment was for defendants. The deeds were executed May 15, 1893, and recorded December 11, 1895. Helbing was solvent at execution and later incurred debt to Montague & Co. before recordation while representing himself as owner; he also exercised ownership acts. The wife was not shown to know of his representations or ownership acts. The trial court found the deed was not made to hinder, delay, or defraud creditors, was not made while insolvent or in contemplation of insolvency, and was without consideration except love and affection; nonrecordation enabled credit. The burden was on plaintiff to prove fraudulent intent; nonrecordation was suspicious but insufficient. Excluding evidence about later concealment of goods and the wife’s sworn claim to the sheriff was not reversible. Judgment and order affirmed.

Tropical Storm Nate is moving toward Mexico’s Yucatan Peninsula and may hit the U.S. Gulf Coast as a hurricane. Louisiana declared a state of emergency and ordered evacuations, mobilizing 1,300 National Guard troops, with 15 sent to New Orleans. Nate, the 15th Atlantic system, has killed 22 people in Latin America. It had 45 mph winds Friday and was expected to strengthen. September was the most active month on record for Accumulated Cyclone Energy, with six storms. Nicaragua reported at least 15 deaths; Costa Rica reported seven deaths and 15 missing.

The passage tests a SPY/TLT pair trading strategy. On June 18, 2021, SPY rose 1.43% and TLT fell 1.67%, then both reversed. The tested rules initiate long SPY and short TLT when SPY falls and TLT rises more than 1.25 times their 50-day average H-L on the same day, closing x-days later. From 2003 to June 2021, without commissions or slippage, the strategy was erratic, inconsistent, and not tradeable, with a 1.93% CAGR, 60% win ratio, and 0.18% average gain per round trip. Parameter changes did not improve results much.

Length of stay (LOS) is the time between hospital admission and discharge, with delayed discharge definitions varying internationally. This retrospective, cross-sectional study examined factors causing delayed discharge from a 23-bed subacute Complex Discharge Unit at St James’s Hospital during the first year of the COVID-19 pandemic. It reviewed adult patients admitted March 2020–February 2021 with hospital LOS >15 days using electronic patient records, and used Kaplan-Meier and stratified Cox regression analyses. Of 390 patients, 83.6% were >65 years, median age was 79, 59.7% were female, 48.20% had >4 comorbidities, and median LOS was 19.4 days. The study identified five factors responsible for delays: complications from primary diagnoses or multimorbidity, frailty or falls necessitating integrated rehabilitation, community services provision, patient-centred needs, and HCAI. It concluded that the most common delaying factors were complexities from primary diagnoses and patient-centred needs such as cognition, psychosocial needs, and carer needs.
OpenAI is preparing a stand-alone TikTok-like app for AI-generated videos powered by Sora 2, with a vertical feed, recommendations, and like, comment, and remix options.

The passage describes the Warren Buffett ETF Portfolio (90/10), an investment strategy inspired by Warren Buffett’s 2013 letter to Berkshire Hathaway investors. It allocates 90% to low-cost, passively managed S&P 500 index ETFs and 10% to government bonds, aiming for long-term growth, reduced risk, and lower fees than actively managed portfolios. The S&P 500 component provides diversified exposure to 500 large U.S. publicly traded companies, while government bonds serve as a less volatile cushion. The passage discusses implementation through lump-sum investing or dollar-cost averaging, notes risks and tax implications, and advises consulting financial and tax professionals. Backtests compare SPY with SHY, IEI, and TLT; longer bond maturities were compensated by extra risk, with TLT performing best among the bond options and nearly matching SPY, though 2022’s bond market caused underperformance. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

Bank of England research suggests a central bank digital currency could make monetary policy changes more effective. Researchers say an interest-paying CBDC with payment services could strengthen and speed rate pass-through and improve quantitative easing by allowing the central bank to buy assets directly from non-banks. The Bank says it is not currently planning to issue one.

In People v Schaub, the defendant was charged with child abandonment after allegedly transferring his ten-month-old child to an undercover police officer for financial gain. The district court dismissed the charge, finding the child was never without care. The circuit court reversed and reinstated the charge. The Supreme Court remanded to the Court of Appeals for consideration as on leave granted.

The Court of Appeals held that the elements of child abandonment are exposure of the child and intent to wholly abandon the child. It found sufficient evidence that the defendant intended to wholly abandon the child, but not sufficient evidence of exposure, because the child was handed to a person to care for her and there was no basis to find she would be left without care or at risk of personal injury from abandonment. It reversed the circuit court and remanded.

O’Connell, P.J., dissented, stating that the evidence supported submitting to a jury whether delivering the child to a total stranger exposed her to injury, that the statute does not require intent to injure, and that the circuit court should be affirmed.

The majority also noted that the Legislature later enacted a statute prohibiting the sale or purchase of people, and that the Court expressed no opinion on whether attempted child selling was an indictable common-law offense because defendant had not been charged with a common-law felony.

Official reports from Cuba say many Americans are destitute and without food or medicine. Consul-General Lee estimates 600–800 are unsupported. Congress is asked to appropriate at least $50,000, partly for return transportation.

The acknowledgements thank staff at the Ronald Reagan Presidential Library, the Library of Congress, the Central Intelligence Agency, and the Office of the Historian, as well as estates granting access or reprint permission. Chris Tudda coordinated declassification review, and Kerry Hite did copy and technical editing. Sources include public speeches and statements from Public Papers, Department of State Bulletin, Congressional Record, Documents on Disarmament, and Weekly Compilation. Walmart plans to bring drone delivery to “most areas that we operate in,” senior VP Greg Cathey said, without a specific timeline. Walmart has tested drones for years and now views airborne deliveries as a key part of its operations and last-mile strategy. Drone delivery is currently available at a handful of its more than 4,600 U.S. locations through partnerships; Walmart announced an expansion with Alphabet’s Wing to 100 stores in several cities and plans to add Northwest Arkansas. Cathey said “100 stores is just the start.” Widespread drone delivery is likely still years away due technical, regulatory, and financial issues, with an FAA beyond-visual-line-of-sight rule pending. Walmart says it has surpassed 300,000 drone deliveries.

The Golden Cross Trading Strategy uses two moving averages, a short and a long. A Golden Cross occurs when the short moving average crosses above the long moving average; the article uses the 50-day and 200-day averages. The trading rules are to buy when the 50-day crosses above the 200-day and sell when it crosses below. Backtesting the S&P 500 since 1960 produced 33 trades, 79% winners, an average trade gain of 15.8%, an annual return of 6.8%, and a 33% drawdown versus buy-and-hold’s 56%. The strategy aims to exploit long-term uptrends while reducing losses in bear markets.

This cross-sectional quantitative study assessed ART non-adherence among HIV patients in the catchment area of Kibungo Referral Hospital, Rwanda. Among 424 respondents, overall non-adherence to ART was 13%, while adherence was 87%. Bivariate analyses found significant associations with age, education, household size, multiple sexual partners, travel and waiting times, smoking, and disclosure to friends. Multivariate analysis found younger age (<31), lack of tertiary education, stigma, perceived ART ineffectiveness, and failure to integrate ART into daily activities significantly associated with non-adherence; setting an alarm as a reminder was not significant. The study concludes that non-adherence was slightly high and identifies these factors, while noting limitations of cross-sectional design, self-reported data, and limited generalizability. The introduction reports global, Sub-Saharan African, and Rwandan factors and prevalence related to ART non-adherence, including poverty, stigma, cultural and religious beliefs, and lack of social support, as well as WHO/UNAIDS targets.

Richard A. Milan filed a pro se § 1983 complaint against Jack R. Duckworth and Barry Nothstien. The defendants moved for summary judgment. The complaint concerned a July 10, 1988, attempted visit with Judy Ballard at Indiana State Prison and alleged violations of the Fourteenth Amendment Due Process Clause and Eighth Amendment. Applying Rule 56 and cases including Celotex, Anderson, Hewitt, and Thompson, the court examined Administrative Procedure 02-00-104 and found no protectable liberty interest in visitation privileges. The plaintiff did not dispute that defendants had discretionary authority to deny visitation, but focused on the failure to provide written notice. The court held this narrow procedural failure did not support a substantive constitutional claim. The plaintiff’s summary judgment motion was denied, and summary judgment was granted for the defendants because the plaintiff failed to establish a violation of a substantive constitutional right.

The passage addresses e-learning governance within digital business ecosystems. It states that e-learning is important for business competitiveness and aims to impart needed knowledge and skills cost-effectively. E-learning governance is defined as responsibilities and practices that provide strategic direction, ensure objectives are achieved, manage risks, and allocate resources appropriately, applying control principles for direction, cost effectiveness, quality, ethics, and security. The paper reviews e-learning systems, e-learning ecosystems, benefits, and governance roles. It proposes an e-learning governance framework of structures, processes, communications and relational mechanisms, and later adds pedagogies and instructional designs. It adopts Darking’s characteristics and dimensions of digital ecosystem governance, including constitution and balance of interests, culture of communication, credibility, attunement and trust, organisation and synchronisation, licensing and regulation, and technological dimension. It also discusses information security governance, risk management, trust, and a regulatory knowledge base, and calls for further research on business benefits of improving e-learning governance practices.

The passage outlines a study estimating the burden of disease directly due to COVID-19 in the Republic of Ireland from March 1, 2020, to February 28, 2021, using the incidence-based DALY metric. It notes Ireland’s lockdown response and international variation in COVID-19 impact. DALYs combine morbidity and mortality as time-based health loss. YLL equals deaths times remaining life expectancy; YLD equals incident cases times duration times disability weight. Data came from public Irish sources, with mortality data from CSO/DoH, GBD 2019 life tables, and population estimates. YLD included asymptomatic, moderate, severe, critical, and post-acute consequences health states, with specified disability weights, durations, and assumptions. Ethical approval was obtained from University College Cork. The analyses section states DALY results are scaled by a factor.

Explainable AI research aims to enhance transparency and trust in LLM and AI decision-making. It can improve understanding of pre-trained language models, address resource limitations, optimize performance, and help identify and mitigate safety risks such as adversarial attacks, harmful behavior, and ethical breaches. Challenges include no unified evaluation framework, computational inefficiency, and difficult practical application. The passage proposes editing concept activation vectors: collecting LLM activation vectors, training a logistic regression classifier to produce a Concept Activation Vector, and dynamically applying it during inference to enhance or suppress concepts, maintain fluency, and support multiple concepts via optimization.

The passage describes data management strategies involving backups, archives, snapshots, and cloud-integrated storage appliances. It details how a storage appliance caches snapshots to cloud storage, arranges snapshot metadata in key-value stores per defined data collection, and performs operations for updating, restoring, and reclaiming snapshots. To reduce eviction of stable data blocks in forever incremental configurations, the passage presents synthetic baseline snapshots and eviction state refresh, including approaches that expand data ownership or use reverse incremental synthetic baselines.

Police are investigating cellphone video showing New York City officers using a stun gun on a pregnant 17-year-old during an arrest in a Bronx apartment building. According to a complaint, she interfered with officers and pushed one; she was charged with resisting arrest, harassment and disorderly conduct. The NYPD says the incident is under internal review.

The speaker discusses Martin as goaltender during the team’s poor start, when the team often scored fewer than two goals and blamed him too quickly. Ray Emery got healthy, won games, became the starter, and Martin was designated for the bench despite being a ready “great soldier.” The speaker notes respect for Anaheim as a big, strong team with good goaltending, expects an emotional home crowd, and says the team must play well early. He says the team has handled tests well except one game in Buffalo. He discusses close games against New Jersey and Buffalo, leadership from Alfredsson, Phillips, and Redden, and the need for depth, goaltending, and adjustments. The court granted in part and denied in part Defendant’s motion for summary judgment and denied Plaintiff’s motion. Plaintiff, an Ethiopian citizen sponsored by Defendant through Form I-864, sued to enforce Defendant’s support obligations. Defendant conceded a valid Form I-864 and Plaintiff’s right to sue but argued no breach or damages. The court held that Plaintiff’s income must be analyzed separately for each calendar year, not in aggregate. It granted partial summary judgment for Defendant as to 2000, 2001, 2002, 2004, and 2005, because Plaintiff conceded income was at least 125% of the poverty line in those years. For 2003, 2006, and 2007, Defendant’s evidence did not establish that Plaintiff’s income exceeded 125% of the poverty threshold. The court found the $49,000 divorce settlement and student loans were not income, while student grants and housing subsidies were income, and bank statements did not prove additional unidentified income. Plaintiff’s motion was denied because she did not show undisputed evidence of breach.

The passage studies time-delayed full feedback in learning in games. It reports that in unconstrained Matching Pennies with the Euclidean regularizer, any time delay \(m \ge 1\) makes OFTRL suffer \(\Omega(\sqrt{T})\) regret and diverge. It proposes weighted OFTRL (WOFTRL), which weights optimism \(n\) times; Taylor expansion shows the time delay \(m\) and optimistic weight \(n\) cancel. When \(n = m + 1\), WOFTRL achieves \(O(1)\) regret and best-iterate convergence in poly-matrix zero-sum games. Experiments on Matching Pennies, Sato’s game, and weighted Rock-Paper-Scissors support \(O(1)\) regret when \(n > m\), \(O(\sqrt{T})\) regret when \(n \le m\), and convergence when \(n > m\). The conclusion names last-iterate convergence and other time-delay types as future directions.

He concludes that the policy is based on America’s role, global change, unchanging moral values, wealth and military power, and service to mankind.

NVIDIA’s Ampere GA10x GPU architecture includes third-generation Tensor Cores that support new data types, TF32 and BFloat16, and a Sparsity feature that can double Tensor Core throughput over Turing. It covers GDDR6X and GDDR6 memory: GDDR6X supports 19.5 Gbps on RTX 3090 and 19 Gbps on RTX 3080; A6000 and A40 use 48 GB GDDR6 scalable to 96 GB via NVLink. Third-generation NVLink provides four x4 links, 56.25 GB/sec each direction and 112.5 GB/sec total between two GPUs. PCIe Gen 4 provides double PCIe 3.0 bandwidth, up to 64 GB/sec in an x16 slot. GA102 consists of GPCs, TPCs, SMs, ROPs, and memory controllers; ROPs are moved into the GPC, yielding 112 ROPs. The GA10x SM contains 128 CUDA Cores, four third-generation Tensor Cores, a 256 KB register file, four Texture Units, one second-generation RT Core, and 128 KB L1/Shared Memory. It doubles FP32 throughput by adding FP32 processing on both datapaths. The second-generation RT Core doubles ray/triangle intersection testing and adds motion blur acceleration. RTX IO enables GPU-based loading and decompression with DirectStorage. Fifth-generation NVDEC supports AV1 decode, and seventh-generation NVENC supports hardware encoding. Display support includes HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4a. The A40 and RTX A6000 are data center/workstation GPUs with 48 GB memory, scalable to 96 GB, and the architecture provides up to 2x improvements in programmable shading, ray tracing, and AI.

Many people think anyone who buys a stock is an investor. Benjamin Graham defined investment as selecting securities that protect capital and promise an adequate return; other purchases are speculation. To protect capital, the passage recommends buying at large discounts to intrinsic value for a margin of safety and choosing financially solid companies with clean balance sheets, low long-term debt relative to equity, strong current ratios, improving ratios, and liquid assets. Whether one is an investor or gambler depends on the selection process, not the assets bought.
