This application is a continuation of several U.S. patents issued to Thomas et al. and claims benefit of numerous Thomas et al. and Foster et al. provisional applications, all incorporated by reference. The passage describes hydraulic fracturing, in which pressurized fluid and proppants are injected to create rock fractures, and fluid ends used to pressurize such fluid under extreme conditions. Traditional fluid ends use a single housing with intersecting vertical and horizontal bores and internal chambers, which can experience high stress, corrosion, fatigue cracks, erosion, and leakage. The described fluid end instead comprises multiple side-by-side fluid end sections, each with a single-piece housing having one horizontal bore. It includes connect plates, stay rods, stuffing boxes, retainers, plunger packings, a fluid routing plug with first and second fluid passages, suction and discharge valves and guides, intake and discharge manifolds, and seals, grooves, and bevels configured to route fluid, reduce stress, and permit component replacement.

A prospective cohort study reports that more than 99% of people who had first-time heart attacks, strokes, or heart failure had at least one of four cardiovascular risks: suboptimal high blood pressure, cholesterol, or blood glucose, or current/former smoking. More than 93% of over 9.3 million people in two cohorts followed for 20 years had more than one risk factor; among women under 60, more than 95% had at least one nonoptimal risk factor before heart failure or stroke. The study distinguishes optimal from clinical thresholds, and doctors often use higher clinical thresholds before prescribing. Researchers say common nonoptimal risk factors can be treated and should be capable of preventing these events.

The present disclosure addresses applying scheduling offset for power saving in next generation wireless networks. A UE receives a power saving signal, such as via DCI, containing a minimum applicable K (K0min) indicating a minimum scheduling offset restriction between PDCCH and PDSCH. The UE determines an application delay based on a predefined value and applies the minimum scheduling offset restriction after that delay; during the delay, another scheduling offset, which may be configured by RRC signaling, is applied. After the delay, the UE may receive second DCI with an applicable K for the PDCCH-PDSCH scheduling offset, compare K with K0min, and apply K if it is larger than K0min or forgo the K0min restriction if K is smaller. The disclosure also provides HARQ feedback for the power saving signal using a time offset specified in the signal or RRC signaling, including HARQ-ACK-only feedback and inclusion or multiplexing of the power saving feedback bit in a HARQ codebook, including dedicated PUCCH resources. It further provides default beam operations for the power saving state, such as selecting PUCCH resources or spatial-domain filters based on valid spatial relation/QCL information associated with activated antenna panels/SRS resource sets, and using CORESET TCI or SRI for PUSCH scheduled by DCI format 0_0.

The triangle-and-two defense uses three players in a triangle zone and two chasers denying assigned opponents the ball. It can be effective against two outstanding scorers, as a change of defense, or late to hold the ball. The triangle provides backside support against back cuts and dribble penetration. Variations can combine against strong post and outside players, with double teams on drives or low post. If opponents use a two-guard front, the triangle can be inverted, shifting like a 2-3 zone. The chasers' pass denial is key, disrupting opponent set plays.

His tenure, marked by frequent edicts and culture-war disputes, was viewed by Oklahomans as a preview of the Trump administration’s top-down approach to overhauling education. The longest woolly rhino horn yet found, preserved in Siberian permafrost and dated to about 19,600 years ago, was nearly the size of a small adult human and 30 centimeters longer than the previous record. The horn was longer than those of any modern rhino, and its skull was proportionally small for an adult woolly rhino, leading researchers to think it belonged to a female. Counted growth layers indicate the rhino lived at least 40 years, the oldest woolly rhino yet found. Its flattened horn may have been used to brush away snow while feeding.

The passage describes static fusion trees on the word RAM, based on Fredman and Willard’s original 1990 version: linear space, polynomial preprocessing, and predecessor/successor in O(log_w n) time. Fusion trees combine B-trees with branching factor w^{1/5} and fusion nodes with k = O(w^{1/5}) presorted keys. A node uses “sketching” to retain only important bits that distinguish the keys; sketches preserve key order, but arbitrary queries require de-sketchifying by finding where the query’s sketch fits, locating the longest common prefix/divergence point, constructing a corrected value e, and searching sketch space again to obtain the correct rank. The passage also explains approximate sketching via masking and integer multiplication with chosen multipliers to avoid collisions and order important bits, parallel comparison using packed sketches and subtraction/multiplication, and constant-time most-significant-set-bit computation using clusters, sketches, and parallel comparison. It mentions dynamic and AC0 RAM versions but focuses on the static version.

The passage is an MIT OpenCourseWare lecture transcript about life cycle assessment (LCA) and its use to quantify environmental impacts. It explains that LCA follows ISO standards and typically has four stages: goal and scope definition, inventory analysis, impact analysis, and interpretation. It traces LCA to Coca-Cola’s 1969 study of cans versus glass bottles, notes later concerns about “hired gun” studies, and mentions standardization efforts by SETAC and ISO 14040. It distinguishes attributional/accounting-based LCA from consequential/change-oriented LCA.

The lecture uses a hand dryer study comparing Dyson Airblade, Xlerator, recycled and virgin paper towels, and cotton roll towels. The functional unit is a dry pair of hands. The study set a cradle-to-grave scope but standardized some supply chain assumptions, used cut-off rules, excluded capital goods, and addressed open-loop recycling and allocation. It built inventory using bills of materials, third-party databases such as ecoinvent, and proxy data where data were missing. The lecture notes data access issues, assumptions about drying time, product lifetime, electricity grids, and that the study was commissioned by Dyson with some Airblade data supplied by Dyson.

The impact analysis discusses classification and characterization, global warming potential, water use, cumulative energy demand, and IMPACT 2002+, including midpoint and endpoint indicators. The interpretation phase includes sensitivity and uncertainty analyses, Monte Carlo simulations, and scenario checks. The lecture states that the Dyson Airblade generally showed the lowest impact, though some scenarios and assumptions, especially drying time and electricity, could affect comparisons. It also discusses how a competitor like Xlerator might respond by commissioning its own study.

The study analyzed secondary data from a cross-sectional baseline survey and a randomized controlled open-label trial to determine malnutrition risk factors and evaluate the impact of intermittent preventive therapy for malaria on the nutritional status of school-age children in North-East Tanzania. At baseline, malaria prevalence was 27%; 23% of children aged ≤10 years were underweight, 21% were stunted, and 28% were thin or severely thin. Malaria was associated with higher odds of stunting, and low socioeconomic status was associated with higher odds of being underweight. During the intervention, changes in mean weight, height, and BMI over time were not significantly different in the DP and ASAQ treatment groups compared with the control group. A unit change in age increased weight, height, and BMI, and female children had higher height and weight than male children. The study concluded that the burden of malaria and malnutrition was remarkable and that public health agencies should reinforce nutritional programs by collaborating with local communities to ensure food availability in schools and provide sustainable nutritional education.

NVIDIA Tesla T4 is an inferencing solution for hyperscale data centers, enterprise solutions, and edge devices, supporting image classification/tagging, video analytics, natural language processing, speech recognition, and intelligent search. It has 2,560 CUDA Cores, 320 Tensor Cores, up to 130 TOPS INT8 and 260 TOPS INT4, up to 40X higher inference performance than CPU-based inferencing, and more than 50X higher energy efficiency than CPU-based inferencing, with up to twice the energy efficiency of Tesla P4. Turing adds an enhanced video engine, Multi-Process Service, 16 GB memory, 320 GB/sec bandwidth, GDDR6, larger L2 cache, compression, improved display/video engines, USB-C/VirtualLink, and NVLink for SLI. Turing also introduces RT Cores for real-time ray tracing with RTX, Tensor Cores, NGX, DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, AI Super Rez, Mesh Shading, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, and Multi-View Rendering. TU104 contains six GPCs, 48 SMs, 3072 CUDA Cores, 368 Tensor Cores, 48 RT Cores, and NVLink; TU106 contains three GPCs, 36 SMs, 2304 CUDA Cores, 288 Tensor Cores, 36 RT Cores, without NVLink or SLI. Tesla T4 uses TU104 with five GPCs, 20 TPCs, 40 SMs, 2,560 CUDA Cores, 320 Tensor Cores, a 256-bit memory interface, 10 Gbps data rate, and 320 GB/s bandwidth. RTX-OPS is a workload-based metric derating Tensor operations 20%, CUDA cores 80%, RT cores 40%, and INT32 pipes 28%. Ray tracing uses hybrid rendering, denoising, BVH, and RT Cores to accelerate real-time physically correct reflections, refractions, shadows, and ambient occlusion.

Between 30 June 2021 and 28 January 2022, 691 participants aged 18–45 were enrolled across four Indian sites; 506 formed the per-protocol population. The study compared immune responses to two doses of Covaxin or Covishield, stratified by baseline serostatus. Covishield elicited higher seroconversion rates, anti-spike antibody GMTs, neutralizing antibodies, and ACE2-inhibition responses than Covaxin in seronegative and seropositive participants. In the earliest cohort, Covishield elicited CD4 and CD8 T cell responses, while Covaxin mainly elicited CD4 responses. The Omicron wave overlapped with vaccination and sampling and affected immunogenicity. Neither vaccine elicited Omicron-specific antibodies in seronegative individuals, while a single Covishield dose elicited measurable Omicron-specific responses in seropositive individuals. Non-responsiveness was associated with higher pre-vaccination antibody titers. The authors conclude that the vectored vaccine elicited stronger and broader anti-spike responses than the inactivated vaccine, and note limitations including sparse Omicron-wave sampling and the absence of a correlate of protection for Covaxin.

The Stanley Cup finals is exciting, especially for first-timers, but overexcitement can cause trying too much; they must calm down and play their regular game. Yankee is a pro-style shot concept built around a post-dig combination from opposite sides to stress safety and linebacker levels. It is often used from heavier personnel to encourage 1-high safety looks. Against Cover 1 and Cover 3, the quarterback can high-low the free safety, throwing the post if the safety plays low or the dig if he sinks. Against Cover 2 and Cover 4, the play is less effective, and the quarterback should quickly move to underneath routes. The progression is post, dig, crosser, then check-down. Variations include a 2x2 version with shallow crossers and a version with whip routes underneath, while the post-dig remains the main focus.

A worst-case climate scenario called a “pulse” involves warm water causing glaciers that hold back Antarctic and Greenland ice sheets to collapse, potentially leading to rapid sea-level rise. Current predictions for Miami are 7 to 8 feet by the end of the century, but a pulse could bring 10 to 30 feet by 2100, with superstorms. A Science Advances study found rapid glacial melt in West Antarctica’s Amundsen Sea and East Antarctica’s Sabrina Coast is counteracting cooling that normally keeps Antarctic waters cool, allowing warm water to pool beneath ice and drive further melt. This positive feedback may accelerate sea-level rise. Lack of Antarctic bottom water could slow ocean currents, associated with superstorms and faster atmospheric warming. Researchers say more study is needed and stopping global temperature rise is essential.

The passage argues that improving apprenticeships requires stronger pre-apprenticeship pathways, especially in construction. Traditional construction apprenticeships are selective, favor applicants with existing knowledge or skills, require advanced technical coursework, and have cumbersome applications, locking out motivated workers who need extra help. Pre-apprenticeships are short-term programs that expose participants to careers and employers, build professional and technical skills, connect them with mentors, prepare them for entry assessments, and often provide industry-recognized credentials. They lack funding, capacity, and outcomes data. The passage recommends creative financing for wraparound support, loans repaid only if earnings increase, employer or union repayment, and better data to attract grants and philanthropic investment. It calls for partnership and strategic investment to strengthen construction pathways, fill in-demand jobs, and promote economic mobility.

A recent experiment tested an AI tool called Waldo, which reviewed more than 430,000 past Reddit posts about cannabis use and flagged one quoted post and over 28,000 others as potentially describing unexpected or harmful side effects. Researchers checked 250 flagged posts and verified that 86 percent represented problematic cannabis experiences. Waldo was trained on 10,000 Reddit posts previously identified by hand; it outperformed ChatGPT, which had 18 times more false positives, but did not outperform human reviewers. The work suggests social media scanning could help public health workers find harmful outcomes, though it remains uncertain whether Waldo would work for other drugs or products. Potential future use would require ethical handling and privacy protections.

Robodoc is a conversational-AI-based app for medical conversations. The paper presents a prototype smart chatbot using OpenAI Large Language Models and models built with Google Teachable Machine via transfer learning. It includes image-based models for X-ray, able to detect viral and bacterial pneumonia, and for OCT, able to detect Drusen, Choroidal Neovascularization, and Diabetic Macular Edema. It also includes a TensorFlow.js diabetes detection model. These models are integrated into a chatbot that uses the user’s message to select and use models intelligently. Results show good integration between the models and the chatbot, with slight deviations from expected behaviors. For the OCT model, a stub function for medical appointments based on patient condition seriousness was tested. The paper also discusses literature, methods, results, risks, and future works. It concludes that public APIs allow a complex model to be built without complex research infrastructure and at low cost, and that bioinformatics may gain more friendly interfaces.

Theo Wellington told the Wilson County Commission that the total solar eclipse will be the biggest public one-day event in U.S. history, with Wilson County near the path’s center, expected population increases, and near-maximum viewing time. The commission also voted to let retiring officers retain service weapons and to equip future Springdale Elementary School with a school resource officer.

The passage discusses swing trading indicators, defining swing trading as positions held from one day to a few weeks, rarely longer than a month. It recommends a time frame of 1–15 days and explains risk-adjusted return as annual geometric return divided by exposure, with return compared to maximum drawdown. It backtests six indicators on the S&P 500 using SPY: Williams %R, WilliamsVixFix, Bollinger Bands, Stochastics, the Internal Bar Strength Indicator, and RSI. Based on backtests, Williams %R is considered the best indicator for swing trading because it showed stable results, the lowest average maximum drawdown, and better risk-adjusted returns. The passage says the top three indicators are regarded as fairly equal.

This application is a continuation of U.S. application Ser. No. 17/684,607, which is a continuation of U.S. application Ser. No. 17/038,260, which is a continuation of U.S. application Ser. No. 16/097,354, which is a U.S. national stage application of PCT/KR2017/004569, claiming benefit of five Korean Patent Applications filed Apr. 29, 2016. The present invention relates to a method and apparatus for encoding/decoding a video signal. The background describes increasing multimedia data, HEVC version 1 established in February 2014, and HEVC methods including intra-prediction, inter-prediction, transform, quantization, entropy encoding, and in-loop filter. Inter-prediction uses reconstructed videos and motion information, may be less effective when brightness changes such as fade-in or fade-out, and more accurate motion information or precise intra-prediction modes can increase transmitted data. Objectives include improving intra-prediction/inter-prediction efficiency, using a weight, improving motion vector precision using reconstructed information adjacent to a current block, correcting an intra-prediction result, effectively encoding an intra-prediction mode, and dividing a current block into sub-blocks for prediction. A decoding method determines whether a current block is merged with a neighbor block; obtains motion information and a weight prediction parameter based on the determination; selects a reference block based on the motion information; and generates a prediction block by applying the weight prediction parameter to the reference block. If merged, the weight prediction parameter is identical to the neighbor block’s; if not, it is obtained from decoded bitstream information. Motion information may include a motion vector whose precision may be upwardly adjusted based on reconstructed pixels adjacent to the current block. The decoding method also decodes intra-prediction mode information, performs intra-prediction, determines whether to correct a prediction sample, and corrects the prediction sample accordingly. Decoding intra-prediction mode information may include generating candidate modes, determining whether a candidate mode identical to the current block’s intra-prediction mode exists, and determining the mode based on the result; candidate modes may be determined based on frequency of use of an upper and/or left neighbor block. It may also decode a difference value between intra-prediction modes of the current and previous blocks and determine the current mode based on the previous mode and the difference value. An encoding method determines motion information and a weight prediction parameter of a current block and encodes information representing whether the motion information and the weight prediction parameter are merged with a neighbor block; a prediction block may be generated by applying the weight prediction parameter to a reference block selected based on the motion information. If merged, the weight prediction parameter is identical to the neighbor block’s; if not, information related to the weight prediction parameter is encoded. The encoding method may encode information representing whether to upwardly adjust motion vector precision based on reconstructed pixels adjacent to the current block. It may determine an intra-prediction mode, correct a prediction sample, encode information representing whether to correct the prediction sample based on the prediction sample and the corrected prediction sample, generate candidate modes, determine whether a candidate mode identical to the current block’s intra-prediction mode exists, encode information representing whether the identical candidate mode exists, and encode a difference value between intra-prediction modes of the current and previous blocks. The passage also describes weight prediction parameter derivation/encoding/decoding, correction coefficients using reconstructed pixel areas, intra-prediction mode determination, inter-prediction using reconstructed pixels, motion vector improvement, and sub-block intra-prediction. The invention is described as improving intra-prediction/inter-prediction efficiency, using a weight, improving motion vector precision, correcting an intra-prediction result, effectively encoding an intra-prediction mode, and improving encoding/decoding efficiency by dividing a current block into sub-blocks and performing prediction for each sub-block.

Organized patriotism, replacing local pride with national feeling and high national ambition, is essential to a nation’s growth; no country can reach full strength if sections or classes put loyalty to part above whole. Industrial and agricultural classes, capitalists and wageworkers, must work together. Efficient education is next in importance. The federal government has limits but should ensure DC schools promote commercial and industrial training, including foreign trade. Technical industrial education is needed to raise mechanics and wageworkers in efficiency, reward, dignity, and power; purely literary public schooling can unfit students for industrial work. Industrial development depends on technical education, and the country must meet educated trained competitors. Help wageworkers; hope the interstate commerce clause is construed broadly; enact advanced DC legislation on industrial training, child labor, factory laws. Farmers’ welfare is vital; farming must become a technical and scientific profession with practical training, and farmers need a chance to rise and develop. National success requires material prosperity and high moral, mental, and physical development; farmer education is especially necessary as frontier conditions vanish, intensive cultivation replaces wasteful management, and better business organization is needed.

Microsoft Corporation filed Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2015. The unaudited financial statements report revenue of $20,379 million, net income of $4,620 million, basic EPS of $0.58, and diluted EPS of $0.57. Revenue decreased 12% primarily due to lower More Personal Computing revenue and a net $1.3 billion Windows 10 revenue deferral, partly offset by Intelligent Cloud growth. Operating income was $5,793 million. The filing includes segment results for Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing; notes on investments, derivatives, fair value, debt, income taxes, restructuring, unearned revenue, contingencies, and stockholders’ equity; management’s discussion and analysis; and risk factors. Deloitte & Touche LLP reported no material modifications from its review.

The leu was steady ahead of Romania’s central bank decision on whether to raise interest rates again. The forint and Czech crown firmed as investors reduced emerging-market currency selling after China moved to reverse yuan falls. Romania’s NBR has raised rates since January and may deliver a fourth hike; monetary conditions have tightened. In Hungary, the forint recovered from record lows, and the NBH discussed inflation with analysts before publishing June meeting minutes.

Share prices in the local bourse rose with most major Asian markets, retracing last week’s losses amid expectations weak US inflation data could keep the Federal Reserve dovish and easing US-North Korea tension. The STI rose 29 points, or 0.9%, to 3,308.69, with 2.2 billion shares worth $1.2 billion traded. Hang Seng gained 1.4%, Kospi 0.6%, and Shanghai Composite 0.9%, while Nikkei 225 fell nearly 1%. Analysts said geopolitical concerns may persist, keeping sentiment cautious and supporting safe-haven demand. In Singapore, banking and property stocks mostly gained; Olam’s Q2 net profit rose, while Asian Pay Television Trust’s quarterly net profit fell.

U.S. stocks rose Monday after the Easter holiday, with the S&P 500 up 0.5%, Dow up 0.6%, Nasdaq up 0.6%, and Russell 2000 up 0.6%. Technology, industrial, and consumer companies gained after China said its economy grew 6.9% in the first quarter, slightly faster than the previous quarter. Alere accepted Abbott’s lower $51-per-share buyout. Eli Lilly and Incyte fell after the FDA declined to approve their rheumatoid arthritis pill. Snyder’s-Lance dropped on a weak forecast and CEO retirement. Arconic rose after CEO and Chairman Klaus Kleinfeld agreed to step down. Straight Path climbed after a possible competing buyout offer. Two TPS7H500x-SP controllers can operate in primary-secondary mode using SYNC. The primary’s RT is populated and its SYNC provides a clock at twice the switching frequency; the secondary’s RT floats and operates in external synchronization. This can synchronize two independent converters, with only SYNC shared, or a single interleaved parallel-phase converter, which also connects VSENSE, COMP, SS, and HICC. The secondary inverts the clock, causing a 90° or 270° output phase shift.

The passage explains using Python to backtest a classic MACD trading strategy: downloading Apple historical data from Yahoo Finance with yfinance, calculating the MACD using 12- and 26-period EMAs, the 9-period signal line, and the histogram, then generating regime values and strategy returns and plotting results. It reports a 15.04% CAGR for the MACD strategy versus 19.07% for buy and hold, with the strategy invested 51.13% of the time, and states the strategy is for informational purposes.

Former prime minister Jean Chrétien, at a Vaughan Liberal rally for Steven Del Duca’s nomination after the Yonge St. van attack, said Toronto came together despite the sad events. Del Duca urged reflection and blood donation, asked supporters to work hard despite polls favouring Doug Ford, and praised Premier Kathleen Wynne; Chrétien also praised Wynne. Outside, LiUNA Local 183 members protested budget labour changes.

3DPCNet is introduced as a pose-only, estimator-agnostic module that maps any estimated 3D pose from a camera-centered frame to a fixed body-centered canonical frame. It uses a hybrid encoder with parallel graph convolutional and transformer branches, fused via cross-attention and adaptive gating, and predicts a continuous 6D global rotation converted to SO(3) by Gram-Schmidt orthonormalization, plus an optional residual correction. It is trained with synthetically rotated poses using a composite loss. On MM-Fi, it reduces MPJPE by about 27% and rotation error from 20–22° to 3–4°, with stable cross-subject and cross-environment performance and non-zero PA-MPJPE from residual adjustments. On TotalCapture, canonicalized poses from off-the-shelf estimators produced wrist acceleration signals closer to IMU ground truth than a geometric baseline, especially at lateral views. Limitations include non-rigid residual deviations, no absolute scale recovery, dependence on input pose quality, and pose-space augmentation. Future work includes controlling the residual toward SE(3)-rigid behavior, temporal modeling, scale and gravity alignment, and clinical and performance validation.

The IRS reports progress on tax-related ID fraud, while consumers and businesses are warned about con artists seeking data. Under the new federal tax law, payroll withholding tables are changing, and about 90% of workers should see extra cash, though amounts depend on income, children, pay frequency, and W-4 withholding allowances. Employers should use the new 2018 tables by Feb. 15. Examples show a married couple earning $90,000 with two children could get about $61 extra semi-monthly, while a single person earning $35,000 could get nearly $32 more. The child tax credit doubled to $2,000 per qualifying child. Taxpayers may need to revisit W-4s, the standard deduction increases, some itemized deductions change, and bonus withholding is now 22%.

Christian Brothers defensive lineman Bill Norton, a 6-foot-6, 270-pound four-star 2019 prospect and reigning TSSAA Division II-AAA Mr. Football, announced Sunday night he committed to Georgia over multiple offers; he is ranked 11th nationally among strong-side defensive ends by 247Sports composite.

The passage presents a bibliometric analysis of Scopus publications from 2000 to 2024 on wartime and online education, with attention to African higher education. It reviews the growth of online education in African universities since the 1990s through ICT, policy shifts, and telecommunications deregulation, while noting challenges such as weak ICT policies, poor infrastructure, limited internet access, rural–urban digital divides, lack of skilled personnel, instructor resistance, and difficulty adapting pedagogy. It also describes how wars in Africa disrupt higher education, destroy infrastructure, create insecurity, and hinder ICT deployment. The methodology used Scopus, search terms including “wartime and online education,” screening 90 documents to 53 for bibliometric analysis, with Microsoft Excel and VOSviewer. Results show publications from ten countries, led by the United States with 21 and Ukraine with 10; further screening on wartime, education, and online learning identified only Ukraine, Austria, and the United States. Social sciences were the leading subject area. Keyword clusters focused on learning—e-learning, online, online teaching, university teacher—and warfare—student, teacher, Ukraine, war. The discussion and conclusion identify a research gap on wartime and online learning in African higher education, noting no African countries among the highlighted findings. Online education is described as a lifeline during conflict, but African universities face infrastructure and preparedness obstacles. The study calls for research on organizational sustainability, brain drain, trauma, and inclusive online learning, and notes limitations from using only Scopus and not analyzing authorship, affiliations, citations, or references.

Dick Tuck, a Democratic Party operative known for political pranks and subterfuge, especially against Richard Nixon, died at 94 in Tucson, Arizona, friend Lorraine Glicksman said. He began pranking Nixon in 1950 while at the University of California, Santa Barbara, and staged stunts including bogus fortune cookies, posing as a fire marshal, a Chinatown sign about the Hughes loan, and causing Nixon to destroy 1968 campaign buttons. He worked in Robert F. Kennedy’s 1968 campaign and ran in California’s 1966 Democratic Senate primary, drawing 10 percent. He said he wanted Nixon’s resignation day called Nixmas.

Mathieu Henderson finished his four-year OHL career with a breakout season, ranking ninth among OHL defencemen with 10 goals and 44 assists in 68 games for Flint. Flint was eliminated 4-1 by Sault Ste. Marie in the opening playoff round. Henderson improved his plus/minus to minus-seven from minus-45, crediting his coaches and opportunity. After the season, he played three ECHL games for South Carolina but was not on the playoff roster. He is deciding whether to play pro in North America or Europe or go to school, and credits his parents as his biggest supporters.

The lecture reviews VCG mechanisms for private-value social choice, noting that VCG implements the utilitarian solution in dominant strategies, is not budget balanced, and can be impractical when the action space is very large. It then focuses mainly on Google: its dominance in search, high profits, expansion into other products, and antitrust suits by the U.S. Department of Justice and states. Google runs an ad auction on every search, using standing per-click bids, quality scores, ranking by quality-weighted bids, k+1 pricing, and pay-per-click; commercial queries show more ads. The Edelman-Ostrovsky-Schwarz model treats ad positions as prizes with click counts and private values. Google’s generalized second-price auction is not VCG, induces bid shading, but its equilibrium payments replicate VCG, making it ex post efficient; quality weights and reserve prices are important. The Athey-Ellison search model endogenizes prizes through consumer search and shows that, with uniformly distributed search costs, consumer surplus and social welfare are maximized at the same reserve price. Anderson-Renault and Armstrong-Zhou papers address endogenous pricing and platform information design.

GST is scheduled to roll out on July 1, with preparations at an advanced stage. The civil aviation ministry sought a two-month deferral, citing airlines’ lack of readiness and concerns, while the finance ministry said implementation is on track and denied delay rumors.

The passage describes managing indexed data in computing environments and optimizing index file sizes based on storage conditions related to indexed data. It also presents a data intake and query system that receives, parses, indexes, stores, and searches machine-generated data as timestamped events using forwarders, indexers, search heads, late-binding schemas, extraction rules, data models, and acceleration techniques. It further covers security features, data center monitoring, cloud-based and clustered system arrangements, and example interfaces and processes.

The IRS announced higher 2026 federal income tax brackets and standard deductions to adjust for inflation. The standard deduction will rise to $32,200 for married couples filing jointly and $16,100 for single taxpayers. Income thresholds for each bracket increased, with the top 37% rate applying above $640,600 for individuals and $768,700 for married joint filers. Changes also affect long-term capital gains brackets, estate and gift tax exemption, child tax credit eligibility, and earned income tax credit eligibility. The announcement came a day after the IRS said it would furlough nearly half its workforce due to the ongoing government shutdown.

This passage describes the SEV-ES/SEV-SNP GHCB protocol. GHCBData bits specify the GHCB guest physical address, supported protocol version range, and SEV page table encryption bit number. The hypervisor supplies capabilities before GHCB establishment; the guest selects a supported protocol version or terminates. A CPUID request protocol can return one register value at a time and does not support non-zero sub-leafs or function 0x0000_000d. GHCB GPA registration is required for SEV-SNP and supports get-preferred, register, and unregister requests. NAE events include page state change, SNP guest request and extended request, SEV-TIO guest request, AP creation, #HV doorbell page, #HV Send IPI, #HV Timer, APIC ID list, SNP Run VMPL, Secure AVIC backing page, and termination request. VMGEXIT handling uses GHCB fields and VALID_BITMAP, with errors reported through SW_EXITINFO1 and SW_EXITINFO2. SEV-SNP AP booting can use an AP jump table or SNP AP Creation. #HV doorbell interrupt delivery uses PendingEvent and NoEoiRequired fields with defined host and guest behavior. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported.

Egyptian archaeologists unveiled the tomb of Hetpet, an Old Kingdom priestess of Hathor, on the Giza plateau. The Fifth Dynasty tomb has an L-shaped shrine and well-preserved wall paintings showing hunting, fishing, offerings, music, dance, and monkeys. It includes a purification basin with her name and titles, and excavations will continue.

SOS full court pressure forces offensive reaction and can increase or decrease tempo, change pace, surprise, and fatigue opponents, causing errors, forced shots, turnovers, and easy baskets. Primary shadow presses—Back, Up, Face—differ in initial alignments; secondary Blitz presses deny first passing lanes and trap deep. Deployment varies by personnel and situation. Execution requires SOS fundamentals, forcing the ball away from the middle. Except for hold actions, presses end in Base Go Red; pressure is off if the shadow player is out of position or on a deep/middle outlet.

UK and Ukraine discussed trade and investment after the UK leaves the EU, welcoming continuity of the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement/DCFTA. The UK would be treated as a member state for international agreements during the Implementation Period; both agreed to strengthen trade.
Amber Enterprises received Sebi approval to raise estimated Rs 555 crore via IPO, comprising Rs 450 crore fresh issue and Rs 105 crore promoter sale.

The passage reports a study of perineuronal nets (PNNs) and extracellular matrix (ECM) molecules in the hippocampus in substance use disorder (SUD), major depressive disorder (MDD), comorbid SUD/MDD, and controls, using human postmortem samples and rhesus macaques with chronic alcohol self-administration. In human SUD, PNN numerical densities were increased in CA1 stratum oriens and other hippocampal subregions; WFA-glia were increased in CA4 and dentate gyrus; Pvb, Vamp2, and Chsy1 expression were increased, while Mmp9 and Ctss were decreased. In MDD, PNN densities were decreased in CA1 SO/SP and increased in CA4, WFA-glia were increased in several regions, and Pvb, Vamp2, and Ctss were increased. In comorbid SUD/MDD, PNNs were reduced in CA1 SP and increased in CA2 SP, WFA-glia were decreased in multiple regions, and Acan, Chsy1, and Pvb were increased, with lower Gfap. Rhesus macaques with chronic alcohol self-administration showed increased PNNs in combined subfields, CA1 SO, CA3 SO, and CA3 SP, and increased WFA-glia in the dentate gyrus granule cell layer. The passage concludes that increased PNNs may stabilize contextual reward memories in SUD and that MDD comorbidity is important, as MDD often showed opposite ECM changes.

The passage describes systems and methods for localizing and classifying abnormalities in medical images. It discloses a jointly trained localization network and classification network, a multi-task network, a multi-modality fusion network for mpMRI images, and a regression network for lesion scoring. It also describes detecting an abnormality by deleting portions of an input medical image to generate incomplete images, using a trained generative adversarial network to generate synthesized images, determining a normal image, and detecting the abnormality based on the input medical image and the normal image. Additionally, it describes training and optimizing deep learning models using multi-site datasets and deployment datasets, including reordering datasets by similarity or uncertainty and selectively iteratively updating models.

The speaker saw little difference from Anaheim, but their team did not play its game. A disputed goal was ruled no goal on the ice and after review. The opponent capitalized on the power play and played its game plan; the game is behind them.

Trump tweeted asking who would restore lives devastated by the Russia collusion investigation, saying people came to Washington with stars in their eyes and returned in tatters. Most directly affected were his inner circle and former campaign aides, though many young aides left due to administration infighting, not the investigation. Trump remains focused on the probe and believes it aims to delegitimize his presidency; John Kelly said Trump is “somewhat embarrassed” by the investigations. Rudy Giuliani declined to say whether Trump would be questioned by Robert Mueller, saying he was comfortable on collusion but less so on obstruction. Trump called Mueller’s team “13 Angry Democrats” and alleged FBI spying; Marco Rubio pushed back. Trump falsely claimed a New York Times source “doesn’t exist,” though the source was a senior official who briefed reporters under White House ground rules.

A University of Virginia Health System thoracic surgery recovery program, reviewed after its first year, reduced morphine-equivalent use by 74 percent in one patient group and 59 percent in another without compromising pain evaluations; reduced median hospital stay for thoracotomy patients by two days; saved more than $1.3 million; and freed beds for an estimated 28 additional patients. It enrolled 139 patients and was compared with over 220 previous patients. Benefits occurred without increased surgical complications or readmissions. Researchers noted limitations, including limited cost detail, but called the initiative successful. Findings were published in the Annals of Thoracic Surgery.

Two Lashkar-e-Jhangvi militants, Shaikh Muhammad Mumtaz and Muhammad Ahmed Khan alias Muna, escaped from Karachi Central Jail late Tuesday. At least a dozen officials were suspended, and DIG Prisons Ashraf Ali Nizamani sought a case against them. IG Prisons Nusrat Mangan said a committee was formed and teams were dispatched. The speaker calls it one game to win the Stanley Cup, would have accepted it during the season, and plans to prepare to win, describing it as another game like playoff overtime.

French President Macron’s maiden visit to Nigeria dominates Nigerian front pages. Reports cover security talks on the G-5 Sahel force, intelligence sharing, and Boko Haram; a trade and reforestation MoU creating about 150,000 jobs in Ogun State; and Macron saying Nigeria must address Fulani herdsmen violence. AMD shares surged after an AI chip deal with OpenAI. Evercore’s Emanuel noted a bubble scenario could take the S&P 500 to 9,000 in 2026. Culpeper defeated Courtland 2-1 on Monday. Courtland committed seven errors, five in the final two innings, while Culpeper made routine plays. Both pitchers, Alex Kobersteen and Jake Dudley, threw complete games with nine strikeouts and two hits allowed; Kobersteen allowed two unearned runs. The Department of Education will halt two Obama-era rules set to take effect July 1 and create committees to review and improve them. One required for-profit colleges and certificate programs to show education leads to gainful employment or lose federal aid. Another clarified borrower defense loan forgiveness for defrauded or misled students and created fast-track relief for closed colleges. The November 30, 2000 VentureWire newsletter reports 724 Solutions’ agreement to acquire Tantau Software for about $375 million in stock; El Dorado Ventures raising a $250 million fund; MaMaMedia reducing staff to 15 employees; and iVMG naming Samer Salameh as president and CEO. Etisalat Nigeria has not agreed with 13 local lenders on restructuring a $1.2 billion loan after a missed payment. Its CEO declined comment; regulators favored a default deal over receivership.

Greece's central bank chief urged Athens and foreign lenders to complete the country's bailout review by end-February, warning that further delays would rekindle uncertainty and undermine the expected recovery. Talks have stalled over labour and energy reforms, fiscal targets and IMF involvement, with euro zone finance ministers expected to discuss the issue next week.

The passage explains offensive goal kicks in soccer. Their primary objective is to retain possession after the kick and create an effective attack. A goal kick occurs when the ball crosses the defenders’ end line after last being touched by an attacker. It is taken from the goal area, with the ball stationary, and opposing players should be outside the penalty area until the kick is taken, though the kicker may take it if they are not. Any player may take it; the ball is live once kicked and visibly moves, opponents may then enter the penalty area, and any player except the original kicker may kick it, per Law 16. For youth generally 10 and under, smaller fields and build-out lines help, with defenders required to retreat behind the line before challenging. For youth 11 and above, options expand to multiple targets and a midfielder, with coverage determining the kick. Adults may use all options, including short and deep kicks; the goalkeeper usually takes the kick. Goal kicks are restarts and direct, and wind can cause unusual outcomes.

Project Sashakat, endorsed by the Finance Ministry, aims to promote faster resolution of non-performing assets through a five-pronged strategy. A panel headed by Sunil Mehta recommended an AMC/AIF-led approach for NPA cases above Rs 500 crore, steering committees for stressed accounts over Rs 50 crore, and a template approach for SME loans up to Rs 50 crore within 90 days. It suggested an asset trading platform and did not recommend a bad bank. Analysts called the proposals positive.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced an agreement to build a Qatari Emiri Air Force facility at Mountain Home Air Force Base in Idaho, allowing Qatari pilots to train with American military personnel. Hegseth said it will host Qatari F-15s and pilots to enhance combined training, interoperability, and partnership.

A new experiment will investigate whether giving new mothers a large untaxed supplemental monthly income, beyond existing benefits, causally affects babies' and toddlers' emotional and brain development during their first three years.

Scorpion stings are a life-threatening emergency with uncertain global burden, higher reported envenomation and mortality in developing countries, and greater risk of severe envenomation in children. This prospective descriptive cross-sectional study at Tesseney Community Hospital in Eritrea from June 2019 to May 2020 included 165 admitted scorpion sting patients. Most were urban, older than 15 years, and stung on the foot at night; common manifestations were localized pain, sweating, and vomiting. Case fatality was 4.8%, largely associated with Abroug class III. Children under 15 and no formal education were possible predisposing factors for severity. Most cases occurred in summer, especially September and October. Treatment included local anesthesia, analgesics, diazepam, and nifedipine/SAV. The study concludes severity is greater in children and recommends preventive education and further studies.

The passage explains that random walk theory models stock prices as completely unpredictable, making historical prices and technical, fundamental, or sentiment analysis futile. A random walk trading strategy uses random entries and exits and assumes a 50% chance of price rising or falling; its key application is diversification, preferably through a broad market index fund, rather than market timing. It compares the theory with the efficient market hypothesis: both conclude consistent outperformance is nearly impossible, but random walk says markets are random while EMH says prices reflect all available information. It credits Bachelier with coining the theory and Malkiel with popularizing it, discusses pros and cons, and reports backtests where random entries in SPY produced positive results while GLD did not.

The passage discusses rising regulatory complexity and the need for firms to treat compliance as a strategic advantage. It notes increasing penalties, reputational and operational risks, and the role of technology in real-time monitoring, audit readiness, and globally consistent but locally adaptable programs. It presents StarCompliance as a compliance platform provider and promotes its executive brief on the costs of non-compliance.

The passage explains that official car mpg figures come from the European Commission test protocol and are often unreliable. The current NEDC test hasn’t been updated since 1997, allows manufacturers to subtract 4%, lacks sustained motorway driving, permits eco mode, turns off ancillary loads, allows lower test speeds, removal of some parts, higher tyre pressures, and lacks policing across labs. From September 2017, WLTP will replace NEDC, with all new UK cars using WLTP figures by September 2018. Which? tests on a rolling road using WLTP cold, hot and motorway cycles. It tests cars in default mode, with air conditioning, lights and radio on, without tampering or adjusting results. It tests hybrids similarly, collects air-polluting emissions, and uses PEMS on real roads when lab NOx readings are suspicious. Which? publishes mpg data for over 700 reviewed vehicles and tests about 120 new cars yearly. Its research found over £800 annual fuel-cost difference between the most and least efficient medium-sized hatchbacks.

This report recounts U.S. relations with Hawaii, stating that U.S. policy early and consistently opposed foreign aggression threatening American paramount rights and interests there and contemplated annexation as a contingent necessity, at times avowing and attempting it. It cites a contingent 1851 cession deed, Marcy’s 1854 annexation advocacy and draft treaty, Seward’s 1867 preference for annexation over reciprocity, Johnson’s 1868 message, Grant’s 1871 solicitation of Senate views, Fish’s 1873 instruction not to discourage annexation, post-1875 defense of exclusive U.S. commercial rights and support for the Hawaiian Government while able, and Blaine’s 1881 advocacy of benevolent neutrality with an American solution if impracticable. It also notes John C. Jones’s 1820 appointment as Agent of the United States for commerce and seamen.

Anthurium, from South America, has red, pink, or white flowers and filters ammonia and xylene; its sap and leaves may cause allergies. It needs light without direct sun, dampness, 18–21°C indoors, winter misting, and yearly repotting.

The study applies a quasi-experimental approach to estimate how college teaching modality affects COVID-19 cases and deaths in neighboring counties. It matches similar colleges with different modalities and compares in-person versus online, in-person versus hybrid, and hybrid versus online. Results provide evidence that college reopening, especially in-person teaching, increases COVID-19 cases and deaths over time. The authors note limitations in prior studies, including endogenous modality choice, testing effects, lagged deaths, and other institutions, and use differing reopening dates, cellphone mobility data, and reweighting methods for identification.

Economic exclusion after the war seriously affects Austria-Hungary and Germany, and transit trade to Turkey cannot solve immediate problems of work, supplies, and financial burdens. The passage lists assets regarding Bulgaria, Turkey, outside Europe, Russia, the Vatican, American resources, intangibles, and changed German policy. Bulgaria’s asset is satisfying her just claims now that Russian occupation of Constantinople is removed; a satisfied Bulgaria may share Middle Europe’s economic advantages and be less exploitable. Turkey’s assets are military successes with religio-political effect and Turkey’s financial and economic weakness and need for assistance. Outside Europe, assets include German colonies and Germany’s exclusion from the Pacific and Central and South America. The Russian revolution contains anti-capitalist feeling, religious love of Russia, and moderate nationalist feeling, making it difficult for Germany and a dissolving force. Viral genome sequencing has shifted toward near-real-time analysis, but global SARS-CoV-2 sequencing is highly concentrated: the United States and United Kingdom contributed 54.9% of GISAID sequences as of July 1, 2022, and 10% of countries produced 90.3%. Established multinomial or logistic regression methods require large sequence numbers and struggle with geographic heterogeneity and sparse data. The authors present a Bayesian hierarchical multinomial model that partially pools sequence data across countries and variants to estimate country-specific variant prevalence, country-specific growth rates, and global relative fitness, using shrinkage toward shared distributions. Applied to SARS-CoV-2, the model estimates heterogeneous country-specific fitness for BA.4, BA.5, and BA.2.12.1 and finds BA.5 more fit globally than BA.4 and BA.2.12.1. Retrospective validation against a single-country maximum likelihood multinomial model using reference dates and Brier scores found the multicountry model had lower Brier scores at early reference dates, more stable fitness estimates, and could estimate fitness before a variant was observed in a country, whereas the single-country model had wider uncertainty and gaps. The authors note assumptions including random sampling, correct lineage and date assignment, even mixing, and equal generation intervals, and they describe a dashboard and future extensions to other pathogens and finer geographic scales.

The paper studies Gorenstein-projective modules over the ring of dual integers Z[ε] = Z[T]/(T²), noting that classifying all modules over Z[ε] is not considered feasible. It states that G-proj Z[ε] is equivalent to torsionless Z[ε]-modules, perfect differential structures of abelian groups, and orbits of bounded complexes of free abelian groups, and that it lacks the Krull-Remak-Schmidt property. The main theorem establishes equivalences involving the stable category of G-proj Z[ε] modulo projectives, a stable category of submodules of finitely generated free Z[ε]-modules modulo projectives, D^b(Z)/[1], and homotopy/stable categories of perfect differential structures. The theorem can also be established for any principal ideal domain. The paper further describes a chain of categories linked by dense functors and a commutative cube.

John Clarke, Michel Devoret and John Martinis won the 2025 Nobel Prize in physics for demonstrating quantum effects in an electric circuit. In the 1980s they showed quantum tunneling and energy quantization in a Josephson junction, involving billions of electrons on a hand-sized chip, contrary to expectations that such effects occur only at atomic scales. The work underlies superconducting qubits in quantum computers. They split the 11 million Swedish kronor prize. Martinis later led Google’s quantum computing effort, whose team controversially claimed a calculation beyond traditional computers in 2019.

Twenty years ago, the Open Source Definition was published, building on Richard Stallman's free software advocacy. The Open Source Initiative dates its inception to February 3, 1998, when Christine Peterson proposed "open source" during a meeting prompted by Netscape releasing its source code. The term was sought as an alternative to "free software," which often required explaining that "free" meant liberty, not price. Both concepts make source code available under a license favoring user freedom. Bruce Perens dates the OSD announcement to February 9, 1998. The more commercially palatable messaging worked; major tech companies now depend on open source, and Red Hat's Tim Burke says open source leads innovation rather than cloning.

Storage systems take power from the grid or local generation and return or use it later. Storage has capital and running costs, including round-trip efficiency, and must provide benefits greater than costs. Technologies differ: lithium ion batteries suit small-scale use, are lightweight and efficient but expensive per unit; pumped hydro suits large scale and is cheap per unit; flywheels have low efficiency and storage but can dispatch power quickly and aid frequency stability. Other options include compressed air, cryogenic energy storage, flow batteries and hydrogen. Lithium ion costs are falling, but a 7kWh home battery must cost less than A$7,000 fully installed, about A$1,000 per kWh, to break even; current costs are A$1,000-3,000 per kWh. Retail variable rates exaggerate wholesale peak-off-peak differences, and a flat 25c rate would require about A$300 per kWh. Network savings depend on growing demand; National Electricity Market demand has declined significantly since 2009, making grid storage benefits negligible except in high-growth corridors. Pumped hydro costs about A$100 per kWh, and 1,500 MW exists in the market. Distributed lithium ion storage may eventually win because of human behaviour, not economics.

The ADS9803 supports a speed-boost mode for up to 8 MSPS sampling on a user-selected analog input channel pair, while the remaining six analog input channels are idle. In this mode, the selected pair is converted on every sampling clock, and the data output interface remains the same as normal mode. Register writes and reads use 16-bit configuration registers grouped in three register banks with 8-bit addresses; bank selection is done by writing to register 0x03 in bank 0. Read access is enabled by setting SPI_RD_EN = 1b and SPI_MODE = 1b. For daisy-chain SPI configuration, CS and SCLK are shared, the first ADC’s SDI connects to PICO, each ADC’s SDO connects to the next ADC’s SDI, and the last ADC’s SDO connects to POCI. DAISY_CHAIN_LEN sets the chain length. The passage also describes register read/write procedures, register controls for SPI/daisy-chain mode, bank selection, daisy-chain length, data format, averaging, test patterns, gain error correction, analog input bandwidth, power-down, reference, output data lanes, common-mode range, speed-boost, and PGA initialization. Application information describes the ADS9803 as an eight-channel, 20-bit, 2MSPS DAQ system for ATE, with post-calibration TUE of 0.0015% at 25°C ±5°C, low-noise bandwidth up to 22.7 kHz and wide-bandwidth up to 700 kHz, wide-bandwidth settling to 99.95% FS in 7.5 µs, three power supplies AVDD_5V, VDD_1V8, and IOVDD, layout and decoupling guidance, development tools, support resources, ESD caution, revision history, and mechanical, packaging, and orderable information.

This retrospective study enrolled 109 patients with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage after aneurysm treatment to create a predictive model for shunt-dependent hydrocephalus (SDHC). Data analyzed included age, gender, BMI, treatment modality, new neurological deficits, laboratory values, aneurysm location, Fisher grade, and Hunt and Hess scale (HHS). Univariate analysis found age ≥65 years, clipping versus coiling, and HHS ≥3 significantly associated with SDHC. Stepwise logistic regression showed age ≥65 years, clipping versus coiling, and HHS ≥3 contributed to SDHC development. A nomogram based on these variables had an AUC of 0.753. The study concludes that risk factors include age >65 years, HHS ≥3, and treatment with clipping rather than coiling, and that a nomogram was developed to make relative risk perceptible. Limitations were the retrospective design and limited case number.

An international team found live Kuphus polythalamia, a giant black mud-dwelling shipworm that feeds on sulfur, in a Philippine lagoon. In the northern Rocky Mountains, earlier, warmer, drier springs are changing streams and threatening native cutthroat trout. A nationwide study links long-term outdoor exposure to trichloroethylene (TCE), an industrial solvent used in metal degreasing and dry cleaning, with a higher Parkinson’s disease risk in older adults. Using Medicare data and ZIP+4 locations, researchers compared 221,789 people with Parkinson’s and over 1.1 million without it. Those in the highest outdoor TCE exposure group had a 10% higher risk than the lowest group after adjustments. The study shows an association, not causation, and identifies hot spots, especially in the Rust Belt. Limitations include focusing only on Medicare-aged individuals and using 2002 outdoor air estimates.

This study examined primary school teachers’ perspectives on the participation of primary school students with disabilities in inclusive education in virtual education during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a qualitative phenomenology design, the study was conducted with 10 general education primary school teachers in two provinces in the Marmara region. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews and analyzed by content analysis. Findings showed that some students with disabilities participated in virtual classes at a high rate with parental support, while others could not attend regularly due to family illiteracy, internet or device problems, health recommendations, low motivation, or limited participation. Teachers reported problems including difficulty following lessons and homework, low interaction, reluctance to watch EBA TV, crowded classrooms, limited communication with parents, and insufficient time for students with disabilities. Some teachers reported no problems when parents followed students and EBA tracking features were used. Suggested solutions included family-teacher cooperation, device and internet support, social activities, keeping schools open, using EBA support points, and coordinating with rehabilitation centers.

This study analyses the Omicron BA.1 wave in England from November 2021 to January 2022 using 48,615 English Omicron BA.1 genomes, global genomes, and epidemiological and human mobility data. It identifies at least 6,455 independent introductions, with the earliest estimated between 5 and 18 November 2021. Most importations were singletons, and importations increased exponentially before plateauing in early January 2022 despite travel restrictions on southern African countries. During restriction weeks, the average weekly estimated importation intensity from the US was about four times that from South Africa. Early importations before 15 December accounted for about 6% of introductions but about 80% of reported BA.1 infections up to the end of January 2022. The eight largest transmission lineages comprised over 60% of English genomes, with timing of introduction as the main determinant of lineage size. Greater London played a central role in initial spatial expansion, followed by later spread involving the Midlands and northern England. Mobility analysis found that trips between “home” and “hub” local authorities decreased by 11.97% for every unit increase in weekly COVID-19 cases per 100 people at the hub, with distance modifying the effect. BA.2 later replaced BA.1 as the dominant lineage. Limitations include possible underestimation of introductions and residual sampling bias.

The TLV321/2x comparator family consumes 40 µA per channel with 40 ns propagation delay. TLV321x has a push-pull output; TLV322x has an open-drain output that can be pulled up to 5.5 V independent of comparator supply. Input voltage range extends 200 mV below V– to 200 mV above V+, with ESD clamps to V+; input current should be limited to 10 mA or less. Unused channel inputs must not be tied together; they should be tied within the specified input range with at least 50 mV differential. The family contains 1.8 mV internal hysteresis. Outputs must be treated as high-speed digital devices with proper PCB layout. Push-pull outputs sink and source, must not be connected to another output, and unused ones must float. Open-drain outputs sink only, support logic OR’ing and level translation, recommend pull-up current between 100 µA and 1 mA, and unused ones may float or tie to V–. Direct output shorts can cause thermal runaway, so current-limiting resistors are recommended. ESD protection exists on inputs and outputs. POR holds output low during start-up for up to 32 µs after VPOR of 1.65 V is crossed. Comparator operation compares VIN to VREF; overdrive affects propagation delay. External hysteresis can be added using positive feedback in inverting or non-inverting configurations. Low-side current sensing is a typical application, with supply bypassing and layout precautions recommended. The document also includes support resources, revision history, packaging, and legal information.

NVIDIA GA10x/Ampere architecture includes GA102, GA104, RTX 30-series, A40, and RTX A6000 details. GA102 has 168 FP64 units, with FP64 TFLOP rate at 1/64 FP32. Each GA10x SM contains 128 CUDA Cores, four third-generation Tensor Cores, a 256 KB register file, four Texture Units, one second-generation Ray Tracing Core, and 128 KB L1/shared memory. GA102 memory subsystem uses twelve 32-bit controllers (384-bit total), with 512 KB L2 per controller and 6144 KB total L2. ROPs are now part of the GPC; full GA102 has 112 ROPs versus 96 in TU102, improving multisample anti-aliasing, pixel fillrate, and blending.

The GA10x SM is partitioned into four processing blocks, each with a 64 KB register file, L0 instruction cache, warp scheduler, dispatch unit, and math units, sharing 128 KB L1 data cache/shared memory. It has one third-generation Tensor Core per partition, four total, each twice as powerful as a Turing Tensor Core. L1/shared capacity is 33% larger than Turing; graphics cache partition is doubled. FP32 is supported on both datapaths, doubling peak FP32. Each partition can execute 32 FP32 operations per clock or 16 FP32 and 16 INT32; all four can execute 128 FP32 per clock or 64 FP32 and 64 INT32. FP16 double-speed is supported, and standard FP16 is handled by Tensor Cores. The unified shared memory/L1/texture cache is reconfigurable; L1 is 128 KB per SM. Full GA102 has 10752 KB L1; shared memory bandwidth is 128 bytes/clock per SM versus 64 in Turing. RTX 3080 L1 bandwidth is 219 GB/sec versus 116 GB/sec for RTX 2080. Ampere is up to 1.9x more power efficient than Turing at the same performance.

Second-generation RT Cores include BVH traversal and ray-triangle intersection testing and double the ray/triangle intersection rate over Turing. RTX 3080 is up to 2x faster in ray tracing than RTX 2080 Super. Async Compute allows concurrent RT Core and graphics, RT Core and compute, or two compute workloads, with assignable priorities. RTX 3080 renders a Wolfenstein: Youngblood frame in 6.7 ms (150 FPS) using 2x FP32, L1 cache, second-generation RT Cores, third-generation Tensor Cores, GDDR6X, and new concurrency features. GA10x RT Core adds an Interpolate Triangle Position unit for ray-traced motion blur, up to 8x faster than Turing; measured up to 5x faster motion blur with RTX 3080 versus RTX 2080 Super in Blender Cycles 2.90.

Third-generation Tensor Cores accelerate more data types and add Sparsity for up to 2x matrix multiplication versus Turing. They support TF32 and BF16; GA10x GPUs do not include Tensor Core acceleration for FP64. FP16/BF16 provide 4x FP32 throughput; TF32 provides 2x FP32. Fine-Grained Structured Sparsity uses a 2:4 pattern, compresses weights, and doubles math throughput. RTX 3080 delivers 119 peak FP16 Tensor TFLOPS with FP16 accumulate, 238 with Sparsity; 238 INT8 TOPS and 476 INT4 TOPS, doubled with Sparsity. DLSS uses Tensor Cores; Ampere adds 9x Super Resolution scaling, enabling 8K gaming at 60 fps.

Memory uses GDDR6X with PAM4 signaling, MTA encoding, up to 19.5 Gbps, and 936 GB/sec peak bandwidth, over 52% improvement versus TU102 in RTX 2080 Ti. RTX IO with Microsoft DirectStorage enables GPU-based lossless decompression, up to 100x I/O performance versus hard drives and traditional APIs, offloading CPU cores.

A40 is a GA10x-based data center GPU for visual computing; versus Quadro RTX 6000 it delivers up to 2x FP32, 2x ray tracing, and 5x (10x with Sparsity) AI training/data science throughput, with PCIe Gen4 up to 2x bandwidth and 48GB scalable to 96GB via NVLink. It supports vGPU, Quadro Sync, and EGX. Display supports 4K 120Hz and 8K 60Hz, DisplayPort 1.4a, DSC 1.2a, HDMI 2.1, and HDCP 2.3/1.x. Fifth-generation NVDEC decodes MPEG-2, VC-1, H.264, H.265, VP8, VP9, and AV1; GA10x is the first GPU to support AV1 hardware decode, up to 8K60 HDR with low CPU usage. Seventh-generation NVENC supports hardware encoding up to 4K H.264 and 8K HEVC.

RTX 3090 has 82 SMs, 10496 CUDA Cores, and 24GB GDDR6X. RTX 3070 uses GA104 and GDDR6. EDR detects GDDR6X transmission errors and replays transactions. RTX A6000 includes GA102, 10,752 CUDA Cores, 48GB GDDR6, and NVLink support for 96GB combined memory.

The passage recommends a book by Barrett, who argues that originalism is the correct method of constitutional interpretation because the Constitution’s enacted text is binding law and should be read according to the meaning of the language the lawmakers employed. Accepting that premise for discussion, the author considers a Supreme Court case involving Louisiana’s second majority-Black congressional district, created to avoid a Voting Rights Act violation. The challengers rely on a racial-predominance doctrine that invalidates districts where race predominates unless strict scrutiny is satisfied. The author argues this doctrine lacks support in the original public meaning of the Fourteenth Amendment and cannot be justified under the Fifteenth Amendment because it does not involve vote dilution or denial or abridgment of the right to vote. Even under originalism, precedent and stare decisis matter, but the author says tension with Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act makes the racial-predominance doctrine unworkable or inconsistent, so a good originalist would reconsider and jettison it, preserving Congress’s power to make vote dilution claims actionable under the 1982 Section 2 amendment unless Congress legislates otherwise. The author hopes Barrett will deliberate on the case with intellectual honesty.

The United States advanced to the Davis Cup quarterfinals by beating Serbia 3-0, with Ryan Harrison and Steve Johnson winning the doubles after singles wins by Sam Querrey and John Isner. Switzerland, without Roger Federer, lost 3-0 to Kazakhstan. Belgium failed to clinch against Hungary after losing a four-hour doubles; David Goffin was favored in reverse singles. TI provides technical, reliability, design, application, web, safety, and other resources “as is,” disclaims warranties, and limits their use to skilled developers designing with TI products. The Investors Intelligence Sentiment Index, also called Advisor Sentiment, surveys over 100 independent market newsletters and assesses authors as bullish, bearish, or expecting a correction. It produces weekly bullish, bearish, and correction percentages, plus stocks above 10-week and 30-week moving averages. Created by AW Cohen in 1963, it was initially intended to recommend when to be long when most advisors were bullish, but because advisors were often wrong at turning points, it became a contrarian indicator. Bullish readings over 55% are considered too optimistic and potentially negative; readings below 35% too pessimistic and positive. Weekly readings above 70% suggest overbought, below 30% oversold. AAII surveys individual investors since 1987; Investors Intelligence focuses on advisors and commentators. Chartcraft publishes it.

Police are reviewing video of a white officer punching a 25-year-old black man during a traffic-stop struggle; the officer is on paid leave, the NAACP seeks a federal investigation, and the man was released after posting bond.

Department of Education employees’ automatic out-of-office email replies were altered without their consent to partisan language blaming Senate Democrats for the government shutdown, sources told WIRED. Some employees changed them back to neutral language, only for the partisan response to be restored. It is unclear who made the changes. DOE human resources had provided neutral suggested language, while other agencies, including the Department of Labor, received suggested language blaming Democrats, according to sources and screenshots. Anonymous DOE employees said the Department unilaterally changed messages without staff knowledge or consent. Experts alleged the partisan language could violate the Hatch Act, which can result in fines or job loss. A professor called it coercive and invasive. The DOE press line returned the same partisan out-of-office message.

The policy brief argues that the “out-of-school children” (OOSC) indicator is inadequate because it focuses solely on formal school enrollment and overlooks formal, informal, and non-formal educational pathways, as well as broader geopolitical, cultural, and social factors driving exclusion. Using Afghanistan as a case study, it advocates replacing OOSC with an “out-of-education children” (OOEC) indicator. The brief describes Afghanistan’s education landscape, including historical conflicts, madrasas, community-based education, online learning, absenteeism, ghost schools, and barriers such as geographic disparities, nomadic lifestyles, child labor, and disabilities. It states that OOSC privileges formal schooling, delegitimizes alternatives, and fails to capture complex exclusion. The OOEC indicator is presented as broadening understanding, catalyzing education-system transformation, and reimagining education as an interconnected ecosystem. The brief concludes that shifting to OOEC requires changes in data systems, credentialing, collaboration, and resource allocation to support inclusive, equitable, high-quality education for all children and realize SDG 4.

SFS is an AMD firmware feature for developing and distributing fixes for selected high-priority system issues. Datacenter operators can apply SFS patches without rebooting. AMD distributes fixes in Seamless Firmware Servicing Update Packages. Applying an SFS package can change the SFS Patch Level (SFSPL), individual firmware and Security Patch Level (SPL) versions, and the System Patch Level (SYSPL). SFSPL and SYSPL increase monotonically, and some patch functionality may be reverted in later patches. SFS verifies that updates apply to the correct existing firmware and operational state. AMD cryptographically signs each package, and customers can optionally co-sign by providing a public key to the ASP during early boot; the ASP verifies AMD and customer signatures before applying updates. SFS updates occur at runtime, must be reapplied after reboot, and in multi-socket systems are communicated to the first socket’s ASP. BIOS options for SFS enablement and required co-signing are off by default. SFS packages are non-persistent, may patch registers, firmware images, or portions of firmware, and require proper versions and dependencies. SFS provides version information to the host OS and includes attestation, resiliency, and SEV/SNP considerations.
Appeal from conviction for third-degree criminal possession of a weapon upon guilty plea; judgment affirmed. Counsel's Anders withdrawal granted; pro se issues precluded by valid appeal waiver.

The passage sets out rules for passport applications. Applicants must swear allegiance to the U.S. Government and provide a personal description including age, stature, forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, chin, hair, complexion, and face, plus a credible witness certificate. Additional requirements apply to native citizens, persons born abroad to a native citizen father, naturalized citizens, women, children of naturalized citizens, and residents of U.S. insular possessions. Passports expire two years from issuance; new applications are required. A passport may cover a wife, minor children, or servant; others need separate passports. Professional titles are not inserted. Insular executives may reject applications for unlawful or improper purpose or noncompliance. Theodore Roosevelt, Oyster Bay, July 19, 1902. Fees are listed.

Archaeologists in Mexico will excavate a Maya-sealed tunnel thought to lead beneath a pyramid to a hidden cenote. The Great Mayan Aquifer Project, led by Guillermo de Anda, plans to clear tunnels near the Ossuary to find an entrance to the cenote under El Castillo at Chichen Itza. Cenotes supplied fresh water and were central to Maya cosmology as entrances to the underworld, where offerings and human sacrifices were made to deities such as Chac. El Castillo has 365 steps and four visible cenotes; a hidden cenote was detected beneath it. De Anda says excavation may take three months and could reveal a fifth direction, the axis mundi. His earlier analysis found about 80 percent of sacrificed individuals in the Sacred Cenote were children aged 3–11, many in poor health. More research is needed.
Lab tests suggest jostling air and methane microbubbles create tiny lightning zaps, possibly sparking swamp will-o’-the-wisps, whose ignition was mysterious.

The European Union’s Global Gateway plan is funding clean energy and electrification in Africa, aiming to expand electricity access and move the continent off fossil fuels while offering an alternative to China’s Belt and Road Initiative. Nearly 600 million Africans lack electricity. EU-funded projects include a high-voltage transmission line in Côte d’Ivoire, rural electrification in Cameroon, wind and hydro energy in Lesotho, and mini-grids in Madagascar. The EU estimates the program could create 38 million green jobs by 2030. China has invested heavily in BRI infrastructure and African clean energy and critical minerals. The US also pursued infrastructure programs including PGI, and the West is pursuing the Lobito railway. Africa is described as a battleground over resources, and its decarbonization is called essential to net zero.
