Changing lifestyles and hectic schedules are shifting food habits toward convenient snacks, including cheese snacks. Altered taste preferences and westernization are also cited as reasons for rising global cheese snack consumption. The global cheese snacks market is expected to rise at a CAGR of 5.2% from 2017 to 2025. Savory cheese snacks and frozen/processed cheese are popular, baked products are gaining prominence, and companies are focusing on taste and quality.

Soumya Swaminathan, a pediatrician and current ICMR Director General, will become the first Indian Deputy Director General (programmes) at WHO in Geneva in late November. She says her goals will align with the WHO Director General’s priorities, including universal health coverage, epidemics, non-communicable diseases, and access to diagnostics and drugs. She notes India’s UHC commitment and heterogeneity in infant mortality rates, and stresses preventive and promotive healthcare through health and wellness centres. Her father, M S Swaminathan, says international exposure provides perspective and learning.

The passage outlines general analysis considerations and sections for a statistical analysis plan. It specifies TLF reporting with ICH numbering, two-sided testing at 0.05 unless otherwise noted, summaries for continuous and categorical variables, and use of SAS 9.4+ and Phoenix WinNonlin 6.4+. Treatment groups are dasiglucagon, GlucaGen, and placebo; analysis sets are safety analysis set, FAS, and PPS. Primary endpoint analysis uses FAS, secondary uses PPS, and safety uses the safety set. The primary efficacy endpoint is time to plasma glucose recovery ≥20 mg/dL within 45 minutes without rescue IV glucose; secondary endpoints include recovery within 10, 15, 20, and 30 minutes and plasma glucose changes. Missing data are analyzed only as non-missing, with no imputation, and no interim analyses are planned. Hierarchical testing applies to dasiglucagon versus placebo for primary and secondary endpoints; GlucaGen versus placebo is not included. The passage also covers demographic/baseline characteristics, concomitant medications, PK/PD analyses, safety analyses including TEAEs, labs, ECG, vital signs, immunogenicity, changes to protocol-specified analyses, and appendices for presentation, QC, and TLFs.

Goldman Sachs analysis found the share of 22- to 27-year-olds without college degrees who are working or seeking work has declined, with a sharper drop than for degree holders. Dallas Fed data show disconnected 18- to 24-year-olds trended upward, reaching about 12% in May, higher than any year from 1989 to 2009. Experts cite economic, cultural, and psychological factors. Some non-degree youth can find work but choose not to seek available jobs, citing cultural bias against non-degree jobs, family-sustaining earnings concentrated among degree holders, mental health challenges, family support, and possible uncounted gig work. Proposed responses include practical work-experience education and reducing stigma around non-degree jobs. Experts see hope for younger people but say helping those already 25 or 30 is harder.

The SPREAD offense is a 3-2 no-post motion offense requiring all five players to pass and handle, with continuity based on basic cuts and reading defensive overplays. The passage details cuts after passes, clearing to corners, back-cut counters when overplayed, triple-threat dribble penetration with kick-out passes, and back-door options from left or right side entries.

Das Acevedo argues that politicians implementing checks on tenure are solving a problem that “didn’t need fixing in the first place,” amid an erosion of tenure protections developed over two decades of state legislation and university policies. At least five tenured faculty were terminated or put on leave over social media comments after Charlie Kirk’s killing. Her book responds to the war on tenure by providing vocabulary and a framework. It says tenure’s main justifications are employment security as in-kind compensation and protection of academic freedom. Critics claim tenure de-incentivizes work or protects bad actors, but the passage says empirical data do not support the productivity stereotype, and just-cause employment still permits firing for cause. Recent dismissals with little due process show tenure’s processes depend on universities’ willingness to follow them.

Research from Ben-Gurion University found that using smileys in work-related emails does not increase perceived warmth and decreases perceived competence. Participants responding to formal emails without smileys gave more detailed, content-related information. Unlike smiling photographs, smileys did not improve friendliness. When sender gender was unknown, smileys led people to assume the sender was a woman. Researchers advise avoiding smileys in initial interactions.

The paper describes the qualitative component of a quality improvement project on regional teaching for Stage 1 anaesthetic trainees in a deanery. It used qualitative methods and thematic analysis, with semi-structured focus groups involving six trainees and eight trainers. Participants described Stage 1 training as complicated by a new curriculum, an extra year, high demands including the primary FRCA, and heterogeneous trainee needs. Barriers to regional teaching included variation and silos across hospitals, fairness concerns, competition, differing teaching compensation, limited time, and logistical issues such as location, group dynamics, rota, funding, and quality control. Some expressed wariness. Motivators included more exam-focused and broader teaching, developing educators, fairness, easier organisation for smaller hospitals, and social networking. All trainees interviewed thought a good programme would be an asset, and trainers supported developing one and were willing to collaborate. The discussion states trainers and trainees favoured a regional programme, but teaching is undervalued, trainers and trainees are poorly compensated, and tools such as the GMC survey lack sufficient detail. Qualitative methods helped QIP planning. Limitations included a small trainee sample and possible interviewer bias. A well-executed regional programme may solve some problems but requires engagement and investment.

This study performed a GWAS of neonatal jaundice in 27,384 Norwegian newborns, including 1,826 cases requiring phototherapy, with replication in two Danish cohorts. Two loci reached genome-wide significance: UGT1A* and CHRDL1. At UGT1A*, the lead variant was in nearly perfect LD with a UGT1A4 missense variant, rs6755571, associated with a five-fold lower risk of neonatal jaundice and replicated. Colocalization suggested association with UGT1A1 expression in colon, not liver. The X-chromosome CHRDL1 locus was also replicated. Parental transmitted and non-transmitted allele analyses indicated neonate-only effects at UGT1A* and the X locus. A maternal GWAS identified signals at UGT1A*, the X locus, and the ABO gene region; the ABO association was explained by maternal-fetal ABO blood group incompatibility. Neonatal jaundice genetics differed from adult bilirubin levels: the adult UGT1A* lead and SLCO1B1 were not associated with neonatal jaundice, and an adult bilirubin polygenic score’s effect was close to null after excluding chromosome 2. The passage states these findings suggest context-specific mechanisms in neonatal bilirubin clearance.

Larry O’Neal, 44, a U.S. Border Patrol agent in Houlton, was indicted on a felony child pornography possession charge. He pleaded not guilty. Investigators traced a downloaded file to his home, arrested him, and found child and adult pornography on a computer and external drive. He was released on bail and faces trial proceedings June 6; if convicted, up to 10 years and $250,000 fine and sex offender registration.

The passage describes hard-sided, collapsible shelters or campers transitionable between expanded and collapsed configurations. They may include a roof section, folding or multi-fold side wall panels, front and rear wall panels, and a floor section. In the expanded configuration, the panels are vertical and form a rigid, weather-tight, lockable enclosure; in the collapsed configuration, the panels fold and are enclosed to form a compact, portable case. The shelters may be transported using vehicles or by people, mounted on roof racks, placed in truck beds, towed on trailers, or attached to wheels. They may include a mattress or bed system, kitchenette, bathroom fixtures, seating, climate control, electronics, plumbing, solar panels, and batteries. Methods include transporting the collapsed shelter, unfolding side wall panels to expand it, and folding panels to collapse it. Dimensions, materials, sealing, latching, and transition mechanisms are also described.

Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated January 26, 2016, reporting that it issued a press release, data sheet, and supplemental materials regarding its financial results for the first fiscal quarter ended December 26, 2015. The documents were attached as Exhibits 99.1, 99.2, and 99.3.

The passage discusses pivot point trading strategies. It defines pivot points as the average of the previous trading day’s high, low, and close, from which support and resistance levels are derived. It says pivot points were invented by floor traders. Lewis Borsellino reportedly used them daily but gave no details. The article presents six backtested strategies tested from 2010 on 1-minute ES, NQ, RTY, and USD/CHF data. It finds none consistently tradeable in those markets and concludes pivot points are hyped and create noise, though some day-trading ideas may warrant further research. Pros listed are ease, objectivity, quantifiability, versatility, and support/resistance confirmation; cons are lagging price and low win ratio.

An RWE executive said RWE Supply & Trading may double or triple its 2017 LNG derivatives volume of 1.5 million tonnes this year to manage price risk for physical cargoes, as Asian demand fragments and pricing may shift from oil-linked. RWE traded 6 million tonnes of physical LNG last year and 7-10 JKM-indexed cargoes this year. JKM swaps quadrupled in 2017 to 50,266 lots.

The lecture delays the next problem set and recaps the number four-vector, defined from rest number density and four-velocity, with covariant conservation expressed as its spacetime divergence equaling zero. It introduces the stress-energy tensor for dust, starting from rest energy density and showing energy density in a moving frame is not a scalar or four-vector component. For dust, the tensor is the tensor product of the four-velocity with itself times rest density, written in index notation as rest density times u^α u^β. Its components are interpreted as energy density, energy flux, momentum density, and momentum flux, with energy flux and momentum density equal when c=1. The tensor is symmetric, motivated by avoiding a net torque and angular acceleration for a small cube. A perfect fluid has no energy flow in its rest frame and no lateral stresses or viscosity; in that frame its tensor is diagonal with energy density and pressure, and a covariant form uses the projection tensor/metric. Dust is a perfect fluid with no pressure. Conservation is given by the spacetime divergence of the stress-energy tensor equaling zero, splitting into energy and momentum conservation in a chosen frame, with integral forms. Point-particle and electromagnetic examples are discussed, including delta functions for a particle and electric/magnetic energy density, Poynting vector, and anisotropic stresses. Newtonian gravity uses energy density, but relativistic gravity must use the whole stress-energy tensor. The lecture then begins a prelude to curvature, using flat spacetime in curvilinear coordinates such as polar coordinates, with a coordinate basis whose basis vectors are not constant or normalized, and notes the metric will have a nontrivial functional form.

Kenneth Hobbs unveiled the second panel of Lawton High School’s 22-foot Wolverine mural in the cafeteria. Funded by the class of 2014, it matches a 2010 first panel funded by the class of 2006. The murals depict school buildings, championship timelines, and teams.

The passage begins with Mike Kimel’s observation that much education research is poor, then quotes an article reporting that racial-, ethnic-, and language-minority schoolchildren have been reported as overidentified as disabled and overrepresented in special education, prompting allegations of bias and federal policies to reduce minority disproportionate representation. The quoted paper’s models, before and after covariate adjustment, find no evidence of such overidentification. Instead, after adjusting for family SES, academic achievement, and behavioral functioning, racial and ethnic minorities are generally less likely than otherwise similar White children to be identified with disabilities, and language minorities are less likely than English-speaking peers to be identified with learning disabilities or speech/language impairments. Other factors, including health insurance, achievement, self-regulation, and externalizing behaviors, are associated with disability identification. The paper concludes that minority children are comparatively underrepresented in special education, contrary to federal efforts. Kimel asks who loses most when such a child is mainstreamed.

The speaker disagrees with Curtis, saying shutting them down requires limiting their puck time and keeping play out of their end. They are unsure about Brett’s status and describe Mike and Joe Nieuwendyk as difficult to contain.

Mental health care services are available in more than 80% of Minnesota’s public school districts, while nonprofit programs also provide unique support in schools. Know the Truth, an independent offshoot of Minnesota Adult and Teen Challenge, began in 2006 as a prevention program and later expanded to peer recovery services. Youth peer support specialist Tiffany White, four years sober, discusses addiction and recovery with students, provides individual and group support, and uses a harm-reduction approach; her contract at Hastings High School was eliminated due to federal funding cuts. St. Paul-based Restoration for All supports African immigrant and refugee youth, offers school staff workshops on cultural understanding and trauma, and provides mental health screening, therapy, suicidal monitoring, peer support, and culturally grounded practices through grants, including a four-year, $400,000 MDH award.

South Korea’s spy agency suspects two female North Korean agents assassinated Kim Jong Nam, the estranged half-brother of Kim Jong Un, in Malaysia, lawmakers said. U.S. sources believed North Korean assassins murdered him, and South Korean intelligence believed he was poisoned. Lawmakers said Kim Jong Un had a standing order for the assassination and there was a failed 2012 attempt. Malaysian police said the 46-year-old held a passport under the name Kim Chol, and an autopsy was underway. A police source said CCTV showed a woman was involved. South Korea’s Unification Ministry said the murder was confirmed; TV Chosun reported two suspected North Korean women poisoned him with a needle and fled by taxi. North Korea’s embassy declined comment.

An AP report describes a Salvadoran woman deported from Texas to El Salvador after she and her partner fled gang violence, hoping to reach her only surviving child in Houston. She had lost two children in El Salvador and feared her family would be wiped out. They were captured about an hour after crossing into Texas, and she was flown back with about 100 other migrants. The article says thousands fleeing ultraviolent gangs in El Salvador, Honduras and Guatemala have been caught near the U.S. border and returned under the Trump administration’s zero-tolerance policy. Although Trump tweeted that illegal immigrants “infest” the U.S. like MS-13, statistics cited show only 0.09 percent of Border Patrol detentions in fiscal 2017 involved Central American gangs. The report describes pervasive gang control, extortion, killings, forced sex slavery, mass graves, and abuses by police and soldiers. It says many deportees try to immigrate again, and the woman, whose partner remained detained, did not know if she would.

A Thames Centre councillor wants the Thames Valley District School Board to adopt a defibrillator policy. After a West Nissouri student fundraised for an AED following a local child’s soccer death, the board declined installation, citing a meeting on a board-approved device and training; the board declined comment.
Belcher v. Kitsap County: appeal from Kitsap County Superior Court judgment was affirmed; opinion now published.

Adrienne Motley passed Octavia Blue for No. 7 on Miami’s all-time scoring list as No. 16 Miami beat Clemson 81-57. Jessica Thomas reached 1,200 career points. Miami led for over 36 minutes, held a 48-30 halftime lead and a 65-34 advantage after three quarters. Motley scored 15, Thomas 18 and Laura Cornelius 14. The game also celebrated Miami’s women’s athletic program and Play4Kay. Miami (19-6, 8-5 ACC) next travels to No. 14 Duke.

The passage is a forwarded Dallas Morning News “Inside UT Football” newsletter dated Oct. 12, 2000. It contains Chip Brown’s Q&A on Texas football, covering the upcoming Colorado game as do-or-die for the Big 12 title, Colorado’s six-game winning streak over Texas, and Gary Barnett’s comments. It reports Mack Brown named Major Applewhite the starter for Colorado, with Chris Simms used only on a “need-to-win” basis; B.J. Johnson and Roy Williams were promoted to starting receiver spots, and Kenny Hayter was expected to get more carries. Reader questions and answers also address coaching, play-calling, offensive leadership, recruiting, player roles, the Missouri game time, and the quarterback rotation’s end for that week.

Law Office of Peter D. Baron renewed 2,510 sq ft at 532 Broadhollow Rd., Melville. Jersey Mike’s Subs, Hand and Stone Massage, and Fortunoff Bedding leased 2,250, 3,000, and 4,500 sq ft at Plaza 200, Carle Place. Hartford Fire Insurance and Hollander Legal Group leased 3,148 and 2,594 sq ft at 105 Maxess Rd., Melville. SCH Sheet Metal leased 11,500 sq ft at 100 Raynor Ave., Ronkonkoma. Marbai Profit Sharing bought 100 North Country Rd., Miller Place, for $850,000.

Stocks rebounded Wednesday, led by banks, energy companies, and smaller companies, as investors hoped Italy would avoid new elections. Major indexes rose; for the week and year, the Nasdaq and Russell 2000 gained, while the Dow was down.

A Valencia man, Travis Phippen, who was shot and wounded, and whose father John Phippen was killed in the Las Vegas mass shooting Sunday, filed a lawsuit against gunman Stephen Paddock’s estate. The suit seeks possession, management, control, and preservation of the estate’s assets, safe deposit boxes, property, and receivables. At least 59 people were killed and 527 wounded; three wounded SCV residents remained hospitalized.

Alexandr Wang advises 13-year-olds to spend all their time vibe-coding—using AI to generate and refine software through natural-language prompts and unstructured tinkering. He says 10,000 hours with AI coding tools can create a major advantage, likening it to early PC users such as Bill Gates and Mark Zuckerberg. Wang, 28, founded Scale AI, became the youngest self-made billionaire at 25, and now leads Meta’s AI superintelligence team as chief AI officer.

A petition to save Gresford Health Centre has attracted more than 600 signatures after Alyn Family Doctors proposed closing the branch and amalgamating patients with its Llay and Rossett surgeries, citing insufficient manpower. The practice has written to BCUHB to consider the proposal. Patients fear travel and appointment pressures, including from proposed housing. BCUHB says it is supporting the practice and patients can provide feedback.

During a penalty kick awarded in normal play, the defending team must prepare for the kick to be live once the ball is kicked. Under Law 14, all players other than the kicker and goalkeeper must be at least 10 yards from the penalty mark, behind the mark, inside the field, and outside the penalty area. Defenders must position themselves immediately to challenge attackers for rebounds and wait until the ball is touched and clearly moves forward before entering the area or arc. They must follow up saved, blocked, or rebounded kicks, clear the ball safely, and then transition to attack. Early entry by a defender leads to a score if a goal is scored or a retaken kick if not. Defenders must also be aware of a rare “tap” penalty kick and practice these situations.

The passage describes a gaming machine, control method, and program. The gaming machine includes a display, speaker, storage device, and controller. The storage device stores tempo data including beat information for the entire BGM and BGM sound data. The controller starts displaying the game progression while outputting the BGM, determines a timing at which an event is displayed based on the BGM tempo data, dynamically configures animation data so the event is displayed at that timing, and causes the display to show the configured animation. The passage states that this synchronizes the event display timing with the beat of the BGM. Embodiments include determining timing based on a player operation and tempo data, randomly determining event content, outputting event sound at the determined timing, using rhythm pattern data for multiple events, and applying the technique to a slot game with reels, symbols, winning determination, reel spin/stop animations, and illumination. The passage also describes control methods and program instructions for these operations, and states that prior gaming machines did not consider the timing at which an event is displayed on the display, causing possible discomfort.

The speaker is deeply affected by the confidence shown in calling him to high office, recognizes the importance of the trust, is conscious of his deficiencies, and will not shrink from responsibility. Following his predecessors, he will explain the principles of his Administration and examine the causes of the United States’ happy condition. Since the Revolution and the establishment of the Constitution, the Government has been self-government, and the country has flourished. Under the Constitution, commerce has been regulated, new States admitted, territory enlarged by treaty, States protected and improved, and individuals have enjoyed rights and blessings, with no capital punishment for high treason. Experience has shown the Government equal to foreign conflicts and war. The speaker urges cherishing the Union and Government and preserving the people’s intelligence and virtue. He warns of dangers from abroad, including war and risks to commerce, navigation, and fisheries, and calls for fortifications, moderate but adequate Army and Navy, and a well-organized militia. He recommends internal improvements by roads and canals with constitutional sanction, fostering manufacturers, and friendly relations with Indian tribes while extending to them the advantages of civilization. Revenue, the Treasury, and vacant lands can meet needs and discharge the national debt. The Executive disburses public money and is responsible for faithful application; the Legislature guards the public purse; economy and regular examination should be secured. He welcomes peace and harmony, desires to preserve peace on just principles with all nations, and aims to promote union and the country’s best interests. He will learn from predecessors, wishes his immediate predecessor well in retirement, relies on other departments, and prays for continued protection.

This qualitative study used an interpretive phenomenological approach to explore IDD stakeholders’ opinions on mNGS utility for developing routine clinical genomic diagnostics. Ten participants were purposively recruited; semi-structured interviews were conducted, transcribed, and thematically analysed. Five themes were identified: diagnostic choice, infrastructure, open data sharing, COVID-19, and communication. Findings showed mNGS was viewed as part of a diagnostic toolkit, not one-size-fits-all, with cost and speed affecting use. Infrastructure barriers included facilities, training and workforce, accreditation and standardisation, and data digitalisation. Open data sharing raised privacy versus surveillance benefits. COVID-19 served as proof of concept and helped build capacity. Communication within and between hospitals and with public and commercial sectors was seen as important. Barriers and facilitators were interrelated, and impact varied by location and funding. The study concluded it filled a literature gap, identified cost, speed, and infrastructure as key drivers for new diagnostics, and suggested COVID-19 demonstrates metagenomics utility for public health and IDD innovation.

The 2025 Nobel Prize in chemistry was awarded to Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar Yaghi for work on metal-organic frameworks. These porous molecular structures can store gases and other chemicals, collect water from air, capture greenhouse gases, and extract forever chemicals. Robson found in the late 1980s that combining copper ions with organic compounds produced a hole-filled crystalline structure. Kitagawa and Yaghi later developed MOFs; Yaghi created an exceptionally porous material in 1999. They share 11 million Swedish kronor. Yaghi heard the news at an airport and credited the U.S. public school system for his success.

NHS workers recreated a historic 1927 photograph found in a broom cupboard to mark the health service's 70th anniversary. Fourteen staff at Sandwell and West Birmingham Hospitals NHS Trust recreated it nearly 90 years later. The recovered images will be displayed at Sandwell Hospital tomorrow during a tea party.

Andrew Lo first discusses an in-class auction of two wrapped packages. The smaller package, an iPod, sold for $45; the larger package, a recently published hedge fund book, sold for $60, though the book retailed for $45. Lo says this illustrates that limited information affects valuation, noting the iPod sold at about a 70% discount.

He then addresses current events: the federal government took over Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, government-sponsored entities that were private organizations with ambiguous government backing. Their purpose was to purchase mortgages and other obligations to provide a secondary market and make credit more available. After the housing market turned down, they could not stand on their own, and the Treasury said it would stand by their claims. Lo discusses concerns about inflation, taxpayer cost, intergenerational burden, shareholders losing most capital, and counterparties’ paper being backed by the U.S. government. He also comments on too-big-to-fail issues and possible restructuring.

The lecture then introduces present value relations. An asset is defined as a sequence of current and future cashflows, excluding past cashflows; cashflows may be positive, negative, or zero. A value operator V_t takes a sequence of cashflows and returns a value, with the market as one example. Cashflows at different dates are treated like different currencies, requiring exchange rates or discount factors to convert them to date-0 dollars. These rates come from the market. Discounting reflects impatience, inflation, and supply and demand. The interest rate or opportunity cost of capital r expresses the exchange rates: present value is CF0 plus discounted future cashflows, future value is $1 times (1+r)^T, and discount factors are 1/(1+r)^t. The lecture assumes known cashflows, known exchange rates, and no frictions, and says annuity and perpetuity will be covered next.

This VentureWire issue dated Nov. 7, 2000 reports Broadcom’s acquisition of SiByte for up to $2 billion in stock; Alta Partners raising a fund targeting $275 million to $325 million; Furniture.com shutting down and laying off 76 of 88 workers; and eStellarNet raising $30 million in its first institutional round. It also lists numerous new funding rounds, bad-news items, new products, M&A, board and personnel changes, VC fund news, and a correction.

In Puerto Cortés, Honduras, Sergio Romero visits the Avontuur, a 97-year-old two-masted sailing schooner. Unlike fuel-powered cargo ships, it traveled from Europe through the Caribbean using wind and a sparse crew, collecting and delivering small cargo.

This report examines Title IX staffing trends in higher education, noting that Title IX staff support federal compliance, safe and inclusive campuses, gender equity, and sexual misconduct issues. It describes Title IX regulations since 1972 and updates in 2020 and 2024 that expanded procedures for sexual harassment and assault, increasing the need for dedicated staff. Using CUPA-HR data from 2019-20 to 2023-24, the report analyzes placement, frequency, composition, and pay equity.

Most Title IX staff are in Human Resources (29%) or Student Affairs/Dean of Students/Student Services (28%), followed by Compliance (11%) and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (11%); fewer are in Legal Affairs, the President’s Office, Academic Affairs/Provost, or Business/Operations/University Affairs. Title IX positions include heads, deputy heads, and investigators. Institutions with at least one dedicated full-time Title IX position rose from one-third in 2019-20 to 43% in 2023-24; 56% still lack one. In 2023-24, 31% had a full-time head, 12% a deputy head, and 16% an investigator. Doctoral institutions were most likely to have Title IX positions (64%), followed by baccalaureate (45%), master’s (39%), and associate’s (19%). Total Title IX positions rose from 542 to 746, a 38% increase; deputy heads grew 58%, investigators 85%, and heads 7%. Most institutions (56%) have no dedicated full-time Title IX staff, 26% have one, and 17% have two or more; multiple staff are most common at doctoral institutions.

Women hold 77% of Title IX positions, compared with 62% of all professional positions. Black women make up 13% of Title IX staff versus 6% overall; Asian professionals hold 2% versus 6%. Median salaries are $96,714 for heads, $84,931 for deputy heads, and $75,000 for investigators, all above the $66,000 professional median. Women and people of color in Title IX positions are paid equitably compared to White men, with Black women at $1.16, Black men at $1.10, Hispanic or Latina women at $1.04, and White women at $1.03 per $1.00 paid to White men.

The report concludes that most staff are in HR or student affairs; many institutions lack dedicated full-time positions; integration into broader roles may limit compliance and contribute to burnout. It recommends reassessing Title IX officer responsibilities, increasing staffing where needed, assessing compliance methods based on legal and regulatory developments, and preparing for possible regulatory changes.
Effort was there, but the team didn't work as a unit; I was unhappy with last game. Talk is cheap, so we must act. Injuries may have helped others step up; others can step up again.

Berkshire Hathaway sold 10.6 million General Electric shares in the second quarter, a stake estimated at $315 million as of June 30. Berkshire received most of the shares in 2013 after lending GE about $3 billion in 2008, and the investment generated a profit of more than $1 billion including dividends. GE changed leaders in the same quarter, with Jeff Immelt handing the CEO role to John Flannery. Berkshire also sold most of its Walmart stake, bought Synchrony Financial shares, and added to Bank of New York Mellon and Apple. Other filings showed Appaloosa sold its SPDR S&P 500 ETF stake, Soros bought a PowerShares QQQ Trust stake, and Viking Global bought Wells Fargo shares.

Gary Allen Darnell, 45, of Cottage Hills, a convicted sex offender, was arrested Thursday after allegedly approaching children by the river and offering them fishing poles. He was charged with loitering within 500 feet of a park, a Class 4 felony.

His Majesty requests that the United States formally acknowledge his Kingdom as a sovereign and independent State, citing tacit recognition through consuls, commercial agents, and naval commanders, though similar European agreements lacked governmental sanction. He describes twenty-three years of change: a written language, government-supported schools, books including the Holy Scriptures, a limited representative monarchy, civil and criminal laws, an annual legislature, courts with jury trials, and foreign use of those courts. He argues that his government demands and renders what sovereign states do. He adds that his dominions are a center of the whale fishery, lie on the main route between western America and eastern Asia, and offer favorable vessel repairs and supplies.

The passage discusses the role of visual arts in early childhood education, including teachers’ views, teaching approaches, challenges, and a study of kindergarten teachers. It states that visual arts support children’s expression, communication, skills, self-esteem, imagination, creativity, social interaction, emotional expression, and intellectual development. The study explored kindergarten teachers’ views and experiences on teaching visual arts and the challenges and opportunities of integrating them into the pre-school curriculum.

The sample consisted of 65 kindergarten teachers in public or private kindergartens in the Municipality of Piraeus. Data were collected through an improvised questionnaire with 21 closed and open questions, analyzed with SPSS and thematic analysis. Most participants were women, aged mainly 23–42, held a four-year degree, had 1–5 years of experience, and had no specific visual arts training.

Results showed that most teachers considered visual arts crucial in early childhood education, believed toddlers respond well to art activities, and agreed that visual arts promote social interaction, emotional expression, social skills, creativity, and intellectual development. Teachers reported that visual arts are integrated into the current curriculum and that positive feedback encourages participation. Common teaching methods included the free approach, experimentation with means and tools, group teaching, and guided approach. The main challenge was managing children, followed by external factors such as lack of time and parental ignorance. Suggested solutions included patience, demonstration, rewards, roles, games, varied materials, cooperation, feedback, and flexibility.

The study concluded that demographic factors did not significantly affect teachers’ perceptions of visual arts. Teachers had a positive view of visual arts but faced resource limitations and classroom management problems. Professional development programs and resources such as art supplies, equipment, and dedicated art spaces were suggested. Limitations included the electronic administration of the questionnaire and the lack of in-depth qualitative understanding through semi-structured interviews.

A Spring ISD teacher at Dueitt Middle School is under investigation and on administrative leave after allegedly calling African American students “cotton pickers.” A parent reported the incident, and students confirmed hearing the slur. The teacher was removed and replaced by a substitute; the investigation is ongoing.

German Ambassador, returned from Berlin, stated Germany would confidentially state peace terms: give up Belgium while retaining certain travel rights on the Meuse; keep Holland, Denmark, and Belgium neutral/buffer states for England; France to retain all French coast land and remain independent; restore Russian territory; treat Serbia and Roumania properly; indemnify Belgium despite its neutral conduct. He said Germany learned from secret British sources that England’s maximum terms with allies were infeasible and minimum terms would cause allied disagreement, and that American pressure would lead England to confidentially state terms out of respect and fear of the President and respect for England’s growing peace party. The Greek Chargé communicated Greece’s answer to the U.S. peace proposal of January 8. Greece appreciated the President’s humane, politic step for honorable peace and international stability. Although neutral, Greece suffered occupation, blockade, and starvation, still sought neutrality, desired the President’s success, favored neutral contact, and was ready to join action for stable peace securing states’ rights, sovereignty, and independence, but was excluded from communication with one belligerent and awaited settlement with others.

This passage outlines SOS Side Screen/Roll Disruptions. “On Ball” switching covers above and below the free throw line: above uses an aggressive contact switch to deny quick jump shots and middle penetration; below uses an aggressive trap near base or corner checkpoints. It details below-free-throw-line scenarios when O5 sets a side screen and O3 is below the free throw line extended: hard double team, pass out of post trap, final matchups, skip pass out of trap, and pass out of trap to low post. Above the line, it describes contact switch, snuggle pass denial, smother, front positioning, and weakside I responsibilities. All-Out SOS disruption traps the point guard before any screen or pass; phases include double team trap and pass out of trap. Secondary trap after pass to O5 on base roll covers post trap and pass out of trap. Rotations occur as ball leaves passer’s hands.

Whitman Howard raised Produce Investments’ price target from GBX 210 to GBX 240, with a buy rating. Shore Capital and Numis also restated buy ratings; Numis set a GBX 286 target. Shares traded up 0.54% at GBX 187.00 on 10,000 shares. Produce Investments declared a GBX 5.03 dividend, a 2.75% yield, payable December 5th.

On November 18, 2022, Amazon.com, Inc. entered into a 364-day revolving credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent, and other lenders, providing an unsecured revolving credit facility of up to $10.0 billion. The initial interest rate is the Secured Overnight Financing Rate plus 0.45%, with a 0.05% commitment fee on the undrawn portion; borrowings are for general corporate purposes, including backstopping commercial paper notes. The agreement contains customary representations, warranties, covenants, and events of default, but no financial covenants.

Marines with Task-Force-Southwest practiced Instant-Eye drone technology at Camp Lejeune; 2nd Law Enforcement Battalion conducted grenade-assault training; the Marine Corps presented a Purple Heart to Lee Anderson.

Three female University of Dayton students reported a naked man entered their bedrooms early Wednesday in separate incidents on Woodland Ave., Frericks Way, and College Park. One said he tried to restrain her. University police are investigating.

The speaker expresses confidence in the country’s prosperity and expects the session to produce measures increasing national prosperity. He notes agricultural abundance and progress in agriculture, manufactures, commerce, and navigation, along with revived public and private confidence attributed to the Constitution and laws. He cites rapid subscription to the Bank of the United States and reports execution of last session’s laws. Western frontier defense and Indian relations are discussed: treaties and measures were used, offensive operations followed when measures failed, some expeditions succeeded, and peace overtures continue. He proposes impartial justice, regulated land alienation, promoted commerce, civilizing experiments, executive means, and penalties for treaty violations. He reports implementation of distilled spirits duties, some discontent, and possible revisions. He mentions the ten-mile-square government seat, a laid-out city, a Census near four million, a completed Dutch loan, and treaties with the Cherokees and Six Nations for ratification. He notes debt subscription results, adequate revenues, provision for current service, and objects including militia, post-office and post-roads, the Mint, weights and measures, and sale of vacant lands.

The speaker says Corey Perry is a young player with major junior success at London and Memorial Cup finals, and that playoff participation in Canadian cities was a learning/development opportunity for young players, including dealing with playoff distractions. Perry takes things in stride; he is effective down low, slippery, and has good hands. The speaker says he did not consider a session physical, describing regroups, shooting drills, and two-on-ones, and explains the team wants quality players and does not separate “black aces” from the group. He says a player’s hand situation makes him doubtful, pending doctor clearance and game shape. He expects a good, high-pace start against Ottawa, stresses staying even-keeled, blocking outside distractions, and focusing on the next game. He cites commitment, leadership, sacrifice, and the unique Stanley Cup opportunity, noting Teemu Selanne’s first opportunity. The approach remains working hard, staying committed, playing the system, and playing the best possible game.

Hampton and Newport News Police apprehended a 15-year-old possibly involved in a January 31 Tinee Giant robbery. A clerk reported an armed, masked suspect robbed the store. Police found a Ford SUV and the teen with a handgun; he was charged with firearm, concealed weapon, and tobacco offenses, but not directly with robbery.

Critics say colleges lack viewpoint diversity, and faculty have skewed left politically. The passage says viewpoint diversity is defined differently by Heterodox Academy, Florida, conservative critics, and an unclear Trump administration. The administration promised nine universities a competitive advantage in federal grants if they ban race- and sex-based hiring and admissions, freeze tuition for five years, cap undergraduate international enrollment at 15 percent, require standardized tests, and maintain a “vibrant marketplace of ideas.” It says signing signals learning and equality priorities and assures civil rights compliance and federal priorities. Education Secretary Linda McMahon said her department may consider how “patriotic” an institution’s education is for discretionary grants. Prospective students compare colleges by viewpoints and may pay over $2,000 extra to attend where fewer students hold opposing beliefs. More perspectives are needed, but federal funding tied to a political agenda could mean educating students on White House priorities rather than fostering a vibrant marketplace.

A Sarasota couple, Michael Bennett and Trisha Steffes, were arrested after accepting an intercepted package containing carfentanil. A search found over 7 grams of fentanyl hidden in a false electrical outlet, plus other drugs and paraphernalia. They face drug charges; both were released on bond.

The passage describes a display device including a substrate with a display area, pad area, and circuit area containing a crack sensing circuit. A crack sensing line extends around the display area and has a first end connected to an input pad and a second end. Data lines are connected to pixels. The crack sensing circuit includes a static electricity discharge element, which may be a capacitor, connected to the second end or to test data lines/connection wires, and may be positioned in a center area of the circuit area. Switching elements connect test data lines to data lines and may not be positioned in the center area. Embodiments may also include a bending area and bending crack sensing lines. The passage further describes defect testing and protection from static electricity.

Alexander Zverev beat Dusan Lajovic 2-6 7-5 4-6 6-1 6-2 in three hours, 24 minutes to reach the French Open third round. Zverev has climbed to third in the rankings and won three Masters titles by 21, but has not reached a grand slam quarterfinal or beaten a top-50 foe at a major. Grigor Dimitrov defeated Jared Donaldson 6-7 (4-7) 6-4 4-6 6-4 10-8, and Kei Nishikori beat Benoit Paire 6-3 2-6 4-6 6-2 6-3. Donaldson used underhand serves while appearing to suffer a leg cramp. Dominic Thiem led Stefanos Tsitsipas 6-2 2-6 6-4 when darkness halted play. Simona Halep beat Alison Riske 2-6 6-1 6-1, Novak Djokovic beat Jaume Munar 7-6 (7-1) 6-4 6-4, Marco Cecchinato beat Marco Trungelliti 6-1 7-6 (7-1) 6-1, and Petra Kvitova and Elina Svitolina advanced in straight sets.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated November 15, 2019. On that date, it notified 401(k) Plan participants that Fidelity Investments was selected as the Plan’s new recordkeeper. To transfer records, Plan account activity will be restricted during a Blackout Period expected to begin January 2, 2020 and end the week of January 12, 2020. On November 19, 2019, the Company provided written notice to Section 16 officers and directors under the Sarbanes-Oxley Act and Regulation BTR that during the Blackout Period they will be subject to trading restrictions on Company equity securities, including derivative securities, acquired through employment or service. The report is signed by David A. Zapolsky.

The editors of the Foreign Relations series have complete access to retired Department of State records and papers, including central files, decentralized “lot files,” Executive Secretariat files, and overseas diplomatic post files. Department central files for 1981–1989 and decentralized files deemed worthy of preservation will eventually transfer to the National Archives and become accessible after declassification and processing. Research is conducted through special access to restricted documents at the Ronald Reagan Presidential Library and other agencies. Some printed material comes from still-classified documents. Reagan Library papers include significant foreign affairs documentation from White House offices, the Department of State, and other agencies. Some research used Reagan Library collections scanned for the Remote Archive Capture project; editors sometimes could not determine whether attachments were attached, indicating “Not found attached.” Documents are presented chronologically by Washington, DC time, with memoranda of conversation placed by conversation time. Editorial treatment follows Office style guidelines, preserves original text with corrections and bracketed insertions, accounts for omissions or withheld documents, and provides source and classification footnotes.

The passage describes a patent application that is a divisional of U.S. patent application Ser. No. 15/987,220 and claims benefit of U.S. Provisional Application No. 62/581,293, relating to a system and method for indicating wireless channel status. It discusses 5G New Radio systems using high frequencies and beamforming, where a UE may experience beam failure and perform beam failure recovery. Example embodiments provide UE methods for receiving and decoding frames after beam failure recovery using assumed quasi-co-located relationships between a channel and a beam identified during recovery, including use of reference signals and spatial domain receive filters. Further embodiments cover updated QCL relationships after recovery, PDCCH and PDSCH, TCI states and TCI field mapping, predetermined TCI values, TCI table updates, and DCI selection. Another embodiment uses no QCL configuration until TCI states are updated, relying on DMRS of PDCCH or PDSCH. The passage states that practicing the embodiments enables the UE to determine which reference signal to use and reduces signaling overhead after beam failure recovery, improving communications system performance. It also includes figures and descriptions of wireless communications systems, devices, and a computing system.

This commentary says children want adults to be genuinely interested in their day, but rote questions and brief responses can discourage curiosity and questioning. It offers five strategies for parents and caregivers: ask specific, open-ended questions; engage with children’s questions; model curiosity by asking questions yourself; admit when you do not know and show how to find answers; and model active listening by repeating, asking follow-ups, and avoiding multitasking. The goal is to help children become better conversationalists and more confident in asking and answering questions.

This cross-sectional study examined self-esteem and physical activity among 10th- and 11th-grade students at Capa Science High School in Istanbul during the 2022–2023 school year. Data were collected from 225 students using a questionnaire with sociodemographic items, IPAQ-SF, Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale, and BMI information. ROSE scores were higher in males, students who exercised regularly, and students with higher school success; ROSE scores also positively correlated with height. No differences in ROSE scores were found across BMI groups. According to IPAQ-SF, 23% were inactive, 61.70% minimally active, and 15.30% HEPA active; males and dormitory residents had higher MET scores. ROSE and MET scores were positively correlated. The study concluded that higher physical activity was correlated with higher self-esteem, while noting the population was specific and height, weight, and school success were self-reported.

The ADS868xW includes a programmable input alarm with low/high thresholds and programmable hysteresis, plus an AVDD alarm; the passage describes using an NTC thermistor and applying hysteresis to prevent false triggering. It recommends separate AVDD and DVDD supplies, specified decoupling capacitors and placement, and notes PSRR improvement with decoupling. It describes NAP and power-down low-power modes entered via RST_PWRCTL_REG and CONVST/CS timing, provides PCB layout guidance for analog/digital partitioning and REFCAP/REFIO decoupling, lists related documentation and support resources, notes ESD precautions, records a document status revision, and includes packaging/orderable and disclaimer information.

Canadian researchers studied blood samples from more than 2,800 people in Toronto to assess undiagnosed celiac disease. Findings consistent with other countries showed celiac disease occurs in about one per cent of the population, while 90 per cent of cases are undiagnosed. The research was called important for estimating the problem’s magnitude and for health care planning. Diagnosing celiac disease can be difficult; blood samples and biopsies should be tested while patients consume gluten to prevent false negatives, and a duodenal biopsy is the gold standard. The study does not differentiate latent from actual celiac disease. Gluten-free foods can be more expensive and less nutritious, and El-Sohemy has a conflict of interest; research was funded by the Canadian Institutes of Health Research.

The Federal Reserve raised its fed-funds rate by a quarter-point to 1% to 1.25% and indicated it would gradually reduce its $4.5 trillion balance sheet this year. U.S. stock benchmarks were mixed: the S&P 500 fell 0.4% and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.9%, while the Dow hit an intraday record but recently traded slightly lower. Energy and materials shares declined, while consumer-staples and utilities shares gained. May CPI fell 0.1%, retail sales were weak, and oil futures dropped 3.7%. Treasury yields moved lower, the dollar fell, and gold rose. Fed Chairwoman Janet Yellen said she still expects inflation to reach 2% next year.

The disclosure relates to using automated insulin delivery records to inform and modify basal insulin dosages for manual or open-loop control. An artificial pancreas application executable by a processor may determine total insulin delivered over a predetermined time period as basal plus bolus amounts, calculate the proportion delivered as basal, and determine whether it exceeds a threshold. If exceeded, the processor may determine an average or modified basal dosage approximately equal to the threshold and generate an instruction to actuate a pump mechanism of a wearable drug delivery device to deliver it. The passage further describes using user insulin delivery history, omitting bolus and nearby basal dosages, applying clustering for time-dependent basal profiles, considering basal/bolus distribution and hypoglycemia safety limits, and implementing the functions across a PDM, smart device, continuous glucose sensor, and cloud-based services.

The court affirmed dismissal of alien enemies’ 1931 bill to recover property seized during World War I under the Trading with the Enemy Act. The District Court held recovery was barred by Public Resolution No. 53, and the appellate court found Cummings v. Deutsche Bank controlling, as Congress could withdraw the grace-based right to recover despite claims of illegal seizure or withholding.

Schneider Electric’s Edge Module is designed to address challenges from expanding digital technologies, including 5G, smart homes, IoT, autonomous cars and drones, which require higher processing closer to end users. The pre-integrated, turnkey module includes power, cooling, software and IT components, supports flexible power and N+1 cooling, and is suited to cell tower edge deployments with configurable racks. Schneider Electric’s EcoStruxure platform enables remote monitoring and control for autonomous “lights out” applications, with built-in security features. The module aims to normalize distributed edge endpoints.

The passage defines IPD, IPU, and DIS as internal pull states during and after reset and references sections on pullup/pulldown resistors and reset pin behavior. It describes boot configuration terminal functions: XIP (NOR) on GPMC uses BTMODE[10] to select GPMC muxing options; Ethernet PHY configuration uses BTMODE[9:8]; ARM Cortex-A8 boot mode uses BTMODE[4:0]. Reserved boot pins are also multiplexed. After reset, these pins function as GPMC data/address pins.

At its Developer Day, OpenAI unveiled a way to embed third-party apps directly into ChatGPT, with a preview Apps SDK for some developers and distribution initially limited to big partners. Demos included Spotify, Canva, and Zillow apps responding to commands. OpenAI plans monetization methods and an agentic commerce protocol with instant checkout. It also announced AgentKit for building agents and Codex’s general availability. The effort aims to keep users within ChatGPT and combine web and mobile experiences into a chat-driven operating system, amid competition and pressure from open source models.

On Friday, worries that a tightening job market would affect inflation and a surge in bond yields drove investors from equities. The Dow fell 665.75 points, or 2.54%, to 25,520.96, its biggest daily point drop since December 2008 and biggest daily percentage loss in 20 months. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq also fell, and Wall Street’s three major indexes logged their biggest weekly losses in two years. A stronger-than-expected January jobs report with the biggest wage gain in more than 8-1/2 years fueled inflation expectations and Federal Reserve rate-hike concerns; the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 2.8450%, highest since January 2014. All 11 S&P sectors closed down, with technology heaviest. Some market players said a pullback was overdue.

Tail risk, or fat tails, means rare events occur more often than a normal distribution indicates; left-tail risk is on the loss side. The passage says tail risk hedging is difficult, may cost lower returns, and can cause ongoing pain until a rare payoff. It presents six alternatives: put options, foreign assets, cash, Cambria’s TAIL ETF, Ray Dalio’s All Weather Portfolio, and trend following. Put options are insurance; Meb Faber’s example bought monthly 5% out-of-the-money S&P 500 puts and invested 90% in 10-year U.S. government bonds, which did best in certain bear markets but hurts returns if always held. Cambria TAIL seeks downside protection via out-of-the-money puts and Treasuries, expects negative returns in most rising markets, and had a since-inception CAGR of -6.92%, but helped in 2018, March 2020, and 2022 selloffs. Cash can be useful at 5–10%; trend following has many small losses and rare big winners. Investors hedge to avoid losses, survive, and reduce behavioral mistakes; trade-offs depend on the individual.

The thesis analyzes Web services related to event management and possibilities for digitized event organization and management, including development of a mobile application that gives users insight into event aspects, allows checking and booking nearby services through sensors, and viewing event situations via drone cameras. It discusses electronic business development after 1995, the difference between e-business and e-commerce, and movement toward digital business. Negative aspects include consolidation, disappearance of SMEs and brick-and-mortar businesses, income disparity, and Internet security risks; protections include antivirus programs, firewalls, encryption, and digital certificates. Technologies discussed include cloud computing, Web 2.0, the Internet of Things, and mobile technology.

The research used event management websites collected through Web mining from 1 August to 15 September 2017, descriptive statistics, inductive conclusions, and a model with five forms: website content; social networks and Web 2.0; public relations and user support; multimedia and mobile technologies; and user experience and technical specification. It analyzed 200 websites—17 Croatian and 183 foreign—using 103 Boolean attributes. Results report findings on website content, social media links and profiles, blogs, public relations, user support, multimedia, user experience, and technical specifications.

The conclusion states event management activities are changing rapidly, users increasingly interact online, and organizers with high-quality online presence will be most successful. Technology is described as omnipresent and necessary for event organization. The research shows room for improvement for Croatian organizations, especially in user experience, social media, mobile applications, and multimedia. Limitations include the selected-country sample, and future analyses should be from the customer perspective and investigate marketing activities and strategies.

The passage is a primer by Jordan L. Couch on AI in the legal profession. It says AI has advanced and can enhance legal practice, improve client services, and streamline operations. AI simulates human intelligence; spellcheck and predictive text are examples. It distinguishes generative AI, which creates new content from existing data, from agentic AI, which analyzes data to provide insights, predictions, or recommendations. It advises asking whether AI is the best tool for a task. Legal uses include document review, legal research, client communication, brainstorming, and drafting. Tools mentioned include Vincent AI, Copilot, ChatGPT, built-in legal software AI features, and custom tools. Part 2 will focus on using and integrating AI.

The Champions League last 16 draw paired Real Madrid with Paris Saint-Germain, Barcelona with Chelsea, Manchester City with Basel, Bayern Munich with Besiktas, Juventus with Tottenham, Manchester United with Sevilla, Liverpool with Porto, and Shakhtar Donetsk with Roma.

Minnesota Wild signed Kirill Kaprizov to an NHL-record eight-year, $136 million extension through 2033-34, GM Bill Guerin announced. The deal is the highest in NHL history in total money and average annual value ($17 million). It starts next season and includes large signing bonuses over the first four years. Kaprizov, 28, will play this season on the final year of a five-year, $45 million deal. In 2024-25, he had 25 goals and 31 assists in 41 games, missing 40 games due to a lower-body injury requiring surgery. In five seasons, he has 185 goals and 386 points.

Photographer Mark Bickerdike documented Ricky’s School of Rock in Linthwaite for several years, capturing around 50 RockJam gigs. The 10-week courses teach young musicians to play in a band and end with a gig. Founder Ricky Comiskey said pupils gain confidence and some form bands. The project has ended.

This qualitative study examined pre-service physical education and health (PE) teachers’ anticipated challenges and needs. It involved 18 pre-service PE teachers from francophone Quebec universities in four focus groups. The study aimed to identify general anticipated challenges, challenges related to supporting student motivation, and how teacher education could better prepare participants. Results showed general challenges were classroom management and students’ lack of motivation. Motivation-specific challenges were student heterogeneity, proposing learning activities to sustain motivation, student engagement, managing disengaged students, and gender differences. Participants wanted more support in planning motivational strategies, learning how to implement them, and additional practice opportunities. The study concludes that participants did not feel current Quebec teacher education programs met their needs regarding student motivation. Recommendations include more practice and explicit links between course content and motivational processes. Limitations include a small sample and universities only in Quebec.

The lecture develops the operator-field mapping in AdS/CFT: field-theory operators correspond to gravity fields, and their quantum numbers should match. It relates an operator’s scaling dimension to the mass of the dual gravity field. For a massive scalar in AdS, the near-boundary behavior is phi ~ A z^{d−Δ} + B z^Δ, with Δ = d/2 + sqrt(d^2/4 + m^2R^2); the BF bound requires real exponents. Normalizable modes are used for canonical quantization and correspond to states. Non-normalizable modes determine boundary sources and deform the boundary theory; in standard quantization A is non-normalizable and B normalizable, while alternative quantization switches them. Thus A maps to deformations and B maps to expectation values. Gauge fields are dual to conserved currents with dimension d−1, and metric perturbations to the stress tensor with dimension d. Correlation functions are computed via a generating functional related to the gravity partition function with specified boundary values, evaluated semiclassically by the classical action.

A Tom Thomson sketch once given as a gag gift sold for $481,250 at Heffel Fine Art Auction House in Toronto. The auction of 118 works raised $14.1 million. Paul-Emile Borduas’s “Figures schematiques” fetched $3.6 million, an artist record; works by Lawren Harris, A.J. Casson, Jack Bush and Jean Paul Lemieux also sold.

A Southwest Airlines employee asked UC Berkeley women’s basketball coach Lindsay Gottlieb to prove her 1-year-old biracial son was hers during a Denver-to-Oakland flight, requesting his birth certificate and then a Facebook post after she offered his passport. Gottlieb tweeted about the incident and suspected his skin color caused the request. Southwest apologized and cited its lap-child verification policy, without specifying why the request was made. Chrissy Teigen and others defended such requests as a child-trafficking precaution.

The passage describes the VIX as a popular measure of implied volatility in S&P 500 index options and a mean reversion indicator: rising VIX may signal buying stocks, while falling VIX may signal selling. It notes that VIX often moves inversely to the stock market/SPY and discusses several VIX trading strategies, including an example using Bollinger bands, while recommending backtesting.

UAE Energy Minister Suhail bin Mohammed al-Mazroui said OPEC and non-OPEC producers plan to announce an exit strategy in June from global supply cuts, but that does not mean the pact will end then. He said it was premature to discuss the strategy’s form or shape before the June meeting. Kuwait’s oil minister said producers would study the possibility of an exit strategy before June. Russian Energy Minister Alexander Novak said it was too early to discuss an exit and withdrawal should be gradual, possibly taking three to six months. Under the deal, producers are cutting about 1.8 million barrels per day.
Nigeria’s inflation declined to 16.25% in May from 17.28% in April; month-on-month headline rose 1.88%, while food inflation was 19.27% year-on-year, down from 19.30%.

The paper addresses exact Nash equilibrium computation in multiplayer imperfect-information games. It formulates the problem as a nonlinear complementarity problem using a generalized sequence-form representation, models it as a quadratically constrained feasibility/bilinear program, and solves it with nonconvex quadratic optimization. In experiments, the approach solved reduced three-player Kuhn poker after removal of dominated actions in 2.47 seconds, with no player able to gain more than 1.4×10−17 by deviating. Gambit’s only applicable method that solved the reduced game was logit QRE, taking over 40 seconds and yielding a deviation bound of 1.67×10−5. The new approach did not solve the full game within 24 hours, while logit QRE solved it in several minutes. For strategic-form games, the NCP approach had smaller runtimes than a MIP approach. The passage concludes that the method is useful for exact Nash equilibrium in smaller games, while logit QRE is more scalable for moderate or larger games.

Box Inc. reported quarterly results ahead of Wall Street estimates, with an adjusted loss of 7 cents per share and revenue of $140.5 million. Billings rose to $116.7 million, and paying customers increased to 85,000. Second-quarter guidance also topped estimates, but shares fell 4.6% after hours.

In John Q. A. Simmonds v. Nicholas T. P. Simmonds, appellee sued to recover 117% acres in Bell County as part of the Willard Chamberlain one-third league headright. Defendant pleaded not guilty and ten years limitations. The jury found for appellee for the land and rents. Plaintiff relied on a duplicate certificate, patent to Chamberlain, an 1850 transfer from Chamberlain by Louis C. Clemons as agent to Joseph P. Sneed, and a deed from Sneed to N. T. P. Simmonds. Defendant offered no paper title and relied on failure to prove title and limitation. The court held the transfer was admissible as an ancient instrument from proper custody, sufficiently identified the certificate, and carried a conclusive presumption of Clemons’s authority. It also held a Land Office affidavit and augmentation certificate were inadmissible or did not disprove identity, and a party cannot introduce evidence of his own truthfulness merely because evidence conflicts. The judgment was affirmed.

Thomas Scullun agreed with J. and W. R. Wing to master the bark Cape Horn Pigeon on its next contemplated season, sailing from port by December 1, 1891, going east and returning; the Wings were to pay half a round-trip ticket to Boston and back, with the other half charged to Scullun and compensation a 1/12 lay in net voyage proceeds. The contract was notarized. On December 7, 1891, the 201-ton bark, navigated with 44 men, was cleared from San Francisco for a whaling voyage, and Scullun swore to a cargo manifest. A later reply to an envoy reported that a Russian commission investigated the arrest of the Cape Horn Pigeon in the Sea of Okhotsk. Lieutenant von Cube, commanding the English schooner Maria, encountered it on August 20 (September 10), 1892, and took it to Vladivostok after log and charts suggested visits to Aniva and Patience bays, where fishing was forbidden to foreign vessels. The commission found the vessel had navigated Russian territorial waters but no cause for confiscation; the arrest was a misunderstanding and the vessel was returned to its owners.

The passage describes a patent application related to intelligent automated assistants, specifically an auditory-based interface for media exploration. It details methods, non-transitory computer-readable media, and electronic devices that receive natural-language speech inputs requesting media, provide media items based on search parameters, and allow users to refine requests while a media item is provided. Additional methods cover providing speech output with playback of a related media item, using a threshold for consecutive non-affirmative responses to media suggestions, and detecting multiple users to obtain and merge their preference profiles for identifying media. The passage also includes background on digital assistants, system and device architecture, and priority claims to earlier U.S. and Danish patent applications.

Dusty Baker believes Jeff Kent deserves Baseball Hall of Fame induction. Kent has hovered around 15 percent on ballots since 2013, below the 75-percent threshold. Kent hit 377 home runs, had eight 100-RBI seasons, batted .290 over 17 years, and won the 2002 NL MVP; Baker praised him.

Carol Moore says a 2010 land deal Jane Sanders championed caused Burlington College’s closure. Federal authorities are examining whether Sanders accurately represented donations as loan collateral; Moore criticized a Sanders-brokered deal with Driscoll’s Vermont Woodworking School as a sweetheart deal for Carina Driscoll.

The NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU, based on the NVIDIA Ampere architecture, is built on TSMC’s 7nm N7 FinFET process and includes GA100 GPU units, third-generation Tensor Cores, Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), third-generation NVLink, HBM2 memory, and L2 cache. It supports asynchronous barriers, asynchronous copy, CUDA Task Graphs, L2 cache residency controls, Cooperative Groups, and fine-grained structured sparsity. A100 Tensor Cores support FP16, BF16, TF32, FP64, INT8, INT4, and Binary, with 2:4 structured sparsity. The A100 implementation has 108 SMs, 40 GB HBM2, 40 MB L2 cache, and 1555 GB/sec memory bandwidth. MIG can partition the GPU into as many as seven GPU Instances for QoS and fault isolation. DGX A100 uses eight A100 GPUs connected by NVLink and NVSwitch and is described as a universal system for AI infrastructure.

QuantifiedStrategies.com offers TradingView trading strategies for sale and translates selected strategies into Pinescript; users can sign up for availability notifications, browse offerings, and email desired strategies. Trading involves risk.
Pete Hegseth summoned hundreds of generals and admirals and argued for shaking up a military he called soft and “woke”; Greg Jaffe discusses the speech.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2019. For Q1 2019, net sales were $59,700 million, operating income was $4,420 million, net income was $3,561 million, basic EPS was $7.24, and diluted EPS was $7.09. Operating activities provided $1,846 million, investing activities used $8,123 million, and financing activities used $2,377 million. Segment results were North America net sales $35,812 million and operating income $2,287 million; International net sales $16,192 million and operating loss $90 million; and AWS net sales $7,696 million and operating income $2,223 million. The company adopted new lease accounting, recognizing approximately $21 billion of operating lease assets and liabilities. Legal proceedings include patent infringement complaints. As of March 31, 2019, cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $37.0 billion; debt included $24.3 billion of unsecured senior notes; and tax contingencies were approximately $3.6 billion.

Design requires a logic-high alert when amplifier output exceeds 1.1V and configuration as in Figure 7-7. Use a low-ESR 0.1µF ceramic bypass capacitor directly between V+ and ground to prevent supply ringing, false triggers, and oscillations from fast output edges. Split or single supplies are allowed with inputs within the recommended range; in split supply, output low is V-. Minimize output-input coupling, place input series resistors close, and optionally add a <100Ω output series resistor to dampen ringing or reflections.

Qualcomm accidentally published and then removed a blog post about the Asus Zenfone AR, a CES-bound device said to be the second consumer Google Tango smartphone and the first Tango phone supporting Daydream View. It will use Snapdragon 821. Evan Blass posted renders; pricing and availability are unknown. Asus also teased another Zenfone with the “world’s best processor.”

Ukraine’s IMF mission chief said the pension system is unsustainable because it supports nearly a third of the population and must limit retirees. The IMF has long pressed for pension reform. Ukraine has resisted raising the pension age, now 57 for women and 60 for men, citing unpopularity and parliamentary opposition. The IMF also cited early retirement and pension-tax avoidance.

The 20-day EMA trading strategy uses the 20-day EMA to generate buy and sell signals: buy when price surpasses the 20 EMA, sell when it falls below. Backtesting on SPY showed low CAGR, significant drawdown, and about 70% time invested. Adding another indicator improved performance but not drawdown. The system worked better for Bitcoin from 2014.

Iron sulfate heptahydrate, or ferrous sulfate heptahydrate, is soluble in water and acids and is produced during titanium dioxide manufacture from ilmenite or by crystallization. It is used medically for iron deficiency and industrially in textile dye fixation, leather blackening, ink, iron chlorosis treatment, water purification through flocculation and phosphate removal, reduction of Cr6+ in cement, and as an iron supplier in agriculture.

The lecture discusses the AEP for discrete memoryless sources, defining log pmf variables, entropy, and typical sets via the weak law of large numbers. It gives bounds on typical-set size and probability: typical sequences have probabilities near 2^{-nH(X)}, the typical set has about 2^{nH(X)} elements, and typical probability approaches 1 as n grows. It relates this to fixed-length source coding and entropy. It then introduces Markov sources as models with memory, covering finite-state Markov chains, transition probabilities, ergodicity, steady-state probabilities, conditional entropy H(X|S), and coding using per-state prefix-free codes or n-to-variable-length codes, with H(X|S) as the limit. Finally, it describes the Lempel-Ziv universal algorithm, especially LZ77: a sliding window, longest match of unencoded symbols, encoding match length and position, a unary-binary integer code, initial window filling, and asymptotic performance comparable to the best code for a Markov source while adapting to unknown or changing statistics.

The speaker thanks attendees at West Point and addresses the Corps of Cadets. He reflects on losing in sports, then discusses the President’s role as Commander in Chief after the Cold War. He says the United States must help build a new world order of democratic, tolerant, economically free governments committed to peaceful settlement, reject isolationism, engage in world affairs, and lead without becoming the world’s policeman. He says force may sometimes be necessary, citing Kuwait, Iraq, and Somalia, while noting difficult decisions not to use force, such as in the former Yugoslavia. He praises the All Volunteer Force, military meritocracy, training, and people. He honors the cadets’ service and recalls enlisting in the Navy in 1942.

Coach Quenneville discusses line combinations, matchups, and merit-based playing time. He says Johnny contributes in all zones without the puck, brings speed, puck possession, special-teams minutes, and draws top matchups; his offense may be down, but he brings more than production. He praises the team’s consistency, four lines, improved defense, goaltending, and Jennings win, and calls coaching the group a privilege. He recalls playoff adversity against Detroit, scheduling and rest, overtime too-many-men penalties, and the team’s response. The passage quotes a Russia–Great Britain treaty stating that in no part of the Pacific Ocean their subjects shall be disturbed in navigation, fishing, or landing on unoccupied coasts to trade with natives, subject to later restrictions. It reports the Paris arbitration decision: Russia’s 1821 ukase claimed Bering Sea jurisdiction 100 Italian miles from her coasts and islands, but in 1824 and 1825 treaties Russia admitted jurisdiction limited to cannon-shot; until Alaska’s cession she did not exercise exclusive seal-fishery rights beyond ordinary territorial waters. The decision’s Pacific Ocean wording applies to Bering and Okhotsk Seas as branches. Authorities cited say connected seas are free, exclusive jurisdiction over large gulfs like Okhotsk is unsupported, and the Kara Sea is open; the ocean is free for navigation, fishing, and peaceful enterprise, and Vattel says small bays and straits may be occupied, but not great areas like Hudson Bay or the Straits of Magellan.

The Toronto Raptors beat the Portland Trail Blazers 130-105, snapping Portland’s four-game winning streak. Damian Lillard scored 32 points and became the fastest player in franchise history to reach 10,000 career points. CJ McCollum had 21 and Jusuf Nurkic 20.
