It addresses insular possessions, education and welfare, child labor, a minimum wage for women, a possible department, restricted and selective immigration, veterans’ care without a bonus, coal cost and emergency authority, government reorganization, agriculture relief through organization, diversification, lower taxes and freight rates, and temporary assistance, Muscle Shoals sale with fertilizer experimentation, reclamation relief, highways and reforestation, and maintenance of the Monroe Doctrine while helping world stability. It concludes that moral power, justice, mercy, good will, and peace should guide America.

Toronto's transit commission says most new streetcars have to be returned to Bombardier Transportation for preventive repairs of inferior frame welds, which pose no safety risk. Bombardier will cover costs; all repairs will be completed by 2022, delaying some planned layoffs.

Ohio State researchers identified TexPSR, a stress pathway in exhausted T cells driven by misfolded protein buildup, as a key cause of T-cell exhaustion and poor immunotherapy response. Blocking TexPSR restored T-cell function and improved immunotherapy effectiveness in preclinical models; high TexPSR levels were linked to poor clinical responses in cancer patients.

The passage contains President James Buchanan’s message to Congress on Kansas and his April 6, 1858, proclamation on Utah. In the message, Buchanan transmits the Kansas constitution, its ordinance on public lands, and J. Calhoun’s letter, and sends the only copy to the Senate. He states that Kansas affairs are not merely a contest between two political parties but between those loyal to the government established by Congress and those rebelling against it. He describes the Topeka government as revolutionary, cites Governor Walker’s reports of resistance, insurrection at Lawrence, and General Lane’s organizing of volunteers, and notes that opponents of the Territorial government refused to vote for delegates or on the slavery question. Buchanan maintains the Lecompton convention was legally constituted, submitted the slavery question to the people, and that elections were later held under the constitution. He favors admitting Kansas under it, arguing this would settle the slavery question, restore peace, allow federal troops to be withdrawn, and prevent renewed agitation. He says he had received no official result of the January election.

In the Utah proclamation, Buchanan states that Utah settlers have shown insubordination, driven off federal officers, interrupted courts, and destroyed or concealed records. He ordered a military detachment toward Salt Lake City to protect federal officers and enforce the laws. He says Mormon forces attacked and destroyed an unprotected baggage train, calling this rebellion and treason. He denies any crusade against religion, offers a full pardon to those who submit to federal authority, orders officials to enforce the laws and citizens to assist, and warns that military forces will remain until the inhabitants show proper obedience.

The passage provides information for employees who combine work with caring for someone, covering flexible working. Turing GPUs include hardware support for USB Type-C and VirtualLink, an open industry standard for delivering power, display, and bandwidth to next-generation VR headsets through a single USB-C connector. The Turing TU102 is the highest-performing GPU in the line, with TU104 and TU106 scaled down. TU102 has six GPCs, 36 TPCs, 72 SMs, 12 32-bit GDDR6 memory controllers (384-bit total), 96 ROPs, 6144 KB L2, and 144 FP64 units. Each SM contains 64 CUDA Cores, eight Tensor Cores, one RT Core, 256 KB register file, four texture units, and 96 KB L1/shared memory. The Turing SM supports concurrent FP32 and INT32 execution, independent thread scheduling, and a unified L1/shared memory/texture cache. NVLink provides high-speed multi-GPU connectivity; TU102 has two x8 links with 100 GB/s bidirectional aggregate bandwidth. Turing Tensor Cores add INT8/INT4 modes and accelerate AI inference; Tesla T4 has 2,560 CUDA Cores, 320 Tensor Cores, up to 130 INT8 TOPS and 260 INT4 TOPS. Turing uses GDDR6 memory, larger L2 caches, memory compression, enhanced video engine, MPS, and higher memory bandwidth. The display engine supports DisplayPort 1.4a, 8K at 60 Hz, DSC 1.2, HDR tone mapping, NVENC HEVC 8K at 30 fps, and NVDEC HEVC 4:4:4 and VP9. VirtualLink supports four lanes HBR3 DisplayPort plus SuperSpeed USB 3. NVLink replaces MIO/PCIe for SLI in TU102/TU104. RT Cores accelerate BVH traversal and ray/triangle intersection for real-time ray tracing, using hybrid rendering and denoising. NGX uses Tensor Cores for DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez. Turing also introduces mesh shading, variable rate shading, texture space shading, multi-view rendering, and resource binding changes. TU104 has six GPCs, 48 SMs, 3072 CUDA Cores, 368 Tensor Cores, 48 RT Cores, and one x8 NVLink link. TU106 has three GPCs, 36 SMs, 2304 CUDA Cores, 288 Tensor Cores, 36 RT Cores, and no NVLink or SLI. The passage also covers RTX-OPS, ray tracing mechanics, BVH, denoising, and ray-traced shadows, ambient occlusion, and reflections.

Ferrari pursued a controlled growth strategy in 2025 to protect and extend its luxury performance car leadership while balancing tradition and innovation. Founded by Enzo Ferrari and tied to Formula 1, Ferrari went public in 2015 and appointed Benedetto Vigna CEO in 2021. It nearly doubled shipments over the preceding decade, and revenues rose from $3.2 billion in 2015 to $7.2 billion in 2024. Ferrari aimed to grow through expansion in growth markets, appeal to a new generation, and new models, including its first fully electric vehicle slated for 2025, without diluting brand exclusivity. The luxury performance market included more than 85,000 vehicles sold globally in 2024. Ferrari generated nearly 90% of 2024 revenues from cars and spare parts and derived only 8% of revenues from mainland China. It sold through 178 authorized dealers with 200 points of sale, cultivated Ferraristi through events and limited editions, offered personalization, and maintained the Classiche program. Its models included Range, special series, Icona, and supercars. Hybrid vehicles grew to 51% of shipments in 2024. Ferrari planned 15 new models from 2023 to 2026 and targeted a 2026 portfolio of 55% hybrid, 40% internal combustion, and 5% fully electric, and a 2030 mix of 20% internal combustion, 40% hybrid, and 40% electric, with a technology-neutral stance. It opened an e-building for electric components and planned to source battery cells externally. Risks included entering new markets, anticipating consumer preferences, and managing controlled-growth risks. Vigna raised questions about industry attractiveness, competitive advantage, threats, moats, disruption, and profitable growth opportunities.

Pakistan’s 120x80-foot national flag was flown at 400 feet at the Attari-Wagah border with India for the 70th Independence Day. Army chief Gen Qamar Javed Bajwa hoisted it after midnight, beginning celebrations. It was reported as South Asia’s highest and world’s eighth highest. Speakers honored migration victims.

Ted Hannah, a 1959 Summerland graduate, reflects on his class’s upbringing and advises the 2018 graduates. He describes a childhood shaped by postwar life, simple activities, no television or Internet, and schooling that provided basic tools. After graduation, classmates pursued education, trades, business, or orcharding, then married and kept in touch through reunions. Noting the 2018 graduates’ material wealth and technology, he says people still need others, urging them to nurture relationships, love family and friends, volunteer, and make others’ lives better regardless of religion, ethnicity, or sexual orientation.

The lecture covers finding minimal trellis representations for binary linear block codes, with the state space theorem giving state-space dimension in terms of past and future subcodes. A trellis-oriented generator matrix is obtained by greedily shortening generator spans until all starting and ending times differ. State-space dimensions are read by counting active generators at cut times, and branch-space dimensions by counting active generators at symbol times. Examples include self-dual codes, the 8,7,2 single-parity-check code, and the 8,1,8 repetition code. Branch complexity is presented as more fundamental than state complexity for Viterbi algorithm complexity; sectionalization can reduce apparent state complexity but not branch complexity. Average dimension bounds relate total state and branch dimensions to k, d, and n, implying that good code sequences require exponentially growing trellis decoding complexity. Projections are discussed as dual to subcodes and used to analyze Reed-Muller codes and central state-space dimensions. Homework problems and postponed topics, including the Muder bound and comparison with convolutional trellises, are also mentioned.

Tesla filed a Form 8-K reporting that on May 7, 2019, it closed public offerings of 3,549,381 shares of common stock and $1.84 billion aggregate principal amount of 2.00% Convertible Senior Notes due May 15, 2024, including securities sold upon full exercise of the underwriters’ options. Tesla entered a Fifth Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank National Association and additional note hedge and warrant transactions with hedge counterparties. The document standardizes the SEV-ES/SEV-SNP Guest-Hypervisor Communication Block (GHCB), a 4 KB decrypted memory page used for guest-hypervisor communication. It defines GHCB layout, protocol versions, hypervisor feature support, GHCB MSR protocol requests/responses, GHCB GPA registration/unregistration, and negotiation examples. It specifies Non-Automatic Exits and supported NAE events, including #NPF/MMIO access, Page State Change, SNP Guest Request, SNP Extended Guest Request, SNP AP Creation, #HV Doorbell Page, #HV IPI, #HV Timer, APIC ID List, SNP Run VMPL, SNP TIO Guest Request, Secure AVIC, Termination Request, and unsupported NAE handling. It also covers guest identification of SEV-ES support, SMP booting under SEV-ES and SEV-SNP, non-maskable interrupts, debug register support, SMM, nested virtualization, SNP Restricted Injection, #HV doorbell pages, essential data, interrupt shadows, EFI SNP Confidential Computing Blob protocol, secrets page reserved area, and changes across revisions 2.01–2.04. SMM and nested virtualization are not supported in this version.

The passage compiles tweets about John Oliver and celebrity friends’ book making Mike Pence’s family pet rabbit gay, with some saying Pence was “owned” or his St. Patrick’s Day was ruined. It cites a tweet that every photo of Pence at a Savannah parade had a pride flag behind him. Chad Felix Greene disputes activists’ claims, saying Pence looked happy, polite, and unaffected and that protesting him was pointless. A Twitter exchange follows about Pence’s positions and religious freedom, ending with “This is the Left.”

Zeenews.india.com’s cookie policy explains how cookies and similar tracking technologies may be stored on and accessed from a user’s device when using its sites, and states that continued browsing means agreement to this. It describes cookies as small text files and other tracking technologies as similar tools that collect information about site use. The sites use these technologies to identify users and interests, remember preferences, track use, control access, protect sites, process requests, administer sites, and conduct research. Third-party service providers use persistent cookies to track and analyze statistical usage and volume information. It distinguishes first-party and third-party cookies, including cookies from embedded content or social networks, which the site does not control. Cookie types include persistent, session, essential, analytical/performance, functionality, and advertising cookies. Users may refuse or withdraw consent through browser settings, though this may affect site access or functionality. Data is kept no longer than necessary, and contact information is provided.

NVIDIA’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended May 1, 2016 reported revenue of $1.305 billion, up 13%; net income of $196 million, up 46%; and diluted net income per share of $0.33, up 38%. GPU business revenue was $1.079 billion and Tegra Processor business revenue was $160 million, while net cash provided by operating activities was $309 million. The lecture discusses ReCellular’s business model, its debated future, and differences from Genco. It then examines Whirlpool’s options among an industry-funded organization, a closed-loop system, or opposing regulation, including cost comparisons, operational barriers, and the note that Whirlpool chose a closed loop but found it more expensive than expected. The lecture ends with final project presentations and assignment details.
XPC=0 SDXC: up to 0.36W, Class 0 without Speed Class. XPC=1: up to 0.54W, Speed Class, re-initialization needed. UHS-I uses S18R/S18A for 1.8V; UHS-II S18A=0. Fast Boot reserved for eSD.

The speaker says Matt will respond well, citing his terrific playoff body of work and timely saves. The coaching staff encourages players, including Geno, to use instincts and calculated risk: make plays when possible and simple plays otherwise while buying into the team concept. In the playoffs, hard defense and limited ice favor cooperative give-and-go play. Penalties and power-play chances are down; last night’s power play struggled with clean entries and zone time. The group has stepped up, with Brian Dumoulin playing in all situations.

In soccer, an individual defender must get goal-side of an opposing ball carrier with proper stance and be aware of teammates. If teammates are set, the defender may use aggressive defending; if not, attack stalling. Aggressive defending includes cutting off the ball, tackling, interposing, or preventing a turn. Attack stalling delays or controls the dribbler until support arrives. One-on-one tactics include staying goal-side, keeping a clean stance, not over-reacting to fakes, denying passes or shots, slowly giving ground, restricting the dribbler’s vision, jockeying, shepherding, and stealing the ball. Near the penalty area or around 25 yards, the defender must stand ground or tackle. Teammates must communicate orally: delay calls include “contain,” “delay,” “jockey,” and “stand him up”; tackle calls include “challenge,” “tackle,” and “take him.” If beaten, the defender chases; if a teammate defends, the original defender switches. Coaches must teach defenders approach, stance locations, techniques, and communication terms through instruction and practice.

Tuesday morning, after a 1 a.m. call about a man threatening suicide on an I-696 bridge, police closed all lanes and arranged 13 semi trucks beneath the bridge to shorten a possible fall. The man later walked off and was taken to Beaumont Hospital in Royal Oak for evaluation.

This disclosure relates to controlling data transmission in wireless communication systems when a device is in an enhanced coverage state to reduce power consumption. A device can be in an enhanced coverage state based on coverage enhancement modes, levels, or classes, signal strength or quality below thresholds, or a number of repetitions above a threshold. An application can receive radio coverage condition information from a modem, determine the enhanced coverage state, and control uplink data transmission. In Solution 1, the application decides whether to refrain from sending uplink data. In Solution 2, the application instructs the modem to transmit data conditionally. Conditions can include data type, QoS, priority, bit rate, timer or counter, device movement, battery level, or whether the device is plugged into a power supply. Configuration information and parameters for transmission restrictions can be provided by the network or via AT commands, NAS or RRC messages, PCO, USAT, or OMA DM. The passage also describes similar control for mobile terminated messages by an application server or SCS.

This study used NHANES 2007–2010 data to examine associations between rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and depression, obesity, and hypertriglyceridemia (HTG), conditions linked to chronic inflammation. Of 20,686 participants, 4,136 met inclusion criteria; 305 had RA. RA subjects had higher rates of hypertension, stroke, HTG, depression, diabetes, and obesity. CRP distributions shifted right in RA and in depression, obesity, and HTG. RA prevalence increased from low to high CRP groups. Depression or obesity was associated with increased RA prevalence, but HTG was not. Coexistence of depression with obesity or HTG was associated with substantially higher RA prevalence across some CRP ranges, with the effect prominent at medium CRP (1–3 mg/L) for HTG and across all CRP ranges for obesity. Three-way chi-square tests confirmed significant differences in RA proportion except for depression plus HTG at low CRP. At high CRP, depression plus HTG had lower RA prevalence than depression without HTG. The study concludes that depression’s association with RA is increased by obesity or HTG depending on inflammatory state, but cross-sectional data, self-reported RA, and nonspecific CRP limit causal inference. It recommends longitudinal studies and broader inflammatory markers.

Microsoft Corporation’s Form 8-K, dated June 26, 2020, reports a strategic change in its retail operations, including closing Microsoft Store physical locations. The related press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1.

The speaker says age is irrelevant in today’s game and prefers a veteran mixture, because players need knowledge and correct positioning rather than speed or skill. He is proud to be part of the group, recalls doubts about winning in the playoffs with Brett Hull, and says personal goals do not matter as long as the team wins. He has bumps and soreness but can play. He thought he would re-sign with Dallas, but after delays and budget issues he urged Mike to call Detroit and feels fortunate after having nowhere to play in August.

The speaker has a leg injury from someone falling on it, has not had it checked, and hopes treatment and rest help so he can try to play tomorrow night. He says most teammates did not come in and are resting, everyone is excited for the Stanley Cup finals, and the team must control its energy and play its best game. He watched a game while icing in the dressing room, described momentum swings, discipline, Tampa’s strong play, and the first draw as important. He also mentioned Calgary fans and having a newborn.

Analysis showed average debt grew by £560 in Q1 2017; single parents with young children added £930 and lone parents with grown-up offspring £940, or £10 per day. Experts suggested helping university-aged children with tuition fees could be behind the highest figures. About 15% took on debt just to get by, rising to 20% of single parents. Average debt was £1,797, and the report highlighted a need for greater financial education amid rising individual debts.

The paper discusses a shift in Information Systems (IS) from positivist, technical approaches toward human and social concerns. It focuses on two developments: complexity science and the User Experience (UX) approach. Complexity science emphasizes complex versus complicated systems, self-organisation, far-from-equilibrium conditions, bifurcation, dissipative structures, and irreversibility. UX is described as superseding usability practice by attending to subjective experience, motivation, and satisfaction, while still requiring mixed methods.

The paper argues that IS are dynamic and constantly adapting, as Ray Paul states, and that because humans are parts of information systems, complexity, irreversibility, and durational rather than spatial characteristics apply to IS. It reviews prior work on complexity and IS, including Benbya and McKelvey’s framework, and supports Kallinikos’s critique of their representational view and near decomposability. It proposes a Knowledge Transfer Partnership between the University of Salford and UX specialists Sigma Ltd, beginning in March 2014, to study irreversible experiences in information systems and how time and irreversibility affect design, usability, complexity, and success. The conclusion calls for moving away from reductionist, mechanical positivism toward a complex, durational understanding of IS, exemplified by UX, with flexibility built into future designs.

The passage presents OntoAligner and a framework for Ontology Alignment (OA) using Knowledge Graph Embeddings (KGEs). Ontologies are formal, structured domain knowledge representations, and OA identifies correspondences between semantically equivalent entities across ontologies. Modern OA uses machine learning and embedding-based strategies, including LLMs, while KGEs remain relatively underexplored. KGEs convert entities and relations into continuous low-dimensional vectors. The work aims to systematically explore and adapt KGE models for OA, evaluate their performance, and investigate hybrid LLM-KGE models. It defines OA formally and combines source and target triples into a unified triple repository called a triple factory, formulating OA as a link prediction task over merged ontologies. The approach is integrated into OntoAligner. The Graph Embedding Aligner uses Parser, Encoder, and Aligner stages: parsing ontologies into metadata and triples, unifying triples, training a KGE model in PyKEEN with a link prediction objective, computing cosine similarity for ranking, and applying one-to-one cardinality and confidence threshold filtering. The paper reviews related work, details methodology, presents experiments and analysis, and concludes with future directions. Table 1 lists 17 KGE models supported in OntoAligner.

The DAWN-plasma study was a randomized, open-label, phase 2 proof-of-concept multicenter trial evaluating convalescent plasma plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in hospitalized adult COVID-19 patients. Protocol amendments and informed consent documents were approved by Independent Ethics Committees; the study was performed according to the Declaration of Helsinki and ICH-GCP, and signed informed consent was required before enrollment. Participants were randomized 2:1 to convalescent plasma plus standard of care or standard of care alone. Convalescent plasma was administered as 800–1000 mL in 4 doses, with the first dose within 12 hours of randomization and the second dose 24–36 hours after the first 2 units; plasma with less than 1/160 neutralizing antibody titers was not allowed. The primary endpoint was the percentage of patients alive without mechanical ventilation at Day 15. Between May 2, 2020, and January 26, 2021, 499 patients were assessed and 489 were randomized (326 plasma, 163 control). Baseline characteristics and concomitant COVID-19 therapy were similar between groups. The proportion alive and free of mechanical ventilation on Day 15 was not different: 83.7% with convalescent plasma versus 84.1% in control (odds ratio 0.99, 95% CI 0.59–1.68, p=0.976). Pre-specified subgroup analyses for the primary endpoint demonstrated a significant interaction with age.

The match-up zone defense combines person-to-person and zone principles and uses a series of defensive rules. Its stated advantages include preventing offensive alignments from splitting defenders, making overloads easier to defend, and confusing opponents; success depends on smart, knowledgeable players and communication. It is described as a passive defense that reacts to offensive movement and allows perimeter ball movement but can be supplemented with aggressive traps. It can dictate offensive alignment by showing a two-guard zone or a 1-2-2 or 1-3-1 zone before applying match-up rules. Basic rules assign defenders X1–X5 against 2-3, 1-3-1, 1-2-2, and 1-4 alignments and may be adjusted to personnel. The passage details defending cutters through switching or interchanging roles and describes trapping that can extend into full- and half-court situations, with the corner as a primary trap zone.

The text discusses distributed systems and container patterns, aiming to regularize distributed system design through common patterns. Containers are foundational, and groups of co-located containers are atomic elements. Single-node patterns include sidecar, ambassador, and adapter.

The sidecar pattern uses an application container and a sidecar container, coscheduled and sharing resources, to augment functionality. Examples include adding HTTPS via nginx, configuration synchronization, topz monitoring, and a simple PaaS. Sidecars should be modular and reusable through parameterization, stable APIs, and documentation.

The ambassador pattern brokers interactions between the application container and the outside world. Examples include client-side sharding with twemproxy, service brokering for portability and service discovery, and request splitting or experiments with nginx. The adapter pattern modifies an application container’s interface to conform to a predefined interface, with examples for Prometheus monitoring, Fluentd log normalization, and MySQL health checks.

Multi-node patterns are more loosely coupled and use network communication. Microservices break systems into small services with APIs, improving reliability, agility, and independent scaling, but making debugging and architecture harder. Replicated load-balanced services use identical stateless replicas behind a load balancer, with readiness probes, session tracking, caching layers, rate limiting, and SSL termination. Sharded services divide requests among shards, often for stateful services and large state. Sharded caches improve memory utilization, and replicated sharded caches add resilience. Sharding functions map requests to shards using deterministic, uniform hashing and modulo; key selection matters, and consistent hashing minimizes remapping when resizing.

Netflix stock closed lower after Elon Musk urged followers to cancel service, while the US government shutdown continued after a GOP funding bill failed in the Senate. The S&P 500 closed above 6,700 on bets of limited shutdown impact. The passage cites economic slowdown, 22x–25x P/E, negative equity risk premium, and AI carrying the market.

DomeShelter Australia offers the Container Mounted DomeShelter™ (CMDS), a robust, weather-resistant, relocatable shelter designed for various industries. It withstands Australian Wind Regions Class A to D, fits existing containers by welding, bolting or Twistlock, and eases shipping and logistics. It benefits oil and gas, agriculture, events and tourism by protecting goods, livestock and providing translucent, cool spaces.

The passage describes systems and methods for providing user interfaces that confirm whether to review or take an action associated with an untrusted email or domain. A driver monitors process creation, and a monitor library may be injected into an application to detect user attempts to access domains not identified as trusted, notify a user console, and pause the request. The user console resolves the URL, queries a server to determine if it is trusted, untrusted, or unknown, and displays a notification based on locally stored settings so the user can confirm the action or revert. Client and server settings hashes are compared, and updated settings are returned and stored if they differ. A company administrator can configure notification content, buttons, help link, checkbox, colors, and visibility through an administrator console, with changes automatically recognized and deployed. Browser-based email client implementations use injected code or browser extensions/plugins with a URL navigation monitoring module and, for extensions, a Browser Intermediary Application. The passage also describes simulated phishing attacks, real-world training, recording user responses, and applications to processes such as messaging applications, browsers, PDFs, and documents.

The passage describes a fluid flow measuring and control device for plumbing. The device includes a main flow channeling system with an inlet and outlet, a parallel bypass channeling system, a flowmeter in the bypass for estimating main fluid flow, a valve for stopping flow, first and second pressure sensors upstream and downstream of the valve, and a transceiver connected to the flowmeter to send data to a computer. The flowmeter may include a chamber, a wheel with rotating blades, and a pair of movement sensors monitoring blades moving in opposite directions to identify rotation direction and assess net flow, including backflow. The valve may be a solenoid valve. The computer may store pre-recorded fluid usage signatures of specific appliances, compare flowmeter data to the signatures to identify appliance use or abnormal fluid usage, and instruct the valve to close. It may also instruct the transceiver to notify a remote server and user mobile device. The device may detect pressure drops when the valve is closed, with low-to-medium pressure drop indicating a leak, and no pressure drop or high pressure drop indicating normal use, after which the valve is reopened. Methods include installing the device at a single plumbing location common to all fluid-consuming appliances, capturing and storing flow-rate data, analyzing data to determine fluid usage signatures, comparing actual measurements to the signatures, detecting leaks or abnormal use, and closing the valve when abnormal flow without a usage signature is identified.

An analysis of districts and Mississippi school data found that schools strong in one subject tend to be strong in others. Among positive outliers, 140 districts appeared on both reading and math lists; only 14 were exceptional in one subject but weak in the other, including 12 strong in math but weak in reading. In Mississippi, school-level reading and math scores correlated 0.87, and growth rates also aligned: among 50 top reading-growth schools, none were below the state math-growth average, while among 50 lowest reading-growth schools, only two reached it. Florida showed similar relationships. The author concludes that schools strong in one subject tend to be strong across subjects.

Crystal morphology affects the sensitivity, safety, and performance of energetic materials and pharmaceuticals. Wulff-based methods—BFDH, SE, and AE—predict morphologies but deviate from experiments; SE and AE lack growth kinetics, AE is sensitive to plane choice, and Wulff methods miss edge/corner effects in small crystals. Zepeda-Ruiz et al. simulated PETN facet evolution with Monte Carlo, but Metropolis–Hastings sampling does not account for kinetics. This work introduces a kinetic Monte Carlo technique to predict crystal morphology using only intermolecular interaction parameters, implemented in the open-source Python package cgkmc. The model encodes the system as a colored undirected graph with occupation numbers and interaction weights, computes total interaction energy, identifies surface sites via coordination numbers, and simulates adsorption and evaporation with rates and a residence-time algorithm. Applied to PETN, it agrees with AE predictions and experiments.

Soccer teams need a ready corner kick defense plan that all players understand and implement immediately when a corner kick is awarded. Coaches must develop and practice a strategy; without it, corner kicks are dangerous. Defenders should try not to concede corner kicks, though sometimes doing so may be correct. Every player has a job, often based on position, and the goalkeeper remains in charge. Players must react quickly, be aggressive, win the ball, clear it high, far, and wide, and prepare for an outlet and transition to a fast-break. Basic defensive techniques and offside positioning remain important. Zone defense assigns players specific areas; it is easy to teach and defenders move out, but opponents may flood a zone and defenders may hesitate. Man-to-man defense has each defender cover one attacker, track them, stay goal-side, and see both ball and attacker; it avoids a flooded zone but can require scrambling and risk losing focus. A mixed zone/man-to-man approach is described as least likely to concede goals, with post and six-yard-line players in zones and others marking man-to-man. Coaching tips include scouting opponents, modifying plans, moving out quickly, goalkeeper positioning, the kicker as a one-man wall, staying 10 yards away, covering quick corners, and practicing until responses are intuitive.

The Mid Screen offense is used by every NBA and WNBA team because it places action in the center, with shooters on the wings, reducing helpside support and offering quick options. It can be a set play or final-leg action. The basic action has the point guard drive off a high post on-ball screen, with options to turn the corner, pull up, pass to the post, or kick out to wings. Defensive actions dictate counters, including drives, kick-outs, post drops, pull-up jumpers, post rolls, isolations, slips, and ball movement against traps. It can flow into motion, single/double, flex, inside triangle, side screen, or power passing continuities, and has variations such as post pop, horns, 1-4 low, post isolation, and two game. Teaching stresses execution, coordination, defensive recognition, timing, and drills, while game strategy includes scouting, varying alignments, and attacking weak defenders. Defenses must also prepare to defend it.
Combined L1 data cache and shared memory subsystem, introduced in Volta V100, improves performance and simplifies programming; A100 capacity is 192 KB/SM versus V100's 128 KB/SM.

The speaker describes getting past Zubov and shooting after waiting for Arnie and Patty to clear the zone. On two-on-ones in the second period, he tried to recover from a likely blue-line turnover on the first, and on the power play tried to give Marty the shot while playing the pass. He says reaching this point is great, but minutes do not win a Stanley Cup, and the team wants to take the next game to Dallas again Thursday rather than drag out the series, learning from Philadelphia’s letdown. He mentions signing with the Devils, Finnish finals experience, moving past one loss, growing comfort against Dallas, their speed and cycling, playoff discipline, and an older player’s strong play.

With Mittelstadt's college season over, questions arose about Rochester. He could sign an AHL or amateur tryout contract to play regular season and playoffs. An NHL entry-level deal would burn a year and prevent assignment to the Amerks. Buffalo prefers an amateur tryout now and an entry-level deal starting in 2018-19. His decision to stay in school or go pro remains.

This passage provides a design example for a synchronous push-pull converter using GaN power devices and TPS7H5001-SP/TPS7H5002-SP/TPS7H5003-SP/TPS7H5004-SP controllers, including component selection and calculations. It specifies 500-kHz switching, 205-kΩ RT, 5-V output with 10-kΩ and 1.4-kΩ feedback resistors, approximately 25-ns dead time with 20.5-kΩ RPS/RSP, approximately 50-ns leading-edge blank time with 49.9-kΩ RLEB, 33-nF soft-start capacitor with approximately 7.5-ms soft-start time, 2.5 transformer turns ratio, 40-μH primary inductance, 170-V primary GaN FETs, 80-V synchronous rectifier GaN FETs with optional parallel Schottky diodes, RCD clamp, 0.47-μH output inductor, at least 1.3-mF and approximately 2.3-mF output capacitance, optional output filter, 7.5-Ω current-sense resistor, 3.3-nF hiccup capacitor, Type 2A compensation with 40.2-kΩ, 15-nF, and 47-pF components, and 102-kΩ slope-compensation resistor. It also gives controller input supply bypassing recommendations and PCB layout guidelines for noise, grounding, high-current traces, and component placement.

Self-driving cars are far off; technology will arrive gradually. SAE's 2014 roadmap defines five levels. Levels 1 and 2, already in production, offer automated acceleration, braking, and some steering but require full driver attention. BMW expects Level 3 on its iNext in 2021; drivers must retake control within seconds. Many firms skip Level 3 for Level 4, which allows longer takeover times and safe stops. Waymo has Level 4 cars and plans a Phoenix taxi service. Level 5 may arrive by the next decade's end.

The passage describes systems and methods for determining abnormal cardiac activity using a deep learning architecture. The methods may receive periods of cardiac data and motion data divided into windows, determine signal quality indices for each window, extract cardiovascular features using the cardiac data, motion data, and signal quality indices, apply a tensor transform to generate tensors, and apply a trained deep learning architecture to classify windows and/or periods into abnormal or normal cardiac activity. The architecture may include a convolutional neural network, a bidirectional recurrent neural network, and an attention network. Subject contextual information, such as medical history and demographic information, may also be used. A report including the cardiac activity classification may be generated. Cardiac data may include ECG and/or PPG data, and motion data may include accelerometer data, optionally from a wearable device such as a smart watch.

This planned secondary analysis of a retrospective cohort study investigated postpartum hypertension risk among people aged 13–54 diagnosed with a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (HDP) at two academic health systems. Using Carolinas Collaborative data, it included HDP deliveries from 2014–2017 with a blood pressure (BP) measurement 15–90 days postpartum. The primary objective was to estimate associations between systolic and diastolic BPs during routine postpartum follow-up and incident hypertension through the first year postpartum; secondary objectives included other risk factors and the proportion with BP measurement per American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists guidelines. The final sample was 2,514; 315 (13%) were diagnosed with incident hypertension after the 15–90-day BP measurement. Higher systolic BP (140 vs. 120 mmHg; HR 1.70), severe preeclampsia/eclampsia vs. gestational hypertension (HR 1.49), and older maternal age (35 vs. 25; HR 1.46) were associated with higher hazard; longer time to BP check (90 vs. 42 days; HR 0.52) was associated with lower hazard. About 40% had no documented 15–90-day postpartum BP check, and only 20% had a BP check at 7–14 days. Modeled 12-month cumulative incidence was 4.7% for optimal BP (110/65) and 13.0% for 140/90. The study noted limitations including retrospective data, missing BP measurements, and potential misclassification, and stated that guidelines were not consistently applied.

JPMorgan Chase is deploying AI across global operations to cut costs, streamline workflows, and enhance client services. It rolled out a proprietary generative AI platform to 200,000 employees and is investing about $18 billion in technology, largely in AI, machine learning, and cloud. AI supports retail banking, wealth and asset management, and institutional functions including credit, onboarding, fraud detection, and risk, with over 175 use cases. Challenges include compliance, transparency, legacy integration, and costs.

iPhones have faced battery-life frustration, reportedly worsened by iOS 11, which Wandera found drains battery more than twice as quickly as iOS 10. In its analysis of 50,000 iPhones and iPads, iOS 10 lasted 240 minutes versus 96 minutes on iOS 11. Some users switched back to iOS 10.3.3, but Wandera advised against it for security. Older iPhones may experience worse drain. Apple’s iOS 11.0.1 improved drain to 159 minutes, a 65% improvement; iOS 11.0.2 was not yet tested. Users can limit background app refresh and location services or use low power mode.

The passage is a collection of October 29, 2001 news items and columns about Enron. They report that Moody’s downgraded Enron’s senior unsecured debt to Baa2, two notches above junk, and put its commercial paper rating on review; Enron shares fell to multiyear lows; and Enron said it was in talks with banks for additional credit after drawing about $3 billion and buying back commercial paper. Analysts said lenders would demand harsher terms. Reports cite write-downs and equity charges from previously undisclosed partnership investments, an SEC inquiry, and the removal of CFO Andrew Fastow. European energy firms were wary of trading with Enron, and shareholder lawsuits were filed. Columns discuss Enron’s asset-light strategy, credibility, broadband trading, and talent concerns. One report says U.S. corporate credit quality is likely to worsen, with more downgrade reviews than upgrades.

The passage lists CS5535/CS5536 specification update items covering AuxOutputFull clearing, UDMA tACK timing, ATAC PRD alignment, LPC aborts, SMB NEGACK behavior, GLPCI retry counting, GPIO High Bank writes after suspend, SMBus hold time, missing LOWBAT_FLAG after standby, and Sleep_X/Sleep_Y deassertion. It gives implications and resolutions, including using interrupts, DWORD alignment, writing SMB_STS twice, Read-Modify-Write for GPIO registers, and programming delay counters. It also includes AMD legal, warranty, and trademark notices.

Connaught Public School in Hintonburg attempted a tunnel ball world record, with over 250 students playing at once for nearly half an hour, aiming to beat Australia’s record of 120. The event raised $10,000 for the school yard renewal project, with planned playground, basketball court, funnel ball net, grass, and tree improvements; Guinness verification is pending.

The passage includes a photo gallery ranking 25 cities by income needed to buy a home, using median sale prices, estimated monthly payments, and assumptions such as a 20-percent down payment and 3.75-percent 30-year fixed mortgage. It then reports that Seattle’s housing market is very hot and that a ValueInsured survey found 71 percent of Washington homeowners worried about a bubble, though the survey included only 1,079 people nationwide. In online digital advertising with real-time auctions, budget pacing aligns spending with campaign goals by setting a spending plan, monitoring actual spend, and correcting deviations in near real time. Auction dynamics, stochastic traffic, noisy signals, and changing market conditions make pacing challenging, and empirical tuning lacks stability and efficiency guarantees. This work designs a controller combining hysteresis control with proportional feedback. It contributes a bucketized hysteresis controller compared with a legacy variable-step pacing system, an analytical framework for parameter selection and personalized spend-rate tracking, and validation through real-world auction experiments. Related work includes optimization-based and feedback-control pacing; prior feedback approaches use proportional or integral adjustments, which can oscillate or require delicate tuning. The proposed Bucketized Hysteresis Controller discretizes error into bands and applies multiplicative updates in variable steps, inspired by bang-bang control and gain scheduling. In the setup, conversion probability is used in bidding, final_bid = max_bid × p(event), and pacing uses paced_final_bid = λ × final_bid with λ ∈ (0,1]. The baseline production controller updates λ multiplicatively using a variable scale α adapted via a fluctuation factor. The BHC calculates normalized error, discretizes its magnitude into bands with thresholds and gains, and updates λ accordingly.

NASA’s Dawn spacecraft released closest-ever images of Ceres, including Occator Crater and its bright salt deposits, or faculae, made of sodium carbonate. Dawn entered a new orbit in June, coming within 22 miles of Ceres, and captured Vinalia Faculae and Cerealia Facula. The origin of the faculae remains unclear, possibly from shallow mineral-laden water or deeper brines. The extended mission may provide answers through gravity, composition, and low-altitude observations. Dawn studied Vesta before orbiting Ceres since 2015. Low on fuel, it likely made its last ion-engine use and will remain in its final orbit rather than crash into Ceres to avoid Earthly contamination. The mission is estimated to last until the second half of 2018.

The Internal Bar Strength (IBS) indicator, calculated as (Close−Low)/(High−Low), measures the closing price’s relative position between the high and low and is a mean-reversion indicator: low values are considered bullish and high values bearish in the short term. The passage says IBS has worked remarkably well for over two decades, especially on stocks and stock indices, and less so on other asset classes; it does not work well on commodity stocks, commodity-heavy markets such as Norwegian and Australian stocks/indices, or gold and metal stocks. Backtests of simple IBS strategies on SPY and QQQ showed positive results, with QQQ compounding at 16.6% versus buy-and-hold’s 9%. The strategy may perform best in bear markets and volatile conditions; adding filters or other indicators can improve results, though curve-fitting risk exists. A weakness is execution, because entry is needed on the close; delaying to the next open reduces returns.

This lecture discusses experimentation and robust design of engineering systems. It contrasts Edward John Russell’s view favoring simple, one-question-at-a-time experiments with R.A. Fisher’s factorial and complex experiments at Rothamsted. Fisher’s work is presented as showing benefits of factorial designs, while noting scaling problems and introducing fractional factorial designs, projective properties, confounding, and trade-offs. The lecture covers robust parameter design to reduce performance variation by choosing control factor settings, and reviews Taguchi’s use of orthogonal arrays and crossed arrays of control and noise factors, combined arrays, and industry adoption, including Six Sigma and Ford’s design process. Research comparing adaptive one-factor-at-a-time experimentation with fractional factorial designs is presented; empirical and theoretical results indicate adaptive experiments can perform at least as well or better under conditions involving experimental error, interaction strength, and informed starting points. Ensembles of multiple OFATs and streamlined robust design are also discussed. Applications include agricultural equipment, sheet metal spinning, and paper airplanes, and a company audit showing unfinished robust design experiments is described. The lecture concludes that adaptive procedures give benefits and can be crossed with fractional factorial designs for robustness. The final portion is a Q&A about problem sets, quiz solutions, extensions, grades, and specific problem-set questions, including Taguchi versus response surface, noise factors, model fitting, and derivations.

Frustrated magnetic systems on geometrically constrained lattices exhibit rich phase diagrams due to complex interactions, especially biquadratic exchange. Classical bilinear-biquadratic Heisenberg models have been studied because biquadratic interactions are important in many magnets. For the isotropic triangular lattice, four phases were identified: ferromagnetic, nematic-like, 120°, and noncoplanar. This paper presents a complete phase diagram for a partially anisotropic triangular lattice of isosceles triangles, with two bilinear (K, L) and two biquadratic (A, B) parameters, reducing the problem to one triangular plaquette. It defines the Hamiltonian, angle constraints forming a tetrahedron, energy, minimization conditions, and tabulates ground states and energies for vertices, edges, faces, and interior, including ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, coplanar, and noncoplanar structures. Phase diagrams for Heisenberg and XY models are shown for selected A and L.

This article presents a theoretical framework on STEM education, project-based learning, design, architectural education/design studio, and technical drawing/visual communication, with literature examples. It states the study’s aim is to obtain new or meaningful results about STEM education by observing architectural education classes, gaining knowledge and judgments about architectural education, and making analogical inferences. The research question asks what prominent elements of the architectural design education method applied in the first year at BUU Faculty of Architecture are. The method is qualitative ethnographic research; the researcher observed first-semester Architectural Design Courses at BUU Faculty of Architecture as a participant observer, took unstructured observation notes for four weeks, and later conducted interviews with eight volunteer students. Data were content-analyzed, supported by validity/consistency procedures and theoretical triangulation/document analysis.

Observation findings are grouped under four themes: facing open-ended problems/student motivation and thinking outside the box; deepening thinking/understanding the problem through various solutions, in-depth research, strong arguments, and field research; gaining experience in portfolio preparation and presentation techniques; and meeting the culture of criticism through teacher statements on spatial errors, questioning design ideas, and emphasizing professional knowledge/skills. Interview findings indicate students perceived the course’s purpose as increasing conceptual/abstract thinking and listed difficulties including model making, expectation of perfection, lack of time, lack of motivation, hand drawing, presentations, invention, and carrying models.

In discussion, architectural education is related to STEM education through analogical inference. Six conclusions are drawn: give students opportunities to solve open-ended problems on their own from beginning to end; increase motivation and make STEM project courses graduation qualifications at K16/K12, while using problem-situation-focused STEM at K8/K4; ensure authenticity/real-life context with sustainability and value; at K4/K8, focus on deepening the problem and firsthand experience with materials/tools; add technical drawing/graphic courses to programs, including non-technical high schools; and at undergraduate level, support theory/practice paradigm change and institutional preparations such as jury-based assessment/evaluation.
