The paper discusses Indigenous futurities, envisioning, relationality, “layering the vision,” and protecting participant anonymity. Research included an anonymous online survey with 35 participants and face-to-face yarns with over 15 people, with the exact number withheld. Findings are re-presented through the story “Our Education, Our Way,” which includes quotes from anonymous participants and depicts community discussion of colonised education, Country as teacher, Aboriginal-controlled education, identity, belonging, and future generations.

The speaker says Darren protects Nick and was respectful of Rod Brind’Amour. Hartford has been a good hockey town, and Dallas embraced the Stars; enthusiastic fans create a hockey town. Guy Carbonneau’s story gives hope for here. A physical, defensive, scoring line is important on and off the ice.

Crystal Palace fought back from two goals down to draw 2-2 at home with Leicester City. Robert Huth and Jamie Vardy put Leicester 2-0 up, while Yohan Cabaye and Christian Benteke scored for Palace. The result left Palace above the relegation zone on 35 points from 32 games, two behind Leicester.

Meb Faber’s S&P 500 trend-following strategy uses the 200-day moving average: go long when price crosses above it and sell when it crosses below. It focuses only on price, ignoring news, earnings, valuations, sentiment, and interest rates. Paul Tudor Jones also calls the 200-day moving average useful for defense against losses. A 1960-to-present test shows the strategy avoided much of the 2008/09 financial crisis and COVID-19 drawdowns. A monthly version returned a 6.3% CAGR versus 7% buy-and-hold and had a 26% maximum drawdown in October 1987. The passage concludes the strategy works reasonably well and can keep up with long-term stock market returns.

The passage states that Congress has not appropriated funds for better antitrust enforcement; while the Department of Justice has done much, a special appropriation under the Attorney-General could accomplish more. It argues that reducing the tariff to address trusts would be ineffective and harmful, and that trust regulation should be separate from tariff revision. Economic policy should be stable but not fossilized, with the protective-tariff principle maintained and radical changes avoided. Tariff adjustments should preserve American business equality and wage standards. Reciprocity treaties are one means of readjustment; if not ratified, direct legislation or expert commission recommendations after investigation could make changes.

Due to increased business and demand for closer technical support, Elmatica is establishing a temporary department in South Africa, following a 245 percent sales increase over 2016, and plans a permanent team.

The text covers AGESA software integration and build models, including binary modules and source integration; call-out routing through a host-provided router; UEFI execution phases and libraries; toolchains; platform build options; PEI and DXE drivers, PPIs, and HOBs; stack and early macros; and AGESA entry procedures for reset, early, post, env, late, RTB, resume, and restore, along with required host call-outs for buffer allocation, deallocation, and reset.

This paper examines language teacher education across English as a Second Language, Bilingual Education, and World Language Education, arguing for a historical perspective on their distinctions, connections, and potential bridging. It applies Valdés’ framework of language curricularization to analyze theories, ideologies, policies, contexts, and core program elements. The authors describe a border-crossing curricular innovation in their own teacher education program: Phase 1 redesigned ESL methods toward translanguaging; Phase 2 created a combined ESL and World Languages methods course focused on Chinese; Phase 3 proposes future World Languages-to-Bilingual Education border crossing. The work advocates a heteroglossic vision, translanguaging, a multilingual turn, critical curricular analysis, language equity, and preparation of critically conscious language educators. It concludes by reflecting on factors enhancing and inhibiting the innovation and encouraging further border-crossings.

Construction crews on the $1.8 billion Las Vegas stadium project have exceeded minority hiring goals since November. An oversight committee heard that 54 percent of work hours went to minorities, women, and veterans, ahead of a 38 percent goal, and $91 million of $509 million in subcontracts went to 32 small businesses, surpassing a 15 percent goal. About 225 workers are hired, expanding to 500 by fall, with completion scheduled for summer 2020.

Microsoft Corporation’s Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2015 includes unaudited financial statements and notes. For the three and nine months ended March 31, 2015, revenue was $21,729 million and $71,400 million; net income was $4,985 million and $15,388 million; diluted EPS was $0.61 and $1.86. For the comparable 2014 periods, revenue was $20,403 million and $63,451 million; net income was $5,660 million and $17,462 million; diluted EPS was $0.68 and $2.08. Total assets were $176,683 million at March 31, 2015. The filing also covers investments, derivatives, fair value, business combinations including Nokia’s Devices and Services business and Mojang, debt, income taxes, restructuring, contingencies, stockholders’ equity, segment information, management’s discussion and analysis, and risk factors.

The lecture covers course logistics for 6.451: the course is offered on an alternate-year basis depending on interest and is videotaped for OCW, with permission sheets to be sent. Handouts include an information sheet, personal data sheet, first problem set due in a week, and chapters 1–3. Problem sets are weekly except before the exam and in the last week, count 15%, and are for practice. The TA is Ashish Khisti, with office hours Tuesday 5–7 in the Stata Center basement; he will guest lecture for lectures 2–4. The midterm is scheduled for Wednesday, March 16, counts one-third, and the final counts one-half. The prerequisite 6.450 is enforced. The course is described as a coding course within a communications context, focused on approaching capacity on the additive white Gaussian noise channel, covering major code classes and decoding algorithms. There is no text; the professor uses course notes. The lecture also discusses channel models, Shannon capacity, dB, conversion from continuous-time to discrete-time AWGN using orthonormal PAM, and spectral efficiency. Chapters 1–3 are orientation material.

This article compares dollar-cost averaging (DCA) and lump-sum investing using S&P 500 backtests from 2000 to 2019 with $60,000. It defines DCA as investing in installments over time and lump-sum investing as investing as early as possible. It cites a Morningstar study finding DCA beat lump-sum investing 27.8% of the time over 10-month periods and 10% over 10-year periods. In backtests, lump-sum investing grew $60,000 to $193,157 with a 6.02% CAGR and a 55% worst drawdown; DCA had a 5.5% CAGR. Reshuffling returns lowered DCA to $87,396 and a 1.9% CAGR, while lump-sum remained similar. The article concludes lump-sum investing is generally best and that randomness and sequence of returns can significantly affect DCA.

The passage presents nine Vanguard ETFs for ultimate diversification: BNDW, BNDX, BND, VTC, VNQI, VNQ, VXUS, VT, and VTI. It notes Vanguard’s role as a market leader, its founding by John Bogle, and the popularity of passive strategies. It backtests each ETF individually from inception and a diversified portfolio with annual rebalancing from 2007 to 2023, using dividend-adjusted quotes; $10,000 grew to $19,318. Portfolio returns were lower than the S&P 500 Total Return index, partly due to bond allocations. It briefly describes each ETF’s tracked index or objective and advises reading the prospectus to determine suitability.

The Weber State University Unity Conference, themed “Redacted: Navigating the Complexities of Censorship,” was canceled after presenters were told to remove mentions of “DEI,” “diversity,” “equity” and “inclusion” from slides days before the event. Sarah Herrmann and her student refused to present without those terms, and other faculty withdrew. Organizers canceled the conference on Oct. 1. Weber State officials said the Unity Conference was funded and organized by Student Access and Success, making it subject to HB 261, while academically sponsored events are exempt. Jessica Oyler explained that non-academic programming could not discuss certain prohibited discriminatory practices or take sides on legislation or policies. The faculty and staff union held an alternative event, where attendees were told content must adhere to HB 261. The university is considering restructuring future Unity Conferences under Academic Affairs or a college to exempt them from the law’s provisions.

The passage is a Motley Fool Money promotional article with compensation and advertising disclosures. It states that partner compensation may affect where and how products appear but not product ratings. It describes the Wells Fargo Active Cash® Card: unlimited 2% cash rewards, a $200 bonus after $500 in purchases in the first 3 months, 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases and qualifying balance transfers, then 18.99%, 23.99%, or 28.99% variable APR, $0 annual fee, up to $600 cell phone protection with a $25 deductible, and recommended good/excellent credit (670–850). It also lists Capital One Quicksilver terms: unlimited 1.5% cash back, 5% cash back on hotels, vacation rentals, and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel, $300 in welcome bonuses, 0% intro APR for 15 months, $0 annual fee, and no foreign transaction fees. It additionally lists an offer with 2% on purchases, $200 cash back after $1,500 in 6 months, 5% total cash back on hotel, car rentals, and attractions booked with Citi Travel, and 0% intro APR on balance transfers for 18 months.

The address reports gratitude for continued prosperity and discusses implementation of last session’s acts. Measures were adopted to preserve peace with Indians, protect frontier settlements, and secure treaty rights. Creek deputies met at Colerain but did not sell land; a new treaty confirmed engagements, trading houses, and military posts. Treaty posts with Britain were evacuated and occupied by U.S. forces; commissions addressed the St. Croix River and captures and condemnations. Spain’s boundary commissioner was appointed, but none for citizens’ claims. Agents were appointed for American seamen. Arrangements with Algiers were expected to succeed, and treaties with Tunis and Tripoli were sought. The address urges naval protection, gradual creation of a navy, encouragement of manufactures, agricultural boards, a national university, and a military academy. It calls for revising officers’ compensation. French cruisers and agents injured trade in the West Indies; the speaker wishes for friendly relations while protecting U.S. rights. It notes improved revenues, debt reduction, militia establishment, harbor security, and ends with congratulations and supplications for the government’s perpetuity.

This compilation of April 23, 2001 news items includes PG&E CEO Robert Glynn’s misreading of California electricity prices before Pacific Gas & Electric’s Chapter 11 filing; a proposed 1,200-MW coal plant in Bent County, Colorado; Saudi Oil Minister Ali al-Naimi’s planned meeting with U.S. Energy Secretary Spencer Abraham; Enron’s Dabhol Power unit meeting lenders over payment defaults and seeking approval to exit its Maharashtra project; ONGC disputing Enron’s Moon Prospect gas claim; and promoters halving the Mangalore Power Company project. Other items cover Spanish electricity market reforms, Karnataka power issues, and Asia/Pacific business briefs.

Eilish McCready, 25, from Glasgow, set up Fearless theatre school a year ago after graduating from an acting and performance course. The inclusive drama classes aim to help children develop confidence and social skills, including shy children and those with additional needs such as autism, without the pressure of end-of-year shows. Classes are kept small. McCready named the school Fearless because she had to be brave to start her own business. Parents report that the classes have helped children’s confidence and social skills. Lizanne Conway says her sons with autism have benefited, and Lisa Byrne says her shy daughter Rua has become more confident. Classes are held at Studio 93 in Glasgow.

Evercore will release its second quarter 2018 financial results on July 25, 2018, and host a conference call at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time that day. Ralph L. Schlosstein, John S. Weinberg, and Robert B. Walsh will review the results, followed by a question and answer session, with telephone and webcast access and replay details provided.

The passage compiles news reports from Oct. 23-24, 2001, largely concerning Enron’s financial situation. Enron might issue more stock to cover potential shortfalls in investment vehicles, though its treasurer said it could repay about $3.3 billion in notes through asset sales and might issue up to $1 billion in stock in a worst-case scenario. CEO Kenneth Lay sought to reassure investors amid an SEC inquiry into transactions involving CFO Andrew Fastow, while Enron’s stock fell. Enron also asked Citigroup to arrange a $750-million loan. Other items cover markets, energy, India, LNG shipping, tax stimulus, and class-action notices.

This winter, offshore fishing will feature sailfish, dolphin, wahoo, and kingfish, with live bait, kite fishing, and wire trace recommended. Inshore, jacks, tarpon, and spawning sheepshead will be in the inlet, beaches, and ICW, caught with shrimp or clams.

A study found that online images, videos, and text portray women as younger than men, especially in prestigious occupations. This distorted input influenced participants’ age estimates and ChatGPT outputs: the chatbot generated younger, less experienced resumes for female names and ranked them lower than male resumes. Using about 1.4 million online images and videos, text analysis, and experiments, researchers showed AI inherits and exacerbates age and gender bias. The findings could help explain the glass ceiling, and the passage notes that overlapping biases, such as gender and age or race and class, can compound discrimination.

The passage describes Michael Gayed’s SPY/XLU weekly rotation system, which switches between the S&P 500 and utilities based on past performance. It says rotation systems switch assets and are used in trend following and seasonality, often traded weekly or monthly. Gayed argues utilities are risk-averse, low beta, and interest-rate sensitive; they tend to outperform when interest rates fall or volatility rises and underperform when rate-rise expectations increase. The strategy outperformed since 1926, but its best years were before the paper was published. From 1999 to March 2014 it returned 6.7% annually versus 4.6% for buy-and-hold; since publication it lagged at 5.1% versus 10.4%. It did not recover from the 2020 COVID crash, and from 2021 its maximum drawdown was -23.6% versus SPY’s -23.9%. The passage concludes it underperformed after publication, but this may be short-lived and it may be too soon to say it stopped working.

Researchers are seeking to rebrand grape pomace as a renewable resource for producing antioxidants, grape oils and dietary fibers for health products. Grape pomace can pollute water and soil and attract pests, and the global wine industry produces about 14 million tons annually. Xu’s team is identifying technologies to extract, separate and identify nutrients from pomace and remove pesticides. They are testing polyphenols against foodborne pathogens and in sow diets, and found phenolic compounds added to high-fat foods inhibited lipid oxidation and extended shelf life. They aim to replace artificial antioxidants with natural grape antioxidants for “clean label” foods and make their performance comparable with EDTA.

Game is selling an Xbox One S (500GB) bundle for £249.99 with Forza Horizon 3, Tekken 7, Halo 5, and Gears of War 4. Amazon UK prices for the items total £297.10, a £47.11 saving. The Xbox One S received 4/5, praised for its small form factor, 4K upscaling, and value as a UHD Blu-ray player. The bundled games scored 5/5, 4/5, 4/5, and 4.5/5 respectively.

All initial two-dose phases began observer-blinded and later became open-label; booster doses were generally open-label, while a small reassigned Dose 3 booster group was observer-blinded. The study took place at 153 locations in 6 countries from 29 April 2020 to 10 February 2023. It included healthy children and adults aged 12 years and older without prior COVID-19 infection or COVID-19 vaccination. Phase 1 had 195 participants; Phase 2/3 had 46,406. In Phase 2/3, BNT162b2 was 95% effective in preventing COVID-19 from 7 days after Dose 2 versus placebo. BNT162b2 and BNT162b2SA produced immune responses as specified. Injection site reactions and systemic events were generally mild or moderate and temporary. Most medical problems were mild or moderate; few serious medical problems were considered related to study vaccine. No Phase 1 participants died; in Phase 2/3, deaths occurred from different causes and were not believed caused by BNT162b2. No Phase 3 participant without prior BNT162b2 died after receiving BNT162b2SA. Participants were followed up to 26 months, and the entire study lasted about 33 months.

NASA's Cassini completed the first of five close flybys of Saturn near the end of its 20-year mission, which will culminate in a one-way plunge into Saturn on September 15. The August 14 flyby passed 1,010–1,060 miles above Saturn's clouds; a second pass may come 120 miles closer. Instruments could gather atmospheric, temperature, aurora, vortex, and chemical data, and the team hopes to determine Saturn's day length. Cassini has spent 13 years at Saturn with 127 Titan flybys. With low fuel and concerns about crashing into Titan or Enceladus, the mission will end after a September 11 Titan encounter triggers its final descent.

This patent application claims priority to numerous U.S. patent applications and describes surgical systems, including smart energy devices, surgical hubs, modular communication, cloud analytics, generators, and ultrasonic devices. It provides methods for applying power to an ultrasonic transducer, measuring impedance, comparing it to a reference, classifying it, characterizing end-effector state, function, or contacted tissue, and adjusting power based on that characterization.

This MIT lecture introduces plasma diagnostics. Diagnostics are described as methods for gaining knowledge about plasma indirectly by inferring quantities from physical effects, since plasma density, temperature, and velocity cannot be directly measured. The course assumes prior plasma physics from 22.611 and will not redo derivations. Diagnostics are important because plasma experiments and fusion progress depend on measurement. Historical examples include the ZETA toroidal pinch, where neutron bursts were initially thought to indicate fusion but were not thermonuclear and came from MHD instabilities; this led to Thomson scattering. Thomson scattering was used to confirm tokamak temperatures of about 1 keV. The National Ignition Facility initially had few diagnostics, but later improved diagnostics accompanied ignition. Experimenters, computational researchers, and theorists need to understand diagnostics for uncertainty, code validation, data reduction, and testable predictions. Desired measurements include the full particle distribution, but theorists typically want moments such as density and average velocity, as well as magnetic fields. Diagnostics are limited: measurements are sparse in space and time, often line-integrated, filtered by instrument response, and may depend on poorly understood physics such as atomic data. The course focuses on principles rather than practical implementations. The lecture also includes an activity where participants plot plasma parameters and mention diagnostics.

The Rams are seeking permission from the Jaguars to interview Doug Marrone for their head coaching vacancy. Marrone went 1-1 as Jaguars interim coach, and Jacksonville may consider making him permanent head coach.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended March 31, 2015. Total net sales were $22,717 million, compared with $19,741 million for the same period in 2014. Operating income was $255 million, compared with $146 million. Net loss was $57 million, compared with net income of $108 million; basic and diluted loss per share were $0.12, compared with earnings per share of $0.23. Cash and cash equivalents at period end were $10,237 million. Operating activities used $1,499 million, investing activities used $1,847 million, and financing activities used $652 million for the quarter. The company reported segments North America, International, and AWS: North America net sales were $13,406 million and operating income was $517 million; International net sales were $7,745 million and operating loss was $76 million; AWS net sales were $1,566 million and operating income was $265 million. The filing also discusses acquisitions, long-term debt, commitments, legal proceedings, income taxes, and non-GAAP financial measures.

Tesla faced serious financial pressures in 2017–2018 as it ramped up Model 3 production. Despite Elon Musk’s April Fool’s bankruptcy tweet, Tesla was burning cash, and investors questioned whether it would need to raise additional capital. Founded in 2003, Tesla became a leading high-performance EV maker with the Roadster, Model S, Model X, and Model 3, and it expanded into batteries and acquired SolarCity. Although its market value rose, Tesla struggled to turn a profit, had generally negative operating cash flow, and repeatedly raised equity and debt; shares outstanding and long-term debt grew, especially from 2015 to 2017. Model 3 production forecasts were cut and the 5,000-cars-per-week target was delayed. Analysts questioned whether Tesla would need more capital; Musk said in 2018 it would not need an equity or debt raise that year. The company’s survival hinged on its need for capital and investors’ willingness to provide it.

NVIDIA Turing introduces GDDR6 memory, redesigned interface circuits, and optimizations delivering 14 Gbps signaling rates and 20% power efficiency improvement over GDDR5X in Pascal. It adds larger L2 caches, memory compression improvements, and approximately 50% effective bandwidth improvement over Pascal. The display engine supports DisplayPort 1.4a, 8K at 60 Hz, DSC 1.2, HDR tone mapping per BT.2100, NVENC HEVC 8K 30 fps, and NVDEC HEVC 4:4:4 and VP9. Turing includes USB Type-C and VirtualLink support for VR, and NVLink replaces MIO/PCIe for SLI in TU102/TU104.

Turing introduces RT Cores for real-time ray tracing, enabling hybrid rendering with rasterization, BVH traversal, ray/triangle intersection, and denoising. It works with NVIDIA RTX, DXR, OptiX, and Vulkan ray tracing APIs. NGX uses Tensor Cores for AI features such as DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez. DLSS uses deep neural networks trained on 64x supersampled images to improve image quality and performance. Other features include Mesh Shading with task and mesh shaders, Variable Rate Shading with content adaptive, motion adaptive, and foveated rendering, Texture Space Shading, and Multi-View Rendering.

Turing GPUs include TU102, TU104, TU106, and Tesla T4. TU104 has six GPCs, 48 SMs, 3072 CUDA Cores, 368 Tensor Cores, 48 RT Cores, and one x8 NVLink link. TU106 has three GPCs, 36 SMs, 2304 CUDA Cores, 288 Tensor Cores, 36 RT Cores, and no NVLink or SLI. RTX-OPS is a workload-based metric that derates Tensor operations 20%, CUDA cores 80%, RT cores 40%, and INT32 pipes 28%. Ray-traced shadows, ambient occlusion, and reflections, BVH acceleration, and denoising are also covered.

Hurricane Harvey damaged or destroyed up to a dozen critical wildlife habitats along the Texas Gulf Coast, including nesting sites, marshes, and coastlines. Agencies began assessments. Aransas refuge salt marshes for whooping cranes were damaged; Attwater refuge received about 50 inches of rain, with endangered prairie chickens possibly dropping from 60 to 10. Scientists factor climate change into management. Some marine species survived, oyster beds lost, dolphins possibly injured.

The study addresses limited research on whether planner-designed transit hierarchies match passenger usage. It proposes a method using smart card data to analyze public transit modal hierarchy from real travel patterns, demonstrated in the Seoul metropolitan area. The method classifies the first and last parts of a trip as ascending and descending stages based on half the total travel distance, analyzes transfers between modes, constructs ascending and descending transfer rate matrices, defines multimodal hierarchy distance, computes average hierarchical order, rescales values for comparison, and separates interzonal and intrazonal structures in multi-zonal systems. Unlike prior studies assuming spatial homogeneity, it does not assume homogeneity, allowing localized modes such as light rail and community buses to be considered.

The case study uses T-money data from November 12, 2019, for Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Incheon, with 10,264,700 trip chains and modes including walking, community bus, urban bus, intercity bus, light rail, and metro. Within Seoul, ascending and descending hierarchical orders showed no significant differences, with a consistent order: walking, community bus, urban bus, light rail, metro. In interzonal trips between Seoul and Gyeonggi/Incheon, the order was community bus lowest, then urban bus, light rail, metro, and intercity bus highest. Including intercity bus lowered the relative hierarchy of other modes. The hierarchical order of intercity bus and metro differed between regions, and urban bus had a lower hierarchical position in Gyeonggi/Incheon than in Seoul.

In Jerry Wayne Hill v. Morehouse Parish Police Jury & Titan Indemnity Company, a Louisiana appellate court reviewed claims arising from a T-intersection accident in which Bradd Rudolph drove into Bayou Bartholomew and Michael Hill drowned. The trial court found the police jury knew of the intersection’s danger and failed to provide adequate warnings, assigned 20% fault to the police jury and 80% to Rudolph, and awarded damages. The appellate court affirmed the factual findings, amended the fault allocation to 65% Rudolph and 35% police jury, and affirmed the general damage award. Concurring opinions disagreed with certain observations, and rehearing was denied.

This study used Shareyourpaper and Unpaywall to assess the potential of self-archiving (green OA) to increase discoverability of clinical trial results publications from German university medical centers. From the IntoValue cohort, 1,897 unique publications published between 2010 and 2020 were analyzed. Overall, 54% were openly accessible via a journal or repository, while 46% were closed-access. Among closed-access publications, 85% had a self-archiving permission in Shareyourpaper to archive the accepted or published version in an institutional repository, mostly the accepted version after a 12-month embargo. Realized green OA was estimated at 16%. The study concluded that much of the closed-access clinical trial results could be made openly accessible through self-archiving, though the potential remains largely unrealized; limitations include reliance on Unpaywall and Shareyourpaper accuracy and the OA definitions used.

Natural gas settled at $3.27/MMBtu, staying in a descending wedge since March highs. Europe’s LNG pivot boosts U.S. exports, while surpluses weigh on domestic prices. Seasonal softness and Canadian supply shocks keep volatility elevated.

U.S. markets fell Tuesday; Canada’s S&P/TSX composite also closed down, but materials and gold cushioned the decline. A three-per-cent U.S. 10-year Treasury yield and company concerns contributed to the U.S. selloff.

Ontario Premier Kathleen Wynne said at Humber College that if people don’t vote, an older white person will. The passage calls this ageist, racist, identity politics, and pandering, citing Ali Taghva and labour lawyer Sunira Chaudhri. It notes older people vote more and visible minorities seem to vote less, but says demonizing one group to increase another’s turnout is shameful; it suggests Wynne engage all groups and create a “safe space” for older white people.

Global stocks rose after Fed Chair Janet Yellen said the U.S. central bank could raise rates as soon as next month. European indexes gained and Wall Street futures were little changed. Analysts called her comments hawkish. Chinese inflation rose, raising rate-tightening concerns. Asian markets mostly gained, though Shanghai and India fell. The dollar rose against the yen and euro, while crude oil declined.

This introductory lecture for MIT course 15.S12 welcomes students to a course on blockchain and money. Gary Gensler says the semester focuses on blockchain and finance, asks about students’ cryptocurrency ownership and blockchain experience, and assigns anonymous cards about their goals. He discusses internet and cryptography history, failed digital currency efforts, PayPal, Alipay, and M-Pesa, and identifies Satoshi Nakamoto’s 2008 peer-to-peer electronic cash proposal as addressing how to move value peer-to-peer without a trusted third party. He defines blockchain as time-stamped append logs secured by cryptography, hash functions, digital signatures, and consensus protocols, mentioning the Byzantine Generals problem and the Bitcoin pizza story. He covers money’s roles, finance’s functions, blockchain opportunities and problems such as performance, privacy, interoperability, governance, and commercial use cases. He compares permissioned and permissionless blockchains, notes crypto finance’s size relative to capital markets, and outlines public policy issues, course structure, and requirements.

Digital laggards tightly control data access, hoard data as power, store it in silos, and favor business judgment or a “culture of genius” over data-driven decisions. Digital leaders use measurement to learn, encourage collecting and examining data, track progress through data-driven metrics, and often combine metrics with 360-degree reviews. A retail case study describes a company that upgraded data systems after acquisition and implemented real-time sales reporting three times daily to support data-driven decisions. Digital laggards set aspirational, insufficiently data-grounded goals, avoid measurement, and focus on process, which stifles innovation. Digital leaders align the organization through transparent, data-driven objectives and shared goals, often via top-down and bottom-up processes, though they can risk overanalysis. Laggards fail to connect goals with strategy, causing misalignment. Data culture can align organizations vertically and horizontally. Leaders emphasize data culture as central, aligning beliefs, values, and actions; laggards acknowledge its importance but face entrenched habits, skills gaps, and insufficient top-down focus. Transformation is difficult but possible, and the passage identifies four patterns: data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant.

Interest has resurged in psychedelics for psychiatric treatment. MDMA-assisted therapy showed reduced PTSD symptoms in Phase II trials, received FDA breakthrough designation, and a Phase 3 study confirmed safety and efficacy.

Amazon.com, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated January 28, 2016, announcing its fourth quarter 2015 and year ended December 31, 2015 financial results. Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2 include the press release and information regarding non-GAAP financial measures.

Exchange-rate exposure affects Ireland. Low euro/dollar brings record American tourists; low sterling/euro deters UK travellers. Brexit raised concerns. Importers, exporters, tourism, holidaymakers and SMEs are affected. Sterling traded at 76p pre-Brexit and near 91p now; euro rose from $1.05 to $1.18. Euro appreciation exceeds ECB preference; low exchange rates supported export recovery. Historically euro averaged $1.35; parity with sterling is implied in 12–18 months if that recurs, though outlook is uncertain. Tourism has limited hedging; UK importers benefit and need hedging; weak sterling hurts car industry and UK exporters. Firms should incur costs in the currency of the selling country.

Cleveland Browns coach Kevin Stefanski was noncommittal Wednesday on whether rookie Shedeur Sanders would be the team’s backup quarterback after Cleveland traded Joe Flacco and a 2026 sixth-round pick to Cincinnati for a 2026 fifth-round pick. The trade left Sanders and fellow rookie Dillon Gabriel as the only quarterbacks on the active roster, and Cleveland listed Sanders as its No. 2 quarterback on the week’s unofficial depth chart. Stefanski said he would let the week play out before deciding on the QB2 role and would not say whether Zappe would be signed to the active roster for Sunday. The passage also includes numerous other NFL headlines.

A University of Michigan study of more than 2,000 older Americans found that 21% of women and 10% of men in Generation X and the tail end of the Baby Boom, now in their 50s and early 60s, met criteria for ultra-processed food addiction, higher than adults age 65 to 80 (12% of women, 4% of men). Using the modified Yale Food Addiction Scale 2.0, the study linked ultra-processed food addiction to overweight, fair or poor mental or physical health, and social isolation. Researchers suggest 1980s marketing of diet-focused processed foods may have contributed, and warn that children today could face even higher addiction rates later in life.

The Bank of England will keep the £5 polymer note and issue the £10 as planned, despite animal-fat concerns. It confirmed tiny tallow traces, rejected costly alternatives, and delayed £20 contracts for plant-based options pending a 2017 decision.

Qarlinngua is a pants-like rock formation in salt water in Canada’s Arctic. The Arctic Bay community calls it “Qarlinngua,” meaning “like pants” in Inuktitut. It is in an uninhabited area of the Brodeur Peninsula on northern Baffin Island, about 80 to 90 kilometres southwest of Arctic Bay, Nunavut. Local hunter Max Kalluk submitted a photo to CBC North; the internet and an Iqaluit tourism office initially doubted it was real, but local sources confirmed the arch exists. It is reachable only by boat, about a four- to five-hour ride, during a small annual window when summer sea ice breaks up. Kalluk estimates it is more than 50 metres tall. Geologists describe it as a sea arch or natural arch formed by wind and water erosion; horizontal layers indicate sedimentary rock or sandstone, with quartz likely resisting erosion. Arctic Bay Adventures is the only tour company taking visitors there, and Nunavut’s tourism director plans to promote it. Geologists estimate it could collapse in decades or thousands of years.

This study examines career transition adaptation and impacts among lecturers and civil servant education personnel who take on additional campus managerial roles in Indonesian higher education institutions. It notes limited prior discussion of individual needs, higher education contexts, and education personnel transitions. Using an interpretive qualitative grounded theory approach with snowball-sampled informants and NVIVO coding, it identifies adaptation through Schlossberg’s 4 S factors—situation, self, support, and strategies—with new dimensions including new tasks, strengths/weaknesses, and organizational support; these factors relate reciprocally. Impacts include changes in behavior, role, learning, and perception, including dual roles, role sacrifice, burnout, motivation, competence, self-discipline, and new identity, with individual performance decline in leadership/functional positions. Findings indicate two career anchors, competence and managerial, differing from Schein. Managerial implications include applying Schlossberg’s theory to lecturers and education staff and using the pattern for bureaucratic simplification. Limitations include qualitative non-generalizability, no race/gender, and researcher as instrument.
Apple Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated September 10, 2019, reporting that Bob Iger resigned from Apple Inc.’s Board of Directors on September 10, 2019.

The speaker discusses returning to play after an injury. He expected head hits because opponents jump when they hit, but his concern was being run from behind into the boards. He felt comfortable after early shifts, played well, but ran out of steam in the third period. He felt fine the next day after possible dehydration or cramping from travel to Edmonton and Denver for a CT scan, which was treated after the game. He cannot change his playing style and aims to contribute to team success. A doctor reviewed the CT scan and said his current risk is no different than it will be in September, about three and a half months after the injury. He expects a normal home routine to help. The team needs better execution, desire, and passion after a tough overtime loss; he expects a better, harder effort at home with a chance to win the Stanley Cup. The CT scan was arranged after Doug’s injury, and a doctor on the family plane reassured his family.
The judgment for the plaintiff was affirmed with costs on the trial judge’s opinion.

This bibliometric analysis used Scopus data from 2013–2023 to examine mathematics anxiety in mathematics education, with 324 journal articles remaining after filtering and analysis using VOSviewer and Biblioshiny. The study aimed to describe trends, topics, journal sources, authors, and international collaborations. Publications grew yearly, peaking in 2022 with 56 documents. Social sciences (35.1%) and psychology (30.7%) were the leading subject areas. Network visualization showed seven clusters with 53 items connecting mathematics anxiety to cognitive and psychological variables. Frontiers in Psychology published the most on the theme, and most journals were Q1–Q2. Garcia-Santillan was the most productive author with 10 publications and 143 citations. The United States had the most publications and collaboration, while Germany was cited the most. Turkey, Indonesia, and the Netherlands had single-country publications; the United States, Spain, Germany, and the United Kingdom had single- and multiple-country publications. The University of Barcelona was the most relevant affiliate with 23 documents. The conclusion identified mathematics anxiety/math anxiety as the most studied topic, Frontiers in Psychology as the most publishing journal, Garcia-Santillan as the most productive author, the United States as most research/collaboration-active, Germany as most cited, and the University of Barcelona as most relevant affiliate. Limitations include using only Scopus and only article document type.

North Korea warned the US it was ready to hit back with nuclear attacks while displaying new intercontinental and submarine-launched ballistic missiles at Kim Il-sung’s 105th birth anniversary. An official said it would answer all-out war with all-out war. China warned conflict could break out at any moment.

NVIDIA Corporation filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended July 26, 2020. For the second quarter, revenue was $3,866 million, net income was $622 million, and diluted net income per share was $0.99. For the first half, revenue was $6,946 million, net income was $1,539 million, and diluted net income per share was $2.47. Results include the Mellanox acquisition completed on April 27, 2020, with total purchase consideration of $7,134 million; Mellanox contributed approximately 14% of consolidated revenue. Reportable segments changed to Graphics and Compute & Networking. Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at the end of the second quarter were $10.98 billion. The report also discusses COVID-19 impacts, debt, intangible assets, stock-based compensation, taxes, leases, and legal proceedings.

The passage describes a detection model training method, apparatus, and terminal device. An initial training model includes an initial detection model and an adaptive model. A training sample includes source domain data with first images having a first identifier for target object presence and a second identifier for domain, and target domain data with second images having a third identifier for domain. The initial detection model determines target object presence from first-image features, and the adaptive model determines image domains. A loss function value is calculated from the detection result, domain classification result, and identifiers, and a parameter value is adjusted to obtain a final detection model. Using unlabeled target domain data increases the training sample size and improves detection model accuracy.

The passage is an email containing May 24–25, 2001 news headlines and articles related to Enron. The articles report on Enron’s Washington influence, Kenneth Lay’s disputed conversation with FERC Chairman Curtis Hebert Jr. about electricity deregulation, Hebert’s possible replacement, Enron’s Dabhol project dispute with the Maharashtra State Electricity Board over unpaid bills and contract cancellation, and related Indian negotiations. Other items cover California energy politics, market performance, business-school interest in energy, and an El Paso gas-price hearing.

Teams must prepare for defensive, even, and offensive jump balls. Defensive jump balls occur when the opponent has a definite advantage; players should move and rotate early, watch the jumper’s eyes and hand, and maintain contact with the jumper. Alignments and rotations include box and diamond rotations, defensive alignments vs. box and diamond, clockwise or counterclockwise rotation on a predetermined signal, and the “Y” alignment with two players back. If the opponent gains possession, a defensive stop is paramount. Even jump balls resemble offensive rebounds: players box out, establish inside position, anticipate and rotate early, watch the jumper, and rotate clockwise or counterclockwise on a predetermined signal. Offensive jump balls can use set plays when a team has a 6-inch or greater height advantage; generally tip forward to the biggest player, maintain defensive balance, and flow into offense if no good shot is available. Proven plays include Possession, Double Tap, Split, Jumper Fly, Forward Fly, Spread, Tandem, and Loop.

Apple removed several ICE-related tracking and documentation apps from its App Store, and developers say they are appealing or fighting the bans. Some apps remain available through Google Play and websites. Apple has not commented; a report said Apple cited a guideline against defamatory or mean-spirited content. Google also removed such apps and reportedly considers ICE officers a vulnerable group. Legal experts said the apps are protected speech, while researchers warned about centralized platform control.

Former Tropical Depression 02W made landfall in the eastern Visayas on April 15, weakened to a remnant low over the Philippines, and exited into the South China Sea. NASA's Terra satellite captured its elongated clouds on April 17; JTWC reported a compact closed circulation moving west, with wind shear and drier air expected to prevent re-intensification.

The Supreme Court considered whether the double jeopardy clause prohibits separate convictions and sentences under 18 U.S.C. §§ 924(c) and 924(j) for the same conduct. The parties agreed that lesser-included offenses generally cannot both be punished unless Congress clearly intended cumulative punishment, and that Congress clearly intended 924(c) to be cumulative with its underlying crime. They disputed whether such intent exists for 924(c) and 924(j). Arguments focused on § 924(c)(1)(D)(ii)’s consecutive-sentence language and § 924(c)’s “in addition to” language. Some justices questioned whether those provisions suffice. The government said § 924(j) lacks language authorizing cumulative punishment for the predicate offense. McCloud cited statutory structure and purpose, while Gorsuch questioned the clear-indication requirement.

Rocky View County faces a $1 million transportation shortfall. Education Minister David Eggen said the province could be open to parents paying bus fees despite new legislation. Bill 1 eliminated bus fees for students living 2.4 kilometres or more from their school. Rocky View Schools surveyed parents on options; many parents expressed willingness to pay fees. Its April 12 decision deadline could be pushed back.

This section provides TI mechanical, packaging, and orderable information for designated devices; it is current available data and subject to change. Notes cover product status, preproduction material type, RoHS values, lead finish/ball material, MSL/peak reflow, and part marking. It also lists carrier-tape dimensions, pitch, and pin 1 orientation, and includes TI information/disclaimers: information is as of the date provided, may be based on third-party information, carries no warranties, limits TI liability to annual purchase price, and resources are provided “AS IS” for skilled developers and are subject to change and applicable terms.

SSD is a chronic mental disorder affecting about 1% of the global population and ranking among the top ten causes of disease burden. Diagnosis is often subjective, and there are no widely applicable objective biomarkers. The study addressed challenges in rs-FC MRI classifiers: accuracy, generalisability, across-session variability, and specificity. It used large harmonized data from four institutions, LASSO, a voting method, and spatial averaging of 100 classifiers, and tested disorder specificity. Discovery and validation datasets included 1,015 and 683 participants after exclusions. FC diagnostic effects were reproducible across independent cohorts. LASSO classifiers achieved 79.6% accuracy and AUC 0.876 in discovery, and 77.3% accuracy and AUC 0.824 in validation. Voting classifiers had higher sensitivity than LASSO, with AUC 0.841, not significantly different. Forty-seven important FCs were identified, and mean FC relationships were maintained for 44 of 47 in validation. Frequent ROIs showed laterality imbalance except in the cerebellum. Sensitivity by severity was highest in the marked subgroup, with less imbalance for voting classifiers.

Amazon’s mobile accessory kit allows wireless earbuds and wearables to integrate Alexa. Jabra Elite 65t, priced at $170, are among the first earbuds to use it. Unlike Google Assistant and Siri, Alexa is not native to a mobile operating system, and testing found limitations when tethered to a smartphone.

The earbuds currently work with Alexa only on Android, with iOS support in Jabra’s Sound+ app coming soon. Alexa in the earbuds cannot make phone calls or access popular music streaming services such as Spotify, iHeartRadio, TuneIn, or Sirius XM; Amazon Music is the only supported streaming service. Music can be started by voice, but there is no built-in phone option to pause or change it. Multi-room audio control works. Calls can be answered by voice, but calling is not supported; text messages and Drop In are unavailable. Reminders are unsupported, and timers and alarms do not produce auditory or visual notifications. The earbuds can also toggle to Google Assistant or Siri, which offer more advanced notification, messaging, and navigation features. Alexa provides traffic information but no navigation. Voice shopping is a strength, including reordering and package updates.

The Elite 65t deliver strong sound quality and a comfortable fit, with a HearThrough ambient sound function. Battery life is 5 hours per charge and 10 additional hours from the case, short of the 24 total hours claimed for Pixel Buds and AirPods. There is no tracker feature if lost. The conclusion is that Alexa performs poorly when not native to the operating system; the Elite 65t have great sound but do not provide a great Alexa experience for calls, music, reminders, or navigation, though feature updates are said to be coming.

Shohei Ohtani was named the Dodgers' starting pitcher for Game 1 of the 2025 NLDS against the Phillies, facing Christopher Sanchez. It is his first-ever postseason pitching appearance. During the 2025 season, Ohtani pitched 14 games, going 1-1 with a 2.87 ERA, 62 strikeouts and 15 earned runs in 47 innings. Manager Dave Roberts hoped Ohtani could pitch through six and into the seventh. The game is scheduled for Saturday, October 4, at 6:38 p.m. ET and will air on TBS and truTV, streamed on HBO Max.

Following the Las Vegas mass shooting, country musicians and fans debated guns and safety. Charlie Daniels called it an anomaly, saying the gunman was a “nut” and fear would mean the bad guys won. Jason Aldean was performing at the Route 91 Harvest festival when a gunman fired from a nearby hotel, killing 58 and injuring more than 500. The debate included country music’s responsibility and N.R.A. ties. Rosanne Cash wrote an essay urging country musicians to stand up to the N.R.A. Daniels supported N.R.A.-backed bump stock regulations but opposed stricter gun laws, criticized gun-control politicians, and cited Chicago, saying such laws would leave people defenseless.

Digital leaders encourage sensible risk-taking and experimentation, see their firms as learning organizations that must adapt, and value data and continuous feedback. They recognize some risks are too costly, so they plan carefully, and they invest in long-term individual development, especially critical thinking skills, despite delayed payoffs.

Inspired by Richard Keen’s post on eclipses, Willis Eschenbach used Mauna Loa Observatory direct solar radiation data since about 1980 to examine atmospheric clarity. He describes extracting maximum solar energy from minute-by-minute data. He notes that at MLO, apart from volcanic eruption effects, atmospheric clarity has been unchanged since 1980, and says this is not true at MLO even if Keen is right globally. Comparing volcanic and non-volcanic periods, he finds El Chichon and Pinatubo produced very similar maximum and average solar radiation results. During volcanic periods, maximum energy through the upper atmosphere was significantly lower and average downwelling total solar radiation was about 24.5 W/m2 less. His theory predicted clouds would rearrange to offset volcanic aerosols; he reports clouds prevented a decrease from about 11AM to 4PM, with 1PM solar input higher during volcanic periods, increasing downwelling by about 7 W/m2, but a loss of about 25 W/m2 remained. MLO temperatures were unchanged over two years with lower solar radiation, and Hilo, Molokai, Barber’s Point, and Lihue showed no eruption cooling. He says he does not know why and suggests climate responses tend to restore the status quo. An update says wind speed differences were within uncertainty. Data came from GISS and MLO FTP; methods converted solar data to ten-minute intervals and separated volcano/no-volcano periods.

The speaker calls Winnipeg a great Canadian market with passionate fans, good crowds, and a strong organization under Mr. Chipman. He recalls the old Winnipeg Arena, a whiteout and “we want the Jets” chants against San Antonio, and later the MTS Centre. He prefers a smaller rink with fans to Atlanta’s barely filled building. He also discusses telling Henrik and Daniel apart and his shooting approach against Thomas.

Energy sector trading involves gaining exposure to multiple energy stocks for diversification and profits, either by buying an ETF such as XLE or VDE or by building a portfolio of energy stocks. The S&P 500 energy sector includes oil and natural gas companies involved in exploration, refining, distribution, and related equipment, materials, and services. As of July 18, 2022, the energy sector had a one-year total return as high as 52.81%, compared with about -9.28% for the S&P 500. Two XLE trading strategies are described with trade counts, average gains, win rates, max drawdowns, profit factors, and returns. The sector is described as difficult to trade but potentially useful for diversification.

The article says Toronto Stock Exchange financials had a choppy March and down-trending April, with big five banks and several small-cap lenders down from February highs. It compares five big banks and five small-cap financials using beta, earnings yield, dividend yield, payout ratio, and dividend history. The big five banks passed the dividend-history test; First National, Home Capital, and Equitable cut dividends, while Atrium and MCAN maintained or increased dividends and had yields above 7%. In the ranking, MCAN placed first, CIBC second, and Atrium third, while Equitable ranked worst. Pros of small-cap lenders include higher dividend yields and smaller price swings; cons include lower liquidity and less diverse business models. The author discloses being long AMIVF, CM, TD, and BNS.

The Hawk Offense consists of a wing isolation, a high post shuffle cut, and a weakside post up; it is similar to the UCLA Offense because a guard cuts to the basket off a high post back screen. The passage outlines defensive fundamentals against dribble penetration, high post shuffle cuts, and low post techniques, plus strategies: basic NBA Show & Recover and All Out SOS Disruption. In Show & Recover, defenders sag/show, force the cutter behind the screen, chase over the pick, recover, and assume pass-denial positions; phases cover one-on-one wing isolation, high post shuffle cut, down screen, and final matchups. In All Out SOS Disruption, the defense traps the ballhandler in the sideline wing area. It lists trap, pass-out-of-trap, matching-up rotations, contact switches against shuffle and down screens, and post/base-go-red trap rotations.

AMD has released two high-end graphics cards, Radeon RX Vega 64 and Vega 56, as competition for Nvidia. Vega 56 is pitched against the GTX 1070 and Vega 64 against the GTX 1080; AMD says Vega 64 is not a GTX 1080 Ti beater, and Nvidia is likely to retain the single-card performance crown. The passage also notes pricing differences, AMD’s CrossFire and X399/Threadripper PCI-E lane support, and FreeSync and Enhanced Sync advantages, with AMD claiming improved minimum frame rates.

Madison Snap and William Francis were convicted and fined $50 each for unlawfully, willfully, and wantonly shooting and wounding a mare. The mare was trespassing in an inadequately fenced field of oats. The court held that damage by the animal does not justify injuring it, and affirmed the conviction and judgment.

Old paper £10 notes will cease being legal tender in the UK on 1 March; people can later exchange them for polymer notes at banks, building societies, post offices or the Bank of England, possibly with ID. The new polymer £10, featuring Jane Austen, entered circulation on 14 September.

The passage explains that the safety is a defensive back positioned deeper than other defenders, serving as the last line of defense against big plays. Safeties generally divide into free safety and strong safety, though some coaches use the terms interchangeably. They cover passes, help against the run, and sometimes cover athletic players one-on-one. Free safeties often roam the middle and have more speed, while strong safeties tend to be stockier, play closer to the line, and tackle more against the run. Safeties need coverage skills, tackling, speed, athleticism, and communication. Notable safeties mentioned include Troy Polamalu, Ed Reed, Ken Houston, Steve Atwater, Ronnie Lott, Brian Dawkins, Emlen Tunnell, Larry Wilson, and Sean Taylor. The position is described as important for defense confidence, turnovers, and field control.

Researchers said Australia’s Great Barrier Reef has recovered from near-extinction five times in 30,000 years, shifting seaward or landward as sea levels changed. Fossil data from 16 sites indicate it moved 20 cm to 1.5 m yearly. Death events resulted from exposure, sea-level rise, and sediment. The reef may be resilient, but scientists fear current sea-surface temperature and acidification changes are too fast. In 2016, a heatwave killed nearly a third of its coral; bleaching threatens corals.

The passage describes a report by Jaber Mustafa and Younis Bukhari, affiliated with the Ministry of Education, following the 2024 Arab Summit in Bahrain. It cites a 2018 UNESCO report that over 10 million Arab children aged 5–15 are out of school and proposes the “Hope” initiative for remedial and preventive solutions. The report focuses on conflict-affected Arab regions, using the Syrian conflict as an example and aiming to help children, including Gazan children. It outlines significance areas such as inclusivity, hope, mental health, resilience, educational and psychosocial challenges, long-term national recovery, and proactive education. The literature review states conflict disrupts early childhood education through displacement, insecurity, school destruction, and inequitable access; in Syria, UNICEF estimates more than two million children were deprived of education in 2021, schools faced about 4,000 attacks since 2011, and nearly 400,000 Syrian refugee children in Turkey are out of school. It also notes psychological and developmental impacts and resource, teacher, and curriculum challenges. The methodology used triangulation with interviews and a survey, including a case study of Ahmed in Alkhabor. Results report disrupted schooling, scarce resources, trauma, limited psychosocial support, and community learning efforts. Proposed solutions include immediate emotional and academic remedies and a proactive, sustainable Hope Initiative. The conclusion states education in conflict zones is both a casualty of war and a beacon of hope, and the Hope Initiative combines immediate interventions with long-term educational frameworks and collaboration.
Jane Goodall died October 1 at 91; her legacy includes enduring skeletons.

After the September 19 earthquake, increased activity from Popocatépetl caused stress in Morelos communities. Authorities advised Tetela del Volcán residents to prepare for a possible eruption. In Hueyapan, 18 kilometers away and hard hit by the quake, residents were scared and some did not want to leave home. Many lost homes or suffered damage; Araceli Soberanes Estrada continued weaving after losing rooms, and state representatives offered help selling her creations. Ashfall was reported in Tetela del Volcán and Zacualpan de Amilpas.

Sean "Diddy" Combs was sentenced in Manhattan to 50 months in prison and a $500,000 fine on two prostitution-related Mann Act counts for transporting sex workers and girlfriends across state lines for drug-fueled sex performances he called "freak offs." A jury convicted him on those counts but cleared him of sex trafficking and racketeering conspiracy. The judge said his good works could not erase evidence that he abused women physically, emotionally, and psychologically. Combs apologized to victims and family. Prosecutors sought at least 135 months; his defense sought no more than 14 months. He also faces civil lawsuits.

The passage presents backtests on DAX 40 and Euro Stoxx 50 futures expiration. Both expire the third Friday of March, June, September, and December. Expiration weeks generally outperformed random weeks: DAX 40 averaged +0.39% with a 57% win ratio versus +0.12% random, and Euro Stoxx 50 averaged +0.3% with a 54% win ratio versus +0.18% random. December was best for both; June was a big loss for Euro Stoxx 50. For DAX 40 after futures expiration, the backtest used 100% margin, four trades yearly, buying at expiration Friday’s close and selling one week later, with no commissions or slippage; average gain was -0.1% and win ratio 47%. The month breakdown mentions September and March as good, June as a small loss, and September as worst. Expiration-week markets are more volatile due to pin risk. DAX 40’s high volume makes it attractive, and post-expiration patterns can inform strategies.

The Second Circuit affirmed Defendant Israel’s conviction and sentence. The court found no abuse of discretion in the district judge’s refusal to recuse, as there was no actual or apparent partiality based on her retaining the case, a docketing error, her adjournment remarks, or her recusal from a related bankruptcy case. The court also rejected challenges to the sentence, including bias, denial of a downward departure for medical needs, insufficient cooperation credit, and length. Given the criminal history and money involved, the twenty-year sentence was within permissible discretion. All claims were meritless.
UC1825BEVM-CVAL uses an RCD clamp for switch-node voltage. R/C starting values depend on allowed overshoot and Equations 30–32; Kclamp 1.5 permits ~50% overshoot.

The disclosure relates to silicone-based elastomeric compositions containing carbon-based particles, particularly dispersed oxidized carbon black, and methods of preparing them from hydrophilic carbon black particles and curable hydrophobic silicone pre-polymers. Methods include treating carbon black with a dispersant miscible in the pre-polymer and having carbon-black-affinic moieties, mixing to form a dispersed composition, and addition-curing or condensation-curing. The passage also describes curable and cured compositions, articles, and specified properties and ranges for carbon black particles, dispersants, and cured compositions.

The passage covers design requirements and recommendations for an ADS8860 ADC application. Specified conditions include VS± = ±15 V, VLVDD = 5.3 V, VLVSS = GND, and ADC REFIN = 5 V. It describes three filters: an input PGA filter for EMI/RFI, a CFB filter with PGA 6.67-kΩ feedback resistors, and an ADS8860 input charge-reservoir RC filter. CFB = 75 pF gives a nominal 318-kHz cutoff, changing to 277 kHz at high resistor tolerance. The PGA848 front end has nominal f–3dB bandwidth of 318 kHz, 277 kHz at high tolerance, and –0.1-dB flatness to 41 kHz. The ADS8860 requires 0-V to 5-V full-scale input; PGA848 REF is set to 2.5 V using a REF6250 5-V reference through a 10-kΩ-to-10-kΩ ±0.05%, ±5-ppm/°C divider, buffered by an OPA192 in a dual-feedback configuration with RF = 2 kΩ, CF = 2 nF, RISO = 20 Ω, a 22-nF bypass capacitor, and 86° phase margin. Power supply recommendations specify PGA848 nominal ±15 V, with supply voltages higher than 40 V (±20 V) permanently damaging the device. Layout guidelines include symmetric input paths, bypass capacitors, separated traces, minimized leakage and parasitic capacitance, minimized thermal junctions, and distance from thermal sources. The document also covers TINA-TI simulation software, documentation support, support resources, and trademarks.

In Brooks v. Missouri Pacific Railroad Co., petitioner’s apprenticeship was interrupted by military service. He sought a North Little Rock seniority date of November 3, 1955. The District Court found promotion was automatic and that, but for his military service, he would have completed his apprenticeship in 1955 and been hired as a journeyman mechanic at North Little Rock. The Court of Appeals reversed. The Court reversed the Court of Appeals for the reasons stated in Tilton, holding that the possibility that supply and demand might have prevented an otherwise automatic promotion should not defeat the veteran’s seniority claim. The cause was remanded.

U.S. stocks rose, led by the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, as technology and semiconductor gains offset energy weakness. Investors remained cautious about a possible government shutdown, which could delay economic data and complicate Federal Reserve decisions. Despite hawkish remarks and tempered easing expectations, markets still priced in a modest rate cut while watching congressional shutdown talks.

Arkady Babchenko, a Russian journalist reported shot dead in Kiev, appeared alive at a news conference, saying his murder was staged to foil an alleged Kremlin hit plot. Ukrainian authorities said a detained Ukrainian citizen was allegedly paid $40,000 by Russian security services to organize the killing and was also linked to an alleged larger plot involving weapons and explosives. Babchenko apologized to his wife and others not briefed on the scheme. He said the SBU approached him and had known of a contract on him for two months. Americans spent over $100 billion on summer vacations last year, and travel can reduce stress and health risks while boosting energy and relaxation, but it can be pricey. Experienced travelers suggest starting with a budget and using online travel sites for bargains. They advise using credit cards without foreign transaction fees and a backup card, checking cell phone carrier options, traveling during offseason, booking flights and lodging early, considering trip insurance, signing up for airline newsletters and watching for short-lived deals, and searching for local discounts.

It handled record 5.1 million cruise passengers and 8.9 million tons of cargo. The Miami Herald reported the study’s numbers may be inflated; Gimenez said he believes they are accurate. The ARM Cortex-A8 Subsystem gives the ARM Cortex-A8 Master control of the device and handles configuration and control of subsystems, peripherals, and external memories. James Madison, on July 9, 1812, recommended the third Thursday in August as a day of public humiliation and prayer, as requested by Congress. The day was for religious solemnity, repentance, seeking forgiveness and divine protection amid war, and praying for peace and justice.

ESPN in the early 2010s was at its height within the cable bundle, receiving over $7 monthly from more than 100 million subscribers plus fees from spinoff networks and advertising; Disney called it a cash cow, and Hearst owned 20%. By 2024, ESPN faced declining revenue, rising live sports costs, changing consumer behavior, increasing competition, and cable/satellite subscribers falling to an estimated 70 million. ESPN launched ESPN+ in 2018 after Disney acquired BAMTech; by 2024 ESPN+ had about 25 million subscribers and $6.30 average revenue per user. Disney CEO Robert Iger confirmed the flagship ESPN would go direct-to-consumer in 2025, and Disney, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Fox announced the Venu Sports streaming joint venture for fall 2024. The case covers ESPN’s history, ownership changes, affiliate-fee model, growth drivers such as the NFL, DBS, and new channels; its content engine and brand; its Internet and streaming strategy; the competitive landscape of incumbent media, technology companies, sports properties, cable/satellite operators, and fans; rising rights fees, fan choice, costs, fragmentation, and piracy; and ESPN’s transition from B2B to B2C. It also reports Disney Q2 FY24 Sports results: ESPN Domestic revenue of $3.866 billion, up 4%; operating income of $780 million, down 9%; ESPN+ at 24.8 million subscribers and $6.30 ARPU; and rights obligations and revenue scenarios. The conclusion asks whether ESPN can become the preeminent digital sports platform and whether it can disrupt itself or be disrupted.

IEX sought to disrupt common-stock trading but has a disappointing share under 3%, which the passage attributes to a split personality: IEX One and IEX Two. IEX One is a contented market mechanic finding a niche in the SEC-corrupted market; its speed bump subsidizes the buy-side rather than the sell-side and is a new tactic but not a new strategy, leaving it a small footnote in the NMS. IEX Two is a disappointed market visionary seeking superiority over other exchanges. The passage states the speed bump is an implicit fee/cost and depends on the SEC’s NMS, which guarantees order flow, lets exchanges escape liquidity concerns, and favors the actively trading sell-side over the buy-side. To dominate, IEX must be different in kind, confront and bypass the NMS, balance buy-side and sell-side interests, and deliver liquidity that brokers and traders support.

In January, the U.S. economy continued slow, steady post-recession improvements: employers added 200,000 jobs, unemployment held at 4.1 percent, and average hourly wages rose 2.9 percent from a year earlier. Economists said wage gains may be accelerating, and Kate Bahn attributed much of the pay boost to minimum wage increases in 18 states affecting 4.5 million workers. Analysts cautioned against broad conclusions from one report. Job growth under Trump was similar to Obama’s: 2.1 million in 2017 versus 2.2 million in 2016. Women’s education in rural Pakistan and Azad Jammu Kashmir is limited despite Article 25A stating education is a fundamental right. The passage reports female literacy at 51.9% nationally and 40.8% in rural areas, lower than male literacy. Reasons include lack of motivation, cultural norms, patriarchal attitudes, lack of educational facilities, illiterate family environment, poverty, early child marriages, and focus only on Quran-e-Majeed. The study used quantitative surveys of illiterate and literate women. Findings list management problems, patriarchy, motivational problems, financial problems, population growth, few educational institutes, traditional and religious factors, technical issues, curriculum, family pressure, and teacher training problems. Both literate and illiterate women considered women’s education necessary and were confident and hopeful for the future. The passage discusses content-based image retrieval for botanical taxonomy and the ImageCLEF/LifeCLEF plant identification task. It notes that apps such as LeafSnap and PlantNet are promising but not yet accurate enough for real-world social ecological surveillance. The LifeCLEF 2014 plant task continued earlier ImageCLEF campaigns and introduced multi-image query scenarios, user ratings on image quality, a new Branch view, and 500 species. The PlantCLEF 2014 dataset contained 60,962 pictures from 19,504 observations of 500 species, collected by 1,608 contributors. Each picture belonged to one of seven view types and was linked to a plant observation; metadata included observation ID, file name, media ID, view content, class ID, species, genus, family, date, vote, location, GPS coordinates, author, year in CLEF, and prior IDs. The task was species retrieval based on multi-image plant observations, with the dataset split into training and testing sets. Participants could submit up to four runs. Evaluation used a primary score based on inverse rank of the correct species, averaged by author and plant observation, and a secondary image-level metric. Seventy-four groups registered, 10 submitted runs, and 6 submitted complementary image runs. Methods included Fisher vectors, bag-of-visual-words, CNNs, matching, and global descriptors. IBM AU’s Fisher vector, CNN, and segmentation runs performed best; Fisher vectors were state-of-the-art, while CNNs underperformed partly due to limited training data and restrictions on external data. Metadata and GPS/locality were rarely explored. Combining multiple images from an observation improved results modestly. LeafScan and Flower categories had the best results, and Branch results were strongest for IBM AU. The conclusion describes the 2014 task as encouraging, with species increased from 250 to 500, while scaling to thousands of species remains difficult; a possible 2015 task would extend to all French flora, estimated at around 5,000 species.

The passage documents device pin and memory-map details. Much of the text consists of terminal-function tables and notes for boot configuration, DDR, EMAC, GPIO, GPMC, HDMI, I2C, McASP, PCIe, reset/interrupt/JTAG, SD, SPI, oscillator/PLL, timers, UART, USB, video, reserved pins, and supply voltages. It describes BTMODE sampling at reset, PINCNTLx MUXMODE pin multiplexing, internal pullup/pulldown behavior, boot-mode pin usage, and recommendations for external pullup/pulldown resistors and supply connections.

In soccer, an offensive switch is an exchange of positions by two attacking teammates used to beat defenders. Switches may be called or natural and may or may not involve the ball. In the basic switch, two teammates near each other run diagonally forward in an X pattern; one starts and the other crosses behind, exchanging duties until returning. It may be done with or without the ball. The objective is to free one or both runners for a pass by confusing defenders in 2 v 1 or 2 v 2 situations, usually in the opponents’ half. A lateral/horizontal switch exchanges positions side-to-side toward opposite touchlines; a vertical switch exchanges positions back-to-front or front-to-back toward opposite goal lines and is not an overlap. Returns should be initiated or acknowledged by saying “Switch back.”

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 8-K dated September 25, 2022, reporting that Joseph Gebbia was appointed to its Board of Directors effective that date. There are no related party transactions requiring disclosure. Gebbia is eligible for Tesla’s standard outside director compensation but waived cash compensation until further notice and joined the Board in waiving equity compensation until July 2023. The passage introduces MatterMech, a benchmark of 4,800 questions across eight nanomaterial synthesis subdomains for evaluating LLMs’ ability to hypothesize physicochemical principles. It was developed by curating approximately 17,000 academic papers, generating question-answer pairs with Claude-3.5-Sonnet, refining them through multi-agent roundtable discussions to reduce hallucinations, and validating quality via human evaluation on a five-point Likert scale. The authors also release MatterDB, a curated dataset of 31,735 papers across eight subdomains, pairing LLM-extracted synthesis mechanisms with academic sources. Fourteen LLMs are evaluated using multiple-choice questions and text-infilling metrics. Findings show LLMs excel at logical reasoning but struggle with conceptual understanding and principle-based reasoning; increased model scale and principle-guided prompting improve performance across subdomains. The work identifies critical limitations in LLMs’ comprehension of materials synthesis mechanisms and states these must be addressed before reliable scientific hypothesis generation. Contributions include the benchmark, dataset, and empirical insights. Limitations include lack of human expert annotations and the benchmark’s static content.

Lecture 16 covers quantization of Dirac theory. The Dirac Lagrangian is used to define canonical momentum and Hamiltonian density; standard commutator quantization gives an unbounded Hamiltonian and bosonic exchange, so commutators are replaced by anticommutators. Mode expansion gives anticommutation relations for operators a and c, a vacuum annihilated by them, and a positive-definite Hamiltonian with divergent zero-point energy; fermionic oscillators contribute minus one-half omega and can be excited only once, yielding the Pauli principle. Single-particle states are particle/antiparticle with two polarizations, spin 1/2, and opposite U(1) charge. The lecture also presents Wightman, retarded, and time-ordered/Feynman correlators, the momentum-space Dirac propagator, the spin-statistics theorem, anyons in 2+1 dimensions, and announces chiral and Majorana fermions.

The passage covers the ADS8681W/ADS8685W/ADS8689W. A data transfer frame begins on the falling edge of CONVST/CS and ends at the subsequent rising edge; it involves RVS, the 32-bit output shift register, the SCLK counter, and is classified as optimal, short, or long based on 32 SCLK cycles. Input commands are 32 bits and include READ, WRITE, SET_HWORD, CLEAR_HWORD, and HWORD operations, with 9-bit addresses and an ignored LSB for HWORD commands. Output data for frame F+1 depends on the frame F command and DATA_VAL[2:0], and can append device address, range, AVDD alarm, input alarm, and parity flags. Data transfer protocols include four legacy SPI modes, dual SDO-x, and source-synchronous (SRC) modes. Register maps list configuration registers and fields. Application information describes a 16-bit SAR ADC with integrated AFE and reference, an industrial analog input module using MUX36D08, alarm thresholds and hysteresis with an NTC thermistor, power supply decoupling, NAP and power-down modes, and PCB layout recommendations. Documentation, support, ESD caution, revision history, and packaging information are also provided.

This study analyzed interactions between a mitochondrial polygenic score (MGS) and lifestyle/environmental factors on age at onset (AAO) in LRRK2-PD and idiopathic PD (iPD), using AMP-PD, Fox Insight, and Tunisian Arab-Berber cohorts (9,745 patients: 486 LRRK2-PD and 9,259 iPD). The standardized MGS was inversely correlated with AAO in LRRK2-PD, with higher MGS associated with earlier AAO, but no association was observed in iPD. In LRRK2-PD, black tea was associated with later AAO and caffeinated soda with earlier AAO; in iPD, smoking and coffee were associated with later AAO, while caffeinated soda and pesticide exposure were associated with earlier AAO. Interaction analyses found MGS interactions with coffee and caffeinated soda in LRRK2-PD, and with caffeinated soda and work-related pesticide exposure in iPD. The study concludes that MGS is associated with earlier AAO in LRRK2-PD but not iPD, and that lifestyle/environmental factors interact with MGS to affect AAO in PD.

On Nov. 21, 2001, Enron said lenders extended to mid-December the payment date on a $690 million note and that it had closed the remaining $450 million of a $1 billion secured credit line. Enron reaffirmed its commitment to a Dynegy takeover; Dynegy said it was continuing due diligence and seeking regulatory approvals. This application is a continuation claiming priority to U.S. and PCT applications and provisional applications relating to periodic beam failure measurements and reporting beam failure. The disclosure concerns digital communications and periodic beam failure measurements in beamformed systems. In embodiments, a UE determines a measurement period duration based on periods of periodic BFD RSs in a BFD RS set, particularly BFD RSs having a QCL relationship with DMRSs of PDCCH receptions monitored by the UE. The UE monitors such BFD RSs during a measurement period and reports a BF instance when measures of all assessed BFD RSs do not meet a threshold. The UE may determine a BF from reported BF instances, identify a candidate beam, and send a BFRQ. The passage also describes handling measurement periods with no BFD RS transmission by ignoring the period or treating it as a BF instance.

U.S. stocks ended lower but off their daily lows on Tuesday as geopolitical risks weighed on sentiment before corporate earnings reports. Tensions involving the United States, Russia, Syria and North Korea drove investors into gold and other safe-haven assets and pushed the VIX above 15.
