Social media networks are strengthening policies, adding staff, and reworking algorithms amid criticism over hate speech, extremism, and fake news. Artificial intelligence can detect offensive language and images, but it is not foolproof, can be biased by human-trained data, and cannot determine intent. Examples include Google Photos’ “gorilla” tagging error, Twitter’s outdated algorithm flagging #gay and #bisexual, Facebook removing a swastika post and the “napalm girl” photo, and Facebook tagging a Neptune statue as sexually explicit. AI still requires human moderators to judge community standards, though it helps prioritize posts and speed reviews. Patients with hematological malignancies and COVID-19 in a French CCP monitored access program were analyzed. In the CCP cohort, 112 patients received CCP; 90-day overall survival was 64.9% overall, 77.5% in B-lymphoid neoplasm, 20% in myeloid neoplasm, and 36.8% in plasma-cell neoplasm. CCP transfusion was associated with decreased temperature, CRP, ferritin, and fibrinogen and increased PCR cycle threshold values. In a propensity score analysis of B-cell neoplasm patients, CCP exposure was associated with lower mortality, including a 63% decrease in risk of death in the main anti-CD20 pre-exposed 16-day population, with hazard ratios varying across sensitivity analyses. Adverse events were limited. The study concludes CCP may be an interesting approach, especially in B-cell lymphoid malignancies pretreated with anti-CD20 mAbs, but findings are retrospective and require randomized confirmation.

The Bittle tree, a tulip poplar planted by Dr. David Bittle on Turbyfill Quad, stood over 100 years before lightning and wind damage made it hazardous and it was removed. Its wood became the Bittle Tree of Life Cross in Antrim Chapel, created by Chris Bowen and George Arthur for Roanoke’s 175th anniversary, as a symbolic feature with roots and branches.

May Baxter-Thornton of Newport and Emma Lewis of Swansea, both child sexual abuse survivors, were appointed to the victims and survivors panel of the Independent Inquiry into Child Sexual Abuse. They will advise on reaching and listening to victims in Wales. Chair Alexis Jay said their Welsh perspective is vital. The inquiry opened in Wales in 2016.

ERW is Electric Resistance Welding, used to transport petroleum, gas, vapor, and liquids under high and low pressure. ERW steel pipes are high-frequency resistance welded, efficient, low-cost, material-saving, and used in aviation, energy, electricity, automobile, light industry, and urban gas networks. They differ from seamless pipes and use hot-rolled coil.

This application is a continuation of several U.S. applications titled “Identification of Audio Content” or “Identification of Audio Content Facilitated by Playback Device.” The disclosure relates to media playback and describes examples in which a playback device receives digital data representing audio content, sends at least a portion of the digital data to an identification system, receives information associated with the audio content, sends the received information to a control device, and plays the audio content through wired speakers. The control device may send a command to the playback device to retrieve information from the identification system while the playback device is playing the audio content, receive the retrieved information, and display a representation of the received information or of metadata retrieved from a metadata curating device at a network location indicated by the received information. The passage also describes non-transitory computer-readable media and methods for playback devices and control devices, an example media playback system with playback devices, control devices, zones, zone groups, and audio content sources, and operations such as detecting discontinuities, sending portions periodically, processing sample rates, extracting data from different audio pipeline positions, segregating frequency ranges, and receiving command inputs or determining missing metadata categories.

One letter says Rep. Ken Buck called health care a commodity, not a right; it argues U.S. health care except Medicare is profit-driven, health care is integral to life, and Medicare for all should recognize health care as a right. The disclosure relates generally to illumination of light modulation devices, specifically light guides providing large-area illumination from localized light sources for 2D, 3D, and/or autostereoscopic displays. The background describes spatially multiplexed autostereoscopic displays using a parallax component aligned with pixel sets to form viewing windows, and notes reduced spatial resolution, non-uniform viewing windows, flicker, cross talk, brightness, and addressing tradeoffs. The disclosure provides directional illumination apparatus and display devices comprising a backlight with plural light sources and a directional waveguide having an input end and opposed first and second guide surfaces for guiding input light and deflecting it through the first guide surface. Display devices include a transmissive spatial light modulator, input and output polarisers, at least one additional polariser on either side, and at least one retarder between the additional polariser and the input or output polariser. The retarder may include correcting passive retarders and switchable liquid crystal retarders, and may use crossed A-plates, C-plates, O-plates, homeotropic or homogeneous alignment layers, patterned electrodes, multiple layers, and camouflage regions. The additional polariser may be reflective and may have transmission directions parallel to the input or output polariser. The waveguide may image light sources in a lateral direction into optical windows according to input positions, with a reflective end, light extraction features, and intermediate regions. Control systems may switch backlight and retarder modes, synchronize the spatial light modulator and light sources, respond to snooper location, and provide autostereoscopic, multi-viewer, privacy, vehicle, and wide-angle/privacy operation. A further aspect provides similar display devices with non-directional backlights. The detailed description describes time-multiplexed autostereoscopic displays, optical valves, stepped waveguides, directional versus non-imaging backlights, light propagation, viewing windows, observer tracking, Fresnel lenses, LEDs/lasers, and related directional display structures.

According to Deloitte, consumer confidence in autonomous vehicles increased, with 49% believing self-driving cars will not be safe versus 73% last year. Over half had more confidence due to brands building them, and 51% trusted traditional car manufacturers over technology companies (21%). Meanwhile, 73% preferred engine-powered vehicles for their next purchase and 2% electric, citing range, price, and charging infrastructure; 37% said lower ongoing costs would encourage electric consideration. Customer service was important to 71%, and the UK government is launching a safety inquiry.

The passage discusses the presidential election cycle theory, which asserts based on historical data that the stock market’s performance in the first two years of a U.S. president’s term likely outperforms the last two years, with midterm election years showing poor performance until the fourth quarter. Yale Hirsch is credited with quantifying the cycle; the Stock Trader’s Almanac states presidential incumbency drives it, with the pre-election year best and election year second best. Since 1952, the S&P 500 averaged 12.5% in election years when a sitting president ran for reelection, 6.7% in all election years, and –1.5% in open-field election years. Historical data show stocks and bonds tend to do less well in the year before a presidential election, while the S&P 500 did better after midterms. The theory cannot always predict market performance exactly. Election outcomes can affect sectors such as healthcare, energy, and trade. The passage advises staying invested and rebalancing; backtests suggest the presidential cycle is a seasonal pattern to consider.

Intel has included a small microcontroller, the Intel Management Engine, in its CPUs for over a decade. It connects to storage and network interface, remains on when the computer is off, and can wake over a network; parts were included at the NSA’s request. Researchers Mark Ermolov and Maxim Goryachy presented a BlackHat Europe exploit allowing arbitrary code execution on Intel ME. It is a local attack requiring physical access and a USB stick. The ME runs Minix, and Intel’s closed-source approach limited prior security research. Mitigation options include System76 firmware to disable ME and Dell’s Lattitude 14 with a disabled ME option. Intel has a detection tool, but there is no generic way to turn ME off. me_cleaner tricks ME into thinking firmware is valid while doing nothing; without valid ME firmware, a computer shuts off after thirty minutes. The current exploit works on ME versions higher than V.11 and excludes Macs. A network-based exploit does not yet exist.

New Jersey Governor Chris Christie signed legislation strengthening protections for people with developmental disabilities and giving families a greater say in their care. It followed Stephen Komninos’s 2007 death in a Haddonfield group home. The measure permits twice-yearly unannounced visits, additional staff, injury notification within two-to-eight hours, and twice-yearly family meetings.

This qualitative literature review uses Mortimer J. Adler’s books and recent international journals on philosophy, Christian education, and Christian education management. It analyzes Adler’s perennialism, continuity of ideas, Thomistic learning, docility and obedience, democracy in education, and education management in Christian and global contexts. It also discusses posthumanism, humanism, technology, Christian family meal intervention, spirituality and chronic illness, moral and character education, cross-cultural student agency, Christian school values, Christian family business social assets, institutional transformation, disaster resilience, and Christian business identity. The conclusion addresses justice, support for women, children not being treated as future workers or scapegoats, docility as not natural slavery, obedience based on intellectual considerations rather than emotion, and placing perennial values and deeper educational management above instant achievement.

A report says the Browns will not rule out Baker Mayfield with the No. 1 pick and he was at least in the conversation. Dorsey remains open to all options; Jackson says Darnold, Allen, Mayfield, and Rosen are in play. Mayfield threw for 4,627 yards and 43 touchdowns.

Nicola Sturgeon criticised Theresa May’s call for a June 8 general election, saying the Conservatives would move the UK right, force a hard Brexit and impose deeper cuts. She called it a U-turn and miscalculation, said May was prioritising her party and exploiting Labour’s disarray, and framed the election as defending Scotland and its future choice. Angus Robertson questioned May’s “now is not the time” stance; Ruth Davidson said Tories sought strong Brexit leadership and opposed the SNP’s referendum plan.

The passage covers MSPM0C1105/MSPM0C1106 device features. The CPU subsystem includes an Arm Cortex-M0+ CPU up to 32 MHz, prefetch/I-cache, SysTick, and NVIC. The devices provide RUN, SLEEP, STOP, STANDBY, and SHUTDOWN operating modes, with configurable policies and PD1/PD0 power domains; wake behavior and module retention/disable states are defined. The PMU generates regulated core supplies and supervises VDD, and the clock module provides LFOSC, SYSOSC, LFXT/LFCKIN, HFXT/HFCKIN and distributes MCLK, CPUCLK, ULPCLK, MFCLK, LFCLK, ADCCLK, CLK_OUT, HFCLK, and HSCLK. DMA_B supports multiple channels, transfer modes, and triggers; the event manager routes events among peripherals, DMA, and CPU. It includes device analog connections, I/O diagrams, SWD/DEBUGSS, factory constants and ID registers, application/layout recommendations, documentation and support resources, revision history, and mechanical, packaging, and orderable information.

Lawyers for Venezuelan TPS holders asked the Supreme Court to leave in place Judge Edward Chen’s order temporarily barring the Trump administration from ending their protected status. The filing argued Chen’s order restored the status quo and that disturbing it would cause massive injuries. Congress created TPS in 1990; Mayorkas designated Venezuela in 2021, redesignated it in 2023, and extended it through October 2026 before Kristi Noem ended the 2023 designation and 2025 extension. The National TPS Alliance and Venezuelan TPS holders challenged Noem’s decision, alleging violations of federal law and the Constitution, including racial animus. Chen barred Noem on March 31; the Ninth Circuit declined to pause, the Supreme Court stayed Chen’s order on May 19, and Chen issued a final ruling on Sept. 5 that Noem acted unlawfully. After the lower court refused to stay that ruling, Solicitor General Sauer returned to the Supreme Court. The challengers argued the prior stay did not foreclose further litigation, Chen’s final ruling rested on different statutory authority and a new claim, and the record was more developed.

Ed Sachse, 56, began in real estate by buying a window-washing business as a teen in Detroit. He studied at Michigan State University, worked as an accountant for Arthur Andersen, moved to Los Angeles, and worked for Douglas Emmett Inc., becoming CFO of Camden Financial. He later became a broker at Coldwell Banker and started his own property management and brokerage company in 1993. At 41, he was diagnosed with stage 4 non-Hodgkin lymphoma and battled it for six years. After the Great Recession hurt his business, he contacted 40 prospects in late 2009; Kennedy Wilson offered to buy his company, and he agreed. He now oversees brokerage and property management for Kennedy Wilson. He lives in Pacific Palisades with his wife, Julie, and has two grown children.

Hayes issued a proclamation on July 18, 1877, stating that West Virginia’s governor reported domestic violence at Martinsburg and along the Baltimore and Ohio Railroad that state authorities could not suppress. He warned persons engaged in domestic violence and obstruction of laws to disperse by noon on July 19.

The invention provides a method and apparatus for an optical waveguide display. In prior art, the field of view is limited by total internal reflection (TIR), and Bragg gratings tuned to one wavelength produce reduced field of view for other wavelengths. The invention coats external surfaces of the waveguide against which guided light reflects internally with a material, preferably a meta-material, having a refractive index substantially equal to or less than 1.0 at optical wavelengths. This reduces the critical internal angle for TIR when light is directed by the input diffractive part, allowing light otherwise outside the field of view to be retained and guided. The apparatus has a first diffractive part for input and a second diffractive part for output, which may be Bragg gratings and may be conjugated to reduce distortion and chromatic dispersion. The meta-material may comprise periodic unit cells with magnetic resonators between conductive meshes, or conductive wires. The waveguide may be multi-layered for different colours, with the material joining or protecting layers. A protective outer layer may be included. A method for displaying light using the waveguide is also provided.

The lecture reviews renewal theory before moving to countable-state Markov chains. It presents the strong law for renewals, the elementary renewal theorem, and Blackwell’s theorem. For arithmetic inter-renewal intervals with span λ, Blackwell’s theorem gives the limit of m(t+λ)−m(t) as λ/x̄, equivalently the limiting probability of renewal at mλ is λ/x̄; the non-arithmetic case involves limits that cannot be interchanged. Age and duration at time t are analyzed for arithmetic span 1. The joint probability of age i and duration k is expressed using arrival probabilities and the inter-renewal pmf, with constraints such as k>i. Asymptotically the joint probability depends only on duration, not age. The duration pmf is k p_X(k)/x̄, expected duration is E[X²]/E[X], and expected age is E[X²]/(2E[X]); the factor 1/2 arises from integer t and time averaging.

The lecture then discusses countable-state Markov chains. A Bernoulli random walk spreads as a quantized Gaussian, has period 2, and has no steady-state distribution because state probabilities go to 0. For a birth-death chain on nonnegative states, p<1/2 is recurrent, p>1/2 is not recurrent, and p=1/2 is recurrent but has no steady state and infinite expected return time. Recurrence is defined as returning to a state with probability 1. First passage probabilities f_ij(n) are defined and related to p_ij(n) and Chapman-Kolmogorov; defective random variables and a smallest-solution theorem are mentioned. A recurrent state yields a renewal process of returns; returns occur infinitely often, but the expected recurrence time may be finite or infinite. States in the same class are both recurrent or both transient.

The author survived sepsis after scratching a hand on a nail, entering a coma, and spending a year recovering. Sepsis affects over 30 million people yearly and kills an estimated 6 million, including nearly 2 million children; 40% of survivors have post-sepsis syndrome, which leaves lasting physical and mental symptoms. It begins with infection, including scratches or bites, and involves an uncontrolled body response causing organ failure. Symptoms include pale/mottled skin, severe breathlessness, shivering, muscle pain, not urinating all day, nausea or vomiting. Anyone can get it; vitamin D deficiency may increase risk. No specific cure exists, though metformin and gene therapy research are promising. Awareness is low globally, and greater public and professional awareness is currently the greatest defence.

The passage presents a real-time face anonymization system for intelligent scientific experiment education within AIED. It notes that AIED systems collect and analyze student data, raising privacy concerns, and that existing face anonymization methods are not tailored to scientific experiment videos where facial privacy, instrument visibility, and operational techniques must be balanced. The proposed framework uses a customized YOLOv8 model, Multi-Scale Feature Fusion YOLOv8 (MSFF-YOLOv8), with BOTSort tracking, Gaussian blurring, and a Contour-Adaptive Occlusion Refinement (CAOR) dilation module. It distinguishes primary and non-primary operators, finely anonymizing primary experimenters while preserving instruments and operations. The study used 51 experiment videos with manual annotations for face detection, segmentation, and tracking. Evaluation metrics included FPS, SOBA, and OBR, comparing SAM, Edge-SAM, YOLOv8, and MSFF-YOLOv8 with or without CAOR. MSFF-YOLOv8+CAOR reportedly achieved 96.02% accuracy at 22.67 fps for 1920×1080 video, with low OBR and reduced mis-blurring. The conclusion states the system balances privacy protection with experimental detail, while further research is needed for precise edge classification during real-time inference.

Sam Altman says intellectual property is trickier for AI video because video feels more real and lifelike, causing stronger emotional resonance. He says rights holders respond differently than to still images and mostly want restrictions and more granular control over character generation. OpenAI’s Sora generated unauthorized videos of characters like SpongeBob and Pikachu. Altman predicts rights holders will eventually welcome AI-generated content.

Research on the human brain has advanced toward understanding and manipulating memories. Findings on “face cells,” the CREB protein, and neuron activation before learning may help specify memory storage. Reconsolidation during recall may allow memory implantation. MIT researchers created an artificial link between a harmless situation and fear, then reversed it, suggesting memories may be implanted and erased with the right tools and procedures. Researchers continue exploring this field’s limits.

The speaker says the team does not care about outside perceptions and is excited to have earned the right to play for the Stanley Cup by beating three good teams. SD Memory Cards are designed for security, capacity, performance, and environmental needs of audio/video devices. A second security system may support ISO-7816 for public networks, mobile e-commerce, and digital signatures. Dublin’s new JD Wetherspoon’s will occupy a 1,600sq metre city centre space made of two buildings—the former Trustee Savings Bank at 12B and former 1839 Baptist Chapel at 12C on Lower Abbey Street—connected by a glazed link at ground and first floor levels after a court decision. The lecture covers auctions as mechanisms for setting prices, with applications in government procurement, Treasury auctions, and online advertising. It introduces the independent private values model, analyzes second-price sealed-bid auctions and the dominant strategy of bidding true value, and discusses revenue via order statistics. It presents oral ascending/button auctions, then first-price sealed-bid auctions, equilibrium bid shading, and revenue equivalence between first- and second-price auctions. It explains limitations of revenue equivalence, including risk aversion, correlated values, and reserve prices, and notes reserve prices can reduce social welfare and depend on entry and commitment. It then discusses common-value auctions and the winner’s curse, using Hendricks and Porter’s study of U.S. offshore oil lease auctions as an empirical example of asymmetric information, informed incumbents, drainage tracts, bidding behavior, and testable predictions.
In HS mode, the ADS7828 holds the clock LOW after the read-addressing byte until conversion completes; to remain in HS mode, use repeated START instead of STOP.

An Alberta Education survey of nearly 10,000 respondents, half teachers, found many wanted more practical skills and basics in reading, writing and math. Some were confused by draft plans. Social studies drew strong views, including concerns about First Nations, Métis and Inuit topics, global history, current events, indoctrination, social justice in music, and cultural perspectives in math. Most said drafts fostered literacy, numeracy, critical thinking and prepared students. The ATA president said writing groups are on track and teacher implementation must be paced well.

The BGF China Flexible Equity Fund enables investors to access onshore Chinese A-shares and offshore Chinese equities through one flexible strategy. It is a long-only, fundamentals-driven, concentrated portfolio of 20–50 companies, managed by Helen Zhu with ten China-focused analysts, seeking opportunities from valuation differences, market-cycle factors, and sector-specific opportunities.

The study examines the perceptions and experiences of students in face-to-face tour guiding departments at Istanbul universities regarding emergency distance education (EDE) implemented during the Covid-19 pandemic. It used a qualitative phenomenological design, purposive sampling, semi-structured interviews and an online questionnaire with 81 students, and thematic content analysis. Students generally considered EDE insufficient for tour guiding education because of insufficient vocational courses, motivation problems and lack of effective communication. They identified advantages of EDE such as effective time management, compensation opportunities, independence from location, savings and ease of access to materials, and disadvantages such as inappropriacy for tour guiding education, lack of motivation, lack of communication, technical problems and poor attendance. Most students reported differences between face-to-face and distance education, mainly in efficiency, socialization, concentration, unidirectionality and self-expression. Nearly three-fifths considered distance education practically inadequate for tour guiding, while most reported understanding distance courses. Students tended to prefer face-to-face education but acknowledged EDE’s advantages, indicating a dilemma.

The Office of the Historian at the U.S. Department of State has released an ebook edition of *Foreign Relations of the United States, 1981–1988, Volume I: Foundations of Foreign Policy*. The ebook contains the full volume content, supports reading and search features, and can be accessed offline. The FRUS series presents the official documentary historical record of major U.S. foreign policy decisions and significant diplomatic activity. Its preparation is directed by the Historian and guided by regulations and a 1991 statutory charter requiring a thorough, accurate, reliable record, historical objectivity, disclosure of deletions, and publication within 30 years. Sources include declassified records available at the National Archives.

Data culture can align an organization vertically through data-driven metrics and objectives that connect individuals and groups to company goals, and horizontally through common data models and transparent access that improve collaboration. Digital leaders emphasize data culture as central, aligning beliefs, values, and actions; digital laggards recognize its importance but face entrenched habits, skill gaps, and insufficient top-down focus. Changing mindsets and behaviors is the most challenging part of transformation, though laggards are not doomed and leaders also face cultural tensions. Mature firms differ in their data culture approach, with key principles including learning, risk-taking, transparency, and measurement. Organizations fit four patterns—data novice, insight ready, tech enabled, and data reliant—and can build on strengths with targeted actions. The passage also describes Keystone Strategy as a consulting firm serving major companies, law firms, and government agencies.

Brad Vis has been chosen as the Conservative candidate for Mission-Matsqui-Fraser Canyon in next year’s federal election. He narrowly lost to Liberal Jati Sidhu in 2015 by a little more than 1,000 votes. Conservative leader Andrew Scheer congratulated Vis.

This study investigates correlations between multilingualism learning and cultural awareness among higher education students in Indonesia. Using an embedded mixed methods design, it surveyed 388 students from several Indonesian universities, with 60 qualitative participants, and measured Multilingualism Competency, Multilingual Learning Process, Psychological Factors, Social Interaction, Cultural Knowledge and Communication, Cultural Practices and Participation, Sociocultural Context, and Capacity and Attitude towards Cultural Learning. The passage reports significant positive correlations among multilingual learning variables, among cultural awareness variables, and between multilingual learning and cultural awareness. It also reports that Indonesian dominates as a mother tongue; Javanese, Bugis, and Makassarese are prominent local languages learned; and English is the most studied foreign language, followed by Korean and Arabic. Learning methods include school, lecture, and independent learning. The study identifies multilingual learning strategies for cultural awareness, including educator training, technological support, cultural integration, inclusive content, active cultural participation, intercultural collaboration, motivation, self-directed learning, and community engagement. It concludes that multilingual education based on cultural awareness can support students’ multilingual competence and cultural awareness in Indonesia.

Amazon.com, Inc.’s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2015 states that Amazon was incorporated in Washington in 1994 and reincorporated in Delaware in 1996, is headquartered in Seattle, and lists common stock on NASDAQ under “AMZN.” It describes Amazon as seeking to be Earth’s most customer-centric company and serving consumers, sellers, developers, enterprises, and content creators. Beginning in the first quarter of 2015, reportable segments changed to North America, International, and Amazon Web Services. Jeong-Suk Cha, 77, regularly uses a sling and lift to move her 48-year-old son Alex, who has cerebral palsy and spinal cord damage and needs 24-hour care. Although his sister Jin Cha, friend Michael Kerr, and personal support workers help, much of the work falls to Jeong-Suk. Alex is on a residential care wait list that agencies call the 50-year wait list. A $100-million class-action lawsuit filed by Koskie Minsky against Ontario seeks damages for negligence, alleging developmentally disabled adults are denied services through ad hoc, inconsistent, unreasonable wait lists. Ontario Ombudsman Paul Dube’s report noted 9,700 people waiting for residential care. The South West LHIN acknowledges limited data on referrals, client characteristics, and wait list numbers. Participation House has 40 spaces and 60 to 90 people waiting. Alex receives 90 personal support worker hours a month, increased to 140 until the end of April. He says he would rather die than go into long-term care/nursing home. Health Minister Eric Hoskins promised to look into the matter and acknowledged more help is needed.

The passage proposes a methodology for a trusting agent to determine the probability of not achieving the full benefit of its invested resources in an interaction with a probable trusted agent. It defines FailureLevel, divides the interaction time space into pre-interaction and post-interaction start time phases and time slots, determines an Amount Invested Curve (AIC) for the net resources at stake, and convolves the AIC with the trusted agent’s FailureLevel to obtain a Factual Amount Invested Curve (FAIC). The ordinate on the FAIC at the end of the AIC gives the Loss of Resource Benefit (LORB) index, which represents the probability of not achieving the full benefit of resources in a time slot. This probability can help the trusting agent decide which probable trusted agent to interact with, along with possible risk.

This is the Office of the Historian’s ebook edition of Foreign Relations of the United States, 1917 Supplement 1, The World War, generated on May 26, 2018. It reproduces the printed volume, supports full-text search and offline reading, and recommends citing document numbers. The passage describes NVIDIA’s GA10x Ampere GPU architecture, including PCIe Gen 4, GA102’s GPC/TPC/SM/ROP/memory-controller composition, ROP placement in the GPC, and GA10x SM features such as 128 CUDA Cores, four third-generation Tensor Cores, one second-generation RT Core, 128 KB L1/shared memory, doubled FP32 datapaths, and larger unified cache. It covers second-generation RT Cores with doubled ray/triangle testing and motion blur acceleration, third-generation Tensor Cores with TF32/BF16 and sparsity, GDDR6X memory with PAM4 and EDR, RTX IO with DirectStorage, display and video decode/encode capabilities, and data center/workstation products including the NVIDIA A40 and RTX A6000. It also includes performance comparisons and specifications for RTX 30-series and professional GPUs.

The Shuffle offense, predecessor of the Princeton, Flex, Hawk, and Reverse Action offenses and traced to Bruce Drake at Oklahoma, uses all five players in constant motion and a rotating series of options to create high-percentage shots, eliminate defensive help and double teams, and draw big defenders away from the basket. It is suited to teams lacking height, involves little dribbling, and requires fundamentals in passing, receiving, spacing, screening, rebounding, and ball possession. The passage details continuity options, rub/shuffle cut reads and counters, flash cut options, and defensive overplay counters such as back cuts.

The Brunswick school board approved the first step toward placing a 10-year, $4.67 million emergency levy renewal on the May ballot; the levy expires next year and would not increase taxes. The study assessed implementation-phase adherence to apixaban at 24 weeks using an EMD, with the primary endpoint being the percentage of days with correct dosing regimen, comparing Primary SOC and Additional Education Program groups. Secondary assessments included adherence at 12 and 48 weeks, within-group changes, adherence in Continued Additional Education, Secondary SOC, and Primary SOC groups, non-adherence risk factors, and adverse events including major bleeding. Sample size was designed for 85% power to detect a 4% between-group adherence difference at 24 weeks, assuming SD 21.1%; primary analysis used a two-sample t-test at 5% two-sided with 95% CI, and an interim analysis occurred at 24 weeks. Of 1162 randomized subjects (583 Primary SOC, 579 Additional Education), 1160 were treated; 1054 completed 24 weeks. Mean 24-week adherence was 91.64% vs 91.88% (difference -0.24%, 95% CI -2.18% to 1.7%, p=0.8117). Adherence was lower from Week 12-24 than first dose-Week 12 in both groups, and lower from Week 24-48 than first dose-Week 24. Persistence and safety endpoints were similar between groups. The conclusion states AEGEAN showed high adherence and persistence through 24 weeks, sustained to 48 weeks, and a proactive educational program did not provide additional adherence or persistence benefits.
The building is great and can benefit Philadelphia when the team plays well and fans respond. The goalie is calm, quiet, makes big saves, and has been huge all year.

SD Memory Cards have independent User Area and Protected Area; the latter is accessed by Part 3 security authentication, and card capacity is the sum of both areas. Capacities define SDSC (up to and including 2 GB), SDHC (more than 2 GB up to 32 GB), and SDXC (more than 32 GB up to 2 TB). Speed Classes are Class 0 (no specified performance), Class 2, Class 4, Class 6, and Class 10, indicating minimum MB/sec performance. SD bus communication uses command, response, and data tokens with start/end bits and CRC; commands are broadcast or addressed, and data transfers use single or multiple blocks. The specification defines card form factors, registers, card identification and data transfer modes, initialization commands, read/write/erase operations, DISCARD, FULE, write protection methods, and password-based lock/unlock, including Card Ownership Protection (COP), Force Erase Password (FEP), and Force Erase. It also defines UHS-I modes (DS, HS, SDR104, DDR50), UHS-II modes (FD156, HD312, FD312, FD624), Application Performance Class, ROM Card requirements, and low voltage interface details.

TDSAT issued an interim order that, until further orders, no penalty can be imposed on operators for not complying with Trai’s tariff reporting requirement. The Phoenix cluster’s black hole appears to recycle hot gas into cold, star-making fuel. MIT and University of Cambridge researchers observed jets of 10-million-degree gas from the central galaxy’s black hole blowing bubbles into surrounding plasma. These jets normally quench star formation, but may also produce cold gas that rains back and fuels starbursts. The Phoenix cluster contains about 1,000 galaxies 5.7 billion light years away; its central galaxy forms about 1,000 stars yearly. ALMA data showed cold gas filaments extending 20,000 light years, matching hot-gas bubbles. The study was published in the Astrophysical Journal.

This study used the NuMoM2b dataset to examine first- and second-trimester placental biomarkers in relation to a composite outcome of retained placenta and/or hemorrhage requiring blood transfusion (RP/PPH). Among 2,192 participants, 67 had RP/PPH. Participants with RP/PPH had higher second-trimester sEng, β-hCG, INHA, PAPP-A, and sFlt-1, and higher first-trimester sFlt-1 and sFlt-1/PlGF ratio; PlGF did not differ. In non-preeclamptic participants, second-trimester β-hCG, INHA, PAPP-A, and sFlt-1 remained higher in RP/PPH. Preeclamptic RP/PPH participants had greater increases in PAPP-A and decreases in sEng; non-preeclamptic RP/PPH participants had greater sFlt-1 increases. Limitations included lack of direct blood loss/PPH diagnosis, small RP/PPH sample, and overrepresentation of adverse outcomes. The findings suggest placental biomarkers, especially second-trimester angiogenic biomarkers, as targets for further PPH risk screening research.

Five Gor Mahia players headline the 2017 Kenyan Premier League MVP shortlist. After the KPL postponed its awards, SJAK will hold its own sponsored awards on December 18 in eight categories, with Patrick Matasi leading the goalkeeper shortlist and other finalists listed for defender, midfielder, young/new player, MVP, and coach awards.

Patterns provide a shared vocabulary for distributed system developers, enabling quick understanding, knowledge sharing, and learning. Former Boynton Beach firefighter-paramedic Luis Garcia spent almost $40,000 of his savings to order 800 doses of Naloxone, also known as Narcan, a drug that blocks opioids from part of the brain and can stop or reverse overdose effects. He travels Florida giving away free nasal Narcan and training business owners, residents and law enforcement officers. On Feb. 3, 2018, at Shepard Park in Stuart, he gave away about 50 doses during an event hosted by the Treasure Coast Substance Awareness Coalition and Martin Health Systems. Garcia said he responded to about 3,000 overdose cases during his career and revived five of six people he helped in the last year and a half. His organization, the South Florida Opioid Crisis Mortality Reduction Project, focuses on providing Narcan to local business owners and educating law enforcement officers.

The study was a secondary analysis of the COVID-19 vaccination programme in the Democratic Republic of Congo from April 2021 to March 2022, using Ministry of Health and WHO African Region data and descriptive analysis in Microsoft Excel. Of 26 provinces, 16 began immunization in the first year. Coverage varied by province; by March 2022, about 5.7% had received at least one dose and 1.03% were fully vaccinated. Functional vaccination sites increased over time but were unevenly distributed, with Kinshasa having the most. Men were vaccinated more than women in each province except Kasai Oriental. There were 8,302 healthcare workers and 46,495 elderly individuals who completed the primary series. Vaccines used included AstraZeneca, Johnson & Johnson, Pfizer, and Sinovac; Janssen was preferred by 48%, Moderna 25%, Pfizer 17%, and AstraZeneca 2%. Compared with Central African countries, DRC had low uptake: it received 14,394,340 doses, administered 1,143,186, or 8% of doses received, and vaccinated 2% of its population with at least one dose. Challenges included vaccine hesitancy, safety concerns, competing outbreaks, health worker shortages and strikes, logistics, expired or near-expiry doses, and difficulty reaching high-risk groups. The study concluded that the first year had mixed achievements and challenges, and slow coverage underscored the need to invest in health systems. Limitations included difficulty counting priority-group denominators, tracking vaccination history, and analyzing aggregated data, and findings may not reflect the nationwide situation.

The passage says oversold stock markets have fallen significantly over a defined period and can be measured using indicators such as the 3-day RSI below 20. It states markets are mean revertive, so oversold conditions may predict short-term rebounds, not long-term results. A backtest on the S&P 500 from 1985 buying when the 3-day RSI was below 20 and selling when the close exceeded yesterday’s high reported positive results, though figures are given as 484 or 448 trades, 0.64% average gain, 75% win rate, 7.7% or 7.6% CAGR, 26% max drawdown, and 2.5 or 2.4 profit factor. It notes the strategy did not work as well before 1990 and mean reversion may not continue forever.

The passage discusses social capital: it appeared in a West Virginia education report about a century ago, gained academic attention from James Coleman in the late 1980s, and was used by Robert Putnam in the early 1990s to compare northern Italy’s civic engagement with southern Italy’s mafia-dominated society. Putnam, called “Mr. Social Capital,” retired from Harvard’s Kennedy School at 77; his 1990s book Bowling Alone popularized social capital and sparked an academic and policy fad, making him one of the most cited living social scientists. The passage notes competing definitions—civic-group membership versus generalized trust—and bridging versus bonding social capital. It cites Knack and Keefer’s 1996 paper finding no effect from civic membership but positive effects from generalized trust. It also says Putnam reported that ethnic fragmentation and diversity do not increase social capital, a finding picked up by ethnocentrists and nationalists.

Tesla, Inc. filed a Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2019. The speaker thanked Grand Forks Air Force Base personnel for supporting national security and local communities after touring flood devastation and attending a community meeting with mayors, congressional delegates, and governors. The First Circuit dismissed the government’s interlocutory appeal for lack of appellate jurisdiction under 18 U.S.C. § 3731. The government appealed district court orders denying a continuance and, as moot, leave to depose witness Anthony Spera abroad after the INS deported Spera despite an AUSA’s request that deportation be delayed and that the AUSA be notified of custody changes. The district court denied the continuance based on the case’s age, Speedy Trial Act concerns, the government agency’s negligence, and the likely six-to-twelve-month delay. The court held the orders were routine case-management decisions denying a continuance based on trial delay, not orders suppressing or excluding evidence, and their incidental effect on the government’s evidence-gathering did not support § 3731 jurisdiction.

Michael A. Gayed’s May 2015 paper inspired a lumber/gold ratio trading strategy for stocks and bonds. Gayed used the ratio as a risk-on/risk-off indicator: stocks when risk-on, long-term Treasuries when risk-off. The authors modified the rules using WOOD and GLD and backtested in Amibroker. Annual returns since 2008 were 11.4%, with a 35% drawdown due to the 2022/23 bond collapse. Rotating SPY/GLD instead produced 8.7% annual returns. This volume documents U.S. bilateral relations with the Soviet Union from January 1983 to March 1985 as part of the Reagan Foreign Relations subseries. NSDD 75 codified a four-part agenda—arms control, human rights, regional issues, and bilateral relations—implemented by officials including George Shultz, William Clark, Robert McFarlane, and Jack Matlock through meetings with Anatoly Dobrynin and Andrei Gromyko. No high-level Reagan meeting with Andropov or Chernenko occurred. Editorial notes and annotations supplement the printed documents. The Advisory Committee monitors the series and advises on compilation, preparation, and declassification. Declassification review, begun in 2015 and completed in 2019, withheld 1 document in full, excised a paragraph or more in 13, and made minor excisions in 20. The Office of the Historian states the volume provides a thorough, accurate, reliable record.

This disclosure relates to AR/VR systems for localizing position and orientation of objects. It describes head-mounted AR display devices with sensors, processors, and storage that monitor sensor information, trigger access to virtual content, and present AR content in an ambient environment. It also describes stacked waveguides with depth-associated focus, cameras for QR code detection and decoding, network requests for virtual content, and methods for sharing content via activation gateways, acceptance, and transmission of content or sharing credentials. The passage further details electromagnetic tracking using emitters, sensors/coils, and IMUs; SLAM/PTAM; sensor fusion; and various calibration, noise-cancelling, multiplexing, and tuning configurations, along with numerous AR applications and system components.

The passage describes NVIDIA Turing GPU architecture and its technologies. RT Cores in each SM accelerate BVH traversal and ray/triangle intersection, offloading the SM for other shading work, and work with denoising, BVH, and RTX APIs for real-time ray tracing. NGX uses Tensor Cores for AI functions including DLSS, InPainting, AI Slow-Mo, and AI Super Rez. Turing also introduces Mesh Shading, Variable Rate Shading, Texture Space Shading, Multi-View Rendering, and updated resource management and VR support. It details TU104, TU106, and Tesla T4 configurations, the RTX-OPS workload-based metric, Hybrid Rendering, and ray tracing fundamentals including BVH, denoising, and ray-traced shadows, ambient occlusion, and reflections.

The passage describes SOS Disruptive Pressure defensive schemes. In baseline disruptions, the on-ball defender pushes a wing ball handler to the corner or baseline checkpoint while the other defenders use SOS off-ball techniques to deny middle penetration, weakside reversals, and limit space. Baseline penetration can lead to Straight SOS defense, an automatic Base Go I trap with the low Helpside I defender, or an early Base Go Red sideline trap. The passage details phases for these traps, pass-out rotations, and final matchups. It also covers Side Screen/Roll disruptions: above the free throw line, an aggressive contact switch; below it, an aggressive trap near base or corner checkpoints when a post sets a side screen and O3 is below the free throw line extended, with X5 trapping O3 with X3 before the screen. All Out SOS Disruption traps the point guard before any screen or pass, forces freelance play, and includes double-team, pass-out, and secondary post-trap rotations. Rotations occur as the ball leaves the passer’s hands, and basic SOS fundamentals apply once matched up.

This work introduces local Boltzmann Generators for equilibrium sampling of large crystalline materials. It uses a locality assumption based on local environments rather than full configurations, implemented with graph neural networks and augmented coupling flows. This enables energy-based training without target samples, efficient inference, transferability across system sizes, and conditioning on external parameters such as thermodynamic states or atomic interaction potentials. The method is applied to Lennard-Jones crystalline phases and various Stillinger-Weber parameterizations, including monatomic water, germanium, and silicon, yielding accurate equilibrium ensembles and Gibbs and Helmholtz free energies for systems above 1000 atoms. The local architecture achieves faster training and higher effective sample sizes than global architectures, supports free energy estimation, volume fluctuations, and phase diagrams, and reduces computational cost. Future directions include sampling liquid phases and broader chemical-space generalization.

The speaker participates in American University’s ceremony and commends its graduates, then discusses world peace. He seeks genuine peace, not a Pax Americana, the peace of the grave, or slave security, and says total war makes no sense in the nuclear age. He calls weapons spending essential to keeping peace but says idle stockpiles are not the only or most efficient means. He urges reexamining attitudes toward peace, the Soviet Union, the Cold War, and freedom at home. Peace should be practical, attainable, and a process built by many nations through concrete agreements, mutual tolerance, and peaceful settlement. Toward the Soviet Union, he warns against distorted views and notes common interests and abhorrence of war. On the Cold War, he advocates perseverance, restraint, nonprovocative weapons, a strengthened United Nations, alliances, communication, arms control, and disarmament. He announces high-level Moscow discussions for a comprehensive test ban treaty and says the United States will not resume atmospheric nuclear tests if others do not. He links world peace to freedom and human rights at home and calls for a strategy of peace.

The disclosure relates to time-aware networks, time-sensitive applications, edge computing, data processing, network communication, and communication system implementations, including low latency and scalable gate control, configuring multiple time-sensitive applications to share the same physical network link, and time-aware energy efficient network communication. It describes TSN and PTP/gPTP synchronization, PTP instances, GM selection, timescales, PTP messages, transmission selection, scheduled traffic, gates, GCLs, and gate operations. It discusses TSN NIC architectures and drawbacks of on-NIC GCL memory, including silicon area, power, and programming complexity. A GCL in host memory with GCL registers and a prefetch buffer is described, using a dedicated channel to prefetch entries and payloads. Complex end station configurations are described in which multiple talkers are presented as virtual end stations connected to a virtual bridge/switch for configuration. A GCE controls gates according to GCLs, and GCLs can be computed for network ports to satisfy latency requirements.

TQQQ is an exchange-traded fund tracking the Nasdaq-100. Option trading in TQQQ can potentially increase profits and reduce risk, and it differs from stock trading because it involves call and put options. TQQQ options are available in European and American styles with various expiration dates and strike prices. Common strategies include buying calls, buying puts, writing covered calls, and writing puts; the best strategy depends on goals, risk tolerance, and trading style. Options are leveraged and carry high risk, so risk management, liquidity, stop-loss orders, and backtesting are emphasized. Minimum capital and trading costs depend on the broker, and slippage may occur. Profits are generally subject to capital gains tax, with individual circumstances and jurisdiction mattering, and consulting a tax specialist is recommended. Fair value can be estimated using Black-Scholes and other analysis. Regulations exist to protect investors, and option trading is speculative and not suitable for everyone.

The speaker addresses national leaders and Americans on what is described as America’s and democracy’s day, marking a peaceful transfer of power after violence at the Capitol. University at Albany chemists synthesized manganese diboride, a boron-rich compound that is more energetic by weight and volume than current solid-rocket materials and remains stable until intentionally ignited. It is over 20% more energetic by weight and about 150% more energetic by volume than aluminum used in solid rocket boosters. Made using an arc melter at 3,000°C, its strained, deformed atomic structure stores energy. Potential uses include rocket fuel, catalytic converters, and breaking down plastics.

Barry “The Hatchet” Vagnoni, a Reading, Pa., Eagles fan since 1954, hosts game-day gatherings in a 2,000-square-foot man cave with a 35-foot bar, 16 televisions, team memorabilia, and locker-room rules requiring Eagles gear and family-friendly behavior. Gap trading strategies are discussed, defining a gap as untraded price levels between the close and the next open, often caused by news or imbalances, with overnight gaps most frequent. Gaps include common, exhaustion, runaway, and breakaway types. Gap trading used to be more profitable but has diminished as computer power and trader numbers increased. Backtests on S&P 500 gaps show fill rates vary by gap size, with smaller gaps more likely to fill, and simple gap strategies are hard to make profitable, though some overnight or swing strategies show modest results.

A review of 10 trials with 77,917 high-risk participants found omega-3 fatty acid supplements may not reduce heart problems. Participants had prior heart attack, stroke, or conditions like diabetes and were randomly assigned to omega-3 supplements or placebo for at least one year, followed for an average of 4.4 years. Risks of death from heart disease, nonfatal heart attack, stroke, and artery-reopening procedures were the same with or without supplements. The senior author said the results showed no beneficial effect and did not support American Heart Association guidelines for such patients. Limitations included varied trial designs and missing smoking or cancer data. Other experts said supplements are inexpensive and safe, patients should not stop taking them, and fatty fish or supplements may be part of a balanced diet.

In 2017, Boscov’s in Wilkes-Barre had record-breaking sales and its biggest volume ever, even as other department stores closed. Customers cited personal service and a hometown atmosphere; officials said it supports downtown. Boscov’s plans a 47th store in Connecticut.

The passage states that school is at a crossroads and needs comprehensive pedagogical and didactic renewal. It begins from the premises that school is for life and that society is changing faster and more drastically, so education must change critically and with a time lag. It discusses Millennials, Generation Z, Generation Alpha, and the Net/Web generation, noting that school changes due to new technological possibilities and different learners. The Web generation involves two worlds, physical and cyber; biological and artificial intelligence, including hybrid forms; Internet 1.0 to 4.0; and shifts from face-to-face and formal education to blended and non-formal approaches. It says this necessitates a shift from digital pedagogy to generative pedagogy, where teachers interact with generative AI as a colleague or partner rather than merely a tool. It reviews technological-social waves and AI/LLMs, describing pedagogical reactions from denial to acceptance. A new generative pedagogy must address questions about the teacher’s role, the value of knowledge and assessment, and a transition in which teachers move toward affective education, relationships, and values.

Bayard received an unmodified audit grade from Fierro & Fierro despite two minimal findings: a $700 deficit in a new federal Community Development Block Grant fund and $64 in mileage reporting errors. Registration is open for Horses4Heroes’ Saturdays at the Ranch Day Camps, Spring Break Camp, and 10 weeks of Summer Camp. Horses4Heroes, a Las Vegas-based non-profit, operates the Horses4Heroes Equestrian Center in historic Floyd Lamb at Tule Springs, offering horseback riding lessons, camps, birthday parties, field trips, and free workshops for veterans with PTSD, victims of domestic abuse and violence, recovering addicts, at-risk youth, teens, and others. Single-cell RNA sequencing enables gene expression measurement at individual-cell resolution, but interpretation relies on slow, subjective annotation and does not scale. Existing computational methods and foundation models require classification heads and predefined categories, limiting generalization. The paper introduces Cell2Text, a multimodal generative framework that aligns gene-level embeddings from a pretrained Geneformer encoder with instruction-tuned language models via an adapter to produce natural-language descriptions of cell type, disease, tissue, developmental stage, and pathways. It constructs a 1M-cell dataset from CELLxGENE with ontology, tissue, disease, and pathway annotations. The model freezes Geneformer and trains the adapter with full fine-tuning on Meta-Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Gemma3-4B-it or LoRA on Llama. Evaluation includes text-generation metrics, classification of cell type, tissue, disease, and pathways, and PageRank-based Cell Ontology similarity. Cell2Text achieves high lexical and semantic scores, outperforms Geneformer+Head and LGBM baselines on cell type, tissue, and disease classification, and shows competitive pathway performance. Fully tuned models achieve high PageRank similarity. The paper concludes that Cell2Text generates interpretable, biologically meaningful descriptions and provides a general strategy for scalable, interpretable computational biology frameworks.

This preprint reports a randomized double-blind placebo-controlled between-subject study in 171 healthy Chinese participants examining whether intranasal oxytocin selectively enhances responses to CT-fiber-targeted gentle stroking touch versus non-CT-fiber medium pressure massage, and whether effects are mediated peripherally by comparing intranasal and oral oxytocin. Participants received 24 IU intranasal or oral oxytocin or placebo, then received gentle stroking touch (5 cm/s) and medium pressure massage on the calf. Behavioral ratings, plasma OT, fNIRS cortical oxy-Hb, SCR, and ECG were measured. Both intranasal and oral OT increased plasma OT concentrations. OT increased pleasantness ratings only for gentle stroking touch, not medium pressure massage. Both OT routes enhanced mOFC, mlOFC, and pSTS responses only during gentle stroking touch; no treatment effects were found for medium pressure massage. Post-treatment plasma OT changes correlated with and mediated pleasantness effects. The authors conclude that exogenous OT selectively facilitates behavioral and neural responses to CT-fiber social touch via peripheral-mediated routes, with therapeutic implications.

Robots navigating unstructured, partially observed environments use world models for motion planning, but uncertainty from sensor noise, occlusions, state estimation errors, and incomplete observations causes inconsistencies between successive maps. These inconsistencies can make deterministic planners such as KEASL generate abrupt trajectory changes or oscillations around obstacles. The work proposes using multiple temporally sampled environment maps when computing edge costs, treating each map as an evolving hypothesis and using the most recent map as the primary hypothesis in which the final solution cannot collide. It explores four search methods: Valid in Every Hypothesis (VEH), Per-Edge Hypothesis (PEH), Goal-Edge Hypothesis (GEH), and Goal-Edge Graph Revision Hypothesis (GEGRH). Experiments used 221 planning problems from UGV field data with two and three successive maps, using ARA* with a 1-second maximum planning time and comparing SH, VEH, and GEGRH; PEH was impractical and GEH was superseded by GEGRH. Results report GEGRH decreased planning time and path duration compared with VEH for two- and three-hypothesis planning, while both multi-map methods had higher planning times and longer path durations than SH. Case studies show GEGRH outperforming VEH in one case and VEH outperforming GEGRH in another. Future work includes more hypotheses, non-binary map information, different cost functions, and hypothesis-certainty estimates.

For optimal ADS7828 performance, physical layout needs care because its SAR architecture is sensitive to glitches on supply, reference, ground, and digital inputs before comparator latching. Power should be clean and well-bypassed: a 0.1 µF ceramic bypass capacitor close to the device, plus possibly 1 µF to 10 µF if +VDD supply connection impedance is high. The external reference input has no inherent noise or voltage-variation rejection, so supply noise and ripple can appear directly in digital results; line-frequency variation is difficult to remove. GND should connect to a clean ground point, often analog ground, avoiding MCU/DSP ground proximity. Some embodiments provide a packet processing pipeline for reconfigurable hardware switches. The switch includes ingress and egress pipelines, each with a parser, match-action unit (MAU), and deparser. For each packet, the parser separates header data from payload and determines which header fields may be processed by the MAU. It places participating fields in a primary packet header vector (PPHV) and nonparticipating fields in a secondary packet header vector (SPHV). The PPHV is delivered to the MAU, while the SPHV bypasses the MAU and is delivered directly to the deparser with the payload. The deparser reassembles the packet from processed PPHV data, unprocessed SPHV data, and payload. The parser uses configuration data from a control-plane compiler/configurator, packet header values, and a parse graph to determine field placement and extraction. Separating PPHV and SPHV improves switch efficiency, avoids wasting MAU resources on unused fields, and allows deeper packet parsing while sending the same amount of data to the MAU. The compiler generates parser and MAU configuration data from received code and flow graphs.

В ритейле RFID обеспечивает инвентаризацию с точностью ~98%, снижение отсутствия товаров до 80%, борьбу с потерями, умные примерочные, автоматизацию логистики через RFID-ворота. BSC показывает ROI 20–30% за два года, сокращение краж до 75%, операционных затрат на логистику и инвентаризацию на 30%, рост продаж 5–10%, сокращение кассового времени на 50%, точность click-and-collect до 98%, улучшение NPS/CSI на 20%. Архитектура сбора данных основана на ETL, SSIS, промежуточной БД, хранилище, кубе и визуализации. Логическая модель включает FactSales, измерения и FactCustBehavior; POS и RFID интегрируются по ID клиента для анализа customer journey. Вывод: RFID трансформирует ритейл в data-driven область, а дальнейшее развитие связано с IoT и ИИ.

The passage provides PCB layout guidance for the UC1825B-SP. Feedback traces should be routed away from the inductor and noisy power traces, as directly and thickly as possible, preferably opposite the inductor with a separating ground plane. Input/output capacitors, feed-forward capacitors if used, and compensation components should be close to the IC, with surface-mount components recommended; compensation should also be away from the inductor. Power traces should be short, direct, and thick, at minimum 15 mils per ampere, and the inductor, output capacitors, and output diode should be close together. Grounds should connect directly to a ground plane, with ground planes on both PCB sides and, on multilayer boards, separation of power and signal planes. Vias should be used per current, and power components arranged so switching current loops curl in the same direction. A ground plane is required; power ground for high di/dt should be designated and connected at a single point if separated; VCC and VREF should be bypassed with high-frequency capacitors; and nothing else should connect to power ground. The passage also includes documentation-update, support, trademark, ESD, packaging/orderable, and disclaimer information.

This study investigated the association between first-phase left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF-1) and the degree of coronary artery stenosis and changes in LVEF-1 before and after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). Patients with chest pain undergoing coronary angiography between June 2021 and June 2023 were consecutively enrolled and classified by maximal coronary stenosis as mild (<50%), moderate (50%–<70%), or severe (≥70%); the Gensini score was calculated. Echocardiography recorded LAD, LVDd, LVDs, LVEF, GLS, E/e', and LVEF-1. LVEF-1 was defined as the proportion of left ventricular volume change from aortic valve opening to peak aortic blood flow velocity relative to end-diastolic left ventricular volume, measured by transthoracic echocardiography. Patients undergoing PCI had repeat echocardiography on postoperative day 4.

There were 39 patients with moderate stenosis, 73 with mild stenosis, and 95 with severe stenosis; 82 of the severe group underwent PCI. With increasing stenosis severity, male sex, smoking, hypertension, diabetes, SBP, DBP, glucose, CRP, BNP, LAD, LVDd, LVDs, E/e', and Gensini score increased, while GLS and LVEF-1 decreased; LVEF did not differ significantly among groups. LVEF-1 was negatively correlated with Gensini score and BNP, with nonlinear and linear negative relationships, respectively. LVEF-1 had significant predictive value for coronary stenosis ≥50% and ≥70%, remaining significant in multivariable models. ROC analysis showed the highest AUC for LVEF-1; cutoff values of 27.9% and 26.9% predicted stenosis ≥50% and ≥70%, respectively. After PCI, E/e' decreased and GLS and LVEF-1 increased. Gensini score and stent diameter were independent factors influencing change in LVEF-1. The passage concludes that LVEF-1 is valuable for assessing cardiac dysfunction caused by coronary artery stenosis, that decreased LVEF-1 is associated with CHD severity, and that increased LVEF-1 indicates PCI therapeutic effect, with greater improvement in more severe stenosis.

For those who had not received BNT162b2 before, Beta-variant responses after Dose 2 of BNT162b2SA were as good as original-strain responses after Dose 2 of BNT162b2. Repeated over time, this can lead targets to integrate the idea that they do not grasp reality. The researchers say anyone could fall victim if they trust the wrong person. This work studies transfer learning (TL) to address domain shift (DS) in neuroimaging with small datasets. It uses Simple Fully Connected Neural Networks (SFCNs) with a feature extractor and classifier. Models are pre-trained on UKB T1 MRI scans and fine-tuned on OASIS-3, IXI, and ABIDE for age and sex prediction. Direct transfer of UKB sex models showed high UKB accuracy (99.5%) but lower performance on other datasets (90.2% OASIS, 59.9% ABIDE, 59.1% IXI). Feature visualizations indicated task-specific features and varying feature reusability across datasets. Fine-tuning only the classifier on the same task improved results; the proposed algorithm 1 then fine-tunes the full model. TL generally improved performance over elastic net regression and random initialization, though negative transfer occurred for ABIDE sex prediction. Full TL was beneficial for small datasets in some cases but overfit for very small ABIDE sex training sets, while fine-tuning the final layer was more sensible. TL also accelerated convergence. The discussion compares TL with feature-based, style-transfer, instance-based, and meta-learning approaches, and suggests UKB may serve as a pre-training resource for neuroimaging, while noting challenges such as scanner variability and disease-specific pre-training.

This study addresses citation intent classification in Turkish academic texts, noting that traditional metrics ignore citation context. It introduces the first large-scale, publicly available Turkish citation intent dataset from Computer Science, built from 723 research articles, with 20,026 extracted citation instances and 2,650 labeled examples. The dataset uses a five-category WoS scheme: Background, Basis, Support, Differ, and Discuss, with annotation combining human experts and LLM-assisted In-Context Learning. Experiments benchmark GPT-4o and Gemini models. Manual prompts improved from 61.3%/52.6% to 83.9%/85.0% accuracy, while DSPy automated prompt optimization achieved 86.5%. Few-shot results varied: zero-shot accuracy was 88.4% for Gemini-2.5-Flash and GPT-4o, with Gemini peaking at 89.1% at 1-shot. Ensemble methods achieved 90.2% for majority voting, 91.0% for logistic regression, and 91.3% for an XGBoost stacked meta-model. Challenges included class imbalance dominated by Background, difficulty distinguishing Support and Differ, and inconsistent LLM classifications. The conclusion states the dataset and stacked ensemble provide a foundation for Turkish scholarly NLP, with future directions including hierarchical classifiers, data augmentation, and broader contextual features.

This work introduces edit distances between constructible R^d-persistence modules. It defines categories JS_d and (1D)^d of finite posets and grids, and categories PMod(E) of constructible persistence modules, with E-paths and edit distance as the infimum of sums of distortions. The main result proves that for E in {JS_d, (1D)^d}, the interleaving distance equals the edit distance on constructible R^d-persistence modules. The proof establishes d_I ≤ d_Ed^{JS_d} ≤ d_Ed^{(1D)^d} ≤ d_I using Galois connections, presentations, and an easy-edit lemma. Consequences include characterizations of interleaving-stable invariants via edit-stable invariants and vice versa, an order-theoretic viewpoint on interleaving, comparison with earlier Galois-insertion work, and appendices comparing constructibility notions and showing finitely presented modules are constructible.

The TPS7H500x-SP family is described as radiation-hardness-assured, fixed-frequency peak current mode PWM controllers for space-grade DC-DC converters. The CS_ILIM pin is driven by a primary-side current signal; OUTA/OUTB are turned on by the internal clock and off when sensed peak current reaches the COMP/2 voltage, with a 150-mV offset. CS_ILIM also configures current limit, and a resistor from CS_ILIM to AVSS detects current for PWM and overcurrent protection. The nominal current-limit threshold is 1.05 V. When CS_ILIM exceeds 1.05 V, the device performs cycle-by-cycle limiting and charges CHICC via 80 µA until CHICC reaches 0.6 V; switching then stops, HICC is pulled to 1 V, and a 1-µA current discharges CHICC until it falls to 0.3 V, after which soft-start is reinitiated. CHICC controls delay and hiccup times, with a recommended minimum of 3.3 nF. The FAULT pin allows external protections; exceeding 0.6 V typical for 0.4–1.4 µs causes shutdown, and recovery includes about 15 switching cycles plus internal logic delay after FAULT falls below 0.5 V typical. Slope compensation, set by a resistor from RSC to AVSS, mitigates subharmonic oscillation above 50% duty cycle; recommended compensation is 1 × m. Thermal shutdown stops switching above 175°C typical and reinitiates power-up below 160°C typical.

The applications section presents a 500-kHz synchronous push-pull converter design using GaN devices and the TPS7H5001-SP. Selected values include RT = 205 kΩ, RTOP = 10 kΩ, RBOT = 1.4 kΩ, dead-time resistors of 20.5 kΩ, RLEB = 49.9 kΩ, soft-start capacitor = 33 nF, transformer turns ratio = 2.5, primary inductance = 40 µH, 170-V primary FETs, 80-V synchronous rectifier FETs, output inductor = 0.47 µH, output capacitance = 2.3 mF, current-sense transformer = 1:100, RCS = 7.5 Ω, hiccup capacitor = 3.3 nF, RCOMP = 40.2 kΩ, CCOMP = 15 nF, CHF = 47 pF, and RSC = 102 kΩ. The controller operates from 4 V to 14 V and requires at least a 0.1-µF VIN bypass capacitor. Layout guidance covers noise-sensitive routing, grounding, bypass placement, and CFP backside metallization. The article advocates a sociocultural, ecological perspective on foreign language education policy and practice in state education systems, focusing mainly on selected Asian countries. It examines divergence between policy intentions and outcomes where English is the first compulsory foreign language, and explores inequality of achievement. Using examples from Malaysia and Thailand, it discusses mandated curricula, CEFR-based proficiency targets, communicative language teaching, national language identities, urban-rural and socioeconomic disparities, and teachers’ proficiency and classroom conditions. It argues that policies often fail to account for sociolinguistic, sociocultural, and socioeconomic realities and can blame teachers for outcomes shaped by context. The article concludes that effective English programs require aligning curriculum outcomes with system capacity and the prevailing realities of local contexts.

Plasmodium vivax and P. ovale can remain dormant in liver cells as hypnozoites and reactivate to cause relapsing bloodstream infections. Radical cure uses 8-aminoquinolines, which cause haemolytic toxicity in G6PD deficiency, and relapse biology remains poorly understood. The study derives analytical likelihoods for the exponential clock model, in which each hypnozoite activates independently at a constant rate, and fits it to longitudinal data from the SPf66 trial, a 21-month daily follow-up of 1344 children on the Thailand-Myanmar border. The model captures multiple recurrent symptomatic vivax episodes across childhood age groups and estimates hypnozoite activation rate, carriage duration, sporozoite inoculum size, and the relapse-to-primary ratio. Higher than expected vivax rates after falciparum monoinfections treated with artesunate monotherapy are compatible with external triggering. Mefloquine treatment provides sufficient drug exposure for one month to eliminate emerging relapses, a post-treatment prophylactic effect that may have masked triggering; chloroquine does not. The model is used to quantify overdispersion in relapse risk and characterise the potential utility of a serological test to guide radical cure.

Natural bacteria from grape plants may help reduce smoke taint by breaking down guaiacol, a volatile phenol linked to ashy aftertaste in wildfire-exposed wine. The Education Department held its first round of negotiated rule-making talks on the One Big Beautiful Bill Act’s student loan changes despite the government shutdown. In UK Biobank, 451,355 participants were stratified by ethnicity-specific BMI category and DM status. DM prevalence was 4.9%; among participants with DM, 10.1% were normal weight, 34.4% overweight, and 55.3% obese. Cardiovascular biomarkers and outcomes were examined. In the non-DM group, overweight/obesity was associated with higher CIMT, arterial stiffness, and CCI, and lower LVEF; these relationships were diminished in the DM group. Within BMI classes, DM was associated with adverse cardiovascular phenotype, particularly in normal weight. After 5,323,190 person-years, incident myocardial infarction, ischaemic stroke, and cardiovascular mortality rose across increasing BMI in both groups. Normal weight DM had higher cardiovascular mortality than obese non-DM (IRR 2.81 vs 1.84). The authors conclude that obesity and DM are additively associated with adverse cardiovascular biomarkers and mortality risk; adiposity metrics correlate more strongly with cardiovascular biomarkers than diabetes-oriented metrics, but both correlate weakly, suggesting other factors underpin the high cardiovascular risk of normal-weight diabetes.

The defendant was charged in a 13-count indictment with offenses arising from six alleged extortionate incidents at three Chinese restaurants over two months. This study examined cross-sectional and longitudinal associations between arterial stiffness and renal function in general adults from China. In the cross-sectional study of 67,060 participants, eGFR was negatively associated with baPWV. In longitudinal analyses, higher baPWV was associated with increased risk of incident CKD, and lower eGFR was associated with higher arterial stiffness risk, indicating a bidirectional connection. Cross-lagged analysis showed that the path from baseline eGFR to follow-up baPWV was greater than the path from baseline baPWV to follow-up eGFR, suggesting kidney function decline preceded the change in arterial stiffness. The authors conclude that arterial stiffness is associated with CKD, and a decrease in eGFR appeared to precede an increase in baPWV. Limitations noted include use of serum creatinine rather than the 51Cr-EDTA technique and a population mainly from central China.

This case study reports one participant with unilateral transtibial amputation who received spinal cord stimulation (SCS) to restore somatosensory feedback in the missing limb. SCS leads were implanted percutaneously near T12–L2, and stimulation was delivered during the prosthetic limb’s stance phase, triggered by plantar pressure. EMG and motion capture measured walking with and without SCS and at early and later time points.

Results showed that with and without SCS at the later time point, muscle activation profiles were similar (cross-correlations >90%), with small timing shifts (<6% gait cycle) in some residual and intact muscles. Step cycle duration with and without SCS was equivalent within ±10%. The residual TFL and VL were more active at the later versus early time point without SCS; residual TFL was 93.6% more active at the later time point with SCS versus early without SCS. Co-contraction area of residual VL and BF decreased from 1.57 ± 0.52 early without SCS to 1.05 ± 0.35 later without SCS and 0.95 ± 0.33 later with SCS. Pelvic obliquity range-of-motion increased at the later time point with SCS versus early without SCS. Residual pelvic drop increased from 3.62º ± 1.04º early to 4.76º ± 1.53º later without SCS and 4.46º ± 1.04º later with SCS; residual pelvic drop was smaller than intact overall. The passage states these changes suggest possible rehabilitative effects of SCS, but additional participants are needed. The study concludes SCS restored sensation and led to reduced knee antagonist co-contractions and increased TFL activation, corresponding to increased pelvic obliquity range-of-motion and pelvic drop.

SCIseg is a deep-learning method introduced to automatically segment the spinal cord and T2-weighted hyperintense lesions in volumetric spinal cord injury images. It was trained and evaluated on 191 SCI patients with 231 MRI scans from three sites, using heterogeneous image resolutions, orientations, scanner manufacturers, treatment strategies, and traumatic/ischemic etiologies. The model was trained in three phases, including active learning, and was reported as the first open-source method for 3D segmentation of both the spinal cord and lesions; it also generalized to degenerative cervical myelopathy. SCIseg-derived lesion biomarkers—total lesion volume, intramedullary lesion length, and maximal axial damage ratio—were correlated with clinical scores, and no statistically significant difference was found between manual and automatically predicted lesion masks. Limitations included use of a single T2-weighted contrast and treating lesions as single, independent entities.

The disclosure describes allocating wireless resources to a multiple BSSID set including a transmitted BSSID (Tx BSSID) and non-transmitted BSSIDs (non-Tx BSSIDs).
